Everybody looks forward to it, because, you know, a lot of the people here don't get trophies, very often. Like Meredith or Kevin, I mean, who's gonna give Kevin an award? Dunkin' Donuts? Plus, bonus, it's really, really funny. So I, you know, an employee will go home, and he'll tell his neighbor, "Hey, did you get an award?" And the neighbor will say, "No man. I mean, I slave all day and nobody notices me." Next thing you know, employee smells something terrible coming from neighbor's house. Neighbor's hanged himself due to lack of recognition. So…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [clearing his throat and interrupting Jim's talking head] Can I speak to you a minute?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Um… yes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael, I really didn't mean to…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Help. Me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm sorry?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I want you to role play firing me. I want you to fire me, and I will take it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, you want me to be you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I want you to be me, and I will be Creed.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, are you firing Creed?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no. That's just the first thing… came… in head.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We should switch seats in order to…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, that's a good idea.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright. [they stand up] Excuse me.[They sit down] I'm really sorry, but I have to let you go. And it's purely budgetary. It's not personal…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Aaaahh! I'm gonna kill myself!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm going to kill myself, and it's your fault!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's an overreaction.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Corporate is really breathing down my neck. And they're saying this has to be done by the end of the month.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Is this you? Are you being you, or is this Creed? Are you…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I… this is Creed.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm improvising, so just try to keep up. [phone rings]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, hold that thought. Hold that thought.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And I'm very angry, and I want…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [picks up the phone] Michael Scott here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm gonna kill you. I'm going to kill you for firing me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Toby? Mm hmm. [looks back to Michael] I really have to take this Creed, so it was really worth…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Get off, get off. No, no. OK… just get off.[sits back down in his chair and waves Jim off.] Just, just… yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What happened?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It wasn't me.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh. That was like crazy. 'Cause I was…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, I know.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uh, hey… Creed?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Huh?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Could I talk to you for a second?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You are great. Very ambitious. And I feel like you want more than this little office has to offer. And I understand that you'd wanna just spread your wings, and fly the coop.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: What are you telling me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I… we're gonna have to… You… you want something better.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: No, I don't. I wanna stay right here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, you wanna leave.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: No, I wanna stay here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why… why are you making this so hard?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Um, I think there's a misunderstanding, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think you're right.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Can I go?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, of course you can't go. We haven't even started this horrible process of… okay, Creed. I need to let somebody go today. They told me I need to let somebody go. And as much as I think you're a great guy, and I like you, you're… you're, goodbye.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Let's fight it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmm?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Let's call Jan and fight this thing together like the old days.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What old days? What are you talking about?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Did you start the paperwork yet?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's right here on the desk, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: You don't have to do this, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I can't, I can't…

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Undo it!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I can't change anything. This is the way…

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: No, you have the power to undo it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't… okay, just listen.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Michael, undo it!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, I went hunting once. Shot the deer in the leg, had to kill it with a shovel. Took about an hour. Why do you ask?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have to fire someone today, okay?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Fine. Fire someone else. Fire Devon. He's terrible. I am so much better at my job than Devon.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, well… I already picked you. And you know that. So, unless I just go through with this, you're always gonna look at me as the guy who almost fired you.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: No, no, no, no, no, no. I will forget so fast. You will be my savior. You're they guy who gave me my life back. Thank you. I knew you'd see it my way Michael. God Bless you. You're a fine man.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't…

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Listen, you will not regret this either. Devon is terrible; No one's gonna miss him. Good, good, good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Devon, could I talk to you for a sec?

scenes.speaker: Devon
scenes.line: Creed's an idiot, you know that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, he…

scenes.speaker: Devon
scenes.line: No, no, no, no, no, no! You had it right the first time.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, maybe I did.

scenes.speaker: Devon
scenes.line: Exactly. You gotta go with your gut, man.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Huh. No! I can't, no. I can't go back. I would look like an idiot.

scenes.speaker: Devon
scenes.line: That's why I'm being fired?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Devon
scenes.line: So you might not look like an idiot?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. It was all the stuff that I said. It was the business downturn, the cutbacks, and, and…

scenes.speaker: Devon
scenes.line: This is unbelievable!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I just hope that you and I can remain friends.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Devon, wait, please.

scenes.speaker: Devon
scenes.line: What!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Look, look. In addition to severance, and everything, I want to give you this gift certificate to Chili's. From me. Okay? No hard feelings.

scenes.speaker: Devon
scenes.line: [takes the gift certificate and tears it up] Kevin, Jim, Pam, Kelly, Toby, Oscar, Meredith, Phyllis, Stanley, or the temp. If any of you wanna meet me for a drink, I'm going to be at Poor Richard's. And the rest of you can go to hell!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [watching nearly everyone leave] What about the Halloween party?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, hey, Jim. Wait, stop. Um, I'm sorry… for pushing you towards Cumberland. Seriously, if you left here, I would blow my brains out.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [motions for her to follow him] Come on.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's just a figure of speech, you know? Blow your brains out? Come on. All it really means is that we're friends. Who else is she gonna talk to if I'm gone, right? I mean, if she left, I wouldn't blow my brains out. Of course, I would take that job in Maryland. Because it's double the pay, and soft shell crab just happens to be my favorite food.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I love Halloween. You know, it's just, it's just fun. Every year, it's just fun. Last Halloween I came as Janet Jackson's boob. It was topical. People got a… a big kick out of it. The year before that, I came as Monica Lewinsky, and I wore a stained dress. The year before that, I also came as Monica Lewinsky. And before that, I was O.J. It was pretty funny. Oh, I wish you were here last year.

scenes.speaker: Children
scenes.line: [ringing the doorbell of Michael's Condo] Trick or treat!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: He… Hey, hey, hey, hey! How you doing? Wow! You guys looks great.

scenes.speaker: Kid
scenes.line: I'm a bumble bee.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You look great! And you're a princess?

scenes.speaker: Kid
scenes.line: A fairy princess.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: A fairy princess. You're very… .

scenes.speaker: Kid
scenes.line: I'm a lion.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're a lion. [trying to to open a bag of candy] Wow, I want to hear your, your… Oh! [the bag tears open, spilling all the candy] Oh, okay, that's all yours. That's all yours. Grab it, grab it. You know what? You guys are getting all of these.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Where is my desk?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That is weird.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: This is not funny. This is totally unprofessional.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok, well, you're the one who lost the desk.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I didn't lose my desk.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, calm down. Where was the last place you saw it?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, who moved my desk?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think you should retrace your steps.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ok, I am going to tell Michael and this entire office will be punished!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Colder… warmer… little warmer… there you go, ooh, warmer… warmer… warmer… warmer… warmer … cold, cold, cold, back up… ooh, ooh, warmer, hot, red hot, hot, very hot.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [In bathroom, answers phone] Dwight Schrute.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [On the phone with Dwight] Hi, Dwight, um, what sort of discounts are we giving on the 20 lb white model.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jim, I've given you this information, like, twenty times.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I know.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's by the ream?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, yeah, ream.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: …now, $9.78, signs and discounts 7%.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok, thank you, gotta get back to work.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wash your hands, Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [On the phone] Right, oh let me just check the pricing list. Hold on one second…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Also on the phone] Sensei, hello it's Sempai…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Umm…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Dwight…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know what, let me give you a call right back. I'm going to uh, find it and then I'll call you back, thanks.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes, I just had a ques-… Yes Sensei. Arigatou gozaimashita. Hai.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Was that your mom?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, that was my Sensei.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, I thought it was your mom.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I am now Sempai, which is Assistant Sensei.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Assistant to the Sensei, that's pretty cool.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Assistant Sensei.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I am a practitioner of Goju Ru Karate, here in Scranton. My Sensei, Ira, recently promoted me to purple belt, and gave me the duties of a Sempai. Not that a lot of people here in America know what a Sempai is, but it is equally as respected as a Sensei.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I don't want to stay until seven again this year.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't really have any control over that Stanley.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael tends to procrastinate a bit whenever he has to do work. Umm, time cards, he has to sign these every Friday. Purchase orders have to be approved at the end of every month. And expense reports, all he has to do is initial these at the end of every quarter. But once a year, it all falls on the same Friday and that's today. I call it the Perfect Storm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [singing and tapping on his coffee mug] I don't want to work, I just want to bang on this mug all day.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Did you ask me here for any specific reason?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uhh, yes, I did, here's the dizzle. I have a very top secret mission for you. I want you to update all the emergency contact information.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Why is that secret? [Pam knocks and walks into Michael's office]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to Pam] Hello, oh God, busy work. Ahh, get away, cretin.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Umm, I put stickers so you know where to sign.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, thank you. I know where to sign.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's just last year you…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Last year they were out of order, weren't they Pam?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, the last pick-up for overnight deliveries is at seven. So you need to have them signed by then. Or much earlier.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Chillax, Pam. Stop Pam-M-S-ing. That's pretty good. Um, actually, I'm sending Ryan on a top secret mission. Tell her what it is.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Updating emergency contacts.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, is that really a priority?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Is it a priority? Oh I don't know, um, what if there is a tornado, Pam? People's legs are crushed under rubble. "Please, would you be so kind as to call my wife? No, I can't because we don't have any emergency contact information because Pam said it wasn't a priority." Think. Think with your head, Pam. Ok, well. She walks out. That's the problem with being a boss is that when you are tough they resent you and when you are cool they walk all over you.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Catch-22.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Catch-22. Yes. Why don't you give me your contact information to start with, ok, what's your cell?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, Larissa Halpert.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: What's her address? [Ryan's cell phone rings]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: 117 Mount Bergin St.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hello?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in his office on his cell phone, talking in a fake high voice] Hey Ryan. This is Michael Jackson calling from Wonderland.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Do you mean Neverland?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is Tito.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Calling from… [Ryan hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [Reading Jim's palm] You're major and minor lines cross at a ridge – that sucks.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You making this up as you go along, aren't you?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I am just following the website.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, at least I don't have cavities.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes, you have very nice teeth.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Who is your emergency contact? [Ryan's phone rings]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Stacy.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [looks to see who is calling but doesn't pick up]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Taps on the glass in his office to get Ryan's attention] Pick up.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hello?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in a high pitched voice] This is Mike Tyson.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Dwight. As Sempai, do you think there is ever going to be a day where humans and robots can peacefully co-exist?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Impossible. The way they're programmed… You're mocking me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No I'm not.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Look, I'm going to offer you a little piece of advice. I'm not afraid to make an example out of you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, that's not advice. What advice sounds like is this:

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And this is more a ying-yang thing. The 'Michael' all cursive, the 'Scott' all caps. Left brain, right brain. Or, duality of man.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Could you practice on the forms?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No women or children, unless provoked.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok, Roy?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Warehouse guy. Doesn't count.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok. Michael? Could you beat up Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, yeah, I don't think that would happen.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Because we're friends.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because I would kick his ass.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, Dwight's a purple belt, so…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So? I've beaten up black belts.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, how did you know they were black belts?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: They told me. After. You see, I used to run with a very tough crowd. Street Fighter types. Real, real bad people, I'm just lucky I got out.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Is your wife still your contact?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Um, ex-wife. Yeah. Um, her last name is 'Becker' now.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: 'Kay.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You don't need to write 'ex'.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And after that, nobody ever messed with the 'Damn Rascals' ever again.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sounds tough. When you're a Jet, [starts snapping] you're a Jet all the way, right?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You were a Jet?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Have you signed the expense reports yet?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, in theory, I have. I just need to cross some t's and dot some i's. Alright, I'm going to be in my office if anybody needs me. [Puts Dwight in a headlock] Hoo-hah. Oh, wow, sleeper hold. That's my rebuttal. Shhh. Hoo. You are the weakest link.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Argggg!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm friends with everybody in this office. We're all best friends – I love everybody here. But sometimes your best friends start coming into work late, and start having dentist appointments that aren't dentist appointments. And that's when it is nice to let them know that you can beat them up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just hit me. You'll see.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I can't. I just got a manicure.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, queer… [realizes he is on camera] eye. Queer eye. That's a good show. Important show. Go ahead. Do it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Just have Dwight punch you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh yeah, that would be kind of worthless because I know a ton of fourteen year old girls who can kick his ass.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know a ton of fourteen year old girls?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What belt are they?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Look, Dwight is a wuss. When we rented 'Armageddon'…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: … he cried at the end of it. He did.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael, I told you, it was because it was New Year's Eve and it began to snow at exactly midnight.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, Bruce Willis. Are they going to leave him on the asteroid?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ok, I'll punch you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, here we go. Alright, come on.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Kiyah!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Fuuuaaaahhhhh… oohhhhh!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Did I want to harm Michael? The one man I've been hired to protect? No, I did not.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you ok? Are you sure you are alright?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. [Jim opens office door for Michael] Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I come from a long line of fighters. My maternal grandfather was the toughest guy I ever knew. World War II veteran. Killed 20 men then spent the rest of the war in an Allied Prison Camp. My father battled blood pressure and obesity all his life. Different kind of fight.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok, he has to be stopped. Please, please, please, please, just ask Michael.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't know.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok, I'll buy you a bag of chips.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: French Onion?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Obviously.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [to Kevin, who he is teaching to fight] Take this pen and stab me with it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Pam knocks on his door] Go away.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I just have a quick question.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I haven't signed them, ok?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, it's not that. Um, I was just wondEring, since I'm probably going to have to stay late, could you ask Dwight to stay late too so he can walk me to my car?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Come in. Um, Pam, I hate to break this to you but Dwight can't stop you from being mugged. He's just not tough enough.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: He's a purple belt. That's really high.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, I could beat up Dwight. That's ridiculous. I could murder him.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's just out there, you…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, so that's what they are saying?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, alright, where is Dwight?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, Kitchen.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Hi-yah!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Good.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Wow, that's actually pretty cool Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Now watch, let me take you from behind.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Watch out Kelly, he might sucker punch you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I didn't sucker punch you, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, Really?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: In case you remember, I was defending my honor… like a samurai.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really? Well, the offer, Dwight, was for one punch which I absorbed. I had no idea that there would be a second punch. So, catch-22.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ok, fine. Tit for tit. Give it your best shot. Two punches. Go!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Look, if we were in a bar right now, there would be two punches:

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You were so dorky!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Improv Teacher
scenes.line: Freeze!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm in.

scenes.speaker: Improv Teacher
scenes.line: You wanna go over the rules one more time?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no. I'm looking in my wallet for money so you can tell me my fortune.

scenes.speaker: Bill
scenes.line: I promise it's worthit . Ooo, I can see you walking out of here and you're thrilled with your reading.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What are you… [whispers to Bill]

scenes.speaker: Improv Teacher
scenes.line: Michael, what did you tell him?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nothing.

scenes.speaker: Improv Teacher
scenes.line: Then why are his hands up? Bill?

scenes.speaker: Bill
scenes.line: He told me he couldn't show it to me, but he has a gun.

scenes.speaker: Improv Teacher
scenes.line: Ok, let's call it a day. Nice job, Bill.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good, it's good. Good work, everybody.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Angela, burger? Dog? Havin' fun?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I got sap on me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Chicken, hot dog, burger.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I'm a vegetarian.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: There is soda inside.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Guh.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I didn't think the premium laser color copy batch would sell as well as it did.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Yeah, it surprised us all. I'll tell you why. Because when they—

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I'm sorry guys; can we please not talk about paper? There's gotta be something else we can talk about.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I think it's alright. Jesus drank wine. [Pam overhears]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey Phyllis, come here for a second.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Sure.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Have you heard anything about any secret office romances?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: You tell me. Well, you do mean you and Jim right? Oh God. I am so sorry, I thought, you guys hang out all the time and you're talking all the time. I'm sorry!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's ok. It's ok.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [smacks Ryan's hand] Not so fast… Fire Guy.

scenes.speaker: Marybeth
scenes.line: How do I get to Bernie's Tavern from here?

scenes.speaker: Bill
scenes.line: Oh, don't worry. We're all gonna carpool.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So Bernie's, huh? We're all going to Bernie's? [to camera] Go to Bernie's?

scenes.speaker: Bill
scenes.line: Oh sorry, we're not going as a group, it's just a private friend who just happens to know all of us from different ways is throwing a private birthday thing.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Right, right, right. Well guys, I'd love to go to Bernie's with you, but, you know, I have an office party. A big office party I need to go to, so… Can't get out of it.

scenes.speaker: Bill
scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, see you later. Nice job, Bill. Not.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [singing] Here I go again on my own. Going down the only road I've ever known…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh by the way how's your side project going?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, yeah I gave that up.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, it turns out I was, um, just grasping at straws.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Just because two people are hanging out, it doesn't mean that they're together, you know? Like people can just be friends. And I think that it was really unfair to think that there was anything else going on.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [singing] Just turn around now, cause you're not welcome anymore.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Surprise! [laughs] Everybody!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Dwight…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow! Who opened the morgue for this thing? I'm just driving by, thought I'd drop in. [to Jim] There's some wine. I would love a glass, if you're gonna open it. Here ya go Temp, take my jacket! [sees Sadiq (IT guy)] Oh, come on! That guy? He is a good guy, not a terrorist. Karaoke, I love it! I am a karaoke fiend. I call dibs. I got next, I got next up. Come on, let's get this party started, ha! Ok? Where's that wine?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, yeah, this is a duet, so, need somebody else, Pam? You wanna come up and sing this one? Need somebody else. Takers, please. [singing] Baby when I met you there was peace unknown. Kelly? Tried to get you with a fine tooth comb. I was soft inside, there was something goin' on. This part goes to the, uh, girl. You do something to me that I can't explain. Hold me closer and I feel no pain. In every beat of my heart, we got something goin' on. Tender love is blind—

scenes.speaker: Michael & Jim
scenes.line: [singing] It requires a dedication, all this love we feel needs no conversation. Divided, together, uh huh. Making love with each other, uh huh.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We're making love!

scenes.speaker: Michael & Jim
scenes.line: [singing] Islands in the stream, that is what we are, no one in between, how can we be wrong? Sail away with me…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Talk! Just talk!

scenes.speaker: Marybeth
scenes.line: I am-

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Shut up!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Funny story:

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Go. Get the door.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Here we are.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Go. Push!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh god.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Push!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, turn it around.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Really shove it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You'll break it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Shove it through! Break it!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You shove it. Shove it back! Here we go. Don't break the branches, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I got a splinter.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, suck it up. We all have problems. Hey, everybody, look what we have! [laughs] Nice, huh?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I've got it leveraged. Push. Straight up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: On three. Ready? Big, one, two, three.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: One, two, three. [they push the tree up and it breaks through a ceiling tile.]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Merry Christmas!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did it work?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [holds up the piece of tree he just cut off with a paper cutter] Well, sort of. Why did you get it so big?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: A, that's what she said, and B, I wanted it to be impressive. The biggest day of the year deserves the biggest tree of the year.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: But what are we going to do with this hacked off part?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, that is a perfectly good mini-tree, Kevin. And we are going to sell that to charity. That's what Christmas is all about.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So this year, for the first time ever, I got Pam in Secret Santa. And I got her this teapot, which I know she really wants, so she can make tea at her desk. But I'm also going to stuff it with some inside jokes. Like, this is my high school yearbook photo. She saw it at the party, and it really makes her laugh. Not sure why. What else … ooh. This is a hot sauce packet. She put this on a hot dog a couple years ago because she thought it was ketchup. And it was really funny, so I kept the other two. [holds up a miniature pencil] This would take a little too long to explain, so I won't. And this is the card. Because Christmas is the time to tell people how you feel.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Is there anything we're missing? Phyllis, you got the lights?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yes, I got those cute little ones. [Angela looks at her disapprovingly] Do you think I should have gotten the big ones?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: We'll see.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Angela drafted me into the party planning committee. Her memo said that we need to prepare for every possible disaster. Which to me seems excessive.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [comes into the conference room in a Santa hat and beard] Merry Christmas! Ho, ho, ho, [points to Ryan] pimp. I'm kidding. What do we got, what do we got? How many plates are we getting?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Fifty.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Double it. Double everything. Double ice cream. Double napkins. Double it. On me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It was a tough year. I had to fire somebody this year. This party has to really rock. Check it out. Christmas bonus. 3,000 G's. I got this for helping save the company money. So I guess some good came out of firing Devon after all. Maybe I should call him and tell him that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I want people to cut loose. I want people making out in closets. I want people hanging from the ceilings, lamp shades on the heads. I want it to be a Playboy Mansion party. And also, I want you to spread the word that I will have my digital camera. And I'll be taking pictures all along the way. And the best and craziest thing that happens will be on the cover of the newsletter. Incentive.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You do realize that we can't serve liquor at the party.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, I know. Damn it. Stupid corporate wet blankets. Like booze ever killed anybody.

scenes.speaker: Kevin & Oscar
scenes.line: One, two, three. [they lift and start to move a desk]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You guys should use a hand truck.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Do we have one?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [having trouble with a plastic tablecloth as Pam stands idly by] Will you help me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No! No way! It… no.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Come on, Mike, let me borrow the hat for just a couple of hours.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You wanna be Santa?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Have you ever seen Santa?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah, I've seen Santa.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Who cares?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I'm sorry. It just doesn't work.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael, I would like to be the elf.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That makes sense because he has elfish features.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [now wearing an elf hat and ears] Okay, everybody listen up! It is time to get your presents, wrap them, and place them under the tree like so. If you do not get your present wrapped and under the tree within the next five minutes you will be disqualified from Secret Santa. All right? No exceptions except Michael.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I got Angela. She is into these posters of babies dressed as adults. I got her one of those. I felt kind of weird buying that.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I got Creed. And to tell you the truth, I don't know anything about Creed. I know his name's Creed. I know he works right over there. I think he's Irish and I … I got him this shamrock keychain.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I got myself for Secret Santa. I was supposed to tell somebody, but I didn't [smiles happily].

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You get something good this year?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think I did a pretty good job.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah? Who did you have?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I can't tell you cause it's a secret.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think I got something pretty nice for my guy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I spent a lot of dough. Lot of dough. Wow.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, there's a $20 limit, right? So … ?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. I wanted this party to be really special so I sorta went above and beyond.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's great. Well don't tell me who it is, cause I can …

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It was Ryan. Yeah. I have Ryan.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Gather round. Secret Santa, let's go. Let's go. Come on. Stanley, no, I'm going to handle the cord. Okay, safety reasons.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I know how to plug something in.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I want to do it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right, let's count it down, like Rockefeller Center. Ready?

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: Three, two, one. [very dim lights come on the tree]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Not great.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I'm sorry, everybody.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I think the tree looks nice.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey, I could get some flares from my car.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no. Shake it off, everybody. Just, let's do Secret Santa.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Presents are the best way to show someone how much you care. It's like this tangible thing that you can point to and say, "Hey, man, I love you this many dollars worth."

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: First present, Oscar.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [rips off the wrapping] Shower radio. Neat.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Oh, good, that was from me.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Thanks, Kelly. You know I was gonna get one of …

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay. Okay. That's enough. Let's keep it moving on. Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, cool. [opens his plastic bag]

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: That's from me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Great. Where did you get it?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I don't know. It was so long ago.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He obviously forgot to get me something, and then he went in his closet and dug out this little number [holds up way-too-short sleeves] and then threw it in a bag.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Yep. That's exactly what happened.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [opens up her present] Oh, my god! Thank you very much, Santa, whoever you are. It's awesome.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: There's a little more to it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: All right, next. Ryan. [tosses present]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, don't!

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [unwraps present] Whoa, a video iPod.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Whoa. Wow. Jeez. Somebody really got carried away with the spirit of Christmas. That was me, I got a little carried away.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Wasn't there a $20 limit on the gift? This is 400 bucks.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You don't know that.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah, you left the price tag on.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I did?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What? Oh, shoot. Wow. Okay, well, who cares? It doesn't matter what I spent. What matters is that Christmas is fun, right?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh hey, for me. What is in here? [opens a handmade oven mitt] Oh, come on.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I knitted it for you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: An oven mitt? Okay. [walks out]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So Phyllis is basically saying, "Hey Michael, I know you did a lot to help the office this year but I only care about you a homemade oven mitt's worth." I gave Ryan an iPod.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Should we just keep opening up the presents?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We don't do anything until Michael gives us further instructions.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I got it! We are going to turn Secret Santa into Yankee Swap.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What is Yankee Swap?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: One person chooses a gift. The next person can either choose a gift or steal that person's gift. If your gift gets stolen, then you can steal somebody else's gift or choose a new gift.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I thought that was called Nasty Christmas.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, we call it White Elephant.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I call it fun!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Why are we doing this?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because it's better. Because it's more special.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It sounds mean.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Shut it. No, it's not. Okay, just give it a shot.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Michael should have asked the party planning committee first. He's not supposed to just spring things on us out of nowhere. [starts to cry]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, Meredith is up first. Here's the deal. You can either pick a new gift or you can steal somebody else's gift that they've already gotten, like the oven mitt.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I'll take the teapot.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, shouldn't we … I bought that specifically for Pam.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yankee Swap! That's what makes it fun. Pam, you can steal the oven mitt now.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'll take the iPod.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: And I have to give it to her? I don't have a choice?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes, now you can steal the oven mitt, the old shirt or the shower radio or pick a new gift.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [after Ryan opens a new gift – a nameplate saying 'Kelly'] That was meant for Kelly.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah, I figured.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think this is going great.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [unwrapping the poster] Yikes.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, it's for Angela, so …

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: That's like, the creepiest thing that I've ever seen.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Angela, you're up.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I'll take the poster. Some people like these.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I will steal the iPod.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Everyone wants the iPod. It's a huge hit. It is almost a Christmas miracle.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, well, Oscar, you little gourmand, you have the next turn.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I'll take the … teapot.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Damn it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, moving along. Meredith, let's go.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I really want the iPod.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's already been stolen this round. Pick something else.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [holding oven mitt] I hope nobody takes this baby, cause this is great. Wow, look at that fine craftsmanship. Somebody really put a lot of work into that. It's beautiful.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I'll take the oven mitt.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sucker! See, I wanted somebody to take it. Boom! Reverse psychology.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Reverse psychology is an awesome tool. I don't know if you guys know about it, but basically you make someone think the opposite of what you believe and that tricks them into doing something stupid. Works like a charm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [opens present] "In addition to these paintball pellets, your gift includes two paintball lessons with Dwight Schrute."

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You and me, Michael. Yes!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Who wants to take paintball lessons? How is that better than an iPod?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I never said it was better than an iPod.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael keeps bragging about his iPod, but you know what? Two paintball lessons with someone as experienced as I am is worth easily, like, 2 grand.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [shooting paintball gun at target] Take that, Saddam!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Last gift. Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I want the foot bath.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: That's the thing I bought myself. I'm really psyched to use it. [pauses] Maybe I should have taken the iPod. Oh, shoot.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Pam, steal something or pick the final gift.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I want the iPod.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Damn it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sure you don't want the teapot?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, I mean, it's an iPod. But …

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Sorry, I …

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. No. Definitely. It's …

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Okay, well, I guess I will take that book of short stories.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes! There you go. I want the teapot. Gracias.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Got to be kidding me.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yankee Swap is like Machiavelli meets … Christmas.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [after Phyllis leaves suddenly] What is she so upset about?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Maybe because you hated her present so much.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Come on! I think that Yankee Swap was a big hit! I think it's a success and I'm the one who ended up with Dwight's stupid paintball pellets.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, but, Michael, the point is that we all bought gifts for specific people.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: And you should have just bought a $20 gift like everyone else.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I didn't. I got a big bonus because I fired Devon, and I used the money to buy something awesome. Sue me!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You got a bonus check?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How much?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It wasn't. It wasn't that much. It was $3,000.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: All right, I'm done now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Unbelievable. I do the nicest thing that anyone has ever done for these people and they freak out. Well, happy birthday, Jesus. Sorry your party's so lame.

scenes.speaker: Liquor Store Clerk
scenes.line: It comes to $166.41.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right, now, you're the expert. Is this enough to get 20 people plastered?

scenes.speaker: Liquor Store Clerk
scenes.line: Fifteen bottles of vodka? Yeah, that should do it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Cool, cool. Box it up.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I bought this teapot for Pam, and I know she really wants it. So, can I trade you for it?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No trades.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Come on, it's a shamrock keychain. Good luck.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: "A real man makes his own luck." Billy Zane.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Look, it has sentimental value, Dwight. Can I buy it from you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No. I want it. I'm going to use it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You don't even drink tea.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: True. But I get sinus infections, and sinus infections can be cured by making your tea from green tea leaf stems …

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay …

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: … and pouring it directly into your nose, like so. [demonstrates]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: To think that my gift for Pam will be used for that, it's a little too much to handle.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: This is awesome.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I know. It's totally going to change the way I work out.

scenes.speaker: Roy

scenes.line: Yeah! [laughing]

scenes.line: Yeah! Oh ho ho [laughing]

scenes.line: Should we help 'em pick up their stuff?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no, no. We don't do that. We don't do that.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.line: Watch out, Pam. You're next!

scenes.line: Why would somebody ruin a perfectly good carpet? I don't know. It could be done out of hate. It could be done out of love. It could be completely neutral. Maybe somebody hates the cleaning lady. And, well, she doesn't do a very good job, obviously, because my office still reeks like you would not believe. I hate her.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what? I am beginning to think that what happened to my carpet was an act of terrorism against the office. The only thing that makes any sense.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [on phone] Hello, am I the 107th caller? [hangs up, dials again] Hello, Rock 107. Am I the 107th caller? [hangs up and dials again] Hell , Rock 107. Am I the 107th caller? [hangs up and begins to dial again] I'm totally gonna win us that box set.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stop.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jethro Tull…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stop it. [Dwight hangs up] Stop. It. [Dwight beings to dial] Don't. Don't.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I need to make a sales call. Please?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [on phone, whispEring] Am I the 107th caller?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [to Roy in Jim's earshot] …back so soon.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: We can go back in, like, a couple of weeks maybe.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, right.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Okay, maybe another month, like, maybe for, like President's Day or something.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, that's right. We could do a three-day weekend. I wonder if I could, like, call in sick on the Friday. Then I get a four-day weekend.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [to unseen co-worker] But it's so weird to fall asleep. And I just hate it. 'Cause I try to go to bed at, like, 9:30.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [to Roy as Jim escapes into bathroom] Are you kidding?

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hi, guys.

scenes.line: We haven't finished getting things in order from your last visit.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm just walking around.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Were you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: It's just that we're really swamped over here, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, and I'm not? Why would you say that? Because I'm having fun? You guys just are workin' for the weekend, aren't you? I'm workin' for the week. Sales team, listen to me. This is what we're gonna do. I'm gonna up the ante a little bit literally. Right here, I'm gonna put a crisp one hundred dollar bill. The person with the most sales at the end of the day gets to keep the cash. Sound good?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [counting cash] Seventy, eighty, one, two three. Eighty-three dollars. Still a lotta money and I'm going to … [moves money after seeing workmen walk by] … I'm gonna leave it right over here where everybody can see it. I will be taking Jim's clients today because he is not here and out of sight, out of the contest. Let's see who winds up with the cash, shall we?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: You're gonna compete against us?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, it is on, Phyllis, it is so on!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It is so on!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: God, this is gonna be fun.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael is gonna wipe the floor with us!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [on phone] So you have 40 boxes going out, and I will deliver those personally in a Sebring. Very good, nice doing business with you. Thank you. [hangs up] Yes! [chuckles] Oh, yeah! Read it and weep. Oh! Oh, look at that! [puts post-it on Phyllis' forehead] Look at me, Phyllis! Oh, what is that? That's my sale! [humming then dancing victoriously]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [walking by with new carpet] What… What's that? Whatcha doing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [stops dance] Nothing.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: [laughing] I think he's dancing.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. Just …

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: That was definitely not dancing.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what, guys? It's none of your concern. It was official business, so just…

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Paper business.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, paper business. Is this done?

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Nope.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Extreme Home Makeover puts together a house in an hour. If you were on that crew, you would be fired like that. [snaps]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Somebody did something bad to Michael's carpet. Maybe that's all we need to know.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [to Oscar] Who do you think did it?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Are you kidding? I thought it was you.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Really? I thought you. [both laugh in Michael's earshot]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This was no act of God. A person did this. A person who works in this office. Maybe all of them.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what? Today is not a good day for a sales contest. We're… we're not… we're not doin' this today.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That doesn't seem fair.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You wanna talk about fair? Does anyone need to smell my old carpet? You explain to me how that was fair, and I'll explain to you how this is fair. Plus I just… I think that picking today was sort of taking advantage.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: But you're the one who picked today.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am a victim of a hate crime. Stanley knows what I'm talkin' about.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: That's not what a hate crime is.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well I hated it! A lot! Okay, I… you know what? If the guilty person would just come forward and take their punishment, we'd be done . [no one comes forward] Very well. Then you are all punished.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What's our punishment?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're all on a time out. Just sit there quietly. [phone rings, Phyllis reaches to answer] No. NO! [phone continues to ring]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: What's up?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nothing much. Let me ask you something. It's actually little awkward.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What do you think of Kelly?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I don't know. Depends if you like a little junk in … [notices camera] Umm… She's really cool.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you interested in her?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah, totally.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Did she say something?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: She said lots of things.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Do you know if she's looking for a long-term thing or if she'd be cool just hangin' out?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I have no idea.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Can you find out?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. Sure.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [to Jim] Oh, long-term, definitely. Fall in love, have babies, spend every second together… but don't tell him that, okay? Just tell him I'm, like, up for anything. I mean, I'm not a slut, but who knows?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do you remember Ed Truck?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Sure. He hired me. How's he doing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How would I know?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I thought you might.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: My biggest fear is turning into him.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Michael, you should have much bigger fears than that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sighs] I wasn't talking literally, Creed. Yeah, being buried alive would be worse. Happy? Why am I talking to you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [meeting Ed Truck in parking lot] Ed? Hi. Thanks for meeting me. Must be kinda neat comin' back.

scenes.speaker: Ed
scenes.line: Yeah. Should we go upstairs?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uh, well, honestly Ed, I really don't wanna be up there right now.

scenes.speaker: Ed
scenes.line: So, what's the problem with my pension?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, no, no, no. You're good. It was clerical. You're good. Um, well, somebody did something in my office, and I now think that they did it on purpose and it was directed at me.

scenes.speaker: Ed
scenes.line: Well, what was done?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I didn't get a good look at… it, but it smells horrible.

scenes.speaker: Ed
scenes.line: Yeah, somebody once did that in my office.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Ed
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, that figures. So how did you deal with people not liking you?

scenes.speaker: Ed
scenes.line: You can't expect to be friends with everybody.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well… s-sure I can.

scenes.speaker: Ed
scenes.line: No. They'll always think of you as a boss first.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Not necessarily. You can love a boss like you do a father.

scenes.speaker: Ed
scenes.line: I'm not sure that ever happens.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, okay. Different management styles.

scenes.speaker: Ed
scenes.line: Why can't your workers be your workers, family be your family, your friends be your friends?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Last week I would have given a kidney to anyone in this office. I would have reached right into my stomach and pulled it out for them. But now, no. I don't have the relationship with these people that I thought I did. I hope they ask, so they can hear me say, "Uh… no. I only give my organs to my real friends. Go get yourself a monkey kidney."

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [on phone] Hey, Brenda. This is, uh, Jim Halpert from the boat. And I got your number from the corporate directory and, well, I was assuming that you probably gave it to them because you wanted me to ask you out, right? Um, so gimme a call back. You can get my number from said directory, um, or just check your e-mail 'cause I just sent you one. Yikes. Uh… give me a call back, I hope. I'll talk to you later. Bye.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: You just asked a girl out on the phone!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [on phone] Yes.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Hello, yes. I'm looking for a gay nerd named Michael Scott.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Who is this? How did you get this number?

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Your mom, you gay nerd!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh my God. Packer. Packster. Whacky Pack. How you doin'?

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Hey, did you get that package I left for you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uh… no. Did anybody see a package here today? No. How big was it?

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: It was pretty big.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did you see a big package? Where did you leave it?

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Left it in the middle of your office.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really? Guys, did you see a big package in my office?

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: You mean the thing?

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: [laughs uproariously]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Are you kidding me? Oh!

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Special delivery!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That was Packer! Oh, you're… you are dead. You are dead, my friend! That is hilar… Oh, God! Of course it was you.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Sit on the throne, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh. [laughs and claps] Yeah, yeah! Oh my God. It was Packer!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It takes an advanced sense of humor. I don't expect everybody to understand. It was done out of love, just like I thought. It's ah… God, these people are so… these are good people. We have fun. [giggles] We just have fun! Oh, I'm just so sorry that I threw the thing out.

scenes.speaker: Jim’s voicemail
scenes.line: You have seven unheard messages.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [voicemail message for Jim] Hey, Jim. It's Pam. I keep looking up to say something to you and then Michael's there and it's horrible. Anyway, I'm bored. Come back!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [voicemail message for Jim] Hey, guess what? I moved my computer so I can't see Michael's head. It's working. I think I can have a career as a very specific type of decorator.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [voicemail message for Jim] Sudoku. Level moderate. 18 minutes. Suck on that, Halpert.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [voicemail message for Jim] I'll transfer you. Dunder Mifflin, this is Pam. Hold, please. Dunder Mifflin, this is … okay, sorry. Michael was standing at my desk, and I needed to be busy or who knows what would've happened, so thank you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [voicemail message for Jim] Hey, what's that word we made up when you have a thing stuck in your shoe? Anyway, I have a thing stuck in my shoe.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [voicemail message for Jim] Hey, I have a chance to sneak out of here early, and I'm not messing this up, so I'll see you tomorrow.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [voicemail message for Jim] Calling from my cell phone. I don't know if you guys figured out who did that to Michael's carpet yet, but I have a theory that involves an inter-departmental conspiracy. Everybody in the office. We need to talk.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: So, I'm happy to be here. It's very nice to see all of you. You're all looking well.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Today's a 'women in the workplace' thing. Jan's coming in from Corporate to talk to all the women about… um… I don't really know what. But Michael's not allowed in. She said that about five times.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Women today, though we have the same options as men, we often face a very different set of obstacles in getting there. So…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [knocks] Hey, what's going on?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Michael… I thought we agreed you wouldn't be here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah… I… You know what… I… I… I just thought about it. I just have a few things I want to say.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hold… Just hear me out. What is more important than Quality? E-Quality. Now studies show that today's woman, the Ally McBeal woman, as I call her, is at a crossroads…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, just uh… you have come a long way, baby. But I just… just want to keep it within reason.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: They did this up in Albany…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: You are not allowed in this session.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And they ended up turning the break room into a lactation room which is disgusting so…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Now you're really not allowed in this session.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I'm their boss, so I feel like…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: I'm your boss.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [stands up] Anybody want any coffee or…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: We're fine, Michael. We just need you to leave, please.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Women in the workplace… yeah, translation "I have been banned from my own conference room so that Jan can talk in secret to all the girls." Oh! Sorry. 'Women of the workplace.' About what? I don't know. Clothes. Me. Eeegkh!

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Ladies, I am so, so sorry. Can we start again? We were on such a roll. I… I… really apologize.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Jan.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Yes, Pam?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael's still at the door.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Michael!

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [in the background] So one obstacle is how assertiveness is perceived differently in men and women. Men who are assertive will be admired. They're called… anyone?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's a terrible idea.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What is?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Them in there all together. If they stay in there too long they're going to get on the same cycle. Wreak havoc on our plumbing.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Everyone. Guys. Circle up, please. Come on over. Bring your chairs. Toby, come on over. You're a guy… too… sort of. Let's do this!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in the background] Well, first of all, I, uh, just want to warm up a little bit. Let's just clap.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Let's just clap. Ready? [clapping] Yeah! Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's what I'm talking about!

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: I don't know what you're doing here, Michael,

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just having a little 'guys in the workplace' thing.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: … but it's very destructive.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why can't boys play with dolls? Why does society force us to use urinals when sitting down is far more comfortable?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Can you please do this somewhere else, Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We have nowhere else Jan. This…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We could do it in the warehouse.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Dwight, excellent idea. Go to the warehouse.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK, OK, Fine. Yeah, actually, perfect. Perfect. You know what? There's another side to this place, gentleman. And I know we all love our cushy jobs and our fun, exciting office. But do you realize that underneath us, there's another world. The warehouse world. A world that is teeming with sweat and dirt and life. Life. The bowels of the office. These guys are down there, they are real men doing real man's work. We are going to learn how a warehouse works.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, I think it's going to work out great. Because managing the warehouse is a very important part of my job. And I haven't been there in months.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Remember on Lost when they met the Others?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: I'm so sorry about that… um… so where were we? Pam, are you okay taking notes then?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Mmmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Please? Thank you. very much.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So let's meet the warehouse! Let's get some shots. Pan around there. This is Darryl, one of our warehouse staff. Darryl, what is your biggest fear?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: My biggest fear is that someone will distract us from getting all the shipments out on time.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know, Darryl is actually the Foreman here and not Roy, which is cool. There's Roy riding the big rig. So Roy is actually going to be marrying Pam sometime this summer. And… uh, she's our receptionist. Sort of a Brangelina thing.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Brangelina is the Brad Pitt and Angelina… Roy…

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: I don't understand.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Roy and Pam. It's a Ram. It's a Ram thing.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [talking to Jim] I bet Roy heard about you liking Pam. I bet he'll try to beat you up.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thanks for the head's up, Kev.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I've got your back if he does. But try to stay out of it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [points at math equasion on chalkboard] Uhhuhhuh. Just in case there's someone down here who shouldn't be. A little "Good Will Hunting" situation. All right. Troops. This is an important day. Big day. Now you may look around and see two groups here. White collar. Blue collar. But I don't see it that way. And you know why not? Because I am collar-blind.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Why don't we go around the table and all say something that we know we're good at. I will start. I am good at public speaking.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Hi. I'm Meredith and I'm an alch… good at supplier relations.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Great. Phyllis?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I'm good at computer stuff, emails, spreadsheets, all that.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [disbelieving] Really?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I don't know. I thought that I wasn't going to be asked that…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: No. Okay. Stop. Go on…

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I've seen some of your spreadsheets.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Really? I thought they were pretty…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't know how I fit in with these women. Here. Or with Jan. Um… I mean we get along great. Fine. Um… I guess the person I have the most in common with is…

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Jim… Halpert. Hey uh, I, uh, you know heard there's a rumor going around about you used to have a crush on Pam.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, no, no. No.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: No, it's cool, because I know you're a good guy. And I know that that crush ended a long time ago, so… you know. We're cool, right?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. Nope. Yeah. Definitely.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: You know, it's great with me cause that way, glad she has a friend at work she can get through the day with. She's not all bap bap bap bap when she gets home.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. I like talking to her too.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: So, we're cool, right?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes. Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yep. Cool, man.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Sweet.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [blows a sigh of relief]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Hey, Mike, look. How bout we go upstairs, too. You know learn how the office works. We can all switch places today.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh… well… okay… yeah, you know what? I don't think… You… You're… My job sucks compared to this. I don't think you'd like it up there.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: The experience…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Guys! Want to start unloading the truck?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay. Let's go. Step up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Check this out! Look at that! Look at that [squeezes blow-up doll] bwup-bwa! [talks in girly voice] Hello! How are… [regular voice] Oh! Kay. That is great. That is good stuff.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: In five years, I'd like to be… five years sober.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: That is an excellent goal.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Four and a half.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I'll tell you one thing. I am not going to be one of those women schlepping her kids around in a minivan.

scenes.speaker: Jan
