scenes.line: …noted.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [walking into Michael's office] I'm going… to the dentist.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I have to have an emergency crown put in.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ouchy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes. It's a new dentist. He's far. I might be gone… three hours.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Three hours, wow. Have fun. [Dwight walks away staring through the blinds at Michael]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Did you get anything good?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: New blouse? Halter top? Camisole? Teddy?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I can save the branch.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: If you let me run it.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [excitedly] "Ok" I can run it?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: What would you do differently?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Mostly get rid of waste. Which is half the people there. And clean house. [to waitress in diner] Right here. It's all for me. Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Dwight, you must feel strongly, to speak with me this way, behind Michael's back, and turn on so many of your co-workers.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The decision to turn on Michael was difficult. [pouring way too much syrup on his food] But once I did it, I didn't look back. And mostly I feel that Michael would approve. It's really what's best for the branch. And I could care less about my co-workers. So [cutting his food, giving Jan a "so there" look], here we are. It's all, on the table. I want… the branch. And I await your decision.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [shoveling waffles into his mouth] Oh, by the way. There's a new Ann Taylor outlet store near here. I know you like their earrings.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [thinks for a second] Where is it?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [on speakerphone with Michael] Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: I just had a very interesting conversation with one of your employees.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh. That's nice.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: No, it wasn't. Dwight just told me that he thinks he can run the branch better than you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: …what?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: …you were at the dentist?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: You can't have people undermining you. Get control of your branch immediately.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What was Dwight thinking? That he could turn Jan against me? She's my ex-lover! …ish.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [Pam walks out of the bathroom wearing her new red shirt] Woooooow.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: It's

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: It's really something.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [smiling] It's too much.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm gonna return it.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: No, you have to keep it today, just see how you feel.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: [walking into the break room] Hey.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: You look nice.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Isn't that like your third soda today?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah I think we can be a big help to your company. [someone dims the lights, signifying that it's game time] Ok, see you next week. Bye. [to Karen] Again?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Scared?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: [with her hands making the rocker sign] Call of Duty!

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: [sounding upset] Andy, Jim, can I see you in the conference room for a minute?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Now?

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: Yes now.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Put the game on hold everyone.

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: This is not working, ok? We are getting slaughtered out there.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It's the new guy. [looks at Jim]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, I'm sorry I don't know… what we're talking about…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: See what I mean?

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: We just need a strategy, ok? We're going to set up a trap in the gun room. All right Jim, are you using the MP-40 or the 44?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Um, sniper rifle?

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: SNIPE–

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: WHAT?

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: JIM!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Are you playing for the other team?!

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: You don't snipe in Carrington, ok?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Saboteur!

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: Andy, it's not—

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Saboteur! I'm going to kill you for real. This game— the game is over. I'm really going to shoot you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do you want an M&M?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No thanks I'm stuffed.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No seriously. You should have an M&M, they're really good.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: …ok. [takes and eats several M&M's]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: They're good, huh?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: …so good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey. I thought you weren't supposed to eat anything for a couple hours after you've had a crown put in.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: They have this new kind of quick drying bonding, so…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sounds like a good dentist.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What's his name?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [long pause] Crentist.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Your dentist's name is Crentist.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Huh. Sounds a lot like dentist.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Maybe that's why he became a dentist.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Let me see your teeth. Let me see 'em. Let me see 'em.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [reluctantly opens his mouth and Michael peers inside] Ahh. Aaaah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You should… floss.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I know…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [exhales] Well then… I am glad you're ok.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Business is like a jungle. And I… am like a tiger. And Dwight, is like a monkey, that stabs the tiger in the back with a stick. Does the tiger fire the monkey? Does the tiger transfer the monkey to another branch? [smiling] Pun. There is no way of knowing what goes on inside the tiger's head. We don't have the technology.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight, can I talk to you for a second?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in Michael's office] Wow, this is tough.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ohhhh. Arrrgggh!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What is it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I just got off the phone with Jan. And um… she demoted me.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. You know what the craziest part of this is? She demoted me to your job!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Gahh!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And she said that you should be expecting a call later from corporate, and that um, I guess that means that you are going to be acting manager of Dunder Mifflin, Scranton.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I can't believe this news. That— wow.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know. I told her I didn't know whether you'd wanna do it… because you've always been so loyal to me. You've been my most trusted ally.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You said that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yep, I did. I did. But I think… you should do it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well… Gosh, if you think I should. Then I will.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [exhales] Perfect, well, we're settled.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right. Well then, you are now acting manager of Dunder Mifflin Scranton Branch, and I… am assistant regional manager.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Assistant to the regional manager. Thank you Michael, for staying on. I really appreciate it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ohh…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey… I can't imagine this place without you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [muttEring] Can't you? That's so nice.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well… I guess we should go tell the troops.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, when I'm ready, Mike. [Dwight exhales, Michael looks at the camera] Ok let's do it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, hi, hello. Everybody, I have some good news, and I have some bad news. I… am being replaced, as your leader, by Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: You're kidding…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You might think that I am kidding, and I understand that.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Congratulations Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Thank you Angela.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: But… why Dwight?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because, Dwight… never lies.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: How does that qualify him to run a branch?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because that's all it takes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, Dwight, would you like to say a few words to everybody… about loyalty?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Thank you Michael. I just want to say, to the few of you who will remain under my employ, that I intend to lead you into the black! With ferocity!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Michael, what will you do?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, I'll be fine.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Do you have any savings?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, I don't, but—

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Michael, you might lose your condo.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I… won't. I won't.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I have this little vacuum cleaner that's broken. If Dwight doesn't work out, maybe that could be manager.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Maybe I'll quit.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It's really happening!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: We can make a difference here.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: You alone? Because I thought together we could—

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh please, don't be naive. But you can be in charge of the women.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: [whispEring] Look how cute he is! He's trying to shoot with a smoke grenade.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm sorry what are you whispEring about?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: I'm sorry nothing, just concentrate on turning around.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm trying—

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Just tap S then D.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: [her players gun is pointed directly at Jim's player's head] Any… last words? No?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What? [Karen's player shoots Jim's player, "You killed Jim Halpert" appears on the screen, Karen giggles]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow. Psychopath. [Karen grins widely at Jim]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I'm just looking.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Please go back to your desk.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: In a minute.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, I remember why I dress the way I do at work. But I'm gonna keep the clothes. I mean, it'll be cool to just have some after work clothes that aren't pajamas.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I guess it's time, that I turn over the keys, to the famous Sebring.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [smiling] No thank you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's a corporate lease Dwight, you've earned it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No thanks.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Not my style.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: But you said you liked it. You've always admired it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well that was before. I'm thinking about getting something German, something with decent gas mileage. Plus, that convertible, it's a ridiculous choice for this climate.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Michael finally breaks] Take it back.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [confused] No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's my car.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What did you—

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: THAT'S MY CAR.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know, Dwight. I know. I know. I know.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You know what?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jan called me about your little meeting!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know, what you did. I made the whole thing up, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I think the Sebring's cool. It's cool. The Seabring's cool. It has a cassette and it has a CD.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh do you? Do you like the Sebring— HOW DARE YOU?! How dare you, Dwight?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Dwight gets on his knees and puts his face down on the ground] Don't fire me. Please.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Give me one good reason why I should fire you RIGHT HERE ON THE SPOT?!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [terrified] I HAVE EXCELLENT SALES NUMBERS!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Not. Good. Enough!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [sobbing] I'll do anything! Anything! I'll do your laundry for a month! For a year!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have a laundry machine!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm sorry! I'll do anything, I swear. [squeaking, crying]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know if I can trust you anymore.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You can't. You can't. But I promise I'll never betray you again. What can I do, Michael. What can I do? [Michael exhales] What can I do? [Dwight has his face to the ground but his butt raised high in the air] What can I do? What can I do?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You can get up. Get up. [Dwight gets up with spit hanging from his lips] And you can hug it out, bitch. [Dwight and Michael have a firm embrace]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hug it out, bitch. That is what men say to each other, after a fight. They hug it out, and doing so, the just… let it go. And walk away. And they're done. Not a good idea to say that to a woman however. I have found. It doesn't translate.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [leaving his desk for the day, pretends pull the pen out of a pretend grenade, and tosses it to Karen]

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: [throws some desk material in the air to signify debris from the grenade explosion, grins as Jim walks away]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yep. Yeah, we hugged it out. But, it turns out, I was still a little angry. So, I felt I needed to punish him, just a little bit more, [cut to Dwight standing on a box with "LIAR" written on a piece of paper hung around his neck, Dwight's head hung in shame] and I'm making him do my laundry for a year.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. [Jan leaves Michael's office; Dwight enters]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey. [shuts door] Is everything okay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is not your business, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: If the branch is in trouble, there are things you can do.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What do you know about management, Dwight?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I know that we need to cut costs. We could fire Meredith. That's a big cost.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm not firing anyone.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Creed might be living here, we could charge him rent.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: … What?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Four nights a week, I sleep under my desk, and then three nights I stay at my place in Toronto. They don't know about this job up there. It's a welfare state. Beautiful countries, both of 'em.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. Here we go. Everybody, you know what? It dawned on me we were all in there watching a movie together before we were so rudely interrupted, Let's get back in there. [no takers] Come on. Movie Monday! Come on, Stanley let's go.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [standing at the supply shelf] I'm on the phone.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ryan?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I'm pretty sure Jan said that we're not supposed to.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, well, we had scheduled this time to watch a movie together, so I guess I will just go play some online Scrabble.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [looks to Angela]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [shakes her head disapprovingly]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The Schrutes are a very loyal breed. But I also have Mannheim blood from my German grandmother. And the Mannheims knew when to cut and run. No sense going down with a losing regime. But the Schrute blood… It's amazing that when these two bloods mix, the whole thing didn't explode.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So, she sleeps with him, but she is still in love with the head surgeon, um, the McDreamy guy, and she starts crying, but the dorky doctor, he's in love with her… [phone rings]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dunder Mifflin, this is Pam. … Uh, sure, I'll get him for you. [to Michael] It's Jan for you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I may have a few weeks ago faked a call from Jan in order to get out of a synopsis of, I think it was, Navy: NCIS. Since then, Michael's been suspicious.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Nnnnice. Wow!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [playing Call of Duty] Oh? Someone's left out in the open, taking a little siesta. Not smart. [shoots] Yes! Finally killed you… [Karen's desk is empty]

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Hey, Jim?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Jan.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: How's work going?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [nervously] Pretty good.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [kills Jim's character, giggles] Oh, you know what, I gotta see Josh right now, but remind me to tell you what Dwight said to me earlier, okay? You'll get a big kick out of it. [leaves]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [baffled expression]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Things are a little bit… different here in Stamford. [shrug] It's not bad.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey Ryan, can I get you a pencil from the warehouse?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Uh, no thanks, I'm good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, it's okay, I'm going down.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Um… Yeah, absolutely.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right, I'll be right back. [goes down pretend stairs]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [laughs uproariously and applauds] Whoo!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [hands Ryan pencil] There you go.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Awesome!

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're welcome.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael, can you get me a pen from down in the warehouse?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't mind if I do. See you in a minute. [goes back down pretend stairs and grabs pen from Stanley's desk]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay. [continues to laugh] Whoo!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There you go, fresh from the warehouse.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey Michael, would you get me some coffee from the warehouse?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There's coffee in the kitchen, Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: But the warehouse coffee tastes SO much better.

scenes.speaker: Ryan & others
scenes.line: Yeah. Yes, it's better. It's great.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [breathless] All right. Okay. [goes back down pretend stairs, crawls on belly to the kitchen for the coffee]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am like Bette Midler in For the Boys. Gotta keep the troops entertained.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [after Michael returns with coffee] With cream and sugar?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sighs] All right.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [on speakerphone] So, I wanted to let you know that we lost Ed Truck.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oookay. Let me see if I have his cell. Is this the only reason you are calling, Jan? Or does somebody miss me?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Michael, Ed died over the weekend.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, wow.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Attention, everybody. I just received a call from corporate with some news they felt that I should know first. My old boss Ed Truck has died.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Oh, Michael, that's such terrible news! You must feel so sad.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, I am. It's very sad. Because he was my boss.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: That's a shame. Ed was a good guy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's right, you worked with him. So did Creed. Well, I'll be in my office in case anybody wants to drop by. Cheer me up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So did you hear the news?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: The news that you just announced? That Ed died?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Is there anything I can do?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, gosh, what can anybody do, really? It's… pssssh… . He was almost 70. Circle of life.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [holds out arms to Pam]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh. Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. Mmmmmm.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [extricating herself] Okay.

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: What's going on with Fairfield County schools? Karen, did you generate that price list?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Um, shoot. Uh, I will. Sorry.

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: Okay, just get it done. Jim, will you make sure?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh yeah, definitely.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [coughing out his words] Suck up! Josh, did you hear what I said?

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: Thank you, everyone.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: [at vending machine] Dammit.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What's up?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Uh, nothing. They're just out of Herr's chips.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: But don't worry about it. My snack food doesn't fall under the umbrella of your authority.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mmm, that's where you're wrong. I'm your project supervisor today, and I have just decided that we're not doing anything until you get the chips that you require. So, I think we should go get some. Now, please.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: It's a real shame about Ed, huh?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. Must really have you thinkin'.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: About what?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The older you get, the bigger the chance is you're gonna die. You knew that.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Ed was decapitated.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: He was drunk as a skunk, he was flying down Route 6. He slides under an 18 wheeler. Pop. It snaps right off.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh my God.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That is the way to go. Instant death. Very smart.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: You know a human can go on living for several hours after being decapitated.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You're thinking of a chicken.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: What did I say?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That is just not the way a Dunder Mifflin manager should go, I'm sorry. Alone, out of the blue, and not even have his own head to comfort him.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [clears throat] So, I'm not exactly sure how to say this…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ed was decapitated.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You said you didn't know how to say it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I didn't… he was driving on the road and he went under a truck. And that's when his head was separated from the rest of him. And I will let you know more as soon as I find out.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: If my head ever comes off, I would like you to put it on ice.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I do not wanna talk about this.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: When I die, I wanna be frozen. And if they have to freeze me in pieces, so be it. I will wake up stronger than ever because I will have used that time to figure out exactly why I died and what moves I could have used to defend myself better now that I know what hold he had me in.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't understand. We have a day honoring Martin Luther King, but he didn't even work here.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [on speakerphone] I understand how you feel, Michael. I really do. So, would it be helpful to give everyone the day off?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You really don't get it, do you? You don't understand these people. That is the last thing that they would want is a day off.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Well, what would you suggest?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [thoughtfully] A statue.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Of Ed?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [scoffs] I'm not sure that's realistic.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I think it would be very realistic, it would look just like him.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: No, that's not—

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We could have his eyes light up, we could have his arms move…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That is not a statue, that is a robot.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think that is a great way to honor Ed.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: And how big do you want this robot?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Life-size.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Mm, no. Better make it two-thirds. Easier to stop if it turns on us.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: What the hell are you two talking about?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, we are talking about how to properly honor a man who gave his life as regional manager of this company, Jan.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: You know what, Michael? I've really tried with you today…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm hm.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: …and I have to get back to work.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh do you? You know who wished they could get back to work is Ed Truck.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: So call me when you feel like having a real conversation.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: But Ed truck can't because he is—

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Goodbye. [hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: DEAD.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Look [holding up sketch] I gave him a six foot extension cord so he can't chase us.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's perfect.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, that is a "no" on the on the West Side Market.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Okay, great. I think that's enough. Can I get back to work now?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow. Never pegged you for a quitter.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: I am NOT a quitter. I will do this all day if you want.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Yeah, all day.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey. What are we doing? What's the game? I want in.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, there's no game. We're just trying to get these chips for Karen.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Did you check the vending machine?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Oh, the vending machines! How did we miss that?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I have no idea. We went right for the copier.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Mm.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And then we checked the fax machine.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Yeah, nothing there.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Did you check your… butt?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oohh… can you imagine how much blood there was? If it happened right here, it would reach all the way to reception. Probably get on Pam.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Okay that's enough.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: We do not wanna hear about this.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, you know what? I didn't wanna hear about it either, Stanley, but I did and now I can't stop picturing it. He leaves work, he's on his way home… wham! His cappa is detated from his head!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: You have just spit on my face.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, you know what? There's something wrong with you. There is something wrong with everybody in here. Because we have lost a member of our family and you don't wanna talk about it, you don't wanna think about it, you just wanna get back to work!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There are five stages to grief, which are [glancing at computer screen] denial, anger, bargaining, depression, and acceptance. And right now, out there, they're all denying the fact that they're sad. And that's hard. And it's making them all angry. And it is my job to try to get them all the way through to acceptance. And if not acceptance, then just depression. If I can get them depressed, then I'll have done my job.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am going to throw you this ball. When you catch the ball, I want you to say the name of a person very important to you, somebody really special who died, and then I want you to say how they died, and you may cry if you like, that is encouraged. Let me just start. Let me show you how this works. I catch the ball. I lost Ed Truck. And… it feels like somebody took my heart and dropped it into a bucket of boiling tears… and at the same time, somebody else is hitting my soul in the crotch with a frozen sledgehammer… and then a third guy walks in and starts punching me in the grief bone… and I'm crying, and nobody can hear me, because I am terribly, terribly… terribly alone.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Excuse me, I'm sorry to interrupt, uh, I need to see Pam. There seems to be, like, something wrong with the radiator in her car.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, fine. Hurry back.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: [as they leave] There's nothing wrong with your car. I just thought you might like a break from the "grief counseling" session.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh. I would like a break.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: How are you likin' the new car?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Great.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Yeah? Sure is small. Got airbags?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I think so. I don't know, I was mainly focused on the cup holders.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: [laughs] Well, you're not still driving so fast, are you? Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [on phone] Hi, yeah. This is Mike from the West Side Market. Well, we get a shipment of Herr's salt and vinegar chips, and we ordered that about three weeks ago and haven't … . yeah. You have 'em in the warehouse. Great. What is my store number… six. Wait, no. I'll call you back. [quickly hangs up] Shut up [to Karen].

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: [laughing] Six?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [as Pam returns to conference room] Okay, we can start. Um…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You waited for me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. Pam, you're a member of this family. So we will wait for our family members. Phyllis, you wanna give it a shot?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [grabbing ball] I got it. When my mother was pregnant with me, they did an ultrasound and found she was having twins. When they did another ultrasound a few weeks later, they discovered, that I had resorbed the other fetus. Do I regret this? No. I believe his tissue has made me stronger. I now have the strength of a grown man and a little baby.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, why don't you throw the ball to somebody else.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [throwing ball back] Nope.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [returning ball to Stanley] Oh, yes Stanley. Come on. Your turn, you have to go.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I will NOT. [throws ball back]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay… I'm going to toss the ball to Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Let's see. I had an aunt that I was really close to. She was this amazing female boxer. Um, anyway, she was injured in a fight, and she was paralyzed. So, you can imagine how upset I was when I found out that she asked her manager to remove her breathing tube so she could die.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow. If you wanna cry, that's okay.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [catching ball] Thanks. Um, a few years ago, my family was on a safari in Africa and, um, my cousin, Mufasa was um, he was trampled to death by a pack of wildebeests and, um, we all… took it really hard. All of us kind of in the audience of what happened.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do you want to talk about it anymore?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Oh, it would probably take me like an hour and a half to tell that whole story.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Me, me, me, me, me me. [catches ball] Yes. Okay, um. I was trying to throw this party once. And everyone was over for the weekend. And then my uncle Bernie died, and so me and my best friend, we had to pretend like he was alive, so…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wait a second. That's Weekend at Bernie's. [upset] Do you think that this is a game?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Well, there is a ball.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right, we're starting over.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: No, I'm done.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You are not leaving. No! We are not done.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: We really have a lot of work to do right now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. Well, you know what? The guy who had my job has died. And nobody cares! And he sat at my desk. [breaking down]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Michael, look. I know this is hard for you, but death's just a part of life. I mean, just this morning I saw a little bird fly into the glass doors downstairs and die. And I had to keep going.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How do you know?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That that bird was dead? Did you check its breathing?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: It was obvious…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Was its heart beating, Toby? Did you check it? No, of course you didn't. You're not a vetErinarian. You don't know ANYTHING! [runs out of conference room crying]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael! [following Michael downstairs] Michael. Michael …

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [seeing bird] Oh, God!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [in disgust] Oh…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh my God! Oh my God, come on …

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Poor little fella.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh shhhh–oot!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: He is a goner.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, he's not.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, he's not. [cradling bird next to face]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael, get him away from your head! He is covered in germs and bacteria!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, you can't get diseases from a bird!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: A dead bird should not be in the kitchen!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We don't know if it's dead.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Ugh, no that thing is

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You want me to flush him?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Attention everybody. This will only take a second of your time. Today at 4 p.m. we will be meeting in the parking lot to have a funeral service for this bird.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I have a lot of work to do.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I'm sorry to inconvenience you, Meredith. But that is what you do when things die. You honor them. Toby killed this bird. And now we are going to honor it.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: But…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no! That's enough! You know what? This bird is dead. He died alone. The least you can do is be there for him now. [to Dwight] Find a box for him.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: I'm calling a supermarket in Montreal.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nice!

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: [on phone] Bonjour. Je cherche des tchips de la marque Herr's. Non? Ah… merci quand meme. Au revoir.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sounded good.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [crying]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's okay. It's okay. [pats Kelly on shoulder] Shh… yes, I know, I know. It's been a tough day, but it's good to let it show.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I mean, how many times to I have to confirm with Ryan [Michael walks away disgusted] for him to know that we have a date tonight?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [trying to shove bird into a can] Argh… gah!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What are… What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What? No, this is about the right size.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, God, no it's not! What is the matter with you? Is that the beak!?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm sorry, I grew up on a farm. We slaughtered a pig whenever we wanted bacon. My grandfather was reburied in an old oil drum. [pause] It would have fit if he had given me another minute.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I need a box. I need a box. A small box… not too confining.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Is it for the bird?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I have it covered. [hands Dwight a decorated box]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: If you wanna do something for the funeral…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes, please.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Maybe you could play a song on your recorder.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Excellent.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Do you have it with you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Always. [runs off]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Did I wake up this morning thinking I'd be throwing together a bird funeral? You never can tell what your day here is gonna turn into.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: [spotting Herr's chips on her desk] Where'd you find them?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Where'd I find what?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I called the manufacturer, who referred me to distributor, who referred me to the vending machine company, who told me that they sell them in the machines in the building next door.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Glad you could all make it.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: You told us we had to.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight, do you have the box?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Actually, I have it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You made this? Wow. [impressed] That's… that's very nice.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: When I was five my mom told me that my fish went to the hospital in the toilet and it never came back so we had a funeral for it. And I remember thinking "I'm a little too old for this." And I was

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'd also like to say a few words if that's okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What do we know about this bird? You might think, "Not much. It's just a bird." But we do know some things. We know it was a local bird. Maybe it's that same bird that surprised Oscar that one morning with a special present from above.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh, I remember that. That was SO funny.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: And we know how he died. Flying into the glass doors. But you know what? I don't think he was being stupid. I think he just really, really wanted to come inside our building to spread his cheer and lift our spirits with a song.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: He's not a songbird.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Shhh.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: An impression, then. Lastly, we can't help but notice that he was by himself when he died, but of course, we all know that doesn't mean he was alone. Because I'm sure that there were lots of other birds out there who cared for him very much. He will not be forgotten.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [quickly] Amen.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [begins playing recorder]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [singing] Just smile for me and let the day begin. You are the sunshine that lights my heart within… on the wings of love …

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Society teaches us that having feelings and crying is bad and wrong. Well, that's baloney, because grief isn't wrong. There is such a thing as good grief. Just ask Charlie Brown.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Let's get back to work.

scenes.speaker: Hannah
scenes.line: Hey Jimmy. Want to see some pictures of my baby?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Umm… sure.

scenes.speaker: Hannah
scenes.line: [shows picture] Here he is.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [chuckles] He's so cute.

scenes.speaker: Hannah
scenes.line: And here's his first bath. Warning:

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [on the phone] Ed Truck died over the weekend.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, wow. He…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Yeah. And I know… I know he was your boss, so I thought you should know.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Does his family know?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Yes, they know, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: But I'm the first in the office?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: I guess, yes. I think it would be appropriate for you to make an announcement to your team, in case they want to pay their respects.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, yes, sure, I will do that…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: …'Cause I'm the first to to find out. Nobody else knows and it is my responsibility to tell them. Well, good. How are you holding up? Want me to come over? [Jan hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ed Truck died. And it blows. They say that with grief, time makes it worse, which is bad for me because I found out before anybody so I've had more time to be sad.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Attention, everyone. As you know, Ed Truck is dead. If you have any contact information on Rolodex files or in Microsoft Outlook, remove it now. Also, if you have any photographs, Pam will make her shredder available during lunch. That is all.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: RemembEring the dead doesn't help anybody. The way to best honor them is to figure out what killed them and prevent that thing from killing anyone ever again. In this case, some sort of steel exoskeleton to protect the neck, or else a device that allows the head to live separately from the body. I'm working on both.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I would like you all to clear your schedules this afternoon, because I am telling corporate to send in a grief counselor. We need to find out what is blocking you. And that way, we'll be able to honor Ed the way he deserves to be honored. May he rest in peace.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: …ces. [chuckles]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What was that, Kevin?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Nothing.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, you said something, didn't you?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: May he rest in pieces. [chuckles] You know, because there's, like, two pieces of him.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You think that's funny.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No. [chuckles]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You are disgusting.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael, no need to call corporate. We are supposed to use Toby. He's trained as a grief counselor.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, that can't be right.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, I am trained in grief counseling, but, ahh, I don't think that's what they need right now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, then I guess that makes you about the worst grief counselor in the world, doesn't it?

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Hey there.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: So how's your day going?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, I will be spending the entire afternoon in grief counseling for someone I've never met.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: That sucks. [laughs] You guys got it much harder up here.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Closer to the epicenter, I guess.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: [laughs] Cool, all right.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, as you know, Ed Truck passed away. So, I'm here to talk about it if anyone would like to.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Not really.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're ruining it, already. They should not be given the choice.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I did not know Ed Truck. So I will probably spend the day zoning out and planning my weekend. I think Ed would have wanted it that way.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Is anyone having any trouble eating?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Concentrating? Is anyone having trouble getting their work done today?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I'm having trouble getting my work done today.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, look, sometimes things crop up later. So, uhh, you should know I'm always available if anyone would like to talk.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow. Wow. No. No. You are the most heartless, soulless person I've ever met.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Michael, I'm sorry…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. No. Shh. Enough. It is going to take me hours to undo all the damage that your have done here. Dwight, Ryan, I want you to take the table out. We're gonna go on a five minute break, and when you come back, we're going to start with a clean slate, and, in the interim, I would like you to forget everything that Toby has said, okay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't think I'm overstating it when I say that Toby is a plague on this company. And he is worthless. You give people a chance to shine and they blow it, just like you knew they would. Grief counseling is not about, "Are you hungry? Would you like a sandwich?" These people are so far gone, you have to stick a food tube down their throats.

scenes.speaker: Michael

scenes.line: How about Cugino's?

scenes.line: I don't want to go all the way to Dunmore.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: How 'bout Cooper's then?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No seafood.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: But, I don't want to go to DJ's.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh, now all of a sudden you get picky?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Okay, forget it. [walks away]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hooters?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ah. [takes a gulp of Gatorade and passes the bottle to Michael] Here, replinish your fluids.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [takes bottle and cleans off cap with his tie]

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [in Scranton] Where's Michael?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: He's not here. I don't know where he is.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [looks around, noticing that no one is working] Wha… what's going on here?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: We know the branch is closing; Michael told us.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Ah, god. Okay. You know what everybody? I'm sure there is a better way to do this but I've drive something like 400 miles today and I'm completely exhausted so I'm just gonna tell you. Your branch is not closing; Stamford is closing. Um, for the time being, it seems that all your jobs are safe.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yes! [hugs Angela]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Stanley! [hugs Stanley]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Is it because of Michael? Did he actually do something?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Well, reasons are not important. Would you just call him, please? Wherever he is… and tell him.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Sure, uh, Jan… um, do you know, is anyone coming back to Scranton?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Back?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Coming to Scranton. Is anyone coming to Scranton?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Uh, we don't know. Probably. A few.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [referring to Michael's ringing phone] who is it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The office.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Gonna get it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, not until I have some good news for them. Not until I have some good news.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I guess some new people might be coming from Stamford. Should be fun. New blood.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Is Jim coming back.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's, um… I hadn't thought about it, huh.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I just don't want it to be weird, you know? I mean, I took his old job and his old desk.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, that might be weird. Overall though, we still all have our jobs… so, good news, right?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Oh, yeah, totally.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Ahhhhh! [hugs Ryan] I'm so happy we don't have to break up now, Ryan! [kisses him] This is the best day of my whole l ife!

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: What you gonna do?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I really don't know. How you doing with all this?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: You know, I'm fine. I'll be better when I know if I have a job.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You'd actually move to Scranton?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Yeah, if they let me, I think I… I think I would.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: New York City is 45 minutes down the road from here. And you wanna move to Scranton? I dunno. If I were you I'd move to New York?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Yeah, you know… I might do that. I, who knows? I… I might do that.

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: Hey Andy!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [after screaming and throwing papers around in the kitchen] What's up, Josh?

scenes.speaker: Josh
scenes.line: I just want to say thanks. Good luck.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Thanks, man. You, too. Totally.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Anything?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Nothing. [puts down binoculars]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What if this doesn't work? What is the office actually goes under?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Then it was an honor to have worked with you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [pats Dwight and sighs] All right, favorite moments in Dunder-Mifflin history. Go.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: My first day when you hazed me by spraying me with a fire extinguisher.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That was hilarious. The foam …

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Uh,… my first sale, my promotion to assistant regional manager, our basketball game, when you took me to the hospital, and told me that you cared about me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, right. Okay, that's enough. That's good.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What were your favorite moments?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, hmm, all of them. I loved them all. Every single one.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What about when Jan said the branch was closing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: God, Dwight!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well, it doesn't…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hey Pam, we're going to Poor Richards. Creed's buying shots.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No thanks, guys.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Have fun though.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Cool.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hey, I hear Jim's coming back.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Really? Where did you hear that?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I was…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [interupting] Hey Ryan, you coming?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Uh yeah, we'll meet you there.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Awesome. Let's go, Phyllis.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [to Pam] I'll tell you later.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Crazy day, huh?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Yeah, man! I'm uh… I'm really glad you're still gonna be working here.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, me too.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Maybe this is good. Finding another job is a pain. There's another annoying boss, another desk, I'd have to learn everything all over again. So, there are reasons to stay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, um, I think I am gonna take that job. And Scranton… it's not that bad. So, if they offer you a job there, I think you should take it.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Okay, yeah. Maybe I will.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Yeah, I'm happy he said that. I mean, I don't think he's into me or anything, but, I'm kind of into him. So…there you go.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What are we still doing here? It's over. Let's go home. Get the car.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [picks up his beeping cell phone]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, this was such a stupid idea! This was so stupid. I am such a stupid idiot. I let everybody down. Everybody hates me. I lost everybody's jobs. Nobody likes me anymore!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [on the phone] Oh my God!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Stranford is closed! Michael, we're not closed. Stamford is closed. Stamford is closed.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We did it? We did it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We did it!

scenes.speaker: Michael & Dwight
scenes.line: We did it! We did it!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Right here! Right here! [pounds his chest against Dwight's]

scenes.speaker: Michael & Dwight
scenes.line: Ouu! Ou! Ouu! Ouu!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, baby!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: In your face!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We did it!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, man.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How did we do it?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I don't … have no idea.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't understand.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well for a minute there, I saw myself selling my house, moving to Costa Rica, learning how to surf. But, Costa Rica will still be there. When I'm 65.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: The Stamford branch is closing and everybody's just packing up their stuff. Andy Bernard made these tasteful hats.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [to office worker] That's the other thing you got to watch out… [to Jim] Yo! Tuna! I wanna talk to you about this new boss, Michael Scott.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: So what's he like? Likes? Dislikes? Favorite sports? Favorite movies? Favorite men's magazines?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know what? I think you just need to meet him.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Playing your cards close to the vest. I get it. Good luck over there, Tuna. Cross me and I will destroy you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sounds good Andy.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: This is going to be an adventure.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes. This is going to be very interesting. All right, I'm out of here. See you later?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Right on. [to Andy] Hey is that Josh's computer?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How'd the run go?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Ah, pretty good. I finished.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's great!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Psh, why is that great?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Because he accomplished something.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What was your mile time?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: About seven.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [scoffs] I could beat that on a skateboard.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, that has wheels.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, well my feet don't. And I can still crush that time.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Really, Dwight? How fast are you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Let's just put it this way. Last weekend I outran a black pepper snake.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I am fast. To give you a reference point. I'm somewhere between a snake and a mongoose. And a panther.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Man, what is taking Toby so long?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, I'll just time him later.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: And you'll compare the times?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah. Are you ready?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, my groin…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Set

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: …is really tight.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Go!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I can't… [starts running]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Am I being mean to Dwight? I don't know. I did just make him run around the building and I have no intention of timing him. This isn't even a stopwatch. It's a digital thermometer. He does make my life harder, sometimes. And on purpose. Like he tried to put meters on the bathroom stalls as a way of bringing in more money for the company. [yells to Dwight] Hey, three more laps to go. Gotta pick it up if you're going to beat Toby.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Aaaaah!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I should probably get back to work.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Here… Who's here?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Nametag?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, please.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Karen Filippelli.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Karen Filip… [In Italian voice] Ka-ren Fili-pell-li.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Probably Italian. Possibly Filipino.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: My branch is absorbing the Stamford branch. Or, as I like to put it, my family is doubling in size. That's all I'm going to say about it because I have a gigantic performance ahead of me. And I have to get into my head and focus. [exhales]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Who's next?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's Andy Bernard.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Andy Bernard.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: If I were you…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Saint Bernard.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: …I would fire Anthony Gardner…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: …before noon…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm not…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: …to consolidate power.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm not firing somebody on the first day.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, no, no! Not somebody. Gardner.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The Japanese camp guards of World War II always chose one man to kill whenever a batch of new prisoners arrived. I always wondered how they chose the man who was to die. I think I would have been good at choosing the person.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Good morning!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Got the food? Good! Looky-looky-looky. What I want you to do… set it up in the conference room, please. Make it look nice. As if you are trying to impress a much older man who's way out of your league.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes! I'm in a good mood today! I'm excited to meet all the new people and to see my old friend again, definitely. That's always a thing that makes people happy… to have an old friend back.

scenes.speaker: Hannah
scenes.line: Hello?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ah! Ding-ding-ding-ding-ding. Our first arrival. Welcome to Scranton. This is Hannah Smoterich-Barr.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hannah Smoterich-Barr.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Welcome to our humble abode. Follow me to your desk. Your ball and chain is right over here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know for a lot of these people this is the only family they have. So… As far as I'm concerned, [holds up WORLD'S BEST BOSS mug] this says 'World's Best Dad'.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ah! There he is Tony… what's your last name?

scenes.speaker: Tony
scenes.line: Gardner.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Gardner! I knew that. There you go. Gift bag… for you. [laughs] Okay.

scenes.speaker: Tony
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Michael, I didn't get a gift bag.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, they're just for guests. If there are any left over, you can buy one later.

scenes.speaker: Hannah
scenes.line: My bag's mostly pencils.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wh…and coupons… to various hot spots around Scranton. [to Tony] All right! Let me show you to your area, sir. Come on, big guy.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Can I have your pencils?

scenes.speaker: Hannah
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hi!

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm Pam.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Karen. I love your sweater.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, thanks. My Mom made it for me.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Really? That's so cool. I've always wanted to learn…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Welcome.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: …to knit.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Welcome, welcome, welcome! [in robot voice] Take me to your leader. Oh wait, I am your leader.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Uh wait, are you a robot or a Martian?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmm… dah. I am actually your boss, Michael Scott. Welcome. Wow! You are very exotic looking. Was your dad a G.I. or uh?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'll be the Number Two guy here in Scranton in six weeks. How? Name repetition, personality mirroring, and never breaking off a handshake. I'm always thinking one step ahead. Like a carpenter that makes stairs.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hello.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ah! You must be Andy Bernard. Aloha and welcome!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: And you must be Michael Scott. Aloha and… hello.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: A-ha-ha-ho. Very good! Welcome to our little kingdom. Ah, we have a bag of nifty gifties for you.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Michael, thank you for welcoming me to your little kingdom, Mike.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Nifty!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: They are nifty! They're nifty gifties.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know who I really like? Is this guy Andy Bernard. He has got this very likable way about him.

scenes.speaker: Martin
scenes.line: …which is why they need a passing game.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to Jim] No way. Get him out of here. We don't want any of this kind in here. Good to see you, man.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to Martin] How are you? Martin Nash, I presume? This is a little gift bag for you.

scenes.speaker: Martin
scenes.line: Oh! Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Free of charge. Follow me, I will show you where all the slaves work. [shakes head] Not… so, your desk is…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hi, I'm Jim. I'm new here.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh my god! It's really you!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, I was just doing a little joke there about how we'd never met…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I know. I don't care.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Awesome! Good to be back. The place looks really good.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's really good to see you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You, too.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Where do I stand with Pam? Um… no idea. I mean, we're friends. Always have been friends. Um… .that is where we stand.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well, well, well. Look what the cat dragged in from Stamford.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Fact – I am older. I am wiser. Do not mess with me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. Sounds good.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I don't know what you're talking about.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I have a smudge on my forehead?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. Looks good.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why are you looking at my forehead?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm not.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Meet my eye line, Jim!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I am.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Stop acting like an idiot!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hey, buddy. Welcome back.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey! How are you man? Good to see… you.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I'm good! How are you? So…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, I'm sorry. Are you sitting here now?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Um… unless you really, really want it back.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know, man, it's really you're call.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Cool, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [whispers] Let me get that for you.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yuh.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: This one taken? No. Good.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah. Jim is a nice guy. That's why I got the desk.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey, this came with the Stamford book. [Sets down box that says: Personnel Files Stamford CT Office Confidential] Can you take care of it?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh, yes I can.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: In general, they do not give me much responsibility. But they do let me shred the company documents. And that is really all I need.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Michael Scott. Thank you. I appreciate it, Mike.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hello. I don't believe we've been introduced. Dwight Schrute. Assistant Regional Manager.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Andy Bernard. Regional Director in Charge of Sales.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: So you'll be reporting to me, then.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Umm, on the contrary.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: My title has 'Manager' in it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: And I'm a director.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Which on a film set is the highest title there is. Do you know anything about film?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I know everything about film. I've seen over 240 of them.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Congratulations.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Toby!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey, Jim!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: How are you, man?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Oh, really good.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I just wanted to say hi.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: How are you? Hey. Welcome back. [puts out fist to bump]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh. Is that like your new thing?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: No, I'm sorry, it's…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. It's cool.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: No, it's nothing. We'll just… [shakes hand]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right. Good to be back.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: So… okay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: All right… sorry… sorry about that.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No problem.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: It was just…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [off camera] …what?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Nothing.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: This thing is so awesome. It will shred anything. Ooh! It will shred a CD. It will shred… a credit card. It will shred… oh! [whispers] Shoot.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [talking to himself] I present the orientation video.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We need to talk!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Not now.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Which is higher? Assistant Regional Manager or Regional Director in Charge of Sales?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I told you the titles are irrelevant. They just relate to pay scale.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
