scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'm gonna go get my banjo out of my car.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Perfect.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: What is going on?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: …I'm messing with Andy. I'm sending him to all the women in the office with… just… terrible information on how to get them to go out with him.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: I love it. I want in. Who's the target?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: …Oh, you know what? … It was… gonna be Pam, but…

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Perfect. What do I do? Just give me an assignment.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, you know what though? I feel like I already sicked him on Pam… we'll give her a break. Let's think of someone else.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right everybody, there has been a lot of name calling against our office today. Corporate maligning, slurring, much of it coming from one of you, who claims that prison is better… than… here. And none of can say "Boo" because none of us have ever been to prison. Well, there's somebody I'd like you to meet. Somebody else who has been to prison, who can tell you what it is really like [puts on bandanna]. I'm prison Mike! You know why they call me prison Mike?!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Do you really expect us to believe you're somebody else?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do you really expect me to not push you up against the wall, beeyotch?! [employees protest] All right, hey, hey, hey, hey, that's just the way we talk in the clink. Been a lot of fun talk about prison today, but I am here to scare you straight. I AM HERE TO SCARE YOU STRAIIIGHT!! In prison you are somebody's bitch. Oh, and you. [points to Ryan] You, my friend, would be da belle of da ball. Don't drop the soap! Don't drop the soap!

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Michael, please. [Michael makes kissing noises]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Where… did you learn all of this?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Internet.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So, not prison.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And prison. Eh, fifty-fifty, both. Look, prison stinks, is what I'm saying. It's not like you can go home, and, recharge your batteries, and come back in the morning and, be with your friends, having fun in the office.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What'd you do, Prison Mike?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I stole. … And I robbed. And I kidnapped… the… president's son. And held him for ransom.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That is… quite the rap sheet, Prison Mike.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And I nevah got caught, neither.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, you're… in… prison, but, mmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Prison Mike? What was the food like in prison?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Gruel. Sandwiches. Gruel omelettes. Nothing but gruel. Plus, you can eat your own hair.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Wow. Prison sounds horrible.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. Yeah. Well, thank you, Andy. Tanks.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Prison Mike. What's the very very worst thing about prison?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Don't encourage him, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The worst thing about prison was the… was the Dementors. They… were flying all over the place, and they were scary. And they'd come down, and they'd suck the soul out of your body, and it hurt!

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Demen-Dementors like in Harry Potter?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, not Harry Potter. … There are no movies in prison. This is my point! You guys got it soft, and cushy! This place is freaking awesome! The people are awesome! Your boss is nice! Everyone seems to get along! People are tolerant! People who… have jumped to conclusions can redeem themselves! Nobody is nobody's bitch. I hope that this scared you. And from me, Prison Mike, to you, I just wanna thank you for listening to me. Letting me be a part of your life today. 'Cause you got a good life! YOu got a good life. A good life. [turns around, takes bandanna off] So. What do you think? It doesn't sound so great, does it?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow. Thank you. Um, that must have been hard for you to relive that. Both of you.

scenes.speaker: Martin
scenes.line: Yeah, that… wasn't really… at all my experience. There were certain elements of what you performed, I've seen on television. But it didn't remind me of my time in prison.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. Okay, fine. You guys think prison is so great? All right. Well, here you go. [locks employees in conference room]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, Michael. Come on. Let us out.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No! If you think is prison is so wonderful, then, enjoy prison! They are such babies. I am going to leave them in there until they can appreciate what it's like to have freedom. And if this doesn't bother them, then I am out of ideas.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [knocking on door] Hey! Let us out of here! Hey! I have–

scenes.speaker: Hannah
scenes.line: Shh!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [answEring phone] This is Toby. Hey Pam. Where are you calling from?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Michael. Why's everyone locked in the conference room?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: They were very disrespectful to me, and to the office. And Martin has had a bad influence, to think that I gave him the benefit of the doubt.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, you're going to have to let 'em out. Or… or I will.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. You know what Toby? I am teaching them a lesson, so.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You know they're teasing you. I mean… obviously, this is… a much nicer place than an actual prison. We get paid to be here. We go home afterwards and have social lives. We have… we have parties here. They're teasing you. To be funny.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [unlocks door] Okay nutcases, get out of there! Good work. Long day. Really long. Why don't you guys head home. Early. Time off for good behavior! Heh. Good job. Enjoy your freedoms!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Martin went from being a new guy from Stamford… to a convict, to… my friend. Back to a convict. Then to… a kind of a nuisance, actually, to be completely honest. And finally, to… a quitter. And I will not miss him. And that is not because he is black.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [singing] So we've been told, and some choose to believe it, I know they're wrong, wait and see, 'cause one day we'll find it, the ainbowray onnectionkay, the lovers, the dreamers, and meeee…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Merry Christmas! [holds up dead goose and puts it on Pam's desk]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Merry Christ–[looks up] NO! Why… why did you bring that here?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Don't worry, she's dead. Oh wait. He's dead.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dwight, what uh…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I accidentally ran over it. It's a Christmas miracle!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, get it out of here.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Relax, OK. And because this is Christmas, I am going to roast this goose and prepare it with a wild rice dressing. Do we have any cayenne pepper in the kitchen?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Merry Christmas Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow. What have we got here?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What does it look like?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Dead goose.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: And circle gets the square.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [to Pam] So can you watch this? I'm gonna get my carving knife out of the trunk.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Oh, Dwight, we talked about this.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, Toby, this is different. He's already dead.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Once I brought in a duck. To prepare for lunch. And people got upset. Apparently, they got attached to the duck and didn't want to see it killed.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: He was already dead. And we Schrutes use every part of the goose. The meat has a delicious, smoky, rich flavor. Plus you can use the molten goose grease and save it in the refrigerator, thus saving you a trip to the store for a can of expensive goose grease.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow. Win-Win.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Exactly. Thank you, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I like goose. If it's already dead is it so crazy we eat it?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: That's crazy. It's crazy.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Dwight, you cannot keep that here.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ok, that is ridiculous. And totally against the spirit of Christmas.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Come on Dwight. We went over this, like for a half an hour.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's Christmas Toby.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: It's a dead animal in an office. You can't…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Toby…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I'm sorry.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [sighs] Please? Please?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Clean it in your car.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I would like it off my desk.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh Pam. Take a chill pill.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Riding a bicycle down the hallway and singing] Deck the halls with boughs of holly. Fa la la la la la la la la. [Struggling to stay on] 'Tis the … ack. [expletive] Hey! [to Pam] I would like a nice slice of Christmas Pam. Side of candied Pams. And perhaps, some Pam-chops, with mint…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Can I help you, Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm looking for the toy drive box.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's behind you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK… Well, I need to put this bike in there. I hope it'll fit, with all these little knickknacks.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow. What kind of bike is that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Umm… I don't know? Average kind?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: The tires look pretty worn.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, that is probably from the test drive.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: But the paint's chipping. Is that your old bike, Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yo, Michael, sweet ride Mike.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, thanks. [Michael and Andy do a fist bump and explosion.]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes? [Pam holds up a bag] Oh Pam, that is so sweet. You didn't have to do that.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [hands over bag] I didn't, it's from corporate.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK. Did everybody get one of these?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yup.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Terrific. Good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is going to be the best Christmas ever. My girlfriend Carol is coming to our party tonight, and I have a little surprise for her. [singing] I've got two tickets to paradise! Pack your bags, we're leaving the day-after-tomorrow! Um, taking her to Sandals, Jamaica, all-inclusive. All-inclusive. You know what that means? Right? Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Creed takes toy from toy drive box.] Oh, I think you're supposed to put a toy

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: And a happy holiday to you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Carol walks through door looking upset] [waves] Carol.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: Hi, is Michael around here?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There she is. A Christmas Carol. Hello [kisses Carol] You're about five hours early to the party. You're such a blonde. [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, everybody. I don't know who you haven't met yet, but I think this is one of them. This is my girlfriend – Carol. This is just the front of her. Show 'em, show 'em the other side.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: [whispers] What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Turn around, turn around. Come on. [making a body turning gesture]

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: Get outta here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, you get outta here.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Michael

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: If I may say. She's even prettier that you described her.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [standing up] Oh, ouch. Michael, I don't think there is anything wrong with the way you described her.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: I really need a moment alone with you. [Carol heads towards Michael's office.]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Not as much as I need a moment alone with you. [puts finger on her back and reaches for her butt] Berp.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: What is this? [Holds up a Christmas photo]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That is my Christmas card. It's a picture of you and me and your kids on a ski trip, having a blast. Ski-sons Greetings.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: No. See, we never went on a ski trip.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: I went on a ski trip.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: Two years ago with my kids and my ex-husband.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, but what you didn't realize at the time was that I was with you in a sense. I was in your heart…

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And next to your kids. What?

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: This is so weird.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't understand?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's a bold move, to Photoshop yourself into a picture with your girlfriend and her kids on a ski trip with their real father. But then again, Michael's a bold guy. [Towards unseen cameraman] Is bold the right word?

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: I think you're a really sweet guy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: But, um, I don't know how to deal with, with this thing [waves Christmas card]. And, and the proposal. And I don't think things are going to work out with us.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no no no Ok, OK, You know what, you're not thinking straight. You know what you need? You need to think this through in [making drum noise] Jamaica's largest fresh water pool.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: What are you talking about?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I got us tickets to Sandals, Jamaica, We leave day after tomorrow. [Carol shakes head in disappointment]. You better find the skimpiest bikini there is.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: Oh, no. Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And it's all inclusive.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: Michael…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: I'm sorry.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, Carol. You walk out that door and it is over.

scenes.speaker: Carol
scenes.line: I know. [Closes door.]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Psst. Jim. [Jim turns around. Pam nods head towards her for him to come over] Um, hey. I need to give you your Christmas gift now because, well, I'll just tell you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: For the past few months I've been sending Dwight letters from the CIA. [hands a folder to Jim]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you serious?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: They're considEring him for a top secret mission. There's his application. Oh, and this is where I made him list every secret he promised he'd never ever tell.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Opens folder and reads from Dwight's file] Last year, my boss, Michael Scott, took a day off because he said he had pneumonia, but really, he was leaving early to go to magic camp. Wow.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So… here's the gift. You get to decide what his top secret mission is. [Jim smiles] Sorry I didn't wrap it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [closes folder] You know what? Uh, I really don't think I should be doing this stuff anymore, you know?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, because of the promotion.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It just feels a little bit, like…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, I get it, of course. OK. [holds out hand for folder. Jim gives Pam back the folder.]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I feel like there's a chance for me to start over. And if I fall back into the same kind of things I used to do., then … what am I doing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'd like everybody's attention. Christmas is canceled.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: You can't cancel a holiday.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Keep it up Stanley and you will lose New Year's.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: What does that mean?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jim, take New Year's away from Stanley.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael, what's going on?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Carol and I split up. Amicably. And I just don't think it would be appropriate to celebrate under the circumstances.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Will they still air 'Rudolph?'

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: That's not fair.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [over everybody else's talking] Are we gonna cancel Hanukah as well?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Fine! [everybody stops talking] Have your party. Just no guests.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: But we invited guests.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, you know what Phyllis? All of your guests would have probably canceled at the last minute anyway, leaving your life a stupid rotten mess.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, oh, oh, oh, it hurts.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I know.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It hurts my heart. It hurts my stomach. It hurts my arms.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: OK, well, why are you laying like that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [moves a little] Thanks. How did you push away the bad thoughts?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Like what?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Like maybe, the real reason they left was because there were things they wanted you to do in bed, that were, foreign, and scary?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well… um I, I don't…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And not that you didn't want to try them. Some wine may have helped. Do you know what I'm referring to?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't need to know.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael. Sorry to interrupt. Uh, It appears we're one bathrobe short.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Take it from Toby.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Copy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, would you like to go to Sandals, Jamaica with me?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's all… [Pam walks away.] OK.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey Dwight. Pretty nice robe- [Dwight grabs bag with robe in it and walks away.] Why?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Phyllis, I need you to pick up green streamers at lunch.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I thought you said green was whorish.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No, orange is whorish.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Uh, so I had a couple of ideas to make the Stamford people feel more at home. Each year we have a Christmas raffle … [Phyllis and Pam nod their heads in agreement].

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It would never work here.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Ok … um, another idea was karaoke …

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: A Christmas drinking game …

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: God help you.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: These are all terrible ideas and none of them are on the theme of "A Nutcracker Christmas." I think you should leave.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: You're kidding.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: You tried this out, and it's clearly not for you. It's time to go. Come on. [Angela gets up from seat] Please. [Karen gets up and leaves] Thank you. OK, thank you very much. [Angela closes door]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What are you doing? ["Goodbye My Lover" by James Blunt plays]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [putting things into a box] We are getting rid of everything that reminds you of Carol.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey, what's the haps? [Dwight shuts door in his face.]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Carol?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, look at this. [looks through papers] Your old condo closing papers. It's riddled with Carol's name. I wish I could throw this in the box. [Michael hits repeat to "Goodbye My Lover" on computer]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why don't you just buy the whole song?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't have to buy it. I just want to taste it. I just… I just want a little taste of it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, look at this, she saved you two thousand dollars 'cause they failed to report a mold problem. [Continues to sift through papers] But wouldn't that affect the final… How did she? Oh, oh, I see what she did. That is good. Wow. Carol is one smart cookie.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [singing] Goodbye my lover. Goodbye my friend. [hits repeat again]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is an old adage, but they say when you find true love, you know within the first 24 hours. With Carol, I knew within the first 24 minutes of the second day I met her.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I feel like I've been kinda cold to Karen and there's no real reason for it. I mean it's not like she's ever done anything to me. So, I think I probably shouldn't be cold to her.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, Karen. Sorry about that meeting today, that was really crazy.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Yeah, right? I'm so glad you said that. Because, I don't know how those meetings usually go.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Um, usually like that.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Does anyone ever stand up to Angela or…?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I think one of her cats did once. She came in with scratches all over her face. [both laugh]

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Um, I really liked your karaoke idea.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Oh cool, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That could really be fun.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Oh, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You guys do a raffle?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Yeah, we do a raffle…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey Kev.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hey. [Toby puts hand on Kevin's back, who is wearing the robe and feels it a little bit.]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: This should've been up yesterday. [refers to party flyer]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: It'll be all right.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [Pam puts up another flyer] What is that? [Reads flyer] The "Committee to Plan Parties invites you to a margarita-karaoke Christmas?" There's no such thing as the "Committee to Plan Parties."

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: There is now. We just started it.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Well, you just can't start a committee. You have to have funding.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: What's your funding?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Two hundred dollars.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What's ours again?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Umm, two hundred and one dollars.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh right.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [pointing] Hey, a margarita-karaoke Christmas party, that sounds like fun.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Please.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: He does your laundry?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Long story. All right everybody, circle up. Here we go. You know what this is? This is the "Amazing Race." [To Ryan and Stanley] And you guys are the retired marines. [To Phyllis and Karen] And you guys are the mother and daughter. [To Dwight and Jim] And you guys are the gay couple. And we are the firefighter heroes. Are we ready to go?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Wait, "Amazing Race" like, the biggest sale wins?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, we're just going to rush out, do the sales thing, and come back.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Is there a prize?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just bragging rights.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Then how is this "Amazing Race"?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's just… brrrrrr… It's "Amazing Race," Phyllis. Okay? We're in teams of two and we are on a mission. All right, so, on your mark, get set, go. Let's do it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Come on!!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Michael. [Michael throws Phyllis' keys under the car.]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Whoah, whoah. Oh hahahaha. Vamanos!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Bueno.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Do you have a pole?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Let's go get a broom.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Seriously? You're going to sit in the back?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Uh, yeah. It's the safest part of the car. In the event of a crash, the driver always protects his side of the car first.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Here we go.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: In order to take down Dwight, I have to chip away at his ally, which, in this case, is Michael. Here's the good news. Every success I've ever had at my job or with the lady-folk has come from my ability to slowly and painfully wear someone down.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What's the deal with Dwight doing your laundry?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ugh… that is a long story. Um, couple of months ago, Dwight tried to go behind my back with Jan and get my job and I am now having him do my laundry as punishment.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Wow, that is a long story, but quite well told, Michael. I find it very interesting. Especially about the part Dwight going behind your back and basically, like, being a terrible person. You know if you want your laundry done right? I used to work at Abercrombie. So, pretty good folder.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Hey Pam. Would you like to go with me to grab a coffee?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yeah, I could use some fresh air. Might be fun.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ok. Sure.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Why are we turning in here, this is a beauty salon?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Um-hmmm.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hey, do you mind if I take the lead on this one and then you can critique me after?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: You want the lead?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah, if you don't mind.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Mind? Nothing would delight me more.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Leave the keys.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You still do that thing?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Leave the keys!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I think you have assembled an amazing team at Scranton. It's really a pleasure to be a part of it. It's like, everyone has their own special skill, you know, just like the Superfriends. Except for Dwight, who is more like a SuperDud. I mean, he would be a Superfriend if there was a Superfriend whose super power was always being late. You know?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hawkman.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: My plan is taking longer than I thought but I don't give up easily. I have walked two marathons.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Walks out of the Ladies' Restroom] Let's go. The men's room was disgusting.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: After you sir.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No thank you, I never let anyone walk behind me. Seven out of ten attacks are from the rear.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok, well, that still leaves a 30% chance that I will attack you from the front.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Uh, yeah, but it will be easier to stop. I can always block the blow. I can counter it with… [Jim slaps Dwight]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Angela, you seem so happy. I bet you wish you were like this all the time.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: This friend of mine – let's call her Noelle – she missed this deadline turning something in to Corporate in New York. But then this gallant gentleman – we'll call him Kurt – he drove all the way to New York and handed it in for her. That's… I don't know. I guess he really just likes her a lot.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's great.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yes, it is. [Walks up to the counter where there is no employee] Hello?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, did you catch that up at Lake Wallenpaupack?

scenes.speaker: Buyer
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know, I used to go up there all the time with my step-dad, and I never caught anything that big.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Caught an eighty-pound shark off of Montauk. It's in the Hamptons. My dad's got a 42-ft Bayliner. Sniped it with a rifle from the crow's nest. Also shot a deer once.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what? Let's get right down to it. Dunder-Mifflin may be just two rooms and a warehouse, but what we lack in flash, we will make up for with hardwork and decency.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ok, this is the classic undersell because you should know we don't work out of a log cabin. We trade on the New York Stock Exchange. Ever heard of it? It's in New York.

scenes.speaker: Buyer
scenes.line: Uh, I have to say I am a little wary with getting involved with a big company. We've had some problems in the past.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think what Andy is trying to express is that while we have the resources of a large company, we will give you the care and attention of a small company.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, man, that is, like, poetry.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I swear, this guy could sell paper to a tree.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stop it. [Puts his hand on Andy's shoulder] Stop it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ow.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dunder Mifflin, this is Pam. [excited] This is Pam. I did?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh man. Talk about your classic "Lame dash O." Do we even want that guy buying our paper?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I… I'm so sorry man. I really screwed that up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ah, no. Don't worry about it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I really 'Schruted' it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: 'Schruted' it. It's just this thing that people say around your office all the time. Like, when you screw something up in a really irreversible way, you 'Schruted' it. I don't know where it comes from though. Do you think it comes from Dwight Schrute?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know. Who knows how words are formed.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: It's a big order. Thanks Kenny.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Yeah, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hey, how's Annie?

scenes.speaker: Kenny
scenes.line: Oh, she's great. This is us last year in Bermuda. Lovely place. You ever been to Bermuda?

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: Stanley Hudson.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Ah, Julius, how's it goin'?

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: Great, great, great.

scenes.speaker: Guy
scenes.line: Stanley.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: So good to see you too. I'd like you fellas to meet Ryan Howard.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I'm gonna let Ryan do a little pitch for you while I do my crossword. Ryan?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Um… [To the Buyers] Hi. Hi. Hi. Hi.

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: Hello, Ryan. What do you have for us?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Oh…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We can offer our biggest discounts on 30% recycled and ultra-premium laser.

scenes.speaker: Man
scenes.line: 'Kay. 'Kay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Can I use your phone?

scenes.speaker: Man
scenes.line: Yeah, sure, go ahead.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Let me talk to you about a few of the other things we can offer. Namely, we know the tax season is coming up, so by April 1st we can have you fully stocked.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [On Phone] One…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We have discount prices on ink cartridges…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Three…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And, also, any forms that you are going to need…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Seven…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We can custom make them.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah I did a watercolor of Frances Willard Elementary School for a contest they were having. They were calling with the results. And I won. I won! My painting won. So I like to thank my mom for always encouraging me. And I like to thank my dad for buying me my first set of art pencils. And I'd like to thank the sixth grade class that picked me.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey Kev, guess what. I won an art contest today.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: How much did you win?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I won $400 bucks on the Celtics game last night.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Cool. Congratulations.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Thanks, so sweet.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Ha ha ha! And you just said, "Hi! Hi! Hi!" Ha heh ha! You sounded like my niece, and she's six months old!

scenes.speaker: Man
scenes.line: We'll I appreciate what you guys are saying but it, uh, makes more fiscal sense to go with one of the big guys.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Sure.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sure, that's true we can't compete with their prices. But let me ask you something. How important to you is customer service?

scenes.speaker: Man
scenes.line: It's very.

scenes.speaker: Phone
scenes.line: Please keep holding, your call is very important to us.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Erm, that's one of the 'Big guys.' Been on hold this whole time.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Dials cell Phone] And this is Dunder-Mifflin.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Dunder-Mifflin customer service, this is Kelly.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Kelly, it's Jim.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Oh my god, Jim. How are you ? I wanted to tell you … . [Jim hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Here is my card. It's got my Cell number, my pager number, my home number, and my other pager number. I never take vacations, I never get sick, and I don't celebrate any major holidays.

scenes.speaker: Man
scenes.line: All right, I get it. We got a deal.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, Angela. I got good news today too. I won an art contest.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: That's great Pam. I like having these little moments with you. You know what? Sprinkles recently had kittens.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I would like to offer you the dominant male. His name is Ash.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Mmm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hmm. I don't think so. But thanks. My building manager… is… You understand.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Well then. Have a nice day.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Thanks. That was fun.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah, I really enjoy spending time with you. You are a very nice person.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I'm so glad you're with Jim. He was hung up on Pam for such a long time. Never thought he would get over her.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: That's nice.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: You can pay me back later for the makeover.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey boss. Got a minute?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, Andy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I forget, why did Dwight say he was late this morning?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: He didn't say.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That's weird. Because I was just walking past his desk and I saw this, which is a tollbooth receipt from New York City, stamped really early this morning. So, why would Dwight go to New York without telling anyone? Do you think he went to see Jan? That's not like him. Is it? Someone told me a story about this, with, like, laundry and betrayal. Did you betray Dwight and try to steal his job or something?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, you are remembEring it wrong.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight betrayed me once before. So this is his strike two. You know what they say? Fool me once, strike one. But fool me twice, strike three.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I like Karen. She's pretty and appears intelligent.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I like pretty women who have the appearance of intelligence.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: My girlfriend is also beautiful and smart. She could be a model or a college professor which is intimidating to a lot of guys.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We should go on a double date.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Dwight's name is on the security sign-in sheet, but I don't know who he met with. And where it asks to state your business, he wrote "Beeswax. Not yours, Inc."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I knew it. [Dwight and Jim walk in]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, doggie.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Hey, do you want to grab a coffee?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sure. Look at you!

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Beesley, coffee?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, thanks. I had some already.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, but, hey, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I won an art contest today.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No way! All right Pam. Congratulations. [high five]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Which one was it?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I sent in one of my watercolors.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Cool.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It was the new one I did.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: You ready Jim?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. Can I see it when I get back?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Congratulations.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Big deal.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey, we nailed the sale!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Where were you this morning?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I overslept. Damn rooster didn't crow.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why do you lie, liar?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I am not a liar.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You are lying right now.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It sure seems like he is lying.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Stay out of this, you!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know that you went to corporate this morning, and I know that you lied about it. And given our history, I need you tell me this instant exactly what you were doing.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael, I cannot tell you what I was doing there. But you have to trust me, I would never do anything to hurt you or this company.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, you know what? I want you to think about your future in this company. I want you to think about it long and hard.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's what she said.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't. Don't you dare. I want to know what you were doing this morning by the end of the day.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's going to be ok.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: How is going to be ok, Dwight? Everyone will know our business.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's not the worst thing in the world. I'll just stand up in front of the office and reveal our true love. It won't be that bad. Look at Kelly and Ryan.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I hate those two people more than anything in the entire world.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well, I don't have a lot of choices.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: So, let me ask you a question.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Did you ever have a thing for Pam?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pam? Did I ever have a 'thing' for her? No, why? Did she say something?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: I moved here from Connecticut…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. Ok, here's the … I had a crush on her before I left. And I told her about it and she didn't feel the same way. So, it didn't amount to anything, and I left. I'm really glad you're here. 'Kay?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: 'Kay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ahem-hem-hem. May I have your attention please? This will only take a moment of your time. Although I love this company more than almost anything in the world, I have decided to step down from my post and spend more time with my family. I do not fear the unknown and I will meet my new challenges head-on and I will succeed. And I will laugh in the faces of those who doubt me. It has been a pleasure working with some of you and I will not forget those of you soon but remember, while today it is me, we all shall fall. In other words, I am quitting. So… .

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oompa-Loompa Doompity-Dawesome, Dwight is now gone which is totally awesome. Why was he gone, he was such a nice guy? No, he was not. He was a total douche. Doompity-doomp.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I would like to give the rest of my belongings to Michael Scott. Just take them. Except this.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good luck.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Dwight will be missed. Not by me so much, but, he will be missed.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Dwight, from sales, was one of the most honorable and efficient employees this company has ever had.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: One of my life goals was to die right here in my desk chair. And today, that dream was shattered.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey man. [Dwight hugs Jim and leaves]

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: What happened on your sales call?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Um, am I happy the way things turned out? Oh, well, happy's such an ugly word. But, um, I saw what needed to be done and I did it and now I'm thrilled. So, it's pretty… [camera had focused in on Angela watching] Hello? Pretty good.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I have left Dunder-Mifflin after many record-breaking years and am officially on the job market. And it's very exciting.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: For your convenience, I've broken it down into three parts: professional resume, athletic and special skills resume, and Dwight Schrute trivia.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I am ready to face any challenges that might be foolish enough to face me.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: How would I describe myself? Three words. Hard-working, Alpha male, Jackhammer, Merciless, Insatiable.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: There is nothing on my horizon except everything. Everything is on my horizon.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [in Staples uniform] I got this job to make some money while I continue my employment search. And uh, it's fine for the time being. Oops. Break's over.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [to Ryan] Big Turkey. [cellphone plays "Rockin' Robin"]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Is that you singing?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: All four parts. Recorded it on my computer. It took me forever.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nice job.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Thank you muchly. [cellphone continues playing]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You gonna answer it?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I called it myself. I just thought you'd get a kick out of the new ring.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yikes.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Side note. I'd just like to say I'm thrilled to be working directly beneath you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I feel I have a lot to learn from you, even though you're younger and have less experience. So here's to the future… Andy and the Tuna. [sings] Andy and the tuna…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I miss Dwight. Congratulations, universe. You win.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, Dwight Schrute has left this company. More personnel turnover.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: The cost of doing business.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, well. It is a big loss. Dwight was the top salesman…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Was the top salesman…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I said 'was'.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [chuckles] Addition by subtraction.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What does that even mean? That is impossible.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Mmmm. Yeah you're right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: But, there is some good news. Oscar is back. Addition by addition. So we are going to have a big party today to welcome him back and hopefully that will lift everybody's spirits.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Hey, everyone.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh, hello, Oscar. How was your gay-cation?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Oh, that's very funny.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah? I thought of it like, two seconds after you left.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [sits at his desk] Hi, Angela.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oscar.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey, boss.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, what's up.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Noooothin'. Ehrrrrrrrrr. Heh. Man. TGI-Wednesday. Am I right?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Gonna go home. Get my beer on. Get my "Lost" on. What are you doing later, wanna hang out?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know. Maybe.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, I will take that as a maybe. [Michael gets up] Where are you going?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Bathroom.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, well, I'm going to the kitchen, I'll walk with you.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [lurking by the bathroom door] Yeah, things are going pretty good. Gettin' a lot of face time with the boss.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oscar? I have a question. Would you like to join the party planning committee?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: The one of all women?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Because I'm gay?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No. No. Certain events have transpired. And I've thought about certain things. And I'm sorry for the way those certain events transpired. [starts to cry] And I would just like to make some changes about certain things and certain situations.

scenes.speaker: Oscar

scenes.line: No. Wholesies. [snatches the candy bar]

scenes.line: Natch. [bites off a lot of candy bar]

scenes.line: Yep. If you don't mind, I think I'll hang some of these posters around my neighborhood. Schools, post office, et cetera.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You know, I may have underestimated you. You're not a total ass. [coughs]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK, I am really going to do this.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Good luck, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what? I need my girls with me. Pam, Karen, even Phyllis. Come on. Let's do this. Let's do it. [sighs]

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: OK, remember, be strong.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I love you guys. Now I'm getting her voicemail.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Don't leave a –

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [leaving a message] Hey, Jan. It's me, Michael. I'm just calling to say that I think we need a little break, permanently. And, uh, I know everybody says this, but I-I wanna remain friends. Or at least business associates who get along. Oh, just so you know, it's not me, it's you. [Jan walks in] OK, buddy. Somebody just walked in. I have to go. Um, so I'll talk to you later.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Michael… [clears throat] I was, um… I was really unhappy with our conversation earlier. And I… I just – I couldn't stop thinking about it. So I decided that I would drive down here and apologize to you in person. So… [takes Michael's hand] I'm sorry.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: So… we're good?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Abso-fruit-ly.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [cell phone vibrates] Oh. Hold on, I'm sorry.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No… No…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: One second. Oh! It's from you. Uh, you wanna grab some dinner?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: OK. [voice on phone] "It's me, Michael. I'm just calling to say that I think we need a little break, permanently. And, uh, I know everybody says this, but I want…"

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Maybe some Italian. [voice on phone] "… to remain friends. Or at least business associates -" [Jan takes the phone away from her ear] Chinese? [voice on phone] "who get along. Oh, just so you know, it's not me, it's you. OK, buddy."

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Oh. [door closes]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sighs] Any man who says he totally understands women is a fool. Because they are un-understandable. There's a wishing fountain at the mall. And I threw a coin in for every woman in the world and made a wish. I wished for Jan to get over me. I wished for Phyllis, a plasma TV. I wished for Pam to gain courage. I wished for Angela, a heart, and for Kelly, a brain. "Michael, how can you appreciate women so much but also dump one of them?" You mean, how can I be so illogical and flighty and unpredictable and emotional? Well, maybe I learned something from women after all.

scenes.line: [phone rings] Dunder-Mifflin paper/sex predator hotline, this is Dwight Schrute.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Dwight. It's Jim.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jim, what are you doing? I'm busy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, you're not. I'm looking right at you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ugh. I'm hanging up.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Don't. [quietly] I have information about the sex predator.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You have information about the sex predator?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I saw him two minutes ago.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Where?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: In the women's bathroom, above the sink.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [hangs up and runs to the women's bathroom] Anti-flashing task force! Above the sink. Above the sink. Hmm. [sees himself in the mirror with two black marks on the mirror making a mustache, removes his glasses and figures it out] PAM!

scenes.line: Love it.

scenes.line: Are you reading it everyday, like we decided you would?

scenes.line: Uh, yes, I am.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Good, good, it's the best business reporting isn't it?

scenes.line: Uh, yeah, it's okay. Its just, I don't think the cartoons are very funny.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Wait, wait, what cartoons?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The a cartoon that goes with each article. This one says Mel Karmazin? I don't, I don't know. I guess I get it.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [Sigh]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We should really start recycling.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Right uh, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Hey, what's going on?

scenes.line: Phyllis got flashed in the parking lot.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [Screams]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Okay, you need to stop that right now.

scenes.speaker: Bob Vance
scenes.line: Phyllis, you okay? You sure?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey good lookin', what ya got cookin'?

scenes.line: I got nothing cooking, it's cooked. It's borscht and its served cold.

scenes.line: Hey listen, I'm sure everyone's already told you but, your presentation out there, was pretty inspiring stuff. Must be nice being a woman around here, knowing they have a protector in you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: If you are trying to kiss my ass, I would not suggest it. Believe me, you do not want to kiss this ass.

scenes.line: Borscht, according to Dwight it's best served cold. You know what else is best served cold? Yeah, gazpacho. You see what I'm doing? I am establishing a mutual love of cold soups. This is the first step in my plan to win Dwight's trust.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I should make you my vichyssoise.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I will never be your vichyssoise.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Orgasms, why can women have them? Yep?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. I'm not a lawyer, but I don't think this is the place to do this.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sometimes I imagine what it would be like to be a woman. I have a full-length mirror in my bathroom, and before I get dressed I will tuck myself between my legs just to see. And, um, it's uncomfortable. So maybe I do understand.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [sings] We're going to the mall. Bye Ryan, bye.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Lets go, fall out, let's go. Move, move, move, move, move.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I got shotgun. Damn it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Let me be clear. There's only one thing that's important to me, and its not friendship. Its dominance, and I think I know a thing or two about dominating. Okay, I lived with a dominatrix for three years in Stamford. Mistress Lila. Taught me more than any college professor I ever had, while attending Cornell, which is where I went to school.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Look at that! Come on! Free underwear!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It is totally inappropriate, but on the other hand…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, Pam, how bout something like that for you. Could sort of cover up any imperfections in the mid section. Just show off the twins a little bit.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's pretty cool.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You can make people believe anything. Today I made Dwight believe I like cold soups. Why? I don't know. I don't have to know. That's what makes me so dangerous.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Idiot.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I learned a lot about women today. And any man who says he totally understands women is a fool. Because they are un-understandable. Jan and I broke up. Why? Because she didn't like one message I left on her voicemail? But that is her peariagative. I thought I understood women, but maybe, can't believe I'm gonna say this, maybe, women don't understand themselves.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ughh… Blech.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: OK, where does it hurt?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just… all over. I don't want to do anything… I'm dying…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, that's not how it works. You have to point to a specific part of the body.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Right there. [Michael points to computer screen.]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [reading from screen] "Abdomen. Menses."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Maybe.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: "The uterus contracts after your egg passes through it."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Not it. I don't have eggs.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: About 40 times a year, Michael gets really sick, but has no symptoms. Dwight is always gravely concerned.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, is it possible you ate food that contained animal waste?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's possible.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uh-huh?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: David Wallace is on line one.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The CFO? Ohh…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK, everybody out. Out. Out. Out. OK.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: To what do I owe this great honor, David Wallace?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: [on phone] Michael, I am calling—

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And Gromit. [David sighs] Jan? Is Jan there?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Jan is out of town right now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, you sigh like Jan. I broke Jan's heart, David, and it was awful. It was… It was never my intention to ruin a life. But you know what? Sometimes…

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: …you just gots to get your freak on.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmmm.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I am calling to see if you can come down and interview for a job we have opening in corporate.

scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Week from today. Bring your first quarter stats and your recommendation for who would take over the Scranton Branch.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow. I wish I had prepared something to say.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: That's not necessary.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: May God guide you in your quest.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK, everybody have their towels and swim suits? We have about an hour and half. I suggest that you all go potty now and then we will be congregating on the partay bus.

scenes.line: Oh I'm excited. Today is Beach Day! And Michael is taking the whole office to the beach. So I'm wearing my bathing suit underneath my shirt [lifts up shirt, definitely

scenes.line: Oscar, you brought your Speedo, I assume?

scenes.line: I don't wear a Speedo, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, you can't swim in leather pants. [laughs] I'm just yankin' your chain. Not literally.

scenes.line: Anybody need sun block? Got SPF 30.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, you know what? Uh, you're not going.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: It's Beach Day…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, I know. I'm sorry, Toby. We… um… Somebody has to stay here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I want today to be a beautiful memory… that the staff and I share after I have passed on to New York. And if Toby is a part of it… then it'll suck.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey, want my sun screen?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, great. I forgot mine and I'm wearing a two piece.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Uh-huh.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thanks Toby.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey Pam, I have a very important job for you

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I thought we were just having fun at the beach.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We are. We are. But, I would like you to take notes. And I want you to find out about people's character. Not their hotness, per se, but their humor, and their charisma, and the indefinable quality that makes you all glad to follow me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What happens to a company if somebody takes their boss away? I will answer your question with a question. It's like what happens to a chicken when you take its head away. It dies. Unless you find a new head. I need to see which one of these people have the skills to be a chicken head.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You want me to write down people's indefinable qualities?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I want you to write down everything that people are doing all day. And then type it up, in a way that is helpful. Alright?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I have the most boring job in the office, so… why wouldn't I have the most boring job on beach day?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This way to the partay bus.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I just want to lie on the beach and eat hot dogs. That's all I've ever wanted.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [singing] [Angela mouthing the words next to him] And the night got deathly quiet, and his face lost all expression. Said, "If you're gonna play the game, boy, ya gotta learn to play it right." [rest of office joins in at varying times] You got to know when to hold 'em, know when to fold 'em, Know when to walk away and know when to run. You never count your money when you're sittin' at the table. There'll be time enough for countin' when the dealin's done.

scenes.line: Everybody, may I have you attention please? Today, we are not just spending a day at the beach.

scenes.line: Oh, sweet mother of God.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: If you don't like it, Stanley, you can go to the back of the bus.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Excuse me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Or the front of the bus. Or drive the bus. Just, we are all participating in mandatory fun activities. Funtivities! And there is a special secret prize for the winner!

scenes.line: Yes! Funtivities! I knew it wasn't just a trip to the beach.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, you know what? Your enthusiasm's turning people off.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I hope there will be management parables.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, [whispEring] Hey Pam, did you get that down?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Like what?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Like everything I said and everything they did and… Just don't…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well… no, I don't… exactly… what?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well write it down before you forget it. That's… You've just been drawing pictures. [sighs] Rrrr. I can't stay mad at you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Here we are ladies and gentlemen. Everybody ready? Last one down is a rotten egg. [Gets off bus] Watch out for snakes!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Everyone put on sunscreen.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright, find a cozy spot. Everybody settle in. [everybody sits down on beach] OK, everybody up! Circle 'round. [motions for circle to form] Let us play some games. We are situated on the northeast corner of scenic Lake Scranton. America's eighth largest indigenous body of water. It is here that a group of Americans will undergo the ultimate challenge. One day, 14 strangers who work together, but only one survivor.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just words. Inspiring words. [under breath] Not a contender. [out loud] For the competitions, you will be divided into four tribes. Each tribe will have a leader that I will pick randomly off the top of my head without thinking. Jim, Dwight, Andy and Stanley.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Choose your tribes. Except for Pam. Not Pam.

scenes.line: Jim Halpert. Pros: smart, cool, good-looking. Remind you of anybody you know? Cons: not a hard worker. I can spend all day on a project, and he will finish the same project in a half an hour. So that should tell you something.

scenes.line: I choose Michael!

scenes.line: I'm not playing.

scenes.line: OK, temp.

scenes.line: Dwight is an obvious candidate for my job. He has the best sales record in the office. He loves the work. He is, however, an idiot.

scenes.line: We will be called Gryffindor.

scenes.line: [starts chanting] Vol-de-mort, Vol-de-mort …[Kevin and Karen follow] Vol-de-mort! Vol-de-mort! Vol-de-mort!

scenes.line: OK, seriously. You really shouldn't be saying that.

scenes.line: Very good. Pam, please take a note that Andy is patriotic.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Andy Bernard. Pros: He's classy. He gets me. He went to Cornell. I trust him. Cons: I don't really trust him.

scenes.line: It is time for the great spoon and egg race. This one is with a little twist.

scenes.line: There's already a twist, you're carrying an egg on a spoon.

scenes.line: Come on Phyllis, you can do it. [Phyllis' egg falls off spoon] Ahh…

scenes.line: Thank you so much. [Stanley sits down and pulls out his crossword puzzle]

scenes.line: Don't worry. You're not…

scenes.line: No where near the big rock.

scenes.line: [takes off blindfold] I just don't want to get hit by it…

scenes.line: What're you doing? No! See, now we're disqualified.

scenes.line: I am okay if I lose every single contest today. Honestly. Because I see these contests as an opportunity for me to demonstrate what a good sport I am. Mallard! [throws a stone]

scenes.line: What are you saying?

scenes.line: OK, I apologize for yelling at you.

scenes.line: That's what being a good captain is about. It's about listening to the members of your team.

scenes.line: I am trying to bring team spirit.

scenes.line: [off screen] Pam…you're missing things. [shakes off hand and starts writing in notebook]

scenes.line: [at Ryan holding egg in spoon] Let's go! Let's go! Come on! Mush! Mush! Come on you bastard! [Ryan takes off blindfold and throws it to ground along with egg and spoon] What the? Damn it temp!

scenes.line: [begins to clap] Great job everyone, that was fantastic. [Michael sighs]

scenes.line: Okay Pam, I have another little project for you.

scenes.line: Does it have to do with these shopping bags filled with hot dogs?

scenes.line: Smart as a whip! Yes! [holds up hot dog packages] These are pre-cooked, so it's not absolutely necessary, but I would appreciate it if you could heat up 800 hot dogs for a little contest I'm going to be having. I would greatly appreciate it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How am I supposed to… get…

scenes.line: Thanks a bunch.

scenes.line: A good manager has got to be hungry. Hungry for success.

scenes.line: OK, who's hungry [Kevin starts to put hot dog in mouth] No, no, no. Do not touch the food. Please. Not yet. That is our next event. A hot dog eating contest. scenes.line: Can I have a turkey burger?

scenes.line: Come on, the winner gets a big, big prize.

scenes.line: [eating hot dog] What is it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I can't say.

scenes.line: You can't say, or you can't pronounce it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [points at Stanley] Word. [Stanley starts eating hot dog] There we go. Let's see it.

scenes.line: Aaaaaand, go!

scenes.line: Excellent!

scenes.line: Sorry! Bye, Andy!

scenes.line: Please just check.

scenes.line: In well?

scenes.line: As well.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Yes. uh, huh.

scenes.line: Wait a minute.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: That would be fine.

scenes.line: If this job is in a well, I don't want it.

scenes.line: [whispEring] Cut it out!

scenes.line: I don't!

scenes.line: What does a great manager need most of all? Courage.

scenes.line: Your loss, Stanley. Meanwhile the rest of us will have a super fun time defeating our fear and creating a lasting memory. Walking through FIRE!

scenes.line: Who among you has the guts to replace me? Let him walk across these coals.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Are you going to try it?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I'm not going to talk through the fire after your disgusting feet have gone through.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Angela, it is a million degrees.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm gonna do it. And I fully expect to burn my feet and go to the hospital. That's the right spirit when doing a coal walk, right?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. No, not you, Pam. You have to keep score.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'd like to try it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pointless.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: But I'm not kidding. I really want to do it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Blah, blah, blee blup, blup, okay? This is about guts. It takes guts to be a regional manager. Jim, you're up.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nope.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ji… why not? C'mon.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, 'cause I don't want my feet to get burned.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You do not have what it takes to be a regional manager.

scenes.line: That's harsh.

scenes.line: Who's next? Andy? Where's Andy? Andy is never here today.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Why don't you go Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because I already did. Remember? I burned my foot on a George Foreman grill.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And that is not the same at all. If you're going to ask other people to do it, you should do it yourself.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright. Okay. Alright. Fine. 'kay. [clears throat, breathes noisily] The mind has to wrap around the foot. [exhales] Okay.

scenes.line: Do you want us to count to three?

scenes.line: Yes. Count to three, please.

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Three. Two. One.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Count the other way. Count… no, no, count one, two, three, not three, two, one.

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: One. Two. Three! Go! Do it! Go, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wait! Am I going on go? Or am I going on three?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: On the go that's after three.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: One, two, three, go!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No! It's okay. I will do this Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't, don't.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [walking on coals] I will walk and stand on these coals until you award me the position of regional manager!

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Wow. Go, Dwight. Keep moving.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [standing still, on the coals] GIVE ME THE JOB! GIVE ME THE JOB!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm not going to give it to you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [falling on his knees, then on all fours] Aaagh, aaagh!

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: [yelling excitedly for Dwight to get off the coals]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael, do something!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Aggggh, that stings!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Being the boss is also about image. I've never looked like that. That was gross. I just, I don't see the connection between a firewalk and management. Worst seventy-five bucks I ever spent. You know what, if I had to pick my replacement based on today, it would be Mr. "Outside Hire."

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Or Mrs. "Outside Hire."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. Ummm, hmm… True. Look, I don't want to leave this branch that I love to an outside hire therefore we are going to have a one hundred point winner take all sudden death tribal council round. To test the aspect of my job that I think is the most important, something I call the Bob Hope factor.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Who's Bob Hope?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: God! He's a comedian.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Oh, like Amanda Bynes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Who's Amanda Bynes?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: She's from "What a Girl Wants."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, I love that movie. Yes, Kelly is right, the person to replace me has to have a great sense of humor and they have to possess the leadership qualities of a Bynes or a Hope. So without further ado, Jim and Dwight show us what you got.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, I know what you're looking for, but um, I got to be honest, I really don't think I should be considered as your replacement.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You are being too modest.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael, on Thursday I'm going to drive down and interview with David for the open position in New York.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hhhh… okay. That is not funny. I am deducting sixty points from Voldemort for false pretenses. Okay, Dwight your turn. Wow us.

scenes.line: The Aristocrats. A man and his wife and his children go into the offices of a talent agency. And the talent agent says, "Describe your act." And the man says something really, really raunchy and the talent representative says, "What do you call yourselves?" And the man says, "The Aristocrats!"

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [breathes deeply and runs across coals] Oooh, uh hah, ooh! Wha-hoo! Ahhhh…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [finishes story] I mean truly repulsive acts.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That is a very, very funny story.

scenes.line: [runs over after walking over fire coals] Hey! I want to say something. I've been trying to be more honest lately and I just need to say a few things. I did the coal walk! Just, I did it! Michael, you couldn't even do that. Maybe I should be your boss? Wow, I feel really good right now. Why didn't any of you come to my art show? I invited all of you. That really sucked. It's like sometimes some of you act like I don't even exist. [turns and looks directly at Jim] Jim, I called off my wedding because of you. And now we're not even friends. And things are just like weird between us, and that sucks. And I miss you. You were my best friend before you went to Stamford, and I really miss you. I shouldn't have been with Roy. And there were a lot of reasons to call off my wedding. But the truth is, I didn't care about any of those reasons until I met you. And now you're with someone else. And that's… fine. It's… whatever. That's not what… I'm not… Okay, my feet really hurt. The thing that I'm just trying to say to you, Jim… and to everyone else in this circle I guess, is that I miss having fun with you. Just you, not everyone in the circle. Okay, I am going to go walk in the water now. Yeah. It's a good day.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pam, that was amazing. But I am still looking for someone with a sales background.

scenes.line: Flintstones, meet the Flintstones. They're a modern stone-age family. Ba-ba-da-da-da. From the town of Bedrock, they're a page right out of history. Ba-da-da-da-da. [overlapping singing of the wrong verses] When you're with the Flintstones, have a yabba-dabba-doo time, a dabba-doo time, we'll have a gay old time!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: WWWWIIIILLLLMMMMAAAA!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Nice!

scenes.line: Well, Bob was going to just drive me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. No, no, no. No guests today. Classic gang only. Just us good friends, and Karen and Andy.

scenes.line: Sometimes Michael gets nostalgic and he talks about the classic gang. That's Michael, me, Jim, Dwight, Angela, Kevin, Oscar, Stanley, Phyllis, Creed, Meredith, Kelly and Ryan. We're a regular Ocean's Eleven.

scenes.line: Jim, David Wallace is calling for you.

scenes.line: Oh, okay. Hello. Hey, David. Sure.

scenes.line: Pam, you broke up with your boyfriend and then kept working together. How did that work out?

scenes.line: You remember you fired Roy for attacking Jim and I don't talk to him anymore really.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Acrimonious.

scenes.line: This way to the party bus. Good.

scenes.line: It's a bus that takes you to a party. Here we go.

scenes.line: Um, I forgot my…

scenes.line: Here we go. Come on. Okay, everybody here?

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.line: Seat belts fastened, folks. Safety first. Hey what is all this?

scenes.line: Nothing.

scenes.line: If I guess, will you tell me?

scenes.line: No.

scenes.line: Please?

scenes.line: No!

scenes.line: Is that a sumo suit?

scenes.line: No.

scenes.line: I know, we're putting on a play for Japanese investors.

scenes.line: No, we are not.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Please tell me. I've been so good…

scenes.line: You are really annoying me. If you don't knock it off…

scenes.line: Please.

scenes.line: Please.

scenes.line: Can we please pull over at the next rest stop?

scenes.line: No. We're only 10 minutes from the lake.

scenes.line: Pull over! Pull over! [Meredith uses a bush while all the other passengers look the other way, except Creed]

scenes.line: Yes, I am choosing my apprentice. Which is why I have modeled all my games after Survivor.

scenes.line: Any questions?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Just one.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yup.

scenes.line: The torches are lit.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, for dramatic affect.

scenes.speaker: Jim

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Very good, Jim. Pam, please note that Jim is very astute. All right, are we ready?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you not gonna put out the torches?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Set!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Go!

scenes.line: I think Jim would be a good boss. Plus he's eye candy. It's OK, Bob… Vance knows he's on my list. Um, George Clooney, Leonardo DiCaprio, Jim, and that British guy that got in trouble with a prostitute.

scenes.line: Because he wasn't following the rules.

scenes.line: I think they were just having fun.

scenes.line: It tells me nothing.

scenes.line: Exactly. Are you sure you're doing that right? Taking an awfully long time.

scenes.line: There's 800 of them!

scenes.line: Okay, all right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's very important that you all try to eat as many hotdogs as you can…

scenes.line: Hotdogs are really unhealthy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Son of a bitch. God! Okay. All right you know what? Here we go. On your mark! Get set!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Is there any mustard?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No mustard! No mustard! Just… eat it. Eat it, Phyllis. Dip it in the water so it will slide down your gullet more easily.
