scenes.line: That's what she said!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no, no, not that— just… come on, you guys, let's do it! I'm serious. Who's got the hungry?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I do!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Who's got the hungry?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I do!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Come on, Ryan…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Let's go.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ryan, I want to see you with a hot dog in your mouth. Right now.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Karen and I are having our own contest to see who can eat the most normal amount of tuna salad in an unspecified but very cofortable amount of time. I don't know what to tell you. Right now? Dead heat.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Keep eating tuna, Big Tuna. Loser!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He's gonna throw up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Dwight and Stanley are in sumo suits] Ready! Go!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: The guy who sits behind me and the guy who sits across from me are fighting to see who becomes my boss. [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Dwight knocks Stanley down] Yeah! Yeah! Yeah! Eat sand, you fat, old man!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh, I'm out of it. Let's face it, the hot dog-eating contest was my best shot.

scenes.line: Michael, since Andy isn't here, maybe I could be the team captain.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You? You haven't made a sale.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I know, but I'd like to give this a try.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't try to flirt your way into this. Sometimes you really creep me out.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [in sumo suit, waves down a car, which swerves around him, runs after it, waving his arms] Wait! [throws sumo hair-hat at the retreating car]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Andy Bernard is in first place with four hot dogs! Dwight Schrute is a close second with three and a half! Here comes Stanley! Here comes Stanley, with three hot dogs!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is an inflatable sumo suit. [blows] Now, in the olden days, when they wanted to find a guy who could be king, they would have him pull a sword out of a stone. Well, times have changed. [blows] And it's not even about who is the best sumo wrestler. It's about who is the best boss. And I don't even care who wins. [blows] It's how they wrestle in a blow-up suit… [breathes in] that will tell me all I need to know [blows] or how sumo… [collapses]

scenes.line: [at Dunder-Mifflin Corporate in NY] David!

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: [confused] Oh, Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Are we all set?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Isn't our interview tomorrow?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes. I just happened to be in the neighborhood, thought I'd drop in and say hello.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: You happened to be in mid-town Mahattan?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thought I'd catch a show.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: In the middle of a work day?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Naaah. You know what? Since I'm here, let me ask you a few questions about the job.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um, how many people are you interviewing?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: We're only interviewing the branch managers and some other upper level company people.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ah, well, good. Out of curiosity are you interviewing anyone who has been here longer than I have, or manages more people?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I don't think so.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Great. One more… question. When you merged those branches who did you put in charge?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I believe we put you in charge.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ah, great. No further questions.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I'm really looking forward to our interview.

scenes.speaker: Michael

scenes.line: As if you had a choice. [scoffs] Duh. [scoffs] Opportunity of a lifetime. [spits chew into Michael's World's Best Boss mug]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Three months ago, I was nowhere. I was just a Cornell grad, in anger management. Look where I am now. Not bad. [washing out Michael's mug]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey! Hunter! Wha's up my brutha? This is Hunter, secretary extraordinaire.

scenes.speaker: Hunter
scenes.line: Uh, administrative assistant.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jan in yet?

scenes.speaker: Hunter
scenes.line: I think she's comin' in… later.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Could you give her a message for me, when she gets in?

scenes.speaker: Hunter
scenes.line: Sure.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just say, "I want to squeeze them." It's code. She'll know what it means.

scenes.speaker: Hunter
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, and Hunter? Could you tell her, [Michael shakes his head and makes the "motorboat" noise] "Brbrbrbrbr!" also?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You showed great leadership potential at the coal walk. Even if you did follow it with that embarrassing personal confession.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I had to make Andy my number two. It's political, complicated, you wouldn't understand. I want you… to be Assistant Regional Manager.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well, in a sense. Although, publicly I am going to retain the Assistant Regional Manager position.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You will be your own assistant.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Correct, I need someone I can trust. But I would also like the title… to be secretly applied to you. Just stripped of its pomp and frills.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay. So… you would be the Regional Manager,

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Mmmmmm, let's call it Secret Assistant

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Do you accept?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Absolutely, I do.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I learned from Jim, if Dwight ever asks you to accept something secret… you reply, "Absolutely, I do."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [knocks on door] Hello, hello!

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Michael, good to see you!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good to see you. Here are the post-merger performance stats that you asked for.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Oh, great. I've been meaning to thank you by the way. You didn't lose a single customer during the merger, and you still managed to trim the budget? That is nice work. [Michael smiles] So, let me ask you a question right off the bat. What do you think are your greatest strengths as a manager?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why don't I tell you what my greatest weaknesses are? I work too hard. I care too much. And sometimes I can be too invested in my job.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay. And your strengths?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, my weaknesses are actually… strengths.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Oh. Yes. Very good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Very good.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Dwight is our new boss.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Oh, Michael's not going anywhere.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Then who do you think will get the job?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Karen. She looks corporate. Those little pants suits.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I think it's gonna be Michael.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Do you really think he's qualified for that job?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: No, but he wasn't qualified for the job he has now, and he got that one.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [laughs] Mm. Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Listen up! Come to the center of the room, please. This… [holds up paper that resemles a sheet sized dollar bill with Dwight's face in the middle] is a Schrute Buck. When you have done something good, you will receive one Schrute Buck. One thousand Schrute Bucks… equals an extra five minutes for lunch.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [raises hand] What is the cash value of a Schrute Buck?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Excellent question, Pam. 1/100th of a cent.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: So ten

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Just… zip your lid! Another announcement. Michael wasted an enormous amount of the group's time and patience with non-work related ethnic celebrations and parades of soft-minded dogoodedness. No longer. No more meetings!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Amen.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Instead, today I will begin my first lecture in a long series of lectures designed to increase your knowledge on the world of paper.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [raises hand] Do we have to?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes! Michael is gone. There's a new sheriff here in these offices, and his name is "me." Conference room! Ten seconds! All of you!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I literally cannot wait to see what Dwight has planned. And I wish Jim were here.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: What do you think we could be doing better?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I've never been a big fan of the name Dunder Mifflin. I was thinking we could name the company something like, "Paper Great. Where great paper is our passion. We're GRRRRRRRRRREAT!" I don't know, could be good. Or, uh, "Super Duper Paper. It's super duper." I don't know, something like that.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Thanks for comin' in, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: It is always a treat when our paths cross.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is always a treat when

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: You're back together.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes. And I am very excited about the prospect of working under her… or on top of her. [laughs] Mm, that's not sexual, just… we're all professionals.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay, uh. Well, I thought it was clear in the description, the position… the job you're applying for… is Jan's job.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't understand. So, we're gonna tag team it?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: No, we're letting Jan go.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Listen up. Let's start… from the ground

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [at the same time as Dwight] Trees.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Trees! And where do trees grow?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [at the same time as Dwight] Forest.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Soil. Right. We have, in front of you here, seven different types of Pennsylvania top soil. Now, what would you say… is the most important element in the production of above ground leafy growth? Probably phosphorus, right? [Angela smiles, shakes her head "no"] Wrong! It's nitrogen! Absorb this information. Good! Now, let us discuss precipitation. Stanley! When rainfall occurs, does it usually fall in a liquid, solid, or gaseous… state?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Liquid.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Very good! You have earned one Schrute Buck.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I don't want it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Then you have been deducted 50 Schrute Bucks!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Make it 100.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We— Don't you wanna earn Schrute Bucks?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: No. In fact, I'll give you a billion Stanley Nickels if you never talk to me again.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What's the ratio of Stanley Nickels to Schrute Bucks?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: The same as the ratio of unicorns to leprechauns.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay—

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That's it!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What—

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Class is canceled, everybody out!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No wait, what are you doing?!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'm punishing them.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, no, no, wait! Class is not canceled.

scenes.speaker: Everyone
scenes.line: [grumbling, getting loud]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: HEY! COME ON! Let's listen to Dwight's presentation! [Dwight winks at Pam]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What— What are you winking for?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Zip your lid!

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: So, that's… my basic 5 year plan. And after that, who knows?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay. Uh, now, this may seem like an odd question, but…

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: …what do you think about Michael Scott?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: He's a very nice man. And he's very well suited for the job he has now.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: This is off the record.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: He would be disaster.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Hey you!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: How was your interview?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pretty good.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Could have gone better I guess.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Oh. [they kiss] I'll put in a good word for you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Cool. Maybe you should do it sooner rather than later.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Daaah, let's just run away together. Let's just run away to Jamaica and live in a bungalow. You have some savings right? You could pay off my debts. It would… be fine. We'd have fun.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: What's… what's the matter? What… what happened in there?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I can't tell you.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Tell me what?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: You son of a bitch!

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Jan, this isn't the time, we're in an interview—

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: You're

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Frankly, it's overdue. Your behavior in the last two years has been completely erratic.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Erratic?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Recently, you don't even show an interest in your work! You smoke constantly in your office. You spend most of the day online shopping. You disappear for hours at a time, sometimes days. Always saying you're visiting your sister in Scottsdale. You go to Scranton far more often than you used to—

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [opens up her overcoat] Is it because of these?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wuuuoooh, hey, whoa, Jan—

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: No, I wanna know. I wanna know! Because if it is, then, then, then I will see you in court!

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: It's not.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: No?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: It's not.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: 'Cause he likes them. [points to Michael] Okay? He likes them. And, and that is, that is all I care about.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: The time has come for you to end your professional relationship with this company. You are clearly unstable.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No— We're all unstable.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Okay, you know what? I'm just not leaving. I'm not leaving. Not leaving.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: David, I did not tell her.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It's like staring into my soul, when I look at this wall.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's like outerspace without the stars, it's so black. [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: This is gonna look so awesome!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's so intimidating! Anyone who comes in here… is gonna have to take me seriously. Abandon all hope, ye who enter here!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [laughs] Totally!

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [giving a hug] Bye Hunter.

scenes.speaker: Hunter
scenes.line: Bye.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Good luck with your band.

scenes.speaker: Hunter
scenes.line: Oh, thank—

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Don't let them change you, okay? [Jan drops several items, Michael and Hunter help pick them up, she starts to walk out the door] So long, [censored].

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So, I am gonna… give her a ride home. Let me know about the job.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Actually, Michael, I think we're gonna take it in another direction.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good, I'm glad we're on the same page. I have a lot of ideas for new directions.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: No, we're not giving you the job.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what? That… is actually good… because, um, I don't think I could take… my girlfriend's job. That's not being a good boyfriend. So, I respectfully withdraw my name from consideration. Do you accept my withdrawal?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I do.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good. Very good. I'm glad we are finally on the same page. Still have my job in Scranton, though.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good. That's all I ever wanted. These two. [points at Jim and Karen] Either one of them… excellent candidates.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Wow. That was some serious… hardcore… self destruction.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. Kinda feel bad for her though.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Don't! She's nuts! [they laugh]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, man. You know what? This might take a while. You really don't have to stay, if you don't want.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Okay, good! Because, um, a bunch of my friends are meeting downtown for lunch. And, I was gonna meet them, so…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Just call me when you're done.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sure.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Good luck, Halpert.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Receptionist
scenes.line: [phone rings, picks up] Dunder Mifflin, this is Grace. Sure.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Oh, God! I mean, I just don't understand! It's just

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know. I know, I'm sorry about that. That was terrible.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Oh, just… No, actually I think it's good, you know? It's fine, actually, I do. I really think it's great that it happened. Because, you know, my work has always been the thing that has gotten in the way of my happiness, so… [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, it's… [Jan starts crying, high pitched whining] No, don't cry, it's gonna be OK.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [sobbing] Oh, I know, I know. It's just… I'm sorry. It's just these painkillers that I started taking since the surgery. Ohhh! They make my moods totally unpredictable! Wow! What am I gonna do?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [whispers] I don't know. [normal volume] Well I guess… you could come and stay at my condo. I think I could back out of the sale. [Jan exhales] Probably get some negative feedback on my eBay profile.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Live together. Actually, wait a minute! This could be great! This could be perfect! You know, my full-time job could be our relationship. I could wear stretch pants and wait for you to come home at 5:15. [laughs] It could work. This could work, really!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in the office, imitating the terminator] I'll be baaaaack! And I am baaaack!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How'd it go?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. No, Pam. I'm baaaaaack! For gooood! Kevin Nealon.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Everybody, may I have your attention please? It is with great honor and privilege that I announce to you that I have officially withdrawn my name for consideration from the corporate job. I know, I know, I know. "Michael, what are you thinking? You were a shoe in." Well, got down there. I nailed the interview. And the strangest thing happened. Why is my office black?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: To intimidate my subordinates.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's stupid.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It was Andy's idea.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You shouldn't have taken it. Bad management! Good thing I'm baaaaaack. [laughs] Ryan, coffee.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I don't do that stuff anymore.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, it's for me, bimbo. Kids.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So I'm back. And I am never, ever going to leave. I am going nowhere. This place… is like… the hospital where I was born, my house, my old age home, and my… graveyard… for my bones.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Did… Karen get the job?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to everyone] Back to work. [to Ryan] Still waitin' on that coffee.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Pam, hello.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dwight, hello.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I wanted to thank you… for helping me, when you held the title, Secret Assistant to the Regional Manager. You served the office with great dignity. [Pam salutes Dwight, Dwight returns the salute]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, I don't know what the future holds, but… I'm optimistic. And, uh, I had fun goofing around with Dwight today. Jim and I… are just… too similar. Maybe one day I'll find my own Karen. But— you— that is, a, um, you know, not— A man. A man version. But, uh, until then… I can hold my head up. … I'm not gay.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I don't know how I feel about hiring a Sixers fan.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I should leave. [pretends to get up] [they laugh]

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Uh, let me ask you a question, Jim. You're clearly a very bright guy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Always hit your numbers, personable, you make a great impression on everyone you meet—

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm sorry, wait, so is the question "How'd I get to be so awesome?" [laughs] Because, I don't have an answer for you. [laughs]

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Uh, oh, hey, do you have your quarterly numbers?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes, absolutely.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: And that, uh, questionnaire. Sorry to make you fill that thing out…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, no, absolutely.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: …that's a HR formality. We have this very irritating HR guy here, he's probably the only person you're not gonna like. [Jim notices a small note inside his papers, it reads "Jim, Don't forget us when you're famous! Pam" It has a gold medal yogurt lid attached.] Kendall. Ugh. So, first up…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [hands David his papers] There you go.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: How do you think you function here in New York?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [not thinking clearly because of Pam's note] What's that? Oh, uh, great. You know? I just um, I really appreciate the buildings, and uh, the people, and um, there's just a [sic] energy… New York has, uh… Not to mention, they have places that are open past eight. [David laughs] So that's a… bonus.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: You've been in the Scranton branch a long time. [Jim stares at Pam's note] What have you liked most about that place?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [thinks] The friendships.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay. Well, we want the person who takes this position to be here for the long haul. So… long haul. Where do you see yourself in ten years?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [flashback to Beach Games] How are your feet?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Medium rare. Thanks. [they laugh]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: The real reason that I went to Stamford… was because… I wanted to be… not here.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I know.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And even though… I came back, I just, I feel like I've never really… come back.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, I wish you would.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [phone rings, Pam answers] Dunder Mifflin, this is Pam. Just one moment, I'll transfer you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I haven't heard anything, but I bet Jim got the job. I mean, why wouldn't he? He's totally qualified, and smart, everyone loves him… and, if he never comes back again… that's OK. We're friends. And I'm sure we'll stay friends. We just, we never got the timing right. You know? I shot him down, and then he did the same to me, and… But you know what? It's OK. I'm totally fine. Everything is gonna be totally— [Jim walks in]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pam. [to camera] Sorry. [to Pam] Um, are you free for dinner tonight?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right. Then… it's a date.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [to camera, tearing up, smiling] I'm sorry, what was the question?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: [on phone] So, I know we left the other day on a note of uncertainty. But, after some more thought, I'm very pleased to be able to offer you this job. [laughs] Great! I'm so glad. We're all very excited you're going to be joining us. It'll be nice to have another MBA around here.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [on phone, smiling] I'm excited too. Okay. Bye.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Who was that?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [still smiling] Nobody. You and I are done.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: What?! [Ryan smiles and glances at the camera]

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Where do you see yourself in ten years?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, [clears throat] I've actually done a lot of thinking about that. And in ten years, I am living in a big house, with my kids. And in this house we have screens on the walls that have famous art on them and I have a remote that works everything, that has like a belt-loop attachment, or in my ear, like a gluetooth. And, because it's the future, I can take just a little tiny pill and get all my vitamins for the whole day.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: A… multivitamin?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I don't know what it's gonna be called, but… my point is, the future of this company is now. And the future… is me.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Michael, what happened?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jan got fired. And I realized that I could not work for a company that would fire my girlfriend. But more than that, I realized that… I couldn't take a job that would take me away from this place. This is where I belong. This is… my home. And home is where the hardest.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Home is where the

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Heart is. That makes a lot more sense. You think they'd help each other out like that at corporate? [Oscar shrugs] I think not!

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Well, if Michael gets the job, I will be so upset, because Dwight used to have a crush on me, so if he's boss, it'll be really awkward.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Mmm-hmm. [nods]

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: But if Jim gets it, you should be happy, because you have a crush on him, and he totally doesn't feel the same way, and then he'll be gone.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, well, you know, whatever happens. [Kelly puts her hand on Pam's shoulder] Oh.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Pam, he's just not that into you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, I know. We talked about it and he told me.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: No, seriously Pam, wake up.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Kelly made me realize something. She and I have… nothing in common. And I need more friends.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Define scorched earth policy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: When an attacker goes through another country sometimes they wi…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Nyah ah! Too long! What is the Dharma Initiative?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It is the source of all energy on this planet.

scenes.speaker: Dwight

scenes.line: I…

scenes.line: I was thinking that we…

scenes.line: That's cool.

scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.line: Thank you for the permission. Psych! Alright let's just go around the room, and tell me what you believe in.

scenes.line: OK.

scenes.line: Alright.

scenes.line: Alright! [high fives Pam]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: That's why we're cursed.

scenes.line: No.

scenes.line: I will do some research.

scenes.line: I was in the hospital room with her. How contagious is that, is that like an STD?

scenes.line: Then we will burn Utica to the ground.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [whispers] Dwight. Granted, maybe this was not the best idea, but at least we care enough about our employees that we are willing to fight for them. And if you so much as harm a hair on Stanley's head, we will burn Utica to the ground. [they get up to leave]

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Jim, hang on a second?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes?

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: So you're still doing this kind of stuff, huh?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, trying to quit though.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: If you wanted to see me, you could have just called me like an adult.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh no, I didn't want to see you. Not that I'm not happy seeing you, right now, I'm just saying ultimately I was here for the copier. Equal, I'd say it was equal. So, good to see you…

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: [huffs]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I mean, it's just that- [clears throat] You know, Pam and I are still dating, so, and, I just mean that things are going really well, so I didn't want to see… you…

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Oh, things are going really well? Are they? They are? That's great, that's so great. I wanna hear more about how happy you are with Pam. Can you tell me more about that? Thank you so much for coming to Utica, and breaking my copier, and telling me how well things are going in your relationship, really, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [slinking out of the room] Alright, you are welcome. I'm going to go because of, um, traffic.

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Traffic, yeah. Oh, def- go, go because of traffic, definitely, beat-beat the traffic, mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I… will… [gives up and walks away]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We tried and we failed. Stanley, you may go. Here is a box, for your things, but I doubt that that box will be able to contain all the memories that you have of this place. Fly away sweet little bird, fly away and be free. Pam, I'm gonna need some help writing a want ad.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um, wanted:

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I wasn't really planning on leaving, all I wanted was a raise. How on Earth did Michael call my bluff? Is he some sort of secret genius? [laughs] Sometimes I say crazy things.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm so sorry, Rolando told me everything. How humiliating. Would it help you to return to another age? A time of refinement, and civility.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you inviting me to the Finer Things Club?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [nods head yes]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh-oh, come on!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Irish accent] Angela's Ashes, top o' the morning to us. Frankie's prose is funnier than a pot of gold, say I.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Okay, did you get it out of your system.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yep. No, I mean I really liked it. I thought was uh, a fun read.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Fun?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: What was fun about it for you? Was it the death of the twins?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, that wasn't fun.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Did you even read it?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Of course I read it.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: How does it end?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Who was the main character?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Angela. Nope. The ashes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [mouths "I'm sorry" to Oscar]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: And let me just add, that as a member of The Finer Things Club, I would bring a strong financial contribution to any discretionary funds that we may have. Finally, here is a recommendation from former U.S. Senator Rick Santorum.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Okay, that's enough, uh. Thanks, Andy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Mmmhmm. [leaves]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: He's gonna ruin everything.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, my God. His letter of recommendation from Rick Santorum is three fifty-dollar bills.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Wow. Now we can afford hard-cover books.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I like it just us three. [very quietly] I don't want it to change.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I love The Finer Things Club. My ex-wife used to have a book club, and I would read their book and sometimes listen from the kitchen.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: The Finer Things Club was not sanctioned by the Party Planning Committee. Renegade clubs are dangerous. I squashed the Weight Loss Buddy Support Group. They didn't need to gather. It was just gross.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [slurping her from her big cup] I don't know why I'm not in The Finer Arts Club [slurring]. It's bullcrap. [throws her cup on the floor, something splashes on the camera] You clean it up.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [opens envelope Toby has handed him] Dear Andrew Bernard, after carefully examining your application to The Finer Things Club, we are unable to offer you a position at this place and time. We would, however, like to place you on a list in case an opportunity arises when your inclusion can be tolerated. Your position as an ongoing financial patron, however, is yours to cherish. Sincerely, The Finer Things Club. [pauses to consider] Yeees! [to Phyllis] I got waitlisted.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I got into Cornell off the Wait List. A lot of people were like, "Oh, you just got into Cornell because your dad donated a building." No. Okay. I got into Cornell because I'm smart. I'm smart enough to have a dad who donates buildings to things.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Utica is snoozeville, um, Albany are the prepsters, Nashua, no parking, um, Akron is haunted, Camden… is in a basement, Yonkers has the two hot girls, and here in Scranton, we are the cool guys.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Woo! Shotgun!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, you're driving, right?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, I am, but I want shotgun for you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mmm… I'd prefer to sit in back.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wait! I wanted to sit next to you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, Dwight! Dwight, Jim is sitting next to me. You're gonna sit in the back left where I don't have to see your ugly moongob.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, that is so mean! You know what, I'm not going.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm sorry. I'm sorry. Dwight, you're handsome. You're a very handsome man, get in the car.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Woohoo!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [on phone] So, there was no sales call.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nnnno. Uh, turns out, it was just a really bad idea involving fire. But I think I fixed it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wait, you're going along with this now?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I have to. Pam, if I'm not there, someone's going to go to jail. Or die.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Right. And, you wouldn't be able to talk to Karen.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I promise you that has nothing to do with it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: A little bit.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, yeah I don't want to see her get physically harmed, that's for sure.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Because you love her? [baby voice] Because you love her very much?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right, I'm gonna go now.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay. Have fun with your girlfriend!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, I will. [idiot voice]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm kidding around. We joke about that stuff all the time. I'm not really the jealous type, so, I don't care if Jim sees Karen. I care a little.

scenes.speaker: Security guard
scenes.line: They sprayed me in the eye. [Dwight and Michael are trapped by/under a copier in the stairwell]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [moans] Scranton rules! [sprays Silly Spray]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight! Stop it! [moans] Can you help me please, I'm being crushed.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Would it have killed you to spend the afternoon making love to her in a motel room? Like I begged you to? Pam would have understood. Heck, Pam would have done it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Pam is down for anything.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You embarrassed me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You embarrassed us.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah. We shoulda brought Andy. I cut a chunk out of my penis for nothing.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I really didn't think I was going to have a good time, but I did. Totally did.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I love camping. [in a singing voice] Anything can happen.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Oh, it wasn't camping, it was more of a wilderness retreat. [Michael walks in]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Morning.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ryan invited some of the branch managers and Toby into the woods for a "get to know you" weekend. Michael wasn't invited. Apparently they already knew everything they needed to know about him.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Did you sleep in cabins?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Under the stars. It was really beautiful, you should come.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Bob and I took rock climbing lessons once. [Michael laughs]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Michael wasn't invited on Ryan's camping trip. Toby went, but Michael didn't go. He wasn't invited.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Who went?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Me, Dan from Buffalo, Mark Chisholm, Jeff from Albany and Ryan, obviously. Made so many s'mores, that I finally had to say, "No more s'mores, no more s'mores." [everyone in room but Michael laughs, Michael exits break room]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Ryan invited me to go on his wilderness adventure retreat. It was this amazing, beautiful experience [Michael knocks on the window behind Toby from outside]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [from outside] Hey, nobody cares. Nobody cares. I need that room at some point, so just, wrap it up.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Michael wasn't invited.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hypothetically, if I were to ask you to go camping, and you know what hypothetical means? [Jim makes a face] Not real.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Got it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So if I were to hypothetically ask you to go camping with me, would you go?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Absolutely, yes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: When Michael plays the hypothetical game, I always say yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, you wanna go today?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And I am always busy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, can't go today, 'cause I'm donating blood.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How often can you actually donate blood?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Is there a limit?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Your body only has a certain amount.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, is that it? Or?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, just this whole Toby, camping thing, uh, seems a little lame.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: How so?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: A bunch of guys, in a tent? Making s'mores? [makes a noise and gestures with his hands]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What's that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello, I'm Broken Mountain. You know, here's the thing. That's not how you go camping. I think you go camping by yourself—

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: In the wilderness. It's not with a group of guys frolicking around in tents. It's one guy, or two guys, if your plans change.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Not gonna change.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I wanna do it myself. You know, I want to go and, and find out something about myself, I wanna get outta here. All the cliques, and the office politics. Fluorescent lights. Asbestos.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I thought we had that looked at.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm sick of it Jim. I'm sick of this place.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: When Jan and I had satellite, we used to watch a reality show called "Survivorman." And, it was interesting because it was about a guy who would go out in the middle of no where and just try not to die, try not to get eaten by an animal, or be overexposed.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK, I will only need two things. Roll of duct tape and a knife.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [winks] I'm on it. [leaves room]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK. Thirty minutes or less, please come back. Save the receipts. [Dwight comes back with set of knives] Hey, what…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Let's see if any of these will work. [clears the front of Michael's desk]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, hey hey! Dwight. [Dwight rolls out an assortment knives]. Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I keep various weaponries strategically placed around the office. I saved Jim's life with a can of pepper spray I had velcroed under my desk. People say, "Oh, it's dangerous to keep weapons in the home or the work place." Well I say, "It's better to be hurt by someone you know accidentally, than by a stranger on purpose."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight and I are going out. He will return later, but I will not. I will also be taking a personal day tomorrow, and perhaps the next day.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Do you want me to ask where you're going?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Great.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight will be driving me deep into the Pennsylvania wilderness.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Where he will then leave me to either die or to survive. The choice is yours.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hmm, no, the choice is actually yours. Are you sure you want to do this?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, and I am leaving you in charge of the office for the rest of the day and for the next several days. Do not try to follow me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK, great.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is a very personal, private experience in the wild, that I wish to share it with me, myself and I.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yup.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: When I return, I hope to be a completely changed human being.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That'd be great.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Do I believe that Michael possesses the skills to survive in a hostile environment? Let's put it this way:

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is what a true survivor man does. You simulate a disaster, like a plane wreck. You could only wear the clothes that you have on, and you could only use the stuff you have in your pockets. Now, in this case, this disaster is a serial killer. Creepy guy who's abducted me and is taking me out into the wilderness to leave me for dead.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, I would never leave you for dead. You would never escape.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, yes I would. And I would survive.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I would make sure that you were dead.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: First, I would remove your teeth and cut off your fingertips so you could not be identified.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: And they would call me the Overkill Killer.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You… you are as creepy as a real serial killer. For real. [blindfolds eyes with tie] OK.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am putting this on so I have no familiarity with my surroundings. Now this way, I can't retrace my steps. I don't know what streets we've been— [Dwight whacks Michael with his shoe] Ow! What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It would be better if you were unconscious.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No! Gosh! Dwight. [Dwight tries to hit Michael with his shoe again] Stop it, stop it! Stop it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Do you want to do this right or not?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just, please allow me to have one cathartic experience in my life?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Jim, we need to order a cake for Creed's birthday.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, wasn't it just someone's birthday?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yes. Kelly's was last week, remember?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I do remember, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It's birthday month. Creed's is today. Oscar's is week after next. Meredith's is at the end of the month. [Jim exhales deeply] Michael usually goes with red and white streamers…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know what, I have an idea. Why don't we just do one big shared party?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: There are thirteen people working in this office, so thirteen times a year Michael gets a cake and balloons, and some sort of joke gift and makes a toast. There are two types of toasts. One is a joke about how old you are.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [flashback to Stanley's birthday] Look at those wrinkles. Blacks do crack! Not crack the drug.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And the other is something inappropriate. Or horrible. Or both. What else? He only sings the high harmony to "Happy Birthday." And he's a very big believer in surprise parties. Maybe even, arguably, possibly to a fault.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [flashback to Kelly's birthday, hiding in the elevator] Happy Birthday!

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Ahhh!! [drops the papers she was holding]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [flashback to Oscar's birthday, hiding in the break room] Happy Birthday!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Ahhh! [runs into door and Michael laughs]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [flashback to Phyllis' birthday, sneaking up on Phyllis' car] Happy Birthday!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh! [Michael laughs]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So… I think, yeah, I think getting these out of the way might be productive.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We can just have one big fun party. Everybody's happy, nobody wastes their time.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I don't like it. [Angela leaves]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow! You're shaking things up a bit, huh?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's a pretty good idea, don't you think?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Do you think it's a good idea?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No… I think it's a great idea.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [smiles] Hmm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We're here. [gets out of the car]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight will take my blindfold off when we are deep in the forest. Just the two of us from this point out.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [leading Michael from car] Here we go. Just the two of us [gestures for camera crew to follow]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Here we go, into the wild. Mighty forest. Can you smell the trees and the nature?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Keep going, you're fine. Just some bushes and some thickets [leads Michael into some tall grass] Keep going. You wanted wilderness, you got it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know, try sending them another invoice.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright. [starts walking away, but returns] Oh, did you see my memo by the way?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [picks up and reads memo] "Let's be honest, as fun as birthdays are we could all use a break from the constant cake, so let's celebrate birthday month in style today." This is really cool.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right? I was just thinking…

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: No, totally, totally. This way we get it all out of the way at once and it could actually be fun.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right! Exactly. [pats Oscar on the back and walks away] Knew I could count on you. [Oscar rolls his eyes]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Good a spot as any. [They stop and Dwight starts spinning Michael around in circles]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What are you doing? Stop. Dwight, Dwight. Just —

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm just —

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stop.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Spin. I'm trying to confuse your sense of direction. [stops spinning and takes Michael's blindfold off] Behold.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright, good. Thank you, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Here's your knife. Here's your duct tape.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright, very good. Ahh, OK. [Dwight gives Michael a hug]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Good luck, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thanks for the ride. OK. Leave me be, Dwight. [Dwight runs off]

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Hey, Jim, can I have my own cake?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What's that?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I really prefer devils food cake.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, sure.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK. [Meredith leaves]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow! That was easy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, people like me I guess.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [knocking from outside window in break room] Jim.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I hate devils food.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well I think Meredith was just —

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Screw Meredith, I don't think it's fair to let someone else pick the cake on my birthday.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Everybody's birthday.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Today is actually my birthday and I want to pick the cake.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What do you want?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I want pie. I want peach pie.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You want a birthday pie?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I want a nice cobbler.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I'm gonna to talk to Angela and we're gonna see what we can do about a pie.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I don't care who you talk to. Just make it happen.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It will be Angela.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: You tell her it's for Creed. She'll know what that means.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to own camcorder] Day One. I'm in the interior of the vast Pennsylvania wilderness. I've brought with me only the bare essentials. A knife, roll of duct tape, in case I need to craft some shelter or make some sort of water vessel. It's hot today. The sun is in the two-thirds easterly quadrant, which would make it about [looks at watch] 2 o'clock in the afternoon. It's really beating down on me now. I think that I want to get a little more comfortable because the sun is depleting my resources. [cuts pants with knife] OK. OH, there we go. Watch that I don't hit my corroded artery here…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I lied to Michael. I said that I would leave him alone, but I will not. I will remain close by to provide unseen moral support, but I will never help him. I will let harm befall him. I will even let him die. But I will never let him lose his dignity.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There we go. [standing with short sleeves and short pants] Much better. Now everything I brought with me can be used. My sport coat here, can be fashioned into a backpack of sorts [ties jacket around neck].

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm going to wear what was once one of my pant legs. [puts pant leg on head like a hat]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: See, this is a beautiful piece of material [rips other pant leg in half] This could be used for all sorts of things.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Some sort of kerchief to keep my neck nice and comfortable.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Tuna. [rolls in chair to Jim's desk]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Andy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Me likey the ice cream cake, okay? Fudgie the Whale.

scenes.speaker: Jim

scenes.line: So…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: It was me!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What's that?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: I spray-painted that dog. It was sleek, and shiny, and perfect little haircut, it was parading around like it was God's gift to this God-forsaken town [laughs] and I just couldn't take it anymore, so I went over there and I held down my knee and I just spray-painted it until I was good and done. [claps] It bit me on the arm, [reaches out and taps Jim] I didn't even feel it.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: What are you doing to him? What… [sees neighbors' dog] is this about that stupid, ugly mutt?

scenes.speaker: Neighbor
scenes.line: She's a Weimaraner, you bitch!

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Please, please. Don't hurt him, okay?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: W.B. Jones is renovating their offices and their construction crews are taking up some of the parking spaces we used to get.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So we had to park at a satellite parking lot over there.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Which just means we get to see more of our lovely street. Tell them what we saw today Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh today, we saw a junk yard dog attacking the bones of a rotisserie chicken.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Nature.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Been here nine years. Now all of a sudden I'm supposed to park half a mile away.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I lost a penny out of my loafers, Oscar.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [sitting down, rubbing his feet] I will quit. As God as my witness, I will quit if this is not fixed.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Some of us like the walk more than others.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [off screen] Hurts like hell.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [to Michael who is looking at a chair catalog] Did you pick a new chair? It's been awhile.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pam, when I first opened this catalog, I thought I was just going to be picking out a chair.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: But instead, you found something to distract you from ever picking out a chair.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael started the process of selecting a new chair about three weeks ago. And normally I wouldn't care, but he promised me his old one. It's way better. It's one of these. [makes a shrrhhh sound of a chair moving downward as Pam slumps down] I really want it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [holding up the catalog] Have you ever seen this woman?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Her?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmm…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: The one in the really great mesh black high-back swivel chair?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Look at her smile. Those eyes, look at her eyes. She's got – I don't know what it is actually, she dresses like a professional and yet you know there is a side of her that could just curl up on a couch.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Or in a great chair.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, yeah, maybe, but remember after my dinner party when I said that I was swearing off women?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I definitely remember your dinner party.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think what I meant was that I was completely swearing off one woman. [whispers] Jan. I think that fate put this catalog in my hands.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Actually, I put the catalog in your hands 'cause you have to pick out a new chair.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What is it like being single? I like it. I like starting each day with a sense of possibility. And I'm optimistic because every day I get a little more desperate and desperate situations yield the quickest results.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ladies and gentleman, would you please open your supply catalogs and kindly turn to page 85. [phone rings]

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [on phone] Yo, is this his new chair?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [on phone] No, he hasn't picked one yet.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [on phone] Daat!

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: When Pam gets Michael's old chair, I get Pam's old chair. Then I'll have two chairs. Only one to go.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am ready to start dating again. Getting back on the market. So, FYI, for those of you who are thinking about fixing me up with any of your friends, use the woman on page 85 as a template. That will be all.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I left my cell phone in my car.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Call us when you get there so we know you're OK. [Andy gets up and leaves]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to Kevin] Listen man, I am completely over Jan, so, would you set me up?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: If I had someone to set you up with Michael, then I'd take her for myself.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I thought that you were engaged?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Nope. Stacy broke up with me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Whaaaat? God, that's terrible man. Eghh, she's crazy. Umm, are you still on good terms with any of her friends?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Not anymore.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: It's a bitter situation.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah… ugh. She's… [gets up and leaves] you don't deserve her. Alright.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sitting on Oscar's desk] Oh hello Oscar Mayer Weiner lover. I bet that you have a bunch of very liberal girl type friends that trust you implicitly because they know you'd never touch 'em, because of your condition. Umm…

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I have a friend who's single.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Sandy. She's gorgeous and she's got a feisty personality, too.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmm, I see, feisty. So she's not jolly or sassy? Not like a jolly, sassy opera singer?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Umm, no, she's a professional softball player.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oooo. Catcher or in field?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Umm I don't know Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Is she a dress wearer or a pants wearer? Could we share a row boat? Could, could a row boat support her?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What are you asking?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think I'm being very clear what I'm asking. Would an average size row boat support her without capsizing? [silence] It bothers me that you're not answEring the question.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: No, alright no, she can't fit in a row boat.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Damn it, I knew it! I knew it Phyllis! OK!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What is wrong with these people? I would do anything for them and they're just hanging me out to dry.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dating shouldn't be hard for somebody like me, but it is and you know why? Because nobody here is willing to help me. Nothing would ever get done in this office without a formal request, would it? Well, fine. Here goes.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I don't think that this is—

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, now OK, I know that this is probably not appropriate, but I need help. Because I want to play ball with my kids before I get too old. And before that happens I need to get laid. And before that happens I need to be in love. And I don't wanna hear "Ahnnn… I can't help elhh la la." No. No. I'm a catch and I am not going to be the one who got away. So, this is what we're going to do. Dwight is going to hand out index cards and I want you all to write down the name of an eligible woman for me to date by the end of the day. No, by the end of the hour or you are fired.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [gets up from chair] Write legibly people.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Because of the construction at W.B. Jones, half of us have to park in the satellite lot.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmm…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It's like a ten minute walk.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No, thirty.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, look, I am in an assigned parking place in front, so… Alright, alright, alright, umm let me try to think about what it would be like to not have one. [thinks] OK, yes that would be bad.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That would be bad.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: OK.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Nice.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: …So help us out.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wish I could, but I can't. Well can, but won't. Should, maybe, but shorn't.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Michael, please he–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What part of shorn't don't you understand, Kevin? Look I could probably handle it, yes, but I think it would be a good exercise for you guys to do it yourselves.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: We won't let you down.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh you can't because I don't care. Listen, [Kevin and Andy high five as they leave Michael's office] don't forget to fill out those cards. My love cards.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: There's nobody I hate enough to write her name on this card.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Well, I'm setting Michael up with my fat friend anyway, he can just deal with it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [to Jim] Who are you putting down?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, you don't know her.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Who is it?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Your mom.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, whatever. [Jim holds up the card] [Pam laughs] Give it to me. Give it to me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, Wendy. Hot and juicy red head. Give this a try. [Michael dials phone number. Phone rings.]

scenes.speaker: Wendy’s phone operator
scenes.line: Wendy's.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello Wendy, this is Kevin's friend, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Wendy’s phone operator
scenes.line: This isn't Wendy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, I'm sorry, could you put her on please?

scenes.speaker: Wendy’s phone operator
scenes.line: Dude, this is a Wendy's restaurant.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [under breath] Damn it Kevin. OK, umm, could I just have a frosty and a baked potato please?

scenes.speaker: Wendy’s phone operator
scenes.line: You have to come to the restaurant to order food.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I'll send somebody to come pick it up. Just have it ready.

scenes.speaker: Wendy’s phone operator
scenes.line: It's ready now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well put it aside. [hangs up the phone] [Dwight enters] Umm… yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: OK, I have collected the rest of the ladies.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good. Good because this batch was awful. Umm… this one says chair model…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I wrote that. Michael, you shouldn't have to settle. This is my pledge to you. I will find her and I will bring her to you and as God as my witness, she shall bear your fruit.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That sounds good. [both smile] Go get her. Wa-Wait, wait, wait, wait. First, go to Wendy's, get my food. Come back and then go.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [on phone] That is fantastic. Thank you, thank you very much. This is just what I needed.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The furniture company gave me the name of the advertising agency. They gave me the name of the photographer. The photographer, a Spaniard, used a Wilkes-Barre modeling agency. The agency gave me the following information. [reads from notepad] Deborah Shoshlefski. 142 South Windsor Lane. Dead. Car accident. Case closed.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: She's dead? [Dwight makes knife slitting noise] She's so young.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: She was so young and now she is dead. As dead as every dead animal who has ever died.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, God. Oh…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why don't you sit down? Michael… come on. [gets up and leads Michael to sit in his chair] Here we go. Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael, you didn't even know her.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Try not to be so hurtful Jim.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jim, how dare you. [Jim's face is in shock]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Please, not at a time like this. [sighs]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: OK Michael, you know what? I might have someone for you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh really? What's her name? Burger King?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, I mean it. [walks towards Michael] She's really nice and sweet and you guys might actually get along. [hands over card to Michael]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't, I don't think I'm ready. Is she hot?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm setting Michael up with my land lady. She's really sweet and… whatever, I just can't take Michael like this.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No question about it, I am ready to get hurt again.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: We need to assemble the five families.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [while brushing teeth with an electric toothbrush] No, not the five families.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: We have to.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: The five families are the five companies of Scranton Business Park. The bosses rarely meet. There's Michael Scott, Regional Manager, Dunder Mifflin. Bob Vance, Vance Refrigeration. Paul Faust of Disaster Kits Limited. They call him "Cool Guy Paul." W.B. Jones of W.B. Jones Heating and Air. Grade A Bad Ass. And Bill Cress of Cress Tool and Dye. Bill Cress is super old and really mean.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [still brushing teeth] Sorry, I don't have time for this right now. I'm trying to get a date with Pam's hot friend. And she needs to meet me right now.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [to Andy] I'm calling the meeting anyway.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to cashier at coffee shop] Thank you very much. Our suspect has straight brown hair. She is wearing blue jeans and a black top. So… behold our bachelorette [cut to a blonde woman in a skirt]. Give her ten for looks and a three for her ability to describe herself. Hello, my lady. [woman walks right by and doesn't respond]

scenes.speaker: Margaret
scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [turns around to see the woman from his description] Ugh.

scenes.speaker: Margaret
scenes.line: Are you Michael Scott?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Is who a Michael what?

scenes.speaker: Margaret
scenes.line: Oh, I'm sorry, I'm, I'm supposed to be meeting someone named Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, that's not, yeah I'm not… OK…

scenes.speaker: Coffee shop worker
scenes.line: Michael? Michael? [reads cup] Large hot chocolate with caramel and a shot of peppermint.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So you get the rent checks every month and what happens next? What…

scenes.speaker: Margaret
scenes.line: You're asking what I do with the checks that people write to me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just making conversation.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why is it so hard to meet people? I… you know… it's uh… All I want is somebody nice and sweet and someone I can talk to and share an experience with, you know? Why is it so hard for people like us?

scenes.speaker: Margaret
scenes.line: I don't know.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You wanna see what I walked out on? This is gonna blow your mind. [holds up cell phone with a picture of Jan] Look at that.

scenes.speaker: Margaret
scenes.line: She's beautiful.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. Yeah, and you can't see her whole body. Down here, she's got a boob job. Just… she was just crazy smart and really manipulative and I don't know.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Michael? Hello? Michael? [Michael hangs up phone]

scenes.speaker: Margaret
scenes.line: I'm gonna head out.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, OK. Well, umm… I enjoyed this conversation. It was very nice. It was like talking to the sweet old lady on the bus.

scenes.speaker: Margaret
scenes.line: That's incredibly rude.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Now you ruined it. [gets up and leaves]

scenes.speaker: Bob Vance
scenes.line: Where's Scott?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh Michael Scott could not make it today due to an unforeseen prior engagement.

scenes.speaker: W.B. Jones
scenes.line: Let's just meet back in an hour.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Gentleman please. We called this meeting. Andrew Bernard is the name of me. And this is my associate, Mr. Kevin Malone.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [nervously stuttEring] I… have… things…

scenes.speaker: W.B. Jones
scenes.line: Alright, what do you want?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well first of all, I'd just like to say [pulls out note cards] what an honor it is to be sitting here with you gentlemen.

scenes.speaker: W.B. Jones
scenes.line: You have about ten seconds—

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: We want our parking spaces back!

scenes.speaker: Paul Faust
scenes.line: Whose parking spaces?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: W.B. Jones' construction guys park in our parking spaces every morning and some people have to park really far away and walk all the way to the office. And some people sweat too much for comfort and—

scenes.speaker: Bill Cress
scenes.line: Ohh… God…

scenes.speaker: Paul
scenes.line: I don't have time for this you guys. [to W.B. Jones] Just give 'em back their spaces.

scenes.speaker: W.B. Jones
scenes.line: OK.

scenes.speaker: Paul
scenes.line: We good? OK. Could have done this over e-mail.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: After Stacy left, things did not go well for awhile. And, and it was hard to see… [starts breaking up] It's just nice to win one.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Margaret the land lady? Really Pam, is that what you think of me?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: She's sweet and cute. I thought you'd get along.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, OK, Well I'm looking for a passionate affair, not companionship. I'm a man… of intensity, of, of cool and youth and, and passionately. God…[walks away back to his office]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [walks up to reception] Margaret?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I know.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You just got yourself kicked out of your apartment. [both laugh]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh I don't care, I didn't really like that place that much anyway. I'll just move.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh really? Who's gonna take you in? You're messy. You're a klutz, you spill everything. And you leave the volume on the TV way too loud.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, maybe I'll just move in with my boyfriend 'cause he's kind of a slob, too.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK, sure. Let's do it. [Pam laughs]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, I umm, well I'm not gonna, I'm, I'm not gonna move in with anyone unless I'm engaged.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Have I not proposed to you, yet?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hmm, I don't, know…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, well, that's coming. [smiles]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, right now?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. Not gonna do it right here, that would be rather lame.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: OK, so then, when?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pam, I'm not gonna tell you. Hate to break it to you, but that's not how that works.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, right, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wait, I'm serious. It's happening.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ohh kay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And when it happens, it's going to kick your ass, Beesly. So… stay sharp.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I've been warned.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I am not kidding. [shows camera an engagement ring] Got it a week after we started dating.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know man. I was with Jan for so long. I was excited about meeting somebody new. Put my heart out there. It's just… [sighs]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You know what you need? Closure.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're right. What do you mean though?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: There was a woman in your life who affected you very deeply, and she left before you could say good bye. I think you need to say good bye.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Come on. I'll drive.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: We did it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [at same time as Kevin] I did it.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: We got our spaces back.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Wow. [Stanley laughs and high fives Kevin]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Nice job.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nice. [fist bumps Kevin]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, there it is. You're welcome.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Did I do this for me? No, I did this for the little guy. For Joe Sixpack. The guy who wakes up every morning in his four hundred dollar a month apartment, wonders how's he gonna pay his mortgage that month. Wonders how he's gonna fill his car up with oil. Wonders how I'm gonna pay my kid's orphanage bills. That guy shouldn't have to wonder where he's gonna park.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [looking at the chair model's headstone] How did she die?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I guess you could say she died of blunt force trauma and blood loss. She got in a car accident and plowed into the side of an airplane hanger.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: God.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: She was so innocent.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: She was stoned apparently.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know I used to think that I had this perfect person out there waiting for me, but knowing that, that's just silly because she's dead. What do you do?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You wait until next year's chair catalog comes out and you find someone who's still alive.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, you move on.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Where do you want to go for dinner?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't know, I kind of hate all our regular places right now. Oh, you know what [Jim gets down on one knee], that one…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey Pam, will you wait for me one second while I tie my shoe?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [smiling] I hate you. [walks away]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What? My shoe is untied. What is your problem? [Pam laughs] Oh my God, you thought I wa— oh.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, oh.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, no, no.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How could I have thought that? How could I have thought that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [singing] Bye, bye, Ms. Chair Model lady. I dreamt that we were married and you treated me nice. We had lots of kids…drinking whiskey and rye, oh why'd you have to go off and die? Why'd you have to go off [with Dwight] and die?

scenes.speaker: Michael/Dwight
scenes.line: [singing] OH! You believe in rock 'n roll. Can music save your mortal soul? And then [jumbling up the words] can you have to dance real slow. Well, I know that you're in love with him. 'Cause I saw you dancing in the gym. [more jumbled words] 'You both kicked off your shoes. Those rhythm and blues…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Return.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Rhythm and blues…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This'll be [with Dwight] the day that I died.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is moving day. I have spent the last month here at Dwight's lovely farm, taking a little bit of a vacation, clearing my head after Jan and I, um [Dwight puts his fingers to his head and makes a shooting noise] ssp… No, I did not kill her. We were just at different places in our lives. No, I thought I'd be the bigger man and allow her to stay at the condo. She has since moved on; she is staying with her sister in Scottsdale. Fresh outlook, and it's all good.

scenes.speaker: Dwight

scenes.line: Okay, everybody, shh! So, earlier today, Stanley sassed me, and Toby gave me some suggestions on how to discipline him. They did not work, obviously, because they were stupid, so I am now going to fake fire him.
