scenes.line: Yes it is a good idea. It's the only possible solution I have left.

scenes.line: No, okay… I've had enough of you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stanley Hudson, you are fired.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Are you serious?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am serious, we are all serious. You are fired like a heart attack.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: You're firing me over three words. Have you lost your mind? Do you think I'm gonna let you do this to me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmm.

scenes.line: I've watched you screw up this office for ten years, and I'm filing a lawsuit, and I'm gonna tell them about every stupid thing you've ever done up in this office.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright alright, okay, you know what? Now you know how I feel. This was a fake firing. Lesson learned. Good work, everybody. Very nice.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: So I'm not fired.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's it. And uh… do you have anything to say to me?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Oh yes, I do. You are out of your damn, little pea-sized, mind. What is wrong with you? Do you have any sense? At all?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay…

scenes.line: Do you have any idea how to run an office?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Every day you do something stupider than you did the day before.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's not-

scenes.line: And I think, "there's no possible way–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right, all right…

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: He can top that."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: But what do you do?! You find a way, dammit, to top it! You are professional idiot!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, STOP IT! Okay, everybody out.

scenes.line: Who?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Everybody, except Stanley.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Let's go.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I can't find my glasses.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, you know what? Why don't you take my hand, and leave them, and let's get out of here.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, okay.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [chuckling] It's Michael versus Stanley, and it is the clash of the titans. In one corner, you have Michael, and he is mad. And then, in the other corner, you have Stanley, and he's mad. So that's about it!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [starts to cry] I don't understand why you keep picking on me.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Oh, for the love of God.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You just, do, and I don't know why, so… please help me understand.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Fine. Here it is:

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am good person, and sometimes, good people don't get no respect. Rodney Dangerfield. [as Rodney Dangerfield] Hey, I don't get no respect. No respect at all. When I was in the sandbox as a kid, I got not respect. My wife likes to talk after sex, so she called me from a hotel room, and said, "I don't respect you!" Ahh, thoughtless. Aw, you know what don't get no respect? Airplane food. Why don't they just make the plane out of the airline food? My wife don't get no respect, some–take her, please, for example. [as Jeff Foxworthy] If you don't get no respect, you might be redneck. [as Borat] Respect is niiice. Borat. [as Rodney Dangerfield] What's the deal with Grapenuts? No grapes, no nuts. I don't get no respect!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So I'm thinking, as a reward for our loyal clients, that we contact their assistants, and we find out where they live. scenes.line: Has potential to be your best idea yet. [Michael smiles]

scenes.line: That's the dumbest thing I ever heard. [laughs]

scenes.line: Dammit, Phyllis. Alright, everybody out except Phyllis.

scenes.line: You know, I don't care what he did to me. He's mean to other people, that's what gets me. He's just…

scenes.line: Who else is he mean to?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Everybody. He just, he's always, he's always talking about people behind their backs to me.

scenes.line: Like that people are stupid, and that they're idiots, and that they're sluts.

scenes.line: Because he's mean. He's, he's like a really mean-spirited guy. He talks about how gay Oscar is…

scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.line: And that Angela's a midget, and that [indicates Jim] your chin is too big.

scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know, I know. I think it's tiny. I think it's too small if anything. And that your glasses make you look ugly.

scenes.line: She's never worn these glasses before.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, he's just mean.

scenes.line: Michael, I think that what Stanley did to you was rude. Maybe you should just get him aside and tell him that he was behaving badly.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's complicated, Pam. I mean, the world looks a lot easier from behind your reception desk.

scenes.line: Well, I actually agree with her, I think you should talk to him. And you also might want to explain to Andy that no one wants to help him decide whether or not he has a rash.

scenes.line: Oh, yeah, and then, yell at Creed, because you know what? Looking can be as bad as touching.

scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.line: I put Stanley on a pedestal, for a long time. But sometimes he can just be a big, fat jerk. I… jerks don't deserve to be on pedestals. Jerks should be placed up somewhere where everybody can see how jerky they are. Big marble… jerk stand.

scenes.line: Pretty disgusting.

scenes.line: Oop, got some blisties.

scenes.line: This is all we need.

scenes.line: He's nice and he seems interested.

scenes.line: Hi.

Show of hands, anybody want to intern at Dunder Mifflin? We do not offer college credit, we cannot give you any sort of pay, but it is a really fun work environment. Anybody? Show of hands? Damn… it. scenes.line: Oh, thank you! I don't know why I doubted it, because I'm so clearly awesome!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes! So when do you start?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't know, I didn't read it carefully, I just saw "congratulations" and I skimmed the list, I saw my name, I came in here to tell you and get a snack.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow. Busy morning.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So, you know it means I have to go to New York for three months…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's not a big deal. I'll come visit you. And you'll visit me. It's only two hours away. It'll be fine. That part's gonna suck, but it'll be great.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, it sucks, but it'll be great.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: See how easy that is?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ohh… [they hug; she laughs]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I wouldn't go if things weren't so solid with Jim. And down the road, if we have a family, I couldn't go then either. So, the timing's perfect… And that is the first time I've ever used the word "perfect" in here!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey, Stanley…

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Hmm?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I want to introduce you to…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [watching from his office] Toby's replacement. Ugh. Wow.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: So what do we know about her?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, we know that Toby thinks she'll be great. So, strike one, I hate her already.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I hate her too.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why do you hate her?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Because she… stinks… with her… ways… and her… head.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know, Dwight, sometimes… I don't know, I think you say things just to agree with me.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Would that be such a bad thing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah! It would! Just have a thought. Have an original thought. Although, I will agree that her head is weird. You know what we need to do?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We need to sell her an elevator pass.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: But our, our elevator doesn't require a pa… [gasps]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Exactly. A little old-fashioned hazing.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hi. Are there any local companies that rent antigravity machines?

scenes.speaker: Woman over speakerphone
scenes.line: Antigravity machines?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: That's right. Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Woman over speakerphone
scenes.line: What do they do exactly?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: They make you feel lighter…

scenes.speaker: Woman over speakerphone
scenes.line: Antigravity… Um… Anti…depressants? I could put you through to someone on that.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [knock on door] Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, hey, do you still work here?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I'd like to introduce you to my replacement.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nah.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Come on.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. I think I will pass.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Michael Scott, this is Holly.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hi. Yeah. Right. Okay, well, they hired a female Toby. Good for the world. Thank you, God, for creating two of you. Here's how things work here:

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thanks to Toby, I have a very strong prejudice against Human Resources. I believe that the department is a breeding ground for monsters. What I failed to consider though, is that not all monsters are bad. Like E.T. Is Holly our extraterrestrial? Maybe. Or maybe she's just an awesome woman from this planet.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [shaking Holly's hand] The pleasure's all mine.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, thanks. I'm really looking forward to sitting down with you and finding out more about what you do here.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Any time.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: What do you do here?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: …Excuse me.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: What is wrong with this woman? She's asking about stuff that's nobody's business. "What do I do?"… Really, what do I do here? I should've written it down. "Qua" something, uh… qua… quar… quibo, qual…quir-quabity. Quabity assuance! No. No, no, no, no, but I'm getting close.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [whispEring] Have you been introduced to Kevin?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: No. Which one's Kevin? [they glance over at Kevin subtly, who is stifling a giggle]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: He's here on a special work program. He's slow, you know, in his brain.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh. Good for you guys.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hazing is a fun way to show a new employee that she is not welcome or liked.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Accounting department, listen up. Holly, Human Resources. Angela, Oscar, and Kevin. [accountants mumble hellos]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hello. Hello. [to Kevin] Hi.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: What do you do?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I do the numbers.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, good for you.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Do you want a M&M?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, no, that is so sweet. But thank you though.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah. I keep them here at my desk so that everybody doesn't take them.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Well that is a very safe place for them.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Here she is! Holly… You know, if we hung Holly from the ceiling, we'd have to kiss underneath of her. So-I know. Oh, sorry. Question, are you real, or are you a Hollygram?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh… [laughs along] Nice, I've never heard that one before actually.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I bet.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: That's good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I bet. Are these guys boring your ears off?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: No, no, I…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh… What, um, what is your commute like? How long does it take to get in?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Ooh, uh…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know, I should make you a mix. Do you have a, uh, a CD player?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Um… Y-yeah. Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Great.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Do you like it? It's a photo of everyone in the office. So you can take it to Costa Rica.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You're-you're not in it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well I was taking the picture.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I love it. I love it… I would love a picture of the two of us, to also take to Costa Rica.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Sure, do you have a camera here?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: No, uh… [shouts] Does anyone have a camera here? [no one answers him] No one has a camera here. Uh…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I'm gonna… I'll go get one. Stay. [runs out of the office]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [on the phone] So I just got the fax closing the sale, and uh, it's big. It is really big.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Congratulations!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Don't interrupt.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I just-

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Congratulations on doing your job. Did you enter the sale on the website?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, I didn't. I just logged it in right here, so…

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: All right, try to be a team player here, Jim. Log it in the website.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right, well it already went through, so…

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Don't worry about that. Just re-log it. [hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hello?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [listening to "Crash Into Me" on his computer] Hmm… Jim? [Jim comes into his office] I am downloading some N3P…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's not it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Music…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: For a CD mix tape…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Close.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: For Holly.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And I'm looking for perfect songs that work on two levels.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What are the two levels?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The two levels being, uh, "Welcome to Scranton"…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And "I… love you."

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. Let's start with the "I love you" level.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, what's the group that was from Scranton that made it big? Was that U2?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes. You don't love Holly.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think I do.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: But you just met her.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, it was love at first sight. Actually, it was-no, it was when I heard her voice. It was love at first see with my ears.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, okay, it doesn't work like that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, you're not a romantic.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Actually, I think I am. And I have a little bit of experience in office romance.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh really?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Like, with who?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We've been through this.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pam?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes, we are still dating. And guess what? I took it slow.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, you took it too slow.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, we're really happy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This thing with Holly feels a lot like love to me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And that's really sweet. And you can think that. But you don't say that out loud, and you definitely don't say it to her.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't want her to get away.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I know. Here, Michael, you can court her as you get to know her, you know? I mean, the office is a great place for that. Pam and I, we got to know each other right out there. I mean, the first time we joked around was at my desk. And the first meal we ever had was, in the break room, actually. We were at two separate tables and, I remember that. The first time we kissed even, was right outside, and… Look, all I'm saying is that you can get to know someone really really well, like I did, right here at work.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I was thinking… fireworks for the party. What do you think?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh boy. I appreciate your help, but I can't…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, no, no, no, no, no. I just meant I wanted to pay to have fireworks at the party.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Why would you do that?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Because I'm gonna miss Toby. Yep, he's a heck of a guy, and I think we should send him off right. It doesn't matter. Here ya go. [hands her an envelope with money in it]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well we all want a good party, right?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm going to propose tonight. Holy crap!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hey Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Do you need some help?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I can't decide what to get.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Well, what do you like to eat?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Well I like pretzels, but, I really like chips.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hmm. Well how much money do you have there? [looks at the change in his hand] Okay, let's see… fifty… Oh, this is a button. Okay. Fifty-five, sixty-five, okay, you have seventy-five cents. So, that means you could get anything up in the top row.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hmm…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I'm totally gonna bang Holly! She is cute, and helpful, and she really seems into me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [on phone, leaving a message] Hey, Ryan, it's Jim. Look man, I don't know what's gotten into you lately, but you know what? I really don't care, because you're trying to get rid of me. And I bet you don't think I care enough about this job to actually fight back, but you're wrong, because I do, and I will. So you can keep trying to push me out of this place, but guess what? I'm not going anywhere. [hangs up and exhales sharply]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [tool clicking] Damn it!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello, Holly. [Holly is on the floor with her desk chair in pieces] Woah, what are you doing? You don't, uh, you don't have to do that. I mean, we have already put-together chairs. That's how we buy them actually.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, I'm trying to adjust the lumbar support on Toby's chair and… that made this up/down lever thing not work, and then I took the whole chair apart, and that… is the story of me on the floor. It's pretty good, right? You know, I'm gonna sell the movie rights.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And the sequel, "Woman Stands at Desk and Works." So, I have no idea how you, [he sits on the floor] how you sit like that.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yoga.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [as Yoda] Sit on floor and put together chair we will. [laughs nervously] Yo-da. Um…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [as Yoda] Pass curvy metal piece, you will.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So are you in down this weekend? Cause, I'm not-I'm not… I'm not gonna be in town. I'm going out of town.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Ohh, so you can't make my orgy? Kidding!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Kidding. [overdramatically] Acting!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [overdramatically] Acting!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [overdramatically] Acting!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [laughs] Lovitz.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I did it! [exhales]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What'd you do?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I talked to her-Holly. Just pleasantries, nothing, you know… not like, do you want kids or, religion, or what side of the bed do you want. Hey, I can take either side of the bed at this point.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow. Okay, so how'd that feel?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It was hard. I wanted to kiss her.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, I'm so glad you didn't.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Whew, oh God. [inhales] Laying a base. Laying a base…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: There you go. There's plenty of base-laying left, right?… Hey. Hey!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [giddy] Yeah…

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hello Angela.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Phyllis, you look like you're gonna have a heart attack.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Can I get a list of your vendors?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I shredded it.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Why would you do that?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Gosh, I just don't know. Why do you think?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [knocks files off desk] Sorry.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [Michael and Holly are still working on the chair] What'd you guys do?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, there he is. Thought you had gone home already. Why don't you go home, and come back for the party?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, we still have to do the exit interview.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes we do.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'll let you in on a little secret:

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [Michael hands him a present] Wow, thanks, Michael, I…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Can I just say that, of all the idiots, in all the idiot villages, in all the idiot worlds, you stand alone, my friend.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [enters conference room] Hello.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey! Hi, good to see you.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: You too.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm just having a little exit interview.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yeah, I know, that's why I'm here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um, no, no, no. This is very boring stuff. Why don't you take a tour? Have you seen the baler?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: No, no, I'll look at it later. It's part of my job.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [enters conference room] Did you need me to take notes?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hi Pam. Stay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um… Alright, well then, I will proceed. [takes out note cards] I just have some questions that I was gonna ask. Um… Who do you think you are?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I'm Toby.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. Correct. Um… What gives-what-what gives you the right?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Um, I-I brought the binder. Do you wanna take a little look?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sure. You know what? That sounds good. I'll take a little look-see.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Here you go.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thank you. [reads] What would you improve about Dunder Mifflin?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: This place, um…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, no no no no no…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I've got some ideas, I guess…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No no no no no. I'm not asking it. I'm just reading it out loud.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, I'd like to hear the answer.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well let me see… I would, uh…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [hides his face from Holly; whispers to Toby] I'll kill you.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I guess everything's okay.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I made it this far, right? What's the point?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Toby, why don't you open your present?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, no no no, no, no. No, this-hey, hey, hey, hey, this might not be what I think… that I don't even know is in there, because there are a lot of presents in my car, and I don't know which is which…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [unwraps present; present is a rock with a Post-It note rubber-banded to it; reads] "Suck on this."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What the hell is that?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's… What do you mean, "Michael"? That's not even my handwriting. [exits conference room] Hey! What the hell is going on here?! Who thought it would be hysterical to give Toby a rock for his going-away gift?!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You did.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You made me wrap it. I thought it was over the line. I just- [Michael slams conference room door in his face]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, you know what that is? You know what that is? That is… a psyche. Psyche. So, that is not my real gift to Toby.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So what is your gift?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: My gift is forthcoming, Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What is it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am going to give Toby…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Your watch?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: …Yes, I am. That was it. How did you know that?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I just knew.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How did you know?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh that is so sweet.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well… That's my watch.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Thanks, I'm gonna set it to Costa Rica time.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, that's good.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [from outside the conference room] Hey, it's the kid! Look, look, look, look, look! [Michael, Toby, Holly, and Pam exit the conference room] Hey! It's the temp! Look! [everyone is crowded around Jim's computer]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh my gosh.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: It's the temp! [all are watching a YouTube video of Ryan being escorted out of Dunder Mifflin corporate offices by policemen]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Is that the police?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Well this is what happened: uh, Ryan's big project was the website… which wasn't doing so well. So Ryan, to give the impression of sales, recorded them twice:

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [still watching video of Ryan] Oh my God. Ryan… Oh my God.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I cannot wait to visit Ryan in prison. I'm gonna wear my hottest track suit, and get my hair done, and then be like, "Hi Ryan." And then all the other prisoners are gonna be like, "Damn! Ryan, you got a hot ex-girlfriend. Ooh, I would never have treated her so bad when I was outside of prison."

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Would you do me a favor and connect me to Ryan?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Absolutely. [dials and hands Jim receiver]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [clears throat] Right to voicemail. [into phone] Hey, Ryan, it's Jim. You know what? Totally disregard that last voicemail, because you obviously have your hands tied. Good luck! [hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: What's protocol on this?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I normally do nothing, I guess. No, you shouldn't- [Holly knocks on Michael's door]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Michael, are you okay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [voice straining] I'm just worried about my friend.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, of course you are.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just, I'm fine. I'm holding it together. I-I have a business to run.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: No, hey.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm cool.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Stop. You can let yourself be upset. He's your friend. You know what I usually find?…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Holly is sweet and simple, like a lady baker. I would not be surprised to find out that she had worked in a bakery before coming here. She has that kind of warmth. I'm pretty sure she's baked on a professional level.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [everyone exits the building to find a carnival-themed party in the parking lot] Woah! Cool! A bouncy house!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Kevin, take your shoes off first!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No antigravity machine, huh?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Sorry, Michael, I don't think they're real.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ferris wheel's pretty cool though.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow. Look at our parking lot.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, who'd have thought? [Pam sees fireworks being set up; smiles]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Is Jim gonna propose tonight? He is, isn't he? No, he's not… Is he?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, it was a pretty good company, but I just couldn't see a future there. They kept hiring from the outside. It was easy to get in but impossible to rise up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's what she… a lot of places are like that.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I think it's really cool you hired Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You have it?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Almost. [she unlocks Holly's car]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, here we go. Here we go. [Mose carries a raccoon in a cage] Put it in. [he puts the raccoon in the car]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I like, uh…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: That-That's my car.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey. What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Mose drops cage and runs] Mose!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What the hell is going on here?!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: N-nothing you need to know the details of.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There is a raccoon in the car, Dwight!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: N-no there's not.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why did you do that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It was playful hazing.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. There is no such thing as playful hazing. Dwight, I want you to look at Holly right now. Everybody, I want you to look at Holly right now, and maybe if you look at her deeply enough, you will see what I see in her. And that is that we are all very lucky to have her here. Holly is the best thing that has happened to this company since World War II. Fifty years, she is the best. [to Dwight] Take care of that, all right?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's not rabid.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Shh…

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Thanks for bringing that up.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Get it out. Come on, get it out. Get it out.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm really sorry.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Michael, thank you so much for saying that. [puts a hand on his arm] I feel so welcome here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I just… Um, excuse me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did you see that! Did you see it? Did you see what… wow-wee! Uh, well, Jan didn't believe in showing affection, so… sometimes I don't know how to react when a girl touches me. Oh… I like it! [giggles]

scenes.speaker: Vance Refrigeration Guy
scenes.line: Hey Mrs. Vance, we're all out!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hey, Kev, I need you to do me a solid and go buy some more barbeque sauce. [Kevin nods] Okay.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Cool! You drive your own car?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yup. This is my car. Do you drive your own car?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yep. Just like you.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Okay, bye.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Bye. Kevin, I'm really proud of you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [on microphone] Alright! Let's hear it for Darryl and his band. [applause] You know what? Let's also give a shout-out to Phyllis for this awesome party, huh?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [everyone applauds] Yay, Phyllis!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Probably the best one that we have ever had, right? [cheers and applause] But the real reason that we are here, is to say goodbye to a guy who we will probably never ever see again. Now, a lot of you know that I am an accomplished songwriter.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Song parody writer.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have done things like um, "Beers in Heaven."

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Classic.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Or, "Total Eclipse of the Fart."

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Not my favorite, but…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I like that one.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's not my favorite…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I like that one.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I love to sing them, but I am not going to be doing that today. I am going to be doing something I wrote specifically for Toby. [to band] Do you know, um, "Goodbye Stranger"? Supertramp?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah. [music starts]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sings] It was early morning yesterday… I was up before the dawn… and I really have enjoyed my stay… Toby must be movin' on.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm gonna to miss Toby. He has a nice, calming presence in the office.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [singing] Goodbye Toby, it's been nice. Hope you find your paradise…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Don't tell him I said this, but I always thought he was kinda cute.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [singing, screaming into the mic] Come tomorrow, feel no pain! Feel no pain! Toby! Toby! Tobee-yy! Toby's goin' away! See ya! He's outta here! See ya! He's outta here! Ohh! Goodbye Toby! Goodbye Toby! Goodbye Toby! Goodbye Tooo-by!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Not bad.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, hey. Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Someday I would love to hear "Beers in Heaven."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, okay. Yeah. Well, actu-too soon. It's uh, it's uh, very sexual. [cell phone rings] Sorry. Kevin. [answers] Kevin, where are you? You missed my song, buddy.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah, Michael, I'm at Gerrity's. You have to come down here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just pay for it and we'll reimburse you when you get back.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No, I-I brought my money. Michael, there's something that you need to see.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What is it?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Just hurry. [hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Is he okay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. He's at the supermarket and he needs me.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yeah well, the party, driving to the supermarket… it's a big day for him.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, that's true. Don't move a muscle. I will be back momentarily, all right? [Holly freezes; Michael laughs] No, you can drink-you can finish your drink and then I'll-okay, I'll be back.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Well it was good to see you.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: It was great to see you, Jan.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Yeah, so…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: O-kay. Hello Jan.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Hello… Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow, Kevin, really? We're- [to Jan] Sorry. We're in the middle of a party. [to Kevin] Is this why you called me down here?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah, Michael, I just uh…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: I…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I think you kids have a lot to catch up on.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, okay.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thanks, Kevin. Um… [Kevin walks away, revealing Jan's pregnant belly]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow. I can't believe it! Look at you! [Jan laughs] Are you nauseous?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do you-do you have cravings? You never touched my Propecea, or my Accutane, did you?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Uh, no.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good. Good. Thank God.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: I didn't…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Cause that's…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: … touch that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow, I am so happy. I am so deliriously happy…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because you're pregnant, and because it obviously happened when we were together. And, I am very…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Yeah, it did…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: … proud.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: … happen when…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: … we were together. That's true. And-but, you… are not… uh, you're not the dad.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You cheated on me… when I specifically asked you not to?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: …Not to. No, I did not. I did not cheat on you. I did not.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, okay…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So it's mine, and it's not somebody else's, so… I know… the whole toilet seat thing is a myth, so…

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: I went to a sperm bank.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You did?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Yuh-huh.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: When we were going out?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Uh, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: W-I don't understand. You always used to be very cautious… I'd wear two condoms.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: I know.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You'd rather have somebody else's sperm than my sperm?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: No, no no… it's not just any sperm bank. I mean, it's really… this is a really, really great place. It's amazing, actually. I'm gonna bring you the catalogue. You should look through it. It's… and it's-in fact, it's right next to that little breakfast place that you like in the city where you can draw on the tables.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: IHop.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: IHop.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: If I was 22, and I had lots of time to have lots of children, then sure, let's let Michael have a shot at one of 'em. But, honestly, I need to make this one count.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Oh, that's really good. I feel so much better. I just needed to get all that out onto the table.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm glad you told me.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Look, I don't know what you're gonna be doing tomorrow, but I have my Lamaze class in Allentown, and um… you could come. I usually, you know, use a foam noodle instead of a partner…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um, I'll… I have to think about it.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: My whole life, I have known two things:

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh look, they're starting. [all watch fireworks display; scattered applause and cheers; Darryl's band plays soft music]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [to Phyllis] Well, I hope you had fun today, because you're never ever throwing a party again.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [gets engagement ring from his pocket] Hey…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [on microphone] Can I have your attention please? [music stops] I was waiting for the right time to do this, and I can't think of a better time than right now, with the music playing, and all our friends around, and fireworks going off… My parents are here! Andrew and Ellen Bernard. Thank you for sharing in this joyous moment. Miss Angela Martin, will you please join me onstage? [Angela shakes her head 'no'] Okay, then I will come to you, my flower. [knocks over Darryl's keyboard]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Unh! Damn it!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Angela, will you do me the honor… of giving me your tiny hand in marriage? [shows her a ring]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: …Okay.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Into the mic, sweetie.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I said, okay.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: She said yes! [light applause] And the crowd goes wild! Woo! [music starts playing; Jim puts his ring back in his pocket and exhales sharply]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I've been carrying that ring around in my wallet for six years. Because you don't know when you're gonna meet the right girl and the moment's gonna be right. And tonight, with the fireworks, and the music, and everything… it was right.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Can I be your bridesmaid?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well… it's my own fault.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Tuna! [hugs Jim; makes small explosion sound] I'm engaged!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I know. That's awesome, man. That's great.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Mr. Andrew Bernard… it's got a nice ring to it.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey. Hey, you know, I just realized uh, I don't have a picture of the two of us.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, yeah, um…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Yeah, could we…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Sure. Meredith, do you mind?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [hands Meredith his camera] This one right here.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Okay. One two three- [takes picture] Oh let's do it again. Pam your smile is weird.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: It's digital, so just take as many as you want.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: One, two three- [takes picture] One, two, three- [takes picture]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't know, I just, I really thought Jim was gonna propose tonight…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hey there.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: So you missed something really big.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yeah, Andy proposed to one of your accountants.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, wow.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I'm not so specific as I can be on my first day, but…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I can see Andy proposing to Angela. I can also see him proposing to Oscar. [they chuckle] Oh…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: So… You know, somehow after all those ribs, I'm still really hungry. I don't know, I was thinking of maybe going off-campus somewhere, getting some dessert, or…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, um, well, you know what? You should go to the Glider Diner. Ask Stanley about that. Practically lives there.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I'll go to the diner with you.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh that would be great.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah, we can go eat pie.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I love pie.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Me too.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Have a good night.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Okay. Good night.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Bye.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yeah, it was a good day. I mean, first days are always the hardest, right? Well, I should go. [Kevin is waiting in the car] I gotta buckle him in.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well this is it. I am here to see you off.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Thanks… [Hank is standing next to Michael] Really, Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sorry. Corporate policy.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: It's not.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You might take something.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: I don't think he's gonna take anything.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, security guard.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [watch that Michael gave him beeps] Oh, some kind of… alarm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [on phone, leaving a message] Hi, Jan, it's Michael. I just um, I just want to let you know that I am going to go to your Lamaze class tomorrow. Um, and if there's any details you need to fill me in on, like… what exactly Lamaze is, that would be great. And I… will see you tomorrow morning. [hangs up] I am going to be… kind of a daddy.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Party planning's a real high. Like a runner's high. [gets out of elevator; hears moans and heavy breathing coming from office; opens door and sees Dwight and Angela making out]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [sees Phyllis; gasps] Oh my God!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What? [turns and sees Phyllis; Phyllis gasps and drops the box in her hands]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: This is Jim Halpert…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: And Pam Beesly.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, Pam! Toby says such nice things about you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [to Toby] Thank you!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He didn't mention me, did he?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, no, he said you were a really good salesman.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thanks, Toby.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You're welcome.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I've always gotten along well with Toby. Uh, we're friends. But I don't think we'll stay in touch necessarily. I think I'll probably get updates on him from Pam.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, I think that makes us neighbors.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: It's a couple streets over.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, maybe you can show me some of the fun hangouts, and where to get my nails done.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Sure! That sounds fun!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Great.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I hate that bitch. I wanna cut her face. [Dwight walks by and hears]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Stop! Don't look at me. On the counter you will find bread, peanut butter, and jelly. Pretend to make yourself a sandwich.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Pretend? Or really make one?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Really make one.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Make your own [bleep]in' sandwich.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Will you please? Make a sandwich. Now, according to my sources, you have an issue with the new H.R. woman. Well, so do I. And so does our secret benefactor. That's too much peanut butter. What I propose is a good old-fashioned hazing, and I need your help. If you choose to accept this mission…Wipe the knife off before you stick it in the jelly. Have you ever made a sandwich before? Dammit, Meredith!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [on phone] Well, who can do a party of this size? But you're in the business, you must surely know of some other businesses. Okay, well, I JUST WANT A DAMN DANCE FLOOR! Sorry. So sorry, I shouldn't have sworn, I'm so sorry. Um, thanks for your time. [knock on door] What? Sorry, I shouldn't have said 'what' like that, it was really rude.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Scared me. How's the party planning going?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Jim, I am so f[bleep]ed.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So it's going great, sounds like.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I don't know, I'm not used to the stress.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: When I was growing up, my mom said, "the sky's the limit." I could do anything. Be a teacher's aide, nurse's assistant, some kind of volunteer. But now, I, I'm not so sure.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: This is a picture I've been carrying around in my wallet for about six years. It's this unspoiled beach in Costa Rica, Playa Grande. Um, I take it out when I get stressed or depressed, and it really calms me down. Never thought I'd get to live here, you know. But it turns out they built these great new condos there, so, this could be me, right around, uh, where the trees used to be.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Did you just buy that?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Yeah, I guess it will be my, uh, thing in Costa Rica, be a nature photographer.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's cool.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Yeah. Um, you mind if I get a picture?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sure!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Think you could…[wants to hand the camera to Jim, but Jim is starting to snuggle up with Pam, posing. Toby aims the camera, the flash pops up] Okay. [takes picture] Okay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Good one? [Toby puts on the lens cover and scurries away awkwardly] That's a cool camera.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, this is the second time in two days that the website isn't working. Do you guys know anything about it?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The website is hiding, forming alliances with other sites, preparing an attack for which we will have no defense.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Do you honestly believe that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes, I do.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm gonna get a second opinion.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It was down for a couple hours yesterday, then back up, and now I've heard from a very reliable source that it is once again out of commission. And that reliable source is you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, you could just say you don't know what's going on.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Um, I do, 'cause I just told you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Is Ryan gonna fire me? I don't know. I know that I've done everything I can, and I just brought in a huge sale, and… am I insane, or was this kid a temp two years ago? Because in the three years that he's been here, I think all he's ever done is start a fire and grow a beard. And it's not even a good beard.

scenes.speaker: Troy
scenes.line: Troy Undercook, for Michael.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ahh! I'm sorry, I didn't, I didn't see you come in.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Troy! What are you doing here?

scenes.speaker: Troy
scenes.line: Just filling in for Ryan, as a favor.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Where is Ryan?

scenes.speaker: Troy
scenes.line: He had an urgent matter in New York.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Welcome to our land.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dwight. [to Troy] Michael will be out in a second.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Can I get you a tankard of mead?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Troy, can you do me a huge favor? Next time you see Ryan, can you tell him to check his messages? That'd be great.

scenes.speaker: Troy
scenes.line: If I see him, I'll tell him.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Why wouldn't you see him? You work for him.

scenes.speaker: Troy
scenes.line: I report to Wallace now.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, what's going on?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Looks serious.

scenes.speaker: Someone
scenes.line: What's a…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, my God.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Troy, do you know anything about this?

scenes.line: Uh…

scenes.line: Not that guy who murdered his mother. He was not so handsome. Also Kevin.

scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Party's over. You are so busted!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK, everybody. Phyllis, did I or did I not say fruit?

scenes.line: You said fruit, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And what is that?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Cake.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Happy Birthday, Stanley! [kicks cake onto Michael]

scenes.line: Ronnie was bleh. Things were at an all time sad here. But then I got an e-mail from Ryan, that he was coming back to town. And I called the temp agency and I told them I will pay you any amount, just give me Ryan Howard. Give him to me. I want him. I need him.

scenes.line: All right.

scenes.line: Kelly.

scenes.line: Cool.

scenes.line: Dieting's only half of it.

scenes.line: Mmm-hmm. Saunas.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Gah, the dreadmill. [both laugh]

scenes.line: What?

scenes.line: Really, where?

He is beautiful. This big fat pig is beautiful.

scenes.line: It's my sumo suit. I just didn't inflate it all the way. I am so glad that I bought instead of rented.

scenes.line: Body image. We are here because there is something wrong with society.

scenes.line: See, you're always saying there's something wrong with society, but… maybe there's something wrong with you.

scenes.line: If it's me, then society made me that way. Now, I know a lot of you are probably asking yourself, "Why are you dressed in a plus sized suit?"

scenes.line: Because you're kind of doing Michael Clump.

scenes.line: How do you know Michael Clump?

scenes.line: No, no, no, it goes, it goes… look, "I say, I say, I say, I'll sit on you!"

scenes.line: No, no, no, NO, no! You know what? Fat people are not monsters! Why don't you guys have a little more sensitivity to the subject. Bang! Boom! Case in point! scenes.line: Vamping.

scenes.line: Hey! Why don't you just sit down, please?

scenes.line: Eh, I've been sitting all day.

scenes.line: I did.

scenes.line: Why?

scenes.line: [at a loss for words]

scenes.line: Quiet please.

scenes.line: Sorry.

scenes.line: Sorry.

And in order to be healthy, you have to eat, Kelly. Kelly. [kneels down in front of Kelly, Dwight tries to help him down, Michael shouts gibberish at him] Kelly, I want you to stand up on your chair. scenes.line: [stands up] Everything. She's perfect.

scenes.line: Ok, be more specific.

scenes.line: I wonder what people like about me? … Probably my jugs.

scenes.line: I hate dieting, I hate it so much. I hate this worm inside of me!

scenes.line: I want you to know. Kelly, look at me! I want you to know that you are beautiful. You are truly, truly beautiful. Give me a hug. [Michael hugs Kelly, his head in her chest] Mmmmmm.

scenes.line: Hey Ryan, look. Shaved off my goatee. I am goateeless. We are the goateeless brothers.

scenes.line: Oh…

scenes.line: We better.

scenes.line: I know. I suck.

scenes.line: Umm…

scenes.line: Oh, no.

scenes.line: Really?

scenes.line: No.

scenes.line: Aach.

scenes.line: And you know what? I even got two tickets to see the Counting Crows tonight as a surprise. Why do guys not call when they say they are gonna call?

scenes.line: Ugh.

scenes.line: Mmhmm.
