scenes.line: So, I've gone over corporate policy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What do you think? What do you think of this place?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, it's very nice.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Istn't it? Yeah, it's kind of… business/romantic. So you're from Des Moines?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Mmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow, that sounds so… warm.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: In Summer.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Here too. You know what my favorite season is?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Maybe we should talk about Meredith first.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, get the boring stuff out of the way. Autumn was what I was going to say. When the leaves change. It's just, I… I think it is the most contemplative of seasons.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Ok, so I have gone over this and I have thought about it and I just don't think there is any way I can write a report that doesn't end with her being terminated.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow, terminator, terminator.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I'm from da future.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Andy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yo.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: By any chance, did you see Battlestar Galactica last night?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No, I did not. Was that any good?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Actually not. It was really so-so.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ok. [Dwight turns around, but Jim holds up the stopwatch, threatening to start it]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I mean I like all the crazy monsters and stuff. You know, like klingons and wookies and all that but… [Dwight begins to turn around again, Jim holds up the watch] Sorry, was there something you wanted to add, Dwight?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Is that anything like the original Battlestar Galactica?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know, it's weird. It's practically a shot for shot remake.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Really? [Dwight closes his eyes, clutches the paper in his hands] Huh, that's cool.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Story's kinda bland. It's about this guy named Dumbledore Calrissian who needs to return the ring back to Mordor.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Really? That doesn't sound right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I just don't want my employees thinking that their jobs depend on performance. I mean, what sort of place is that to call home? And Meredith needs this job. This is her main source of money.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Well, that's very sweet but we have to follow the protocol. Those are the rules.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, new idea. We don't report it at all. We just punish her.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: We punish her?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmhmm, tell her she can't have sex for six months.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I don't think we could enforce that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know. I saw this thing, like a belt with a key.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: A chastity belt.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, it's more of a underwear garment that has little spikes like made of, sometimes they are made of metal. You know what I am talking about. You unlock a little door that… down… where you, where you put, where you put the…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He has not stopped working for a second. At 12:45 he sneezed while keeping his eyes open, which I always thought was impossible. At 1:32 he peed, and I know that because he did it in an open soda bottle under the desk while filling out expense reports. And on the flip side, I have been so busy watching him that I haven't even started work. It's exhausting, being this vigilant. I'll probably have to go home early today.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am just saying that I don't think that you understand what I am saying.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: No, you are saying that we should sweep it under the carpet, accept the discount on supplies, not fire Meredith and pretend like the whole thing never happened.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: What am I saying?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well… bleh busted. I don't…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I'm saying that her behavior is unethical and a little icky and I don't think I want to work in an environment where that sort of conduct is tolerated.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, you have to tolerate a lot when you are part of a family.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: It's not a family. It's a workplace.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I will be honest with you. That car ride did not go well and that was not my fault. The only reason I am standing out here right now is because I don't want to take the elevator with her. And I am holding on to her leftovers. [throws Holly's leftovers in the trash]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Dwight walks back to his desk] 19 minutes and 48 seconds. What were we doing for 19 minutes and 48 seconds?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: None of your business.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So I guess I can assume that was personal.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Dwight stares at Angela, buttoning the top button of her blouse] Fine.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So maybe you're not completely ethical after all.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes, maybe I'm not. [Dwight grins and gives a sly look at the camera]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: It's been a little tense. People are suspicious of me. And my best friend in the office won't even talk to me. Turns out being the morality police does not make you popular. I should know because in middle school I was the hall monitor and the kids used to stuff egg salad in my locker. I was just hoping middle school was over.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Kendall from corporate HR is on line one and Holly is on her way in too.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What's the only thing worse than one HR rep?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Two HR reps.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You get me.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Can I sit?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know. Can you? Kendall, my main man.

scenes.speaker: Kendall
scenes.line: [on speakerphone] Listen, Holly, Michael, I just got the report that your branch submitted and there's a lot of stuff about a relationship Meredith is having with…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yes, that came out during the ethics seminar.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Let the record show that it was during the immunity part of the seminar.

scenes.speaker: Kendall
scenes.line: Well, I'm not sure these circumstances warrant any action.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, I think it is pretty clear that it was unethical.

scenes.speaker: Kendall
scenes.line: Well, from what I can gather it seems like a gray area. Look, to be honest the company is getting a discount at a tough time in our balance sheet and I don't know that the right thing to do for the company is to turn our noses up at that.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Umm, Kendall, I understand that the discount is good for the company but I'm just not happy about the way we are getting it.

scenes.speaker: Kendall
scenes.line: I thought it was clear with you, Holly. Your task was to get signatures from the employees showing that they completed the training.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: No, I understand.

scenes.speaker: Kendall
scenes.line: Every other branch has managed to get this to us so if it's not something you can handle then that's a different discussion.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: No. I can do it.

scenes.speaker: Kendall
scenes.line: Good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How do you tell somebody that you care about deeply, "I told you so." Gently with a rose? In a funny way, like it's a hilarious joke? Or do you just let it go, because saying it would just make things worse? … Probably the funny way.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Can I have everyone's attention? Excuse me, may I have everyone's attention, please. We need to finish the ethics seminar.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No way, lady.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: It's a trap.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Everyone, please, I just need your signatures to show corporate that I gave you the training.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Don't sign anything.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, everybody listen up. If you are not in that conference room in two minutes I am going to kill you.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: It's a quarter to five and I have started to gather my things.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Get in there right now or I'm gonna lose it! [everyone gets up to go in the conference room]

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Am I getting fired?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Now is really not the time, Meredith.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: In this next section we examine the difference between sick days and personal days. Sick days are only to be used when an illness precludes you form doing your job or can spread to your coworkers. Personal days, on the other hand, are much more flexible.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Thank you, Meredith, this was delicious.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Hey, where is the steak sauce?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I think we're out.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I got some in my minivan somewhere.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Wait a second, how does the steak factor in again?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I think she got it as a tip, but I don't know why she didn't just take cash.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I don't care what she's doing. I just hope she keeps doing it.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Amen. Just keep the ribs coming.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Stealing office supplies is another big ethical area that there seems to be some confusion about.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: That's a big ethical area?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Listen, I would love to have an honest conversation with management about ethics. Why isn't the company doing better? Mmm… it could be the pad of Post-its I took home last week. Or it could be the twelve million dollars in deferred compensation in stock options they paid the CEO for a year of substandard performance. I'm sure we'll cover both in the seminar.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I've done some things I'm not proud of. Committed some atrocities in Vietnam, uh, two years ago. Princess Cruise Lines.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: During our honeymoon safari in Africa, Bob and I were driving late at night, and he'd been drinking, and suddenly thump. We hit something with our jeep. It was probably a man. We didn't know what to do. We heard the police were corrupt and they might beat us, so we just kept driving as fast as we could. We bribed the airline, got on a plane that night, and fled home. Maybe it was just an ostrich. In a soccer uniform.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Have any of you ever faced any ethical dilemmas in the work place?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Let's keep this rollin'… Ryan?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, but you mean other than embezzling?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Fraud, Jim, Fraud.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Fraud.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Sure, last year you guys were riding me really hard for the website and I just peeled out my Z3 and I knocked the mirror off somebody's car. I never said a thing.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Wait, what?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: You knocked the mirror off of my car.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah, isn't that messed up?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: That guy did a lot of things I'm not proud of.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Wait, when you say "that guy", you mean you?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I mean the guy I used to be. I'm Ryan 2.0 and if it makes you feel any better, that guy did a lot of messed up stuff to me too. [tries to walk away]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No, you mean that you did a lot of messed up stuff to you… too?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Look, I feel you okay? That guy took no responsibility for his actions.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: But are, are you gonna pay for my mirror?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: If I have to answer for everything that guy did… [shakes head] I'm never gonna move on.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: It was like two hundred dollars.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: We're never going to get what need from that guy. [still shaking head, pats Kevin on the shoulder and walks out of the kitchen]

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hey, anybody see a pair of sunglasses?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Umm… I think I saw some in the kitchen. [toaster oven bell rings, Ryan opens it as smoke rolls out and he see's his melted sunglasses on the tray, Ryan takes cooked sunglasses to Kevin] Oh! I didn't do that. That was Kevin 1.0, but he hurt a lot of people Ryan, and I can't accept responsibility for what he did. [Ryan walks away and throws his sunglasses in the trash, Kevin smiles]

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: What are we gonna do?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: About what?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Holly. She's on the warpath. She is gunning for all our jobs. Do you guys have any dirt on her?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Mmm… sometimes her stockings have a run in them.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: No. Something I can blackmail her with.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: One time I said good morning to her, and she didn't say it back.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Stanley, didn't she say a bunch of racist stuff to you?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: No, that was you.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: You weren't even in the room! Thanks for nothing.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Hey, how did it go?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, cr…, oh, God. Meredith, you know what? I just need a minute, okay?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Okay. [remains sitting]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What do you need?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I'm getting fired, aren't I? I can't get fired. I got nothing else. Nothing. No skill set. Can't type, bad on the phone, not great with people.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I… really want to keep you.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Where else am I gonna get another job that lets me come it at eleven and leave at four?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wait, what?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I wish Toby was still here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nnnngah!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [looking pregnant] Hey Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Contractions are coming every ten minutes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK, just remember to keep breathing.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: My cervix is ripening.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK, good.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [drawing two family trees on a whiteboard] Jan is about to have a baby with a sperm donor. And Michael is preparing for the birth of a watermelon with Dwight. Now, this baby will be related to Michael through [draws a question mark] delusion.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael! My water's breaking!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, OK! OK!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Aaaaaaaa! What do you do? What do you do?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I get a call from Jan and I meet her at the hospital.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Right. Highways or surface roads?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I take Quincy Ave to Gibson.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, Gibson is covered in potholes. Your car breaks down. Adapt!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I checked the route – there are no potholes. Come on, get in here and have the baby.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's about adapting to the circumstances.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [annoyed] Andy, would you like to have my baby?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yes! Yeah. [squatting and pushing] Aaaaaaaa! Aaaaaaaa! Aaaaaaaa!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No. OK, no. I'm crowning! I'm crowning! Aaaaaaaa! [runs into Michael's office]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right, OK. [to Andy] Sorry. Sorry. Here we go. Here we go!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The pressure! The pressure!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do it! Do it! Scream! Scream it out, scream it out, scream it out.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Aaaaaaaa!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Aaaaaaaa!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Babies are one of my many areas of expertise. Growing up, I performed my own circumcision.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just keep pushing…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [lying on Michael's desk] Hold me!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm right here.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Cradle my head!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm right here, I'm right here.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm screaming, I'm screaming, I'm screaming! Aaaaaaaa!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [annoyed] All right. Dwight. Just push and breathe.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Numb me up. I want anesthesia!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Shhh. No, you can't have it. It's too late.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No! I don't want natural!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. You have to just push it out!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: OK!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Keep simulating.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Aaaaaaaa!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Do you have the Sharpie?!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Keep simulating.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Do you have the Sharpie?!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, I do!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: OK! When the baby emerges, mark it secretly in a kind of a mark that only you could recognize and no baby snatcher can ever copy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OK.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ready?!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Aaaaaaaa!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Aaaaaaaa! It's coming! Here we go! [drops the watermelon onto the floor] Oh! God! Wow! What was on that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Butter. Newborns are slippery.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nice touch. Good. Let's try that again.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [eating the watermelon] It is going to be the happiest day of my life. [Dwight gets dressed behind Michael and zips his fly]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello ladies, how's my shower going? Phyllis, did you get the live storks?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Damnit, Phyllis! I'm sorry. [more softly] Damnit, Phyllis. It was hard enough to convince Jan to come. So are we set for refreshments?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Per your instructions, we have the personalized M&Ms with the baby names. This is your boy bowl, with the name "Chevy." And this is the girl bowl, with M&Ms with the name "Astird."

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: That can't be right.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Michael wrote down "Astird."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: She said it is the name of a Viking princess. So…

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Ass…turd.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know. I know. It is beautiful. No. Thank you. Is this it? I mean, is this… Two bowls of M&Ms and some balloons? You know what Phyllis, I think you need to step it up. I think you need to get the lead out. Because if I'm not mistaken, we gave you your wedding shower here. We all came into this room and gave you a golden shower. Well you know what, where's my golden shower, Phyllis?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It does not matter to me at all whether this baby is biologically mine. I am going to love it. It's like when the dog nurses the tiger cub. Have you seen that video? It is… it's so bizarre and unnatural, but… it, it happens.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hey, I'm collecting for the baby shower.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: But Phyllis, it's not his baby.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I know, Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Why do we have to pay money to get a gift for his ex-girlfriend's unborn sperm bank baby?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Look at it as if you're paying for the cake, not the baby. Sheet cake.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I do enjoy being the head of the Party Planning Committee. I'm no longer under Angela's heel, and her little grape head is under mine.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [banging on the glass] Hey, hey. What are you doing? Don't talk to them.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Sorry.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Make the party. Don't – make the party, please, Phyllis. [Phyllis starts inflating a balloon with a pump] Pump it!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [on phone] So you know Stacy, right?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right, the one from England.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: There's no one from England, Jim. Katie studied in Ireland – this is Stacy, the one who does the Murakami-style collages.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh. Right, that style.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So, Stacy and Eric get to Bogre's DeTech half an hour early so they don't have to sit on the slab.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Anyway, Bogre's TA Sarah Kaya comes in.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wait, who's Sarah Kayacombsen?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, Sarah Kaya comes in. Don't interrupt, I have like thirty seconds to finish this and get to DigiPres.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So Sarah Kaya says to Eric, "No way. You can't reserve seats." And Stacy gets all up in her face and Sarah Kaya picks up Stacy's new PM pad and throws it at the light box.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [clearly just humoring her] No… way!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ha ha. That's hilarious?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, it's horrible! Jim, she might get arrested.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Who, Stacy?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, Stacy is a boy. Ugh. Frustrating. Why can't you just be in art class with me?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, wait, I gotta go, class starting. [hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK, I'll ta…I'll talk to you later. [hangs up] That was a good story.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Who's Sarah Kayacombsen?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yo. I got the Nard-puppy for ya. What's going on here?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It's a baby game where you guess whose picture is whose.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Awww. Check it out – who would have thought that this little baby would be marrying that little baby?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: That's Phyllis.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well –

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yeah, it is. So I hope you two are very happy together. Pervert.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Why would that make me a pervert, I –

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Well, it does. That's me.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That's not you.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yes it is.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That's mean, come on, that's – [Angela storms out]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ahoy, matey.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Ahoy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ahoy. So, how you doin'?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um, listen. Jan Levinson is coming in today, and she is in the terminal stages of her pregnancy – the child of which I have a vested interest. It's all kind of weird. Anyway, she is incredibly… fat and enormous right now – extremely unattractive. And you are, on the other hand, one of the more attractive people in the office. So, while she's here I am going to be acting kind of cold to you. And I am doing this to pay respect to her bloated feelings. And I'm treating Ryan the same way.

scenes.line: Of course. Yeah.

scenes.line: Can I hold her?

scenes.line: I love babies. I think they are beautiful in all sorts of different ways. I try to pick up and hold a baby every day, if possible, because it nourishes me. It feeds my soul. Babies are drawn to me, and I think it's because they see me as one of them. But cooler, and with my life put together a little bit. If a baby were president, there would be no taxes, there would be no war. There would be no government, and things could get terrible. It actually, probably – it would be a better screenplay idea than a serious suggestion.

scenes.speaker: Kevin

scenes.line: Give me the phone.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Please give me another chance. Mr. Buttlicker.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Give me the phone. Give me the phone.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I have to put you on with my boss.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I should hope so. [Michael takes phone] Who is this?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello, this is Michael Scott, regional manager.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, this is William M. Buttlicker.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello, Mr. Buttlicker. How may we help you?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael, I like the sound of your voice. You know what I'm going to do? I'm going to buy one million dollars worth of paper products today.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [shakes fist, whispers] Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [covers phone, whispers to Dwight] See how it's done? [into phone] Thank you very much, sir. I don't think you'll regret it. [to Dwight] See what I did?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You are the master.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: There is one condition, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You have to fire the salesman that treated me so terribly.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Don't do it, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: … [whispers] It's a million-dollar sale.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: So it's called the Shangri-La Tent. It's two stories, heated and has a bridal suite for my bridal sweet. It's just really simple, really tasteful.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I don't want to be married in a tent like a hobo

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hobos live in trains.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Nana Mimi can't be in canvas that long.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, Nana Mim — Ahh. OK, look. This tent is awesome. And it's in high demand, so I really think we should put a deposit down now.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: OK fine you can have your tent, but only if it's in a field, a hand-plowed field

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Done and done-er.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: There has to be a barn that's old enough that you can see the stars through the roof slats when you lay on your back. And antique tools to look at when you roll over.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Do you have a specific place in mind?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No. But anything within a five- to eight-mile radius is acceptable.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: On it!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Dwight. Dwight. [Dwight's car comes screeching into view]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Get in!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you serious?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Get in! [he peels off into parking space]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK, what are you —

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Shh. [turns radio up loud, playing "Centerfold."] They might be listening to us.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What's that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: They might be listening to us

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Who's they?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Customer service might be monitoring this conversation.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: In this car?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You never know. Better safe than sorry.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [turns radio down] What are you thinking?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Who stands to benefit from our downfall?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: The mob, maybe NASA.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Could be the mob. But then Dunder-Mifflin would need to be a front for money laundEring, and there's little evidence of that.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Is there some evidence?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [on Bluetooth] Ooh, cute shoes online.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: How many shoes do you need?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I don't know. Two, maybe three if one wears out. How many shoes do you need?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm not talking to you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Who are you talking to?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pam.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: She's not here, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, she's not.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [in New York, humming to herself to the tune of "Centerfold"] Na na na na na. Na na na na na na na.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [at computer, spins chair around and makes triumphant gesture] Yes!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I found it. I found the perfect place. A local bed-and-breakfast on a 60-acre beet farm. And even better, I have an in with the owner. Oh, yeah. We work together. It's Dwight Schrute. As in Schrute Farms.

scenes.speaker: Customer
scenes.line: [on phone] So I'd like to redouble my order, if you could put me down for, um —

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wait, shut up.

scenes.speaker: Customer
scenes.line: I'm sorry?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Shh. Do you hear that?

scenes.speaker: Customer
scenes.line: Hear what?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Breathing. Is that you?

scenes.speaker: Customer
scenes.line: Well, I am breathing, yes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well, stop. Hold your breath. I still hear it. Who's there? Kelly, is that you? Hold on. [puts down phone and runs away]

scenes.speaker: Customer
scenes.line: I need paper.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [jumps into Kelly's area] Ha! [Kelly screams in surprise]

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Oh, my God. You scared me.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hear anything interesting?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: What are you talking about?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [laughs] I think you know.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: You always say that, and I almost never know.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What are you up to, girl? Huh? Phyllis put you up to this? Stanley? Are they paying you?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Are you accusing me of something?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Of course I am. I know you're the mastermind, but you're too stupid to do it by yourself.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [behind Dwight]:

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [enters breakroom] Hey. Sorry about Dwight, by the way.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Yeah, he's weird.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, we all handle it differently. I personally choose to handle it like a normal person, but…

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: OK.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, how are you and Darryl?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Um, we're cool. [gets up to leave] Bye.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Bye.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [on Bluetooth] That was weird.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What was?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Have you ever had a conversation with Kelly where she didn't go on for 15 minutes without taking a breath?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, actually.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Did you do something to her?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I don't think so.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, something's off.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, how's things?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Living in the moment.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Do you have any reason to believe that Kelly would be mad at me?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I don't play the politics game anymore, Jim. Can I tell you something? I played it full on in New York. I played it high stakes. For keeps. Made it to the top. But look what it cost. [takes sip of coffee] Can I tell you what else I learned?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wait, that's pretty weird.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, Andy has a mug just like that.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Oh, yeah, Kelly gave them out as party favors. Remember? You got one.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. What party?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Her America's Got Talent finale party over the summer. [Jim makes face] That's crazy. It was packed. I thought everyone was there. You were there. I remember you being there.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I wasn't. But thank you. [to Pam] Do you know anything about this party?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes, I said you definitely should go, but you wanted to visit me instead.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I can't be the only one who didn't — [sees mugs on Angela's and Meredith's desks]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [walks quickly to break room, opens cabinet and finds mugs of Oscar, Creed and Phyllis]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Dwight, let me see your coffee cup.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No. [holds Sheriff's Department mug protectively]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Is that it?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No. Why? No. [puts it in desk drawer and slams it shut]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK, I'm gonna assume that was it. Here's the thing:

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [in New York] Right Dwight is loud.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I knew it! Yeah! Ha-ha! Woo! [kicks near Phyllis' head; she ducks] Boom! Kelly the whole time. Let's get her.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, no, no, no. Dwight, Dwight, Dwight. Let's talk about this.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: What's going on?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why don't you tell us?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Nothing's going on.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Let me paint you a picture of a little girl from southern India, who despite being welcomed into this country will now spend the rest of her life in prison for a crime she did commit.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight. [to Kelly] I was informed by these gentlemen that the reports that you filed may not entirely be accurate.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: What? I — I don't know what you're talking about. This is the first I'm hearing about this.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, come on. You juked the stats, cupcake.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We called about a dozen customers, and they all said that they gave us great marks.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What's going on?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I love your tie, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [looks momentarily flattered, but thinks better of it] Kelly.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I was raped.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You cannot say "I was raped" and expect all of your problems to go away, Kelly. Not again. Don't keep doing that. I'll give you one last chance to come clean. Just tell me what happened.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: OK, all right. OK, I did it. All right? I lied, whatever. Just fire me. But you know what? I did it because you guys didn't come to my party, and you said you would try to and then you didn't even show up, and so you're bad friends.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We have our confession. I'm calling security. [reaches for phone]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't. Don't. Get away from that, Dwight, please. You know what? She's got a point about you two. You do have a problem dealing with people.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: See? I wasn't lying.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You were lying.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I was lying.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes. Jim, Dwight, please excuse us.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I want to be here when you fire her ass.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I will call you when it is time. [Jim and Dwight leave]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have an enormous amount of trouble trying to get people to come to my place. And I hate it. I can't tell you how much leftover guacamole I have ended up eating over the years. I don't even know why I make it in such great quantities. Here's what we're gonna do. We are going to sit here for a while, make it look good. And maybe you should cry. Can you make yourself cry?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: No problem.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think you should do that. [Kelly starts fake-crying, then laughing, then she and Michael both laugh]

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.line: Pam Beesley?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, what are you doing here?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Who's that?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's Alex.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.line: It's Pam. Uh, I came to kidnap you. There's free wine and cheese at the Chuck Close retrospective. Let's go.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, that's gonna be great. Who's Chuck Close?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, I love Chuck Close and his photo-realist paintings. But I have to work.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.line: Uh, well, actually there's something else I'd love to talk to you about. Can we go somewhere else to talk about it?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: OK.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's it. I want to talk to this guy. Put me in his ear.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.line: [in private office] Um.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What's up?

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.line: I'm gonna take a big leap and I want to tell you that I think you should not move back to Scranton.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm gonna make a bigger leap here. He is into you.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.line: Why did you come to New York in the first place?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Because they have a great design program, and I wanted to see if I was any good at it. And I wanted to work on my art, too.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.line: Right. And that's why I think that you should stay here. Because I mean, you — really you just got here, you know? You can't do New York in three months. You know, it has everything. It has — all the opportunity is here. All the — the whole art scene is in New York. You know, it would be nuts to go back to Scranton without getting to fully experience it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Jim's in Scranton.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.line: I know. But all I'm saying is, if there's even a teeny, tiny part of you that really wants to be an artist, then I think you should stay here, because you don't want to wake up in 50 years and look back and wonder what could have been. And that is the end of my speech. I planned it all. Anyway … I will see you tomorrow.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'll see you tomorrow.

scenes.speaker: Alex
scenes.line: OK. [Pam and Jim look worried]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Is that the Matsuhashi B-400? The world's tiniest Bluetooth? [reaches toward Jim's ear] May I?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Don't.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Congratulations on choosing Schrute Farms for your wedding.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: We haven't decided on anything yet. We're still reviewing some options, and it's gonna come down to the numbers.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well, then. Why don't you look over some of our materials? [opens album]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh. Hmm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [looking at Angela] While I describe to you the Excalibur package. In addition to the breathtaking natural beauty and smell of Schrute Farms, I can promise you that our grounds can be catered to fit your exact specifications. [Angela smiles] I will work tirelessly for you over the coming months and be at your constant disposal. [Andy moves his head into Dwight's view] Please feel free to call or stop by, any time of the day or night.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That's very generous.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: While you, my good friend, have nothing more to worry about. This wedding is officially out of your hands.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, thank the good Lord. Deal! [shakes Dwight's hand]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: OK.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Um, what are we talking price wise?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You already said deal.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Pay him whatever he wants.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Can't argue with that. Dwight … [takes Angela's hand] You are going to make us so happy. [Dwight and Angela grin at each other]

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Come on, how did you propose? Spill it. Were you wasted?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How did I propose, let me see… well, I drove her up to Nashua, and I had the ring, a big 10-carat diamond; it was beautiful. And I got down on my hands and knees, and a shooting star crossed overhead, and it just lit up the diamond like a shooting star. And we were in a restaurant, and I put the diamond into a cheeseburger.

scenes.speaker: Kevin & Andy
scenes.line: Ooooh.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And she took a bite, started to choke. So what do I do? I have CPR training. Go around, start doing the Heimlich.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Perfect.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The ring, 10-carat diamond, pops out of her mouth, hits her shrimp cocktail, right onto her finger. Million-to-one shot. All of the Greek people in the restaurant start screaming "Opa!" Which means "congratulations," so…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, man!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [in Jim's ear] Ask how he's doing since the breakup.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So, how you holdin' up?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm pretty much devastated.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ask if there's anything you can do.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know what you should do? Take a vacation.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Maybe go to Sandals, Jamaica. Or the other Sandals, Jamaica. I just don't want to go by myself.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Tell him you'd like to go with him.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We should take a look at those surveys.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why are surveys important? Okay, hypothetical:

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Great marks, Phyllis. [Phyllis walks out of Michael's office smiling]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [to Stanley] Hey, I did good too!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I knew it. Haha! [they high five]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [hand up, seeking a high five] Up! Don't leave me hangin'! [they do]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What do I do with my bonus check? [scoffs] Simple. Purchase paper from myself. Boosts my sales, which boosts my bonus. Last year I bought even more paper to make this year's bonus even bigger. Eventually, I'll get a bonus so big I can retire on it. And I'll use the paper to write my memoirs.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I taught Jim and Dwight everything I know about sales. But there are certain things that cannot be taught, and it is these things that I now must teach them.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Attention, all problem sales persons. Jim Halpert… Dwight Schrute…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [raises hand] Here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Intensive one-on-one retraining will begin after lunch. That is all.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I am no longer the worst salesman in the office. Yes! [Andy gestures excitedly, knocking over his coffee mug] Ow! Dammit!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Dwight and I are both writing letters to our clients. I'm just sending a quick note to say how much I appreciate their business, and he is writing notarized letters to inform them them that lying on customer reviews is a prosecutable form of fraud and defamation. It's just… different styles.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: My job is to manipulate the customer into buying paper. In return, they give me money. I am the predator and they are the prey. Would a mouse give a positive review to a hawk? Should the hawk even care? [sighs heavily, nearly starts to cry] Excuse me, I've got work to do.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [laughs heartily and passes a newspaper to Phyllis]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [laughing] It's good!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey, what are you laughing at?

scenes.speaker: Stanley & Phyllis
scenes.line: [continue to laugh]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Are you laughing at me?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: We're laughing at this cartoon! [passes newspaper to Dwight]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Perfect, isn't it?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [looks at cartoon] How is that funny? What are you really laughing at? Huh?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Haven't you been following the news? Ther university is using its non-profit status to fund its private real estate investments.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [laughing louder] And he really nailed them on it. Somebody's finally holding them accountable!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [looking at cartoon] There's no way you're laughing at this.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [peEring nervously through conference room window] Oh, I don't have anything to say. I'm just hiding from Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [is seen taking apart his phone receiver to check for listening devices]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's good to be paranoid. People need to be more paranoid. Case in point, JFK. If I had been JFK, I would have seen all three gunmen. I would have pulled out my concealed Luger and fired first. Man in book depository, BOOM! Grassy knoll, BOOM! Fake Jackie, BOOM! [pretends to kiss, then shoot imaginary person to his left] Then I shoot myself, so I don't change history and create a paradox. BOOM! But right at the last minute, [contorts head sideways] I twist out of the way of the bullet. Nice try, history. Better luck next year.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So, as it turns out, Dwight is right. How bizarre.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [in Jim's ear] I wonder what else Dwight's been right about…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Major pharmaceuticals do not want you to know that beet juice has medicinal value both as an aphrodisiac and a laxative.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The Scranton Zoning Board has a strong bias against beet farmers. The mayor is in the pocket of Big Lettuce.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Battlestar Galactica isn't a documentary exactly.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The book All The President's Men is about a conspiracy, just not the one people think.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jesus had a daughter, and she was the Mona Lisa.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What we have come to know as fake crab meat is in fact real crab meat, and real crab meat is lobster.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did you know that in Morocco it is common to exchange a small gift when meeting somebody for the first time? In Japan you must always commit suicide to avoid embarrassment. In Italy you must always wash your hands after going to the bathroom. This is considered to be polite.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Why are you telling us this?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am jetting off on an international business trip.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Where are you going?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: To Can-A-da.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Where is it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Canada.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: My boss is sending me abroad to do a presentation to an international client and I have always been intrigued by all things international. The women, the pancakes, the man of mystery…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Meredith, I would like you to pretend that you are from Abu Dhabi.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [British accent] Hello.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am ashamed at your naked face. I must cover it with my jacket. [covers Meredith's face with his jacket] You are now sexy in your culture.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: T minus…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Six point five days. [winces as Kevin smacks him on the back]

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [walks up behind Jim and puts his hands on his shoulders] One more week.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pam comes back from New York next week and everyone here has just been so excited for me. And involved. And intrusive. And weird.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: On more week. [chuckles]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
