scenes.line: Why have I stayed at Dunder Mifflin for so long? Certainly not because of the paycheck. 'Cause I could be making more money as a doctor or a professional athlete. I think it's because they respect me. A boss that will not fire you, even though you just tell him off… right to his face… over the hone. That's respect.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: You did it, man. [fist bumps Jim] Day one. Congrats.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thanks man.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm coming back the wrong way. [smiles at Jim across the parking lot] It's not because of you. I don't like graphic design. That's it. [laughs] Stop smiling. I really didn't like it. It's just designing logos and stuff… and I miss Scranton. But it is not because I missed you. I just really wanted to come home… and I know you said to come home the right way, but you can't tell me what to do. Got it?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I missed you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I missed you too. [Jim kisses her]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You're back.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Uh, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Good. I need you to make five copies of these. [hands Pam papers]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm not going inside.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Alright. First thing in the morning then.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Welcome back.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: We're back together again baby.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: We're back.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: They tried to keep us apart, but they couldnt. It was like destiny.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I— I realized that for whatever reason I… just couldn't do better than kelly.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Oh!

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [whispers] Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Are you swallowing them whole? You're eating them so fast, are they even touching your tongue?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [with mouth full] Yes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Brownies is it? Hm. Pastry cubes made of sugar and fat? No thank you, I'll stick with my jerkie.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So why did you come in here?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: To socialize. And inform.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh brownies! I'm taking two so I can parcel them up and eat them at my leisure later on, much healthier.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: You're taking two?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Yeah, um, but one of them is for Toby.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah why don't you send that to him in Costa Rica?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Um, I'm just gonna hand it to him right now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Heh, okay, weirdo.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Why is that, why is that weird?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: She said she was going to give it to him right now. [starts laughing]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [laughing] She's probably going to, cause they sit next to each other.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, they used to.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Toby works here again.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, can you imagine?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh no.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uhhgh.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You don't know.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know. What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You should probably just meander back there; take a look. See if he's, see if he's back.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmmm, dare I? [laughs] You know what? I'm going to, for old time's sake. [walks to the annex, standing in Toby's cubicle] Great practical joke Jim, you got me to go to the annex. [turns around and sees Toby]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hi, Micha-

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: NOOOO! GOD! No, God, please no! No! No! NOOO!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [watching Toby at Phyllis' desk through his office blinds] Look at him. With his stupid face. Stupid… tan. No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: He looks great.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well rested.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: He looks worse.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Michael, is everyone okay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uh, well I'm afraid not. Toby Flenderson, of H.R., has made a sudden reappearance.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I don't understand, is anyone hurt?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Not on the surface, no, but I can tell people are disturbed, David.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Michael, you texted me, 911 CALL ME.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: All in caps. Do you know what 911 means?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I learned a while back that if I don't text 911 people will not return my calls. Um, but now people always return my calls because they think that something horrible has happened.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Now what I'm curious about is how you were able to go an entire a week without knowing a member of your staff was there.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I did not want to go back to the annex because that is where Holly worked whom I loved.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Also, it's icky back there.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's true. People say it's icky.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay, I have to go.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: David, wait.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Is there no way we can get rid of him?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Not without cause, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have cause. It is be-cause I hate him.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: You have to get along with Toby.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Goodbye, Michael. [hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Dwight comes over, starts to massage Michael's shoulders] Don't do that.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [pours something from the fridge into a bowl and opens the microwave, it is covered in exploded food] Oh, come on! [to the documentary crew] Do you see this? Disgusting.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: So, Tunes, you still gonna buy your old man's place?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, I am. Wait, how do you know that? I didn't tell you that.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ehhh no, I was just walking by your desk. I saw some email. I got peepers of an eagle.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's really not cool.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Kaaw!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: So Jim, you're gonna live in the same house that you used to pee the bed in?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, I guess technically Kev, you're right.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Today's a big day. Today's the day that I show Pam the house that I bought for us. Without telling her. But it's my parent's house, the house I grew up in and yeah, I bought it kind of impulsively. I mean, the price was good and I was helping out my mom. It's got shag carpets. I mean you can't blame my parents it was the 70's. And why would you want to buy ugly wood from trees when you can have paneling? And a painting of some creepy clowns that is apparently crucial to the structural integrity of the building. [tugs and pulls in vain at the clown painting] She's gonna love it. Right?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Could you guys all do me a favor and not talk about this until I tell Pam?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Whoa, you haven't told the misses about the castle? You're in for a spanking my friend. Myself and my lady? – no secrets.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Jim, don't listen to Andy. I think it's so romantic.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh thanks, Phyllis.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Where's your place?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, it's on uh Linden Ave? By the quarry?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Ohhh…

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Cool beans, man, I live by the quarry. We should hang out by the quarry and throw things down there.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Definitely we should.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [reading from a note on the microwave] "To whoever made the microwave mess:

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You want to see some really high caliber acting? Well, Mr. Kurt Russell, you are about to be served. [walks to the annex] Hey Toby, great to have you back, man. Seriously, just a, just a real pleasure to see you again.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well thanks Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're welcome. Missed you. Missed you as part of our family.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well that's sweet, I missed you guys too.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So Costa Rica that was – did you have fun? That must have been fun.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, um, it was amazing. It really was, thanks for asking. Um the beaches were pristine…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nice beaches, pristine beaches?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: …and, yeah, the whole thing was incredibly cathartic.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why'd you come back? Why didn't you stay?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: It was actually kind of hard to meet people I found.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I bet, for you.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: And uh, yeah, plus it was hot.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [shifting uncomfortably and sweating] Shhh hot, why didn't you get an air-condition— should have gotten an air-conditioner for yourself.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Are you all right, Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, I am. I am.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I tried, I tried. I tried to talk to Toby and be his friend but that is like trying to be friends with an evil… snail. I feel like I'm dying inside. I feel like Neve Campbell in Sream II. She thinks she can go off to college and be happy and then, the murderer comes back and starts killing off all of her friends. I learned a lot of lessons from that movie, this is just one of them.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, just summarize.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, fireable offenses include:

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: When it comes down to it, it's a health issue. I should have written that.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mmhmm, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [looks up] Why aren't you as mad or interested in this as me?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh totally. Sorry, are we talking about the microwave still?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Are you inching away from me?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Reach your arms out.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [laughs and swings his arm out which doesn't come close to touching the reception desk] I'm always this close.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pamtown lady sing this song, doo-dah doo-dah. Hello, Pam. Jim may I have a moment with Pam please.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes, I just have to take this call anyway so…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, oooh his mistress. No. I'm kidding. No one would ever cheat on you; you are the complete package, Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What do you need, Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, what I would like you to do is take this folded note, and deliver it to Toby Flenderson? I just want you to just react to whatever this note elicits. Do not read it beforehand. Can you do that for me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good. [Pam stands up and starts reading note] N-no no no, don't.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: "Please hug and kiss me, no matter how hard I struggle. I'm too shy to tell you that I love you."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pam. Pam, you gave me your word.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [kissing Kelly against her desk] You did that for me?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Mmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Are you happy you did?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey guys that's really inappropriate.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [kisses for a little longer] What's up?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um, I got some photos from Costa Rica if you want to see them?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah, yeah I'll see them.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Toby can I see those? Ooh. [takes photos and throws them on the floor] What's the matter? What's the matter? You scared?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Those are fighting words.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You mad? You mad at me?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I hope he doesn't haul off and just hit you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do you want to do that? You want to hit me, you want to punch me?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hmmm?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Huh? He might do it…

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Punch him, Toby!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I dare you to. Come on.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Come on. [making karate moves] Baaah!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What's the matter… haaaww!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hit him! Hit him, Chicken.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah, punch him.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey hey! Come on, Ryan, who's side are you on?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ryan. Come on, man?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No do it, do it. I dare you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Punch him as hard as you possibly can in the face.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Not, not as hard as you can, just a good, solid punch. Come on! Come oooon…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I'm not going to punch you, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Are you really not going to punch him?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: No, why would I punch you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Son of a bitch.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [as Toby picks up his photos] You should have hit him man, guy was asking for it. Once in a lifetime, man.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I thought you were going to parcel those out through the day

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [mouth full of brownie] Just stop it. You haven't done anything helpful all day.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: There's still one thing we could do to get Toby fired.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What's that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [goes over and closes office door] Frame him, for using drugs.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Frame him?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, it's illegal, but… everything they do on The Shield is illegal.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I've never framed a man before, have you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh I've framed animals before. I framed a raccoon for opening a Christmas present. And I framed a bear for eating out of the garbage.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just seems awfully mean. But sometimes the ends justify the mean.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello. I've seen you guys around. I'm Michael Scott, Dunder Mifflin. How you doing? [they stare at him] Uhghh, so I guess you know why I'm here? I need to purchase something.

scenes.speaker: Vance Refrigeration Guy
scenes.line: A fridge?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. Uh, I wanted— I wanted to buy some weed? Some…

scenes.speaker: Vance Refrigeration Guy
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Grass, weed?

scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: What makes you think we'd have weed?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I heard you drug— I heard you dealt.

scenes.speaker: Vance Refrigeration Guy
scenes.line: [whispers in Leo's ear] Hey, just hold on one second.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm not wearing a wire, so…

scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Why would you even say that?

scenes.speaker: Vance Refrigeration Guy
scenes.line: [comes back up to Michael] Hey, that's gonna be 500 dollars.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How much? How many pounds is it?

scenes.speaker: Vance Refrigeration Guy
scenes.line: It's- it's two pounds. I'm losing money on this man just, give me the money. Alright, walk away.

scenes.speaker: Leo
scenes.line: Walk away.

scenes.speaker: Vance Refrigeration Guy
scenes.line: Walk away.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hey, Pam? I just wanted to let you know; I'm totally on your side with the whole microwave situation.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I was just back there, to make some cup-o-soup; the thing is still a huge mess.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I know, can you believe it?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah, it's crazy. But, I guess the thing is at some point, notes or no notes, someone's gonna have to just get there and clean it up.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I guess that's why we have a temp, huh?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Ah ha ha, oh no, trust me. I would just make it worse.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How would wiping it with a paper towel make it worse?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I— I would find a way.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You've seen things cleaned before though, right?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I— Pam, I am hopeless at that stuff I… I, uh…

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Hi, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, hey, hey. Hey. I forgot… I forgot…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [on a cell phone in the hallway] Yes, I repeat a drug dealer is on the premisis of Dunder Mifflin. His name is Toby Flenderson [Michael opens Toby's desk drawer and puts something in it] and he recently returned from a mysterious vacation in Central America. I have risked a great deal to tell you this information. My name is Andy Bernard. Andrew Bernard, that's my name. See you soon.

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 1
scenes.line: Hi, we received a call?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't know anything about that.

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 1
scenes.line: We were tipped off about a possible narcotics situation.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Here?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey, Pam. Hey I got this, okay? Hello, officers, Dwight Schrute, former volunteer Sheriff's Deputy. Listen, I may have inside information that someone is hiding drugs in this very office. [leads them back towards the annex as Creed stands up and starts to put him hands up and then relaxes them behind his ears]

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Just pretend like we're talking until the cops leave.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Those are real cops, real guns. I wonder what's going on. [follows them]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Officers, I reveal to you the perpetrator.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey, what is this?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Search his things.

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 2
scenes.line: Sir, can you step away from your desk please?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 2
scenes.line: Sir, please step away from your desk.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey, what's going on? You don't have my permission to do this.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: They don't need your permission, Flenderson, they've got the company's permission.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey, hey what are- why are you doing this?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uh, you know what? I think that this… uh, this is probably a misunderstanding.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Don't search my stuff.

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 1
scenes.line: Sir?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I have a reasonable right to privacy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Save your whining for the jury there, Flenderson.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Michael!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, let's just cancel this, okay?

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 1
scenes.line: Sir, did you recently return from a trip to Central America?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Oh my God!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no no no… No, no.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: That was… I went to Costa Rica for a few months. What is going on?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, that was… that was legitimate. That was totally legitimate.

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 1
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 2
scenes.line: Check this out.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh God!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: That is not mine. I have never seen that before.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no no no no.

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 1
scenes.line: Turn around.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: What is going on here?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: God! No, that's not… I don't know what that is. And I… I bet he has nothing to do with that!

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 1
scenes.line: Do you have any weapons?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Of course not!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ahh, that's mine.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No! Michael, no!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, it's mine.

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 2
scenes.line: Some basil. Salad dressing, I think.

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 1
scenes.line: Salad dressing?

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 2
scenes.line: Yeah it's, uh, a caprese salad. There's a little bit of, uh, mozerella right there.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Are you kidding me? That's my salad.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: So wait a minute, there's no drugs?

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 2
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Gahh, dammit! [punches file cabinet] Come on!

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 1
scenes.line: We got a fake tip.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wait, officers, are you sure you don't want to interrogate him?

scenes.speaker: Police Officer 1
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [following them out] You have laws that protect you in any kind of interrogation. Why don't you use them?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You must feel pretty good about yourself right now.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I didn't put caprese salad in my drawer, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmm.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Did you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Since when is it illegal to put caprese salad… anywhere.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You know but the police could have been out there you know, catching real criminals instead of here searching my stuff.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Are you kidding me? Are you kidding me, that's who you're worried about? You're… you're worried about the cop's time? You think I framed you, and you're worried about the taxpayer? Dah, God! Welcome back, jerky jerk-face.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You said you were leaving and you made liars out of all of us. So…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I did leave.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, you did. And then you came back, which makes you the biggest liar of… history.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, I don't see it that way.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do you want to hear a lie?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think you're great. You're my best friend.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [stops kissing Kelly] I can't do this.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Can't do what?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: It's not fair to you. And it's really not fair to me.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Wait, what are you saying? I broke up with Darryl so I could be with you.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: That was your choice; don't put that on me. I'm just going on a little trip.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Oh, can I come?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: It's not that kind of trip. I'm going to Thailand with some friends from high school, well, a high school. And if I don't do it now I'll never get to go. And I'll always resent you for it… you don't want me to resent you, do you?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: So you're dumping me?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Let's be adults about this. Let's have sex one more time. And if you have any extra cash, that would be amazing.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Okay?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [walking out of the building] Hey, do you mind if we make a stop on the way home?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Sure.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Cool.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [getting out of the car] What are we doing at your parent's house?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I have a surprise for you. All right, ready? Close your eyes and now [spins her around once] open your eyes. Tadah!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't get it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I bought it. It's ours. Let's go inside, I'll show you inside. [walking inside] So if you can believe it I did it without a realtor. Saving on closing costs is good and, uh, we can put all the money to de-shag the carpet. Which I think will help, the color situation. [Pam walks over to the clown painting on the wall] Yeah, I am really sorry about this. I tried to move it but he is really nailed in there. Worried about art theft, I guess, lot of art theives in this neighborhood. [upstairs] This is the master bedroom but, I'm actually not allowed in here so… [shuts the door]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [outside] So I'm still in the process of converting the garage. It's got great light in here and I'm thinking, it could be perfect [opens garage door] for an art studio. [Pam looks around and then looks at him] Look, I know, I bought this without asking you and it's doesn't look great, I know that. And if you really hate it, I totally understand it's just—

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I love it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You do?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, I love it!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I mean, you bought me a house!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh my God…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You bought me a house!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, I did. [they kiss]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Um, do we have to sleep in your parent's bedroom?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, No, we'll just board that up. It'll be that weird spare room that people ask us about.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: And the clown?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, I can't… really can't move him.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What is my perfect crime? I break into Tiffany's at midnight. Do I go for the vault? No, I go for the chandelier. It's priceless. As I'm taking it down, a woman catches me. She tells me to stop. It's her father's business. She's Tiffany. I say no. We make love all night. In the morning the cops come and I escape in one of their uniforms. I tell her to meet me in Mexico but I go to Canada. I don't trust her. Besides, I like the cold. Thirty years later, I get a postcard. I have a son and he's the chief of police. This is where the story gets interesting:

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Here are our final actual costs for this year.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmm… okay.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: As you can see, we did pretty well, so…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes. Yes, I can see… that we did indeed. Why don't you explain this to me like I am an eight-year old.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Alright, well this is the overall budget for this fiscal year along the x-axis…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Right there.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There's the x-ax…icks.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You can see clearly on this page that we have a surplus of $4300.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmhmm, okay.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: But we have to spend that by the end of the day or it will be deducted from next year's budget.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why don't you explain this to me like I'm five.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Your mommy and daddy give you ten dollars to open up a lemonade stand. So you go out and you buy cups and you buy lemons and you buy sugar. And now you find out that it only costs you nine dollars.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ho-oh!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: So you have an extra dollar.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: So you can give that dollar back to mommy and daddy, but guess what? Next summer…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'll be six.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: And you ask them for money, they're gonna give you nine dollars. 'Cause that's what they think it costs to run the stand. So what you want to do is spend that dollar on something now, so that your parents think it costs ten dollars to run the lemonade stand.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So the dollar's a surplus. This is a surplus.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: We have to spend that $4300 by the end of the day or it'll be deducted from next year's budget.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [whistles poorly] Whoo.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: We should spend this money on a new copier, which we desperately need.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, break it down in terms of, um… okay, I-I think I'm getting you…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Guess what, everybody? Christmas has come early this year. Oscar, very smartly, has discovered an extra $4300 in the budget. Thank you, Oscar. And I have decided with that money I am going to buy a new, drum roll please… [imitates drum roll] Can anybody guess?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: New chairs?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, a new copier! [only Oscar applauds] Unless everybody can agree on something better?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: No, no, please. Please do not do this.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes, Michael, new chairs. These chairs are terrible. We were supposed to get new ones last year.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So… we all agree to get new chairs then. Good?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [over indistinct conversation] Good? Yeah, he said good, I'm good…

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Now listen, we are a paper company. How can we take pride in our jobs if we have to put our fine paper in this wretched machine?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oscar, no. This is not the time for one of your principled stands.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Pam, you make more copies than anyone.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Exactly. That should tell you how terrible the chairs are.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. Okay, good suggestions. All good suggestions. Uh, let's just decide and agree upon one.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I'm with Pam. Chairs.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright, so, teams forming.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: We should really have the office's air quality tested. We have radon coming from below, we have asbestos in the ceilings. These are silent killers.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You are the silent killer. Go back to the annex.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You'll see.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I've talked to Meredith, Stanley and Jim about the chairs. I know they're with me on this.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, actually, I'm gonna go with copier.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What? Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ever since Pam and I started dating, I just feel weird asking her to make copies for me. So, I make my own copies. And that copier sucks. Let me tell you, I-But you know what? Pam and I don't have to agree on everything.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Jim, good for you, standing up to Pam like that.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: The balls on you, man.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: So Michael, what do you think?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why me?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You have to make the decision.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow, okay. Well… I swallowed all your ideas, I'm going to digest them and see what comes out the other end.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Dwight, I'm a little concerned about some of these directions to Schrute Farms…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, do tell.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I mean, like, "156 paces from the light red mailbox, make a left."

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Mmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: "Walk until you hear the beehive."

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: How could it be more clear?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I think Andy makes an excellent point.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: But my biggest concern is that there's only one bathroom.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We'll dig a trench. As long as it's downhill from the well, we should be fine.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Nana Mimi cannot squat over some trench.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well we're not gonna put out stumps, come on.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Let's three-way this little issue, and come to a solution by the time we get to Schrute Farms, how's that for a plan?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: We're getting married at Schrute Farms, no matter what. I have looked at twelve venues, I have lost eight deposits, and I have seen Angela naked zero times. I am not losing another deposit.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So um, I've been thinking about this whole chair/copier thing…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I really think you should reconsider.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, Pam, I really… hate that copier.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, I know.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: But I really think you should reconsider.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Beesly, are you threatening me?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Jim. Jim, Jim, Jim. I'm not threatening you. I love you. [whispers] But you should know, you're on very dangerous ground [kisses Jim]. [at normal volume] All right.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [shudders] Whew.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: This is where you'll have your receiving line. Of course we'll clear out all the livestock and hay and such.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hmm… mm, what's that smell?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You're gonna need to be more specific.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Manure. Get rid of it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Manure covers up the small of the slaughterhouse.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Do you have to slaughter on our wedding day?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You wanna eat, don't you?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Honey, say something!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh, Dwight, if we pay extra, could you slaughter the entrees the day before?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: …I'll consider it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: See? That's how you do it! Makin' progress here. [steps in manure, trying to laugh it off] …Darn! Heh.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: There's a hose out back.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Remember, you were gonna get a new chair, and you were gonna give your old chair to me. Remember that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well that never happened.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know. I haven't decided yet.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I'm just gonna grab some lunch. You wanna come with?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really? Absolutely! Yeah, that would be amazing.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Woah, you guys going to lunch?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mind if I join?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ohh, God!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Let's go.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Best lunch ever! Woo-hoo-hoo-hoo!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Let's do it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right! Cool!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Where we going?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have no idea.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So, I guess that's how they're gonna play this. It is on. [very serious] It is so on.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Look, I really need this new chair. I mean, seriously, how is it possible that in five years I've had two engagement rings, and only one chair?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [laughing uproariously with Michael and Jim] Stop it! Michael.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael, that is hilarious.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [through the laughter] Oh, is somebody making fun of me?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: The best. Great friends. Thank you, Michael. [all three are still laughing]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ahh… I got you some tiramisu. No hard feelings.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Aww.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's cool. [opens the container and smells the tiramisu] Mm, good stuff. [throws it in the garbage]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You look really pretty.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank you. [goes to Michael's office and knocks on the door]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, hey.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You got a second?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I do.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, good.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, that must've been so fun.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: it was fun. We had a good time.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, have I told you you look really nice today?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, is that a new tie?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um, no, not… no. No, I got it at TJ Maxx, four dollars.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That is amazing!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You think that's good? Check out these pants. Nine dollars.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nine dollars. The boys' department.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Look at the ass. Check out the ass.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [applauding] No way!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Look at that. [begins dancing] Unh. Unh-unh.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah! Oh, so I guess Oscar and Jim were talking your ear off about the new copier.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes they were.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: They were.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Here's what I was thinking:

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Have you made a decision on the butter sculpture?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No. I haven't thought of it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay. Cow, goat or sheep. It's not that hard.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I would like cat.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Cats don't make butter.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I would like cow butter sculpture of a cat.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It doesn't make any sense.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yes it does!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay, guys!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I want a butter sculpture of a cat!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Cow, goat or sheep.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What is this? All right, we're all on the same team. Is it- [steps in manure] Damn! Why is that in the kitchen?!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Pam is making copies and is struggling with the machine] You might want to consider changing teams, because we would-we would love to have you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, copier's great.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah. I have my copies. [holds up messed up copies]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: There they are.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: And I have my original. [holds up original paper, ripped in half]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You got it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So suck it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Michael, I got you a hot chocolate. I hope that's okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, thank you my dear.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Wait, Michael! Let me open the door for you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, well, chivalry is not dead after all. Okay…

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: There he is!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There he is! Hello, hello!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hello.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello! Good to see you! Good to see you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm! [gives Jim a high five] Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: There's that ass!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey hey! Yeah! Unh!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Woo! Yeah. Aw, don't take it away!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh… ah, I almost choked.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Here's another place.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It's beautiful.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey-o!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: So… why don't we try this out, we'll see what would happen. Give it a little test drive, what do you say? You pretend to be Angela's father, you will play Angela, and uh, I will pretend to be you. That way you can see what it looks like when you're up here.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [whistling Pachelbel's "Canon in D;" switches to singing then back to whistling]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [to minister] Hello, I'm Angela Martin, and-

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'm Andy.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I work with Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: He doesn't understand a word you're saying.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Although born just minutes from here, he speaks only German. Closed society. So, now, after the readings by all of your sisters, we will arrive at the vows. So, Konrad… [speaks German to minister; minister begins speaking in German] And away we go. This is a little taste of the ceremony, if you will. He's explaining why we're here, what we're doing here, making introductions, blah blah blah… Then he's gonna have Andy repeat a bunch of stuff. He's gonna ask Andy to produce a ring. I have uh, now just uh… just some twine for our purposes, and you will put the ring on her finger. Yadda yadda, then he's going to ask Andy, uh, if he would like to marry Angela. And you will reply, "I do." [Andy mouths, "I do" silently] And then he's going to ask Angela if she would like to marry Andy, to which you will reply…

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I do.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: And there we go. Okay, and that's just about it. Man and wife.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: Got a call about a problem up here.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Did somebody call Hank?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hank, thank God you're here. The office is at a crossroads.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: So, there's no security problem? You know, I hustled up the stairs.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes. I need your sage advice. And everyone, whatever Hank decides, that is the decision. That will resolve this issue. [Hank takes some jellybeans from Pam's jar] Yeah, take as many as you want.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: Thank you. Thank you. You know, it's nice and warm up here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: So what are we talking about?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. Well, we have a surplus. Imagine that your parents give you money for a lemonade stand-

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: I know what a surplus is.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, okay. Good. Good. Well, here's the thing. Some people want to use the surplus to buy a new copier. Other people are complaining about the chairs.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: Is that the copier?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is, yes.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: [inspects the copier] Hmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: I was just thinking. Let me see a chair.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You can try mine.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, there we go.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: Hmm, not much lumbar support.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Now everyone, bear in mind once again that whatever Hank says goes. He is an impartial third party.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: On the one hand, this copier is very old. You should see some of the new copiers they have. You would not believe what they do.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So, the copier.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: Well, let me finish.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right, yes.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: Now the chairs. The chairs are very weak. Very weak chairs. I could not sit all day in this chair.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, what should I do?

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: …Let me see the copier again.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right, get out. Get out.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Dwight, I thought I knew what I wanted. And then, being here with you and the German Mennonite minister… it just all felt right. I made a mistake picking Andy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I know you did. And that's why I have taken care of everything.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: What do you mean?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well Monkey, he's a real minister. And you said, "I do." And I said, "I do." And Andy wasn't signing a receipt; he was signing our marriage certificate as a witness.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Dwight! That doesn't count!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes, of course it does.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No, it doesn't!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It does in the state of Pennsylvania.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I didn't-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Haha, Mrs. Schrute.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: We are not married.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wha…

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Take this thing. [takes off twine ring]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: My… It's not my fault you don't understand German; I've been telling you to take it for years!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Are we, uh… are we leaving or what? [Mose hits Andy in the head with a deflated ball] Ow!

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: [on speakerphone] Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey David- [begins coughing violently] I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I'm eating tiramisu. Some of the chocolate powder just went down my throat. I'm stopping now.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Is this why you're calling me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no, no, no. No. I'm calling- [coughs again] I'm sorry.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm. I'm calling because, um, we have a stupid budget surplus, and people-everybody wants something different.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: You want me to weigh in on a minor budget issue?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no. I want you to make the decision so I'm not the bad guy.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Well if I were you, I would just return the surplus and take the bonus.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The what now?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Branch managers who come in under budget get 15% of the savings.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: …Like a tip? [calculates amount] $645?!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I hate disappointing just one person. And I really hate disappointing everyone. But I love Burlington Coat Factory. You go in there with $645, you are literally a king.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [on the phone] We have that going out Tuesday… Okay? Sure, no, I can… I'll double-check that for you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right, attention everyone.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Let me call you right back. Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have made my decision. We do not need a new copier. We do not need new chairs. This copier… is… [puts paper on glass and makes a copy, then takes paper from glass] working perfectly.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: That's the original.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pam, would you stand up for a sec? [sits in Pam's chair] Hmm. See how relaxed I am? I like this chair. [slowly sinking into the chair] Offers good support, it is urkelnomically correct… it's a good chair. I think we're spoiled because we don't appreciate the things that we have. You think kids in Africa have chairs? No. They sit in big piles of garbage. You think they have copiers? [the chair has slowly lowered itself almost to where Michael is not visible over the desk] They don't have copiers. They don't even- [struggles to get up from Pam's chair] Gah! They don't even have paper. And we are spoiled because we throw out perfectly good tiramisu because it has a little tiny hair on it. My point I this: I have seen the light in terms of what we need, and it is nothing.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Do you know?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do I know what?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I think you know.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm, no…

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Know what?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, know what?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Does anyone happen to know what 15% of 4300 is?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Michael's a genius.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Why'd you say dollars?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because that is how my mind works.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What's 15% of 200? [Michael doesn't answer] Thank you. Everyone, Michael is returning the surplus so he can keep 15% as a bonus.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wait, what?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You can do that?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hey Michael, what's 394 times 5,912?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Let's see…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You're gonna give yourself a bonus of $645 instead of getting the entire office something it really needs?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't need $645; I already have $645, more or less.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You're gonna get us a copier then?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is so stupid.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Or chairs?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is so, so stupid. And, God… [looks at his watch] that's my phone.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I didn't hear a phone.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: To be continued!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, I don't-this doesn't change anything. I have a very important decision to make. We need a new copier. We need new chairs. And I need to figure out a way to keep this money without having everybody hate me.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey Tuna, check it out. Tuna sandwich. Just like you. [Angela walks over to Andy] What-

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [kisses Andy passionately in his chair] Now, I have to take care of a legal issue.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Was that hot or what?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So what's it gonna be?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Michael, you have to make a decision. The day is almost done.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Let me just say, you've been promising me this chair since the day you hired me.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You are a smart guy. I know you'll do the right thing.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [groans in frustration] You think it's easy?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: It's your job.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, you know what? Why don't you guys deal with it? I am going to get up, and I am going to be out in the common area. But you need to decide; otherwise I'm taking the bonus. All right?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is a classic management tactic. You have two sides, a deadline, you know that neither of them are gonna concede. What you do is you put 'em in a room, and you just- [Pam and Oscar come to the door of kitchen] Hey.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Hey, we're going with the chairs.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I just figured I'd rather have new chairs than nothing at all.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thanks Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good work. I'm proud of you. [Pam and Oscar leave] Mother-

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [wearing a fur coat] What did we learn this week? Well, one, thanks to me, my team is much, much faster at coming to decisions than I thought they would be. Number two, never buy a fur coat with a credit card until you absolutely have the money to pay for it. And three, [camera zooms out to see fake blood is splattered on the fur coat] you should know that some people think it's cool to throw buckets of fake blood on you as you are walking out of Burlington Coat Factory.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Truce?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, I guess, since I won.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, you did win. You did win. Anyway, I'm going to need three copies of each of these, stapled and collated. [begins to walk away, then turns back] Totally kidding. [leans in, whispers] I'm gonna need four. [kisses Pam]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What is this?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Happy Holidays, Dwight. But do not open it till Christmas.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You're so pathetic. How long did this take you? Three hours?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Five minutes actually. I am a black belt in gift wrapping.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, no such thing. They don't give out black belts for things that are stupid. [scoffs] Well, I hope it was worth it, cause I'm gonna take it apart in about five minutes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think it'll take you a little longer than that.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Really? If I can skin a mule deer in less than ten minutes, I ought to be able to cut my — [sets briefcase on desk and sits in chair, desk and chair are made of paper, Dwight crashes to the floor]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Eh…

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I'm sorry. It's the largest one I have.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I will not be the big guy in the tiny hat. [Kevin is wearing the same hat]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: This is the first Christmas party I am throwing as head of the party planning committee. The theme is "Nights in Morocco". This isn't your grandmothers Christmas party. Unless of course she's from Morocco, in which case it's very accurate.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, Phyllis, do I need this invite to get in to the party?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Awesome. I think this is going to be the best Christmas party ever.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Angela. You're going to move this for the party right? It's not on theme.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It's the nativity scene.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Alright. You can keep your camel, sheep, elephant and the north African king can stay. Everything else goes in the drawer.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I am not going to judge Phyllis for desecrating Christmas. There is one person who will though and Phyllis just stuffed him into a drawer.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I need you to get rid of the tree.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: But–

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh, I don't think it's blackmail. Angela just does what I ask her to do so I won't tell everyone that she's cheating on Andy with Dwight. I think for it to be black mail, it would have to be a formal letter.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ah. You brought in your doll collection.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: These are not dolls, Jim. These are commodities. Same as gold or oil.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Every year I do research to determine which toy will be the most popular of the Christmas season. This year it's a doll. Half girl, half unicorn. Catchphrase: "My horn can pierce the sky". Pathetic. I bought out every store in the area over the last couple of weeks. And as lazy parents become desperate I will sell them for an enormous profit. Isn't that right princess? [makes doll nod]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's the Christmas spirit.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I am simply punishing those parents that would wait till the last minute to get their child a gift. And such a genetically improbable one. Look at that. How does that happen? King has sex with a unicorn? Man with a horn has sex with a royal horse?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, hey, is that Princess Unicorn? I thought they were all sold out.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: They are now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Cool. [sings] My horn can pierce the sky.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is equal parts scotch, absinthe, rum, gin, vermouth, triple sec, and two packs of Splenda. Call it a one of everything.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [drinks] Oh… my… GOD!!! [laughs] Hit me again.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright… One more time around the block.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I will grant you one wish.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I wish that you'd stop rubbing that lamp in that creepy way.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Stupid. Everyone knows to ask for a hundred more wishes. [Pam laughs] Dumb.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [sitting on floor playing the sitar] Hey, hey… Ange… check it out. [sings] There's a place in France where the naked ladies dance. [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Really Andy? It's Christmas and your singing about nudity and France.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [sings] There's a hole in the wall where the men can see it all.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jim, Jim…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What is it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That is vodka and I mixed it with orange juice. I call it an orange-vod-juice…ka.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow, that is delicious.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Can't believe no ones thought of that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [dancing drunkenly] Ahh yeah!!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [continuing to dance, lifting her shirt] Belly dancing!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Guy
scenes.line: Thank you so much. My daughter is going to love this.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, so glad I could help.

scenes.speaker: Guy
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Merry Christmas.

scenes.speaker: Guy
scenes.line: You too.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Fa-la-la-la-la-la-la-ka-ching.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sighs] Oh, so this is what every day would be like if you hadn't left India.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Meredith's hair is on fire] Oh, oh, oh, oh!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We got a live one! On fire!! [Dwight extinguishes Meredith]

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I'm all right. I'm all right.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Sorry.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: We're back on the 5th, should we just do it then?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Can not do it then. Monthly dental appointment, soft teeth

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What about February 2nd?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ah… would you want to do it on Groundhogs day?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no. I celebrate privately.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's cool.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why don't we just do it now? We'll do it quickly.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Now? It's our Christmas party.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We'll do it quickly.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well what if we can't do it quickly.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [mimicking] What if we can't do it quickly? What if we cant do it–

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Do you know how to do an intervention?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, shut up. Here we go. Everybody gather up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: An intervention. It's sort of hard to describe, but really its– it's a coming together… it's a surprise party for people who are– who have addictions. And you get in their face and you scream at them and you make them feel really badly about themselves. And then they stop.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: It looks like we're going to be here for awhile, so why don't you make a little plate of hummus for everyone. Little triangles of pita, toasted on both sides, fanned so you can easily can grab them.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I don't–

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: And napkins… fanned.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, how do you feel?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: A little better. I threw up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uck… T.M.I.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Fire girl. [looks around] Too soon?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, you know what I thought we should do is have a quick intervention and then get back to the party.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Michael, we are only allowed to talk about Meredith's work performance. We can not ask her to stop drinking.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am not asking her to stop drinking. I am imploring her to quit being an alcoholic.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I'm not an alcoholic.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, obviously you are. Okay, everybody who thinks that Meredith is an alcoholic please raise your hand. [everyone raises their hand]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Aye.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The aye's have it.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I don't care what everyone thinks. I know I am not an alcoholic.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright, well, let's look at this a little bit closer then shall we? [pulls a piece of paper out of his pocket]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: When I was in college I used to get wicked hammered. My nickname was puke. I would chug a fifth of socos, sneak into a frat party, polish off a few people's empties, some brewskies, some Jell-O shots, do some body shots off myself, pass out, wake up the next morning, puke, rally, more soco, head to class. Probably would have gotten expelled if I had let it affect my grades, but I aced all my courses. They called me Ace. It was totally awesome. Got straight B's. They called me Buzz.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Meredith, have you ever used alcohol to alter your mood or deliberately change your state of mind?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Sure.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do you sometimes have a drink to celebrate a special occasion or mark a holiday?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Obviously.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Have you ever under the influence of alcohol questioned the teachings of the Mormon church?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Where did you get this?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I got it on a website, that's not important.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Michael, We should contact some experts. You don't know what your doing.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, you know what Toby? One of my employees is undergoing a crisis and I wish for just once you would take my side on this. I'm doing your job man. Hey, are you texting?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Yeah, 'cause this is kind of a drag.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alcohol is a drag. Yes. Here's what I'd like to do. I'd like to go around the room and have us each express to Meredith how her alcoholism has affected us. I'll begin. This Christmas party is perhaps the best Christmas party I have ever been to, but then you got so drunk that we had to stop and do this. That's how your drinking affected me. Anybody else? Another time when Meredith's drinking affected you? Come on people. If we don't say anything she's not going to get any better. [Kevin raises his hand] Yes, Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Well, Meredith, there was that one time you bought movie tickets and then you got too drunk to go, so you gave them to me. And that was really cool.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's– you didn't– you weren't hurt by that.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah, you said affected by it. Thanks again, Meredith.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: You're welcome.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, no, that's not what we're going for. Who has a problem with Meredith's drinking? It has to bother you. It bothers me. Right? How does it bother you? Dwight, don't you have anything?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, I like Meredith.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Actually, I don't care for Meredith, but I don't believe in this kind of thing. In the Schrute family we believe in a five fingered intervention. [holds up his fist] Awareness, education, control, acceptance and punching.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Who is going to tell us the latest dirty joke? Who is going to tell us what you watched on television last night?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I am fine.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Was John Belushi fine? Was Bob Hope fine? Hey– come here. If anything ever happened to you, I would be very angry at myself for not doing all that I could do.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I know I drink. I like to party

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I want you to say I'm an alcoholic.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I am not an alcoholic!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You can say it as loudly as you want, but we're not going to believe you.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I was waiting until later to hand out this years gifts from corporate. [holds up shot glass] I don't think they're appropriate anymore.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Please stop making me do these things.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh, sorry, it's your job.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: But it's the season of mercy.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: You never showed me mercy when you were in charge. Why aren't you wearing the hairnet?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I lost it. [Phyllis glares at her until Angela pulls out the hairnet and puts it on]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Ok… nice.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I don't mind telling you that I have an addiction. I do. To porn.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [amid groans from the rest of the office] Alright, no, no, no. No. That is the image, I think we can all agree is very disgusting. But you know what, Meredith, you lit your hair on fire today. What about tomorrow.? What is going to happen when you come into work and you're dead?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I stab her in the brain with a wooden stick.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: There are several ways to kill a zombie, but the most satisfying one is to stab it in the brain with a wooden stick.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Everyone in this room loves you, but mark my words, we are not going to support your alcoholism anymore. The next time you light yourself on fire we are not going to help put you out.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, as fire marshal I would have to.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight–

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: She is a hazard to the other people of the office.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sighs]…okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I suppose I could do it if it was a controlled burn in a well ventilated area.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, but you're gonna need a permit for that.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh right, that'll take a couple of weeks.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I can get you one in an hour.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Okay you know, this– this is over.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I agree.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael, I think… you did the best you could, but this is bigger than all of us.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Enabler! Enabler, enabler, enabler, enabler, enabler. It's Christmas and we are turning our back on somebody who is asking for help.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what the only thing I want for Christmas? I want Meredith to get better. That's my only wish. But you know what? My wishes never come true, so I'm not going to wish that on her. I– a watch would be nice.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [watching Meredith and Michael talk in his office] They've been in there for 45 minutes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I know. If she wasn't an alcoholic before, she is now. [Jim laughs]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: That's a halwa shabkia cookie. They serve it during Ramadan. [Angela spits her cookie out]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Mmmm… chewy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Andy playing the sitar] Hey.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What's up?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Do you take requests?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Sure.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Please stop. People are having a Christmas party.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [whispers to Meredith] I'll be down in a minute. [walks over to Toby] Could you write down the number of that rehabilitation center that you mentioned?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Sure. Wow. [Michael throws a pen at his head] Ow…

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: We just missed Poor Richards.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We did?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Yeah, I thought we were going out for a drink?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, shoot. Oh well, we'll have to go someplace else then I guess.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: The Bog? Cooper's, Kelly's…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We could go there, sure.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: …Brixx's, Carmen's…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, yes.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: …The Fort, Andy Gavin's.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have a new place.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Well, it must have just opened up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It– yep, recently.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Yeah… all right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
