scenes.line: You know, I just want to address everyone first.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Oh yeah, take your time. Stanley, pay attention.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Hi, everyone.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Hi. Uh, look it's no secret–

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Hello. Uh, it is no secret that Michael Scott Paper has siphoned off a large chunk of our core business. And I'm here– I just want to assure everyone that we think this is just a temporary setback.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Maybe, and I don't know, if you had just returned Michael's call none of us would've lost clients.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I've been wondEring that myself lately. We're just gonna get started, we're gonna figure this out. Rest assured. Jim, can you come in with us please?

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Uh, Jim hold on. [whispers] You know, David, uh, Dwight's been my guy. Okay?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Hmm.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Yeah, Jim–

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I find that extraordinarily surprising.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: He shows promise and Jim, I don't know– I– he's been a disappointment.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: We'll bring them both in.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Okay, great. Uh, Dwight come on in. Also, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Come along, afterthought.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How much can we afford to pay a delivery guy?

scenes.speaker: Financial Guy
scenes.line: Well, if these numbers you gave me are correct–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: They are correct, sir.

scenes.speaker: Financial Guy
scenes.line: Then you can't afford to pay him anything.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. A lame attempt at humor. Swing and a miss.

scenes.speaker: Financial Guy
scenes.line: Your prices are too low.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Lowest in town.

scenes.speaker: Financial Guy
scenes.line: Why do you think Staples and Dunder Mifflin can't match your prices?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Corporate greed?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Look, our price model is fine. I reviewed the numbers myself. Over time with enough volume, we become profitable.

scenes.speaker: Financial Guy
scenes.line: Yeah, with a fixed cost pricing model that's correct.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Financial Guy
scenes.line: But you need to use a variable cost pricing model.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, sure. Right, so– why don't you explain what that is to– so that they can under– just explain what that is.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Explain what you think that is.

scenes.speaker: Financial Guy
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Explain that.

scenes.speaker: Financial Guy
scenes.line: As you sell more paper and your company grows, so will your costs. For example, delivery man, health care…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, we don't–

scenes.speaker: Financial Guy
scenes.line: …business expansion–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Whatever, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Financial Guy
scenes.line: At these prices, the more paper you sell, the less money you'll make.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Our prices are the only thing keeping us in business.

scenes.speaker: Financial Guy
scenes.line: They're actually putting you out of business.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, okay. Hold on, hold on. Ty, I would like you to crunch those numbers again.

scenes.speaker: Ty
scenes.line: It's a program. There's no such thing–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just crunch 'em. Just crunch 'em please.

scenes.speaker: Ty
scenes.line: [presses key on computer] Crunch.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Did it help?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hi, Jerry. Michael Scott. Well, this is slightly embarrassing. [laughs] Um, I'm going to have to… ask you to pay me a little bit more money for that delivery we dropped off yesterday. Yeah. We did. We got the check, but we're just going to need a much, much bigger check.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: When a child gets behind the wheel of a car and runs into a tree, You don't blame the child. He didn't know any better. You blame the 30-year-old woman who got in the passenger seat and said, "Drive, kid. I trust you."

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Now, would corporate approve a temporary price reduction for returning customers?

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: God, no.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Stupid. Yeah, makes us look weak.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: I agree.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I say we fill Michael's office with bees. My apiarist owes me a favor.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really? Does he do good work or–

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [scoffs] No, Jim. I use a bad apiarist. [sighs]

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Fellas, why don't we take a five-minute break and then we will come back, start fresh, sort this out.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Five minutes exactly.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Okay. Hey, Dwight. Can I talk to you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Sure thing.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [opens phone] Hey. I saw you called.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You're just out of business?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We have maybe a month. I don't know what I'm gonna do.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, yeah, well don't worry about it. We'll figure it out. We'll be okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's what Michael said.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, yeah. Only this time we will be okay. [cell phone rings; Dwight's voice saying "Idiot, Idiot, Idiot"] Oh, that's my new "Dwight" ring.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I like it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Good, right? Hello.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [over phone] Idiot, we're starting back up. This is Dwight, by the way.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, okay. [kisses Pam] Don't worry about it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did I ever tell you about the day that Steve Martin died?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Steve Martin's not dead, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know. But I always thought that the day that he died would be the worst day of my life. I was wrong. It's this.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You want to hear something sad?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I would love that.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So Jim and I are getting married and the wedding's really expensive. So I tried to get a job on the weekends to earn extra money. I applied to Old Navy, Target and Wal-mart. None of 'em called me back. Not even for an interview.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I never went to Thailand.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I went to Fort Lauderdale.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Was it nice?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah, it was amazing. There was a great Pad Thai place, though.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I love Pad Thai.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: You've never had Pad Thai.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. There's a lot I haven't done.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Now, this is the projection over three months?

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: We still have the inventory sitting– [everyone starts chattEring at once]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Let me float something out there, okay? Can I just say– can I say something?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Yeah, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: There is a hive of bees outside the front door. We kidnap the queen, extract her alarm pheromones, place them on a flushable wipe, put that in his bathroom.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I can't believe I'm about to say this, but the cheapest option… is to make Michael an offer.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Yes. Yes, I was gonna say the same thing. We should buy him out.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, but you didn't.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, Man! If only Michael had children. That's how you really apply the pressure.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: What is wrong with you?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Jim, you're– you're pretty close with him. You think they'd be up for hearing an offer?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, I don't know. You know, they've taken a good deal of clients, so–

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I mean I guess– I guess I could go down there and try to nudge them in the right direction.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You know what? Why don't I do it, okay? Michael adores me. I'm the man for this job. Charles, you got my back on this?

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: No, Jim… I think you should go.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, so I'll be back in, um– back in a bit.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [knocking on door] Hmm?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, can I talk to you guys for a second?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We're not hiring, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Actually here for something else.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Listen, I can't make you laugh right now.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know I love a good guessing game, but why don't I just tell you what I'm here for? Turns out you guys have made a pretty big dent in the Dunder Mifflin sales.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Oh, that's nice.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: David Wallace has asked me to come down here and see if you would be interested in Dunder Mifflin buying you out.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Seriously? Are you being serious?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: He's bluffing, Pam.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jim, what you don't understand is that this company's worthl–

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No– We don't have–

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh! See I'm here to learn as little information as possible. All I really need to hear is if your incredibly successful company would be receptive to a buyout.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [stammers] Uh… Yes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Maybe.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Three yeses. I will see you titans of industry upstairs.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, well, we're not only tight-ends, we are also quarterbacks.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Missed the last part.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's a pun.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Got it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yep. Oh… wow.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Okay, so you are not going to reveal in any way that we're broke.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Of course not.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: That we're having any problem at all.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nope, nope, nope.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Just to reiterate, none of us is going to say anything that might indicate that we are going broke.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Right, right. There is no way in hell that I am going to say that we're broke.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, I'm really worried that I'm going to say it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ah…

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: No, man. You're– you're fine.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We have to come from a position of strength.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm good, I'm good.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Just put it out of your mind.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is. I'm good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Michael Scott Paper Company to see Mr. David Wallace. I believe we're expected. [David and Charles walk out of conference room] Well, well, well. How the turntables…

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Michael, in order to expedite these negotiations, we are prepared to make you a very generous offer.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And we are prepared to reject that offer.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Michael, you haven't even heard–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Never accept their first offer. What is your second offer?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Are you kidding me? That is insultingly low. I don't even want to hear what your first offer was.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: What do you hear?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [mumbles]

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Here's the situation. Your company is four weeks old. I know this business. I know what suppliers are charging. I know you can't be making very much money. I don't know how your prices are so low, but I know it can't keep up that way. I'm sure you're scared. Probably in debt. This is the best offer you're gonna get.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'll see your situation and I'll raise you a situation. Your company is losing clients left and right. You have a stockholder meeting coming up and you're going to have to explain to them why your most profitable branch is bleeding. So they may be looking for a little change in the CFO. So I don't think I need to wait out Dunder Mifflin. I think I just have to wait out you.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay, now I don't know that I can get this. I do have to go to the board for approval. How's about $60,000. Hmm? $60,0000. Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [stutters] We'll have to talk–

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: We'll have to talk about this.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just amongst ourselves.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay, yes. Please take the room. Be right outside. Take your time.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, my God. Oh, my God.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We are so rich.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Are you kidding me?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well, Jerry, the one who got away. May I ask why you're leaving the Michael Scott Paper Company? Really? Please hold. [gets up and runs to kitchen] Charles.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: May I have your attention? The Michael Scott Paper Company is broke.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: What? How'd you hear that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: They've been calling all of their clients and begging them to pay more money. That can only mean one thing. They're desperate. Which can only mean one thing. They're total failures.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Great work Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Quiet you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, I mean, great detective work. 'Cause this must be the first case you've ever cracked, right?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You don't crack a case. That has pejorative connotation. That's like calling a policeman a cop. You solve a case, and yes, I've solved plenty.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: So how long can they stay viable?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What are your top five cases?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm gonna answer Charles first.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Because you've solved zero cases.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, one. Case of the beet bandit. Missing beets from all over the farm. No footprints. Inside job. Mose in socks. Boom, case closed.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Okay, do not go anywhere near the conference room.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Done.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Because you have embarrassed me for the last time today. Got it?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm not– I'm not following you.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: You two are morons.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Got it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wh–

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Get out.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: So you've thought it over, yes, and you accept our offer. We can finally put this whole thing behind us? Hmm?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Can you give us another minute please?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Oh, okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: How could you do this to me, Michael? You just cost me $60,000.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Why are you assuming you'd get the whole thing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's a lot of money, okay. But we need money coming in every week. We need jobs. Wouldn't you rather have a fishing pole than a fish?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I would rather have $60,000, honestly.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, Michael's right. Jobs are safer.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Agreed?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Agreed. But that's all, okay.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah, discuss these things–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Shut up, shut up. Hello?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I want my old job back. I want my old parking space back. I want a Sebring.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: They don't make them anymore.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And I want Charles gone.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I am not firing Charles. He is very valuable.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: That's very kind of you to say, David.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I need him gone.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, then I want Pam back.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Uh, you already have a new receptionist–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sales.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Pam's not a salesperson.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, she is. At the Michael Scott Paper Company in it's heyday.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's right.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay. Please continue.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And Ryan.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Ryan cost Dunder Mifflin hundreds of thousands of dollars, Michael. Ryan is–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know, David. I don't care if Ryan murdered his entire family he is like a son to me.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Do you realize what you're asking for here? You're talking about salary plus health benefits–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And dental this time.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Insurance, taxes, social security for three people. This is a heck of a lot more than 60 grand. You're talking about a multi-million dollar buy-out.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: These are our demands.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Your company cannot be worth that much.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Our company is worth nothing. That's the difference between you and I. Business isn't about money to me, David. If tomorrow my company goes under, I will just start another paper company. And then another and another and another. I have no shortage of company names.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Michael–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's one of 'em! Yes. These are our demands. This is what we want. Our balls are in your court.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay. Deal. Okay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Can we have the room please?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Yeah. [David and Charles leave room, Michael shuts the door and closes the blinds]

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yes, yes, yes!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Alright!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes! Can you believe it? That's what I'm talking about!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There are certain defining moments in a person's life. The day he is born. The day he grows hair. The day he starts a business. And the day he sells that business back to Dunder Mifflin. What have I learned from all of this? It is far too early to tell. I just know that I am flying high and I don't even want to think about it. I just want to enjoy it.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Hey, guys–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no. You're done.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: At least once a year, I like to bring in some of my Kevin's Famous Chili. The trick is to undercook the onions. Everybody is going to get to know each other in the pot. I'm serious about this stuff. I'm up the night before pressing garlic and dicing whole tomatoes. I toast my own Ancho chilies. It's a recipe passed down from Malone's for generations. It's probably the thing I do best.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Someone is returning! He started his own company, and now he's back. Who could it be? I'll give you a hint. He is a man. A man you have missed with all your heart. A man who has ruined all other men for you. Who is it?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [whispEring] Who is it?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [whispEring] Who is it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [whispEring] It's Michael Scott. [applause; Michael jumps through sign] Hold it up. Conference room, five minutes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I guess the first order of business is to welcome back me, and Pam and Ryan. [scattered applause] And how about casual Friday again, huh? Reinstituting casual Friday? You all look great. What I want to do right now is try something a little different. I'm going to throw it out there, starting with this meeting. I want you guys to run it. I want you to say whatever you want, take it away. Your meeting.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [after a few moments of silence] Wh–what are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: If there is something that you would like to say as a group, then by all means, you may say it to me right now.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: People are dressed inappropriately.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Take it up with Toby. What I want you to do, is I want you to look inward. And I want you to reflect. And I want you to say something different.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Can you give us a hint?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: When I needed salespeople for my new paper company, everyone here turned their back on me. Am I going to ask them to beg for forgiveness? No. Am I going to ask for big, crying apology? No. Am I going to ask them to slit their wrists for me? No. I just want a tiny, microscopic version of that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oscar, what were you going to say?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Nothing. I didn't say anything.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Do I still have a job here?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Not important. [everyone mutters] Okay, alright. Yes. Yes, you have a job. Frankly, you have a job because Ryan and Pam are starting with us as salesmen.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wait, what?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: How is that going to work?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's going to work very smoothly, because Pam and Ryan are bringing over a ton of clients from Michael Scott Paper Company and–

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: You mean the clients you stole from us.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah , aren't we getting those clients back?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, you lost those clients.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I call foul, sir.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You were bought out. So the company then bought out all of the stolen clients.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, Dwight. Let me explain something to you. I set the rules and you follow them. Blindly. Okay? And if you have a problem with that then you can talk to our complaint department. It's a trash can.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [to Ryan] Don't fall in love with me, kid.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [laughs] Boscov's at the Steamtown Mall?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: It sure looked good on the mannequin.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, you have good taste.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Well, thanks. I sure wish I had more time to talk to my clients, though.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Isn't that what you said to a bunch of my clients when you were stealing them? That I didn't have enough time for them?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, I, um…

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Close your mouth, sweetie. You look like a trout.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: The man is wearing sandals. I don't need to see Oscar's toes at work. Gross! I mean he looks like he just got off the boat.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Can't you just not look at his feet?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Excuse me? Oh. You're so educated, aren't you Toby? So trained to deal with a hysterical woman. I don't want to look at his feet. [storms off] Do your job!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, I was in the Seminary for a year and dropped out 'cause I wanted to have sex with this girl, Cathy. Followed her to Scranton. Took the first job I could find in H.R. Later she divorced me. So no, I wouldn't say I have a passion for H.R.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [hands Ryan a soda] There you are, my friend.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Oh, thanks, man.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pamela.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Fresh hot ink.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: "New File System".

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Trust me, Stanley, you're going to want to read this memo very carefully.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I am not changing the way I do my files.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, no. This goes for all of you. Believe me, you are going to want to heat my words.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: When held over heat the invisible ink will reveal that everyone should meet at the warehouse immediately. Do not ask me where I got the invisible ink. Urine. It was urine.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I'm sorry you're offended by my shoes, but I am not going to drive home to change.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I could loan you a pair of socks.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: No, they're clean. I was going to wear them to volleyball practice later.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I don't think so.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Andrew Bernard.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, what are you still doing at your desk?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What are you still doing not at your desk?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Did you even read the memo?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: All my files are now in reverse alphabetical order–

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, you idiot. There is a code embedded in the memo. Listen, you need to round up all the salesmen, except for Ryan and Pam, and get them down to the warehouse pronto.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, it is on like a prawn who yawns at dawn.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Stop doing rhyming poetry. Just tell them, please. God, the simplest thing.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We're in crisis mode here, do you understand? The two unqualified so-called salespeople are being favored because they all failed together. And frankly, I'm not convinced that Michael and Pam didn't have a thing going while they were gone.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Can I address that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, you're too close.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Stanley, how do you feel about those two taking your clients?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: It's not right. I don't like it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: He doesn't like it.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: You don't take my clients away and give them to a secretary. [sighs] No offense, Jim. I think she's very pretty.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Her face is okay, but– Jesus! What –what are you doing here?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I don't know. I saw a crowd. I thought there might be a dogfight or something–

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Get out! We need to do something. I'm thinking maybe a coup or we take Ryan hostage.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Those sound too harsh.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, I'm not saying we do those things. I'm saying something like those things.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Of course. What is like a hostage?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Excellent question.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: We could write a strong-worded letter.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Words will never be enough.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Strongly-painted picture.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, pictures are too interpretive.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Can I just say something? I know that tempers are high, but I think the best way to handle this might be to just talk to Michael directly.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh. Well, that–that's a great idea, Jim. Oh, I totally see your point. Okay, we'll talk to Michael directly. So uh, meeting is over, I guess. I'll see everyone upstairs.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Great. See you upstairs.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: C'mon. [whispers] Guys. Psst, listen. Now is the time for action. I'm talking action–

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That one's great.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: You look so classy in that picture.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I do? Well–Where is that bowl?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, you have a second?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Michael Scott Paper Company only.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, I think you're going to want to cool it with that 'cause it's starting to upset the other salesmen.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, well—

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Tough.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I will–no, no. I'll talk to them when they all get back from the bathroom.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: This is awkward to talk about, but there may or may not be–but definitely is–a mutiny forming in the warehouse right now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Against who?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: You. Us.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: It's gotta be because they all want their clients.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The old Michael Scott might have taken this, but not the new Michael Scott. They are in for a bitter surprise. I am not to be truffled with.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Six weeks ago, none of these people wanted to come with me. You two were the only ones with the stones to follow.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Mm-hmmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That was us, right there.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We were something else.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: What you gotta do is you gotta go down to that warehouse and you gotta crack some skulls.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Chiklis style.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, the Commish.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yes, but Chiklis Shield style. Not Commish style.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, yeah. The Shield.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: It's crazy what's going on out there today, huh?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I know. Yeah, it's…kinda–

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Sometimes it's best just to say out of it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's true. That's right. Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Want to play a game?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey gang. Where you been?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Lunch.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Where'd you eat?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: A restaurant.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What'd you have, Stanley?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I had a salmon salad. With water, no ice. I was going to get a soda, but the waiter talked me out of it. Her name was Flo, she had black hair.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I had Mexican food.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So since you guys already ate, you won't be eating the stuff you brought with you for lunch, will you? [walks into kitchen] Oh, wow, Stanley. Is that egg salad? Andy brought some salmon.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: That looks great.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight, is that a meat sandwich? You guys hungry?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I can eat.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm going to o have some of this meat sandwich.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's pony.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mom. What kind of sauce is on your salmon?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Dijonnaise.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmm. Thanks for going out, guys.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Mmm.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey, Meredith. Can I talk to you privately for a second?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: About what?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Your outfit.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: What? What's wrong with my outfit?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You–you might consider pulling it down a touch. It's ri–it's riding up a little high.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: A bunch of prudes. You know, Oscar's allowed to wear sandals, but I'm not allowed to wear open-toed shoes? [pulls down dress, office gasps] Is that how it goes?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Meredith, your boob is out.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Fine. [pulls dress up, everyone gasps again]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Meredith, too far!

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Dammit, Meredith, where are your panties?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: It's casual day. Happy? [bends over to get a file, exposing herself to the office]

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [playing chess with Jim] No. IF you do that, I'm gonna do that. IF you do that, I'm gonna do that. IF you do this, I'm gonna do that.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, what if I just do this?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: You don't want to do that.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm just hiding out until all this stuff blows over. With Creed. Playing chess. At work. He's winning. I feel like I'm describing a dream I had.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I'm sorry you feel that way, Mr. Bart. Is there anything I can do to make things better?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa. Give me the phone. Give me the phone.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Exactly.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's my client.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Exactly. This is your first complaint in ten years.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Give me the phone.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Things have been generally good.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Give me the phone. Tell him Dwight Schrute wants to talk to him.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Look, uh, Mr. Bart…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hi, Mr. Bart.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: At these prices with this service…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey, it's Dwight here. Give me the phone.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: You're not gonna find this anywhere else.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Dwight Schrute here. Hey, don't hang up.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: No, no, no. Sir, don't listen.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I know times are tough right now, and I laud your thriftiness. [tries to pull phone out of Ryan's hand] Ryan!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Ryan, hand the phone over.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Stop flustEring me, everybody!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Who let this boy on the phone?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ah! Mr. Bart! Ugh! [slams phone down] I cannot believe you lost that account. He was my client for ten years!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You made him lose the account by screaming at him the entire time. It's okay, Ryan.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You're a secretary! What do you know?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: And you're a temp and I'm taking your phone. I'm confiscating this.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, hey guys. You know what I want you to do? Shake hands, get over it. That was not a shake, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We want our clients back or we quit, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Who quits?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Me.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: And me.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Me too.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You guys gotta be kidding.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, we gotta be deadly serious. We'll start our own paper company. The Schrute-Bernard-Lapin-Vance…Stanley Paper Company.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I love it. I love this idea, and I fully support you. As a matter of fact, I'm going to give you some seed money. [throws money at Phyllis] There you go. There's some seed money for you. And you can take it, no hard feelings. But if you stay, I want an apology, and I want a big one.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: You want us to apologize to you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes I do.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That's completely backwards.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's frontward's.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Michael, you thought you were attacking corporate, but we were the ones who got hurt. You should be apologizing to us.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: That's right.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Michael, you always said we were a family. Then you went after us.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No matter how I look at this, I am in the wrong. And I have looked at this thing, like a hundred different ways. From my point of view, from their point of view…98 others. And the bottom line, I am in the wrong. I'm the bad guy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I need you to arrange a meeting between me and the sales staff without Ryan and Pam knowing.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Gasp. Are you talking about a secret meeting?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Whatever you guys did earlier.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I don't know that first things about secret meetings.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just do it, okay?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'll do–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Get 'em there. Get 'em there.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'll do the best I can.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Are you kidding me?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Deceit does not come easy to me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, okay, okay.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I really love your outfit.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Thank you so much for saying that. I can't believe that Toby thinks this is inappropriate.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You look like J-Lo.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So from the bottom of my heart to the top of my heart, I am sorry.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Are you giving us our clients back?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: If we could just focus and go down the line, and everyone would say, "apology accepted", I think we would all feel better. And then we can break out my gift to you–complimentary white chocolate bark.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Nobody likes that stuff except for you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: They wouldn't make it unless people liked it.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Michael, just give us our clients back. That's all we care about.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. If I give you your clients back there won't be enough clients for Ryan and Pam, and I promised both of them they were gonna be salespeople.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: So?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Fine, have your clients. I can see that's what you wanted all along. [everyone mutters "okay"] However, I rescind my apology.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's fair.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You are not reacting at all as I had hoped.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: What'd I tell you about building forts in my warehouse?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Michael gave all of our clients back to their old salespeople, so now there's not enough for both me and Pam to stay on.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: He can only keep one of us as a salesperson now. He'll make his decision by the end of the day.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I think you should get it. You really grew into it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh. I think you should get it. You've changed a lot and you'd be good at it.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: If you really think that, will you tell that to Michael? That would go a long way coming from you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: So hey, I'm want to set you up with my daughter.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, I'm engaged to Pam.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I thought you were gay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Then why would you want to set me up with your daughter?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I don't know.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jim. Can I talk to you for a minute?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sure. Let me just finish this turn.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [puts Scrabble pieces on board] And Bingo was his name. Let's go.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Challenge.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I need your help. This whole Pam/Ryan debate is screwing with my head.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I don't want to be biased, but I am very close to Ryan. You know that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're close with Pam too.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Eh, she's nice, I guess. You know what? Best thing to do, Pros and Cons list.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pro for Ryan, he went to business school, he's my number one choice.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, that's–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I like his hair.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Cons, Ryan. He defrauded the company. He has never made a sale.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He definitely stole my iPod.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That sounds pretty biased.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You didn't hear my pros. Environmentally-conscious 'cause his mom drives him to work everyday.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. Pam, pros.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I like her. I think that she is a fast learner. Cons, she doesn't always follow through. Sh–New York and the whole art school thing. And Roy. She has a weird voice.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's not true.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't need to tell you that.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think she'd be a really good salesperson.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't think you are being totally impartial though, because you haven't said one bad thing about Pam.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And I won't.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. So be it, then you've lost credibility. And I'm going to go with my guy, and that's Ryan.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right. You're right, sometimes when she's tired, she can be a little bit shrill. But that's not a weird voice.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, wow! Whoa!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Take it easy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ho-ho, man! Wow. [in a high-pitched voice] Honey! I want you to bring the garbage out. 'Cause I'm not going to have sex with you unless you bring out the garba–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have a very difficult decision to make. It's like last week I was at the video store. Do I rent Devil Wears Prada again? Or do I finally get around to seeing Sophie's Choice? It is what you would call a classic difficult decision.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You don't understand clothing, Toby. You're dressed like this amorphous blob of khaki.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: All right, look, what you gotta understand is that when you come to work, you give up certain rights.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Listen up, Flenderson. You're being weak and ineffectual. I'm cowboying this meeting, okay? Here are the new rules. Earth tones only. Also, women are forbidden to wear pants.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: All right, come. Sit down, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I'm running this meeting.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's debatable.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: It's not. It's not. Sit down or I am writing you up.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Ooh, where has this guy been?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Casual Fridays are cancelled. [everyone protests] Let's just not do it anymore.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You're running from the problem.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: There's not a single appropriate outfit in this whole–except mine, quite honestly.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pam, can you come in here, please? Have a seat. [clears throat] Well, there's no easy way of saying this. So I think I will just…drag it out. Since the dawn of time there has been–

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Just tell me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I gave Ryan the sales job. There just weren't enough clients for the two of you. So I had to–

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm sorry, sorry.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, I get it. [Michael laughs] Why are you giggling? Is this a joke? [Michael continues to laugh] Michael, is this– did I get the job?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughing] Yes, you did.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I did?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: For real, you're not kidding?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, you–no.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I did?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, you're the best person for the job. You're going to be great.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, Michael, thank you. Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughing] Oh, oh!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank you. You will not be sorry.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You should have seen your face. Oh man! Oh, that was classic.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh. [laughing] I really thought I didn't get it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, really?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah. 'Cause you said I didn't

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, man. That was really good. That was really good.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What about Ryan?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know, I offered him his temp job back. We'll see. He was not happy at all when I offered him this job and then I told him he didn't get the job, so–

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah. Maybe you shouldn't fake fire people anymore.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't appreciate you telling me what to do. So clean out your desk, you are through here.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thanks, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh! What's our receptionists name?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Erin.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Could you send her in?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [opens door] Erin. Michael wants to see you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Michael

scenes.line: No. [Camera pans to down to show her swinging her foot to the music]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah. No. Well, ok.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Stop squirming.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, stop trying to poke me with a sharp thing.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: You wanted to do this. Just be brave.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I, I – but you're not a professional and I'm thinking maybe we should have gone to a professional.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I'm doing it. No. I'm doing it for free. You have to stop squirming otherwise I'm gonna mess up.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Are you sure that's not the "gay" ear?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Gay ear? Are you 12 years old?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, I…

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Look, I'm gonna count to 3.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Count to twen – count to twenty.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: No. I'm gonna count to 3.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: K

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Agh! Son of a bitch!

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Andy, that was just the ice.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It was?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Yeah. It was.

scenes.speaker: Lynn
scenes.line: Hey, Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hi. Did you have bacon for breakfast?

scenes.speaker: Lynn
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh…cause you smell like bacon.

scenes.speaker: Lynn
scenes.line: I didn't think I did. How's everything going?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Tight. I'm going down the hall to this office to see Michael – there's free espressos.

scenes.speaker: Lynn
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I would invite you but I remember that you just want to be friends.

scenes.speaker: Lynn
scenes.line: We can still…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Are you sure that you didn't eat bacon?

scenes.speaker: Lynn
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh. Whatever it is I like it. Bye.

scenes.speaker: Lynn
scenes.line: Yes, I had some bacon this morning. I just didn't think it was anyone's business.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I love the smell of bacon on a woman.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hey, Lynn, it's Kevin. I was thinking about going and getting a coffee at the Cafe Disco, wondEring if you want to go with. Bye. Angela, my stomach is really hurting.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Just go down, Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: My grandpa was the funnest guy I ever knew. He would sing. He would dance. He would…fall down. But then…he started going to these meetings and everything changed. He…stopped going out at night. He got a job. The fun just dried up. It was really sad. I don't want that to happen to you guys. I'm not gonna let it happen.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: How did I end up back in Crazytown?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It is hard to imagine you playing softball.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I was all-county my junior and senior years.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh yeah? Big deal. I once hit three home runs against Little Flower Catholic.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: The girls school?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I played high school softball. Notice I didn't say "girls" high school softball. Not after the landmark case of Shrute vs. the Lackawanna County Board of Education.That was one case the Pennsylvania Supreme Court got right. I hit the ball right over the protest banners.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [sarcastically] Oh, no. I love Ohio. Next time you're there say "Hi" to my cousin Amel and then kick him in the groin area because he's a cheat and a ball hog. And if he's still married to Clarissa, kick her in the groin area, too. 'Cause she's a heart breaking tart…and a ball hog.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [phone rings, whispEring] Dunder Mifflin, this is Erin… He's not available right now… Uh huh… Yes… Sure, I'll give him the message when he gets up– gets back.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael had chicken potpie for lunch. Actually, let me rephrase that, Michael had an entire chicken pot pie for lunch, and- let me be more specific. Michael ate an entire family-sized chicken potpie for lunch and then he promptly fell asleep, so we're all trying to be very quiet so as to not wake him up before 5:00 pm. Which, actually, should be in about… ten minutes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [whispEring] Okay, I'm gonna go in there and change the computer. Are you sure you can change his watch?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [whispEring] I can do it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [whispEring] What do you need from me?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Normally I don't condone leaving early, but I have an appointment with the horse doctor. How that horse became a doctor, I don't know. [laughs heartily] No, I'm kidding. He's just a regular doctor who shoots your horse in the head when its leg is broken.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [mumbles in his sleep as Pam and Jim change the clocks in his office]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [changing the clock in Michael's car] Like clockwork.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [silently counting] Three, two, one… [Erin turns on the office lights, all laugh loudly]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [wakes up, joins in with the laughter] Uh oh. What's so funny?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You had to be there.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh yay! Geography joke. [still laughing, notices the time] Oh! Wow! Okay. Alright, let's all go home. Come on. See you all tamale.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: See you later!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Bye Michael! [all applaud and cheer, Dwight imitates gunfire] Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [at company picnic] All right, you ready for this?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, we walk around, everyone sees our faces and we leave, right?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wait, should I have left the car running? [both laugh]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, don't get us wrong, we like picnics.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Come on, who doesn't like a picnic?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Tell them what happened last year.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I had this huge spider in my baseball mitt.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, no, that guy who hit on me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, right, some drunk guy hit on Pam last year. Said he was grabbing her for balance.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, you don't grab these [gestures to her chest] for balance.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm gonna say 30.

scenes.speaker: Rolf
scenes.line: Ah, 40. Insect repellent, which we clearly need, reduces the effectiveness of SPF.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Good point, but, thought of that already. Combination SPF/repellent.

scenes.speaker: Rolf
scenes.line: Woah. Homemade?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Of course. You think the EPA would ever allow that much DEET? [both laugh]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Rolph is my best friend. We met in a shoe store. I heard him asking for a shoe that could increase his speed and not leave any tracks.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Michael, isn't that Holly?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We're just friends. [approaches Holly and AJ] Hey, hey, wait a second. Who let you in here, is what I want to know.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh no, I see they're letting just anybody in here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmhmm. Yeah, that's right.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right. Mmhmm. [both start laughing and hug] Hey.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hi. You remember AJ, my boyfriend?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: A little bit. Uh, I meet a lot of people.

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: Hey Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey. [hugs AJ a little too forcefully] Arrggh. So would you guys like some lemonade? Or one of you? Or both of you? Either or. The combinations are endless.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Lemonade sounds great.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: I'd love an iced tea, actually.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You can go to hell. [laughs] I'm kidding. Um, sure, I will get you the best iced tea in the world.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I lied to Kevin. Holly and I can never be just friends. I wrote down a list of bullet points why Holly and I should be together, and I'm going to find the perfect moment today and I am going to tell her. Number one:

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Jim. Pam.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, how are you?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey Charles.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Nice day, huh?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Must be nice to get a rest from all your rest. [walks away]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I don't get it. He's not even my boss anymore.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Do you want me to beat him up for you?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, I shouldn't have to ask you to do stuff like that. You should just do it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Listen up everyone! I've gone over this lineup very carefully. We cannot forget the humiliation we suffered last year at the softball game with Jim's whole spider-in-the-mitt incident. Right?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I could've died, so… I looked it up online afterwards.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Erin, back row. Ryan, you move up a row!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Bro-migo, you think you could put Erin on my row?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why? I don't understand.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: If-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Woah, woah, woah. W-w-wait a minute. I get it. You want her to set you up so you can spike it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh… [laughs sheepishly]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'll tell you what, I'm gonna do you one better. I'm gonna put you next to Phyllis. She is the best setter on the team.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That's…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Sly dog.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: … not what I meant.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Come on, folks!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What is up with you two, Holly?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Um, not much.

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: We're designing a house.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Cool. For who?

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: For us.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow… I'm designing a chair. It's part of your pants. You sit down, you're supported.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I remember your chair pants idea. [laughs]

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: I like that. Put me down for a pair. I'm a size 34 waist.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right, fatty. I will do it. You know what, we should actually rehearse.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Okay, yeah.

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: You guys are really gonna do this?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You bet your fat ass we are.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, in his infinite wisdom, David Wallace has authorized us to put on a little presentation about the history of Dunder Mifflin.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yep, the old comedy team is back together again.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's right.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [in a New York accent] Have ya hoyd the news? Extry! Extry! Read all about it!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Newspapers for sale!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [playing volleyball, yelling at Erin, who hit the ball out of bounds] Are you blind?! Are you blind?! [turns attention to a man on the other team] Sir, with the glasses, are you literally blind? I'm concerned you might be in danger.

scenes.speaker: Man
scenes.line: These are expensive Ray-Bans, jackass.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay, I was just looking out for you. [to Erin] You're doing great, by the way.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [playing volleyball] I got it. [Kevin misses]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ohh! Oh, Kevin! Come on!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Are you blind?!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I could've gotten that, idiot!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Can you see things with your eyeballs?!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's not a sledgehammer! Come on, people! We need to get our heads in the game! Let's focus! Come on, you're better than this! I am better than this! Phyllis, why are you sitting on the ground?!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: We've been out here for a while. I don't need this.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [grunts in frustration]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [playing volleyball, Ryan hits the ball away, not paying attention to the game] Oh come- Ryan, come on, man! W-w-wait. Net. Net. Her hand's on the net.

scenes.speaker: Woman
scenes.line: So what?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Rule violation. Ball is ours. Give it to me. Our point. Okay. Hey, Pam, how ya doin? Hey, do you know if you're right-handed or left-handed? Or do you even know? What hand do you use to answer the phone?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Back off, Dwight. [serves] Hyuh! [the opposing team misses the ball, the Scranton team cheers] What?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Maybe I played a little in junior high… and in high school… maybe a little in college… and went to volleyball camp most summers.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [serves] Hyuh! [other team misses and Scranton cheers] Well, look at that, we win!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nice job, Beesly.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes! We advance to the next round!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh, Lord in heaven.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [to Phyllis] Had to be part of the group. [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I brought some snacky snacks, in case we get hungry.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Ooh, yes please. [takes a bite] Mmm. So what do you have planned for us today? Hmm?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [watching her eat] What?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Do you have a script for the sketch, or…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um, no, I just thought we'd wing it. That cool?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Crystal cool.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [playing volleyball] Hit it Andy!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Bump! I bumped it!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Set!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Don't set it to yourself!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [Pam saves the play and Scranton cheers] Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Ow, my ankle!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What happened?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I… twisted it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You weren't even moving. [Phyllis leaves the court] Okay, sub!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I can play.

scenes.speaker: Rolf
scenes.line: Is there a… Meredith here?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Yeah! Man in!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Rolph, did you not hear me?

scenes.speaker: Rolf
scenes.line: I don't hear cheaters, tramps, or women who break my friend's heart. Let's go!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We could do a movie… sort of thing.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [gasps] We could do Back to the Future.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: We have to convince Dunder and Mifflin to go back in time… fix their parents. [both laugh]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Could we get a Delorean?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Jaws. They swim in the ocean and they terrorize the whole community.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh! [to the theme of "Jaws"] Dun-der. Dun-der…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Dun-der. Dun-der…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dun-der. Dun-der. Dun-der. Dun-der. Blooo!! [both laugh]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh… We haven't found our great idea yet.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. No.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We're circling it.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hmm…

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: [playing volleyball, Scranton wins another game] Nicely done. We're still going to crush you though!

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Yes we are!

scenes.speaker: Rolf
scenes.line: You suckers are goin down! They're gonna wipe their asses with your serves! Piss all over your faces!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, Rolph! Woah. Wait, wait- [shouts of disapproval]

scenes.speaker: Rolf
scenes.line: It's true!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Ah, this reminds me of the HR convention last fall.

scenes.speaker: Kendall
scenes.line: Oh yeah, with Bernie and Efrem. That was hilarious.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Really, really funny.

scenes.speaker: Kendall
scenes.line: Really funny.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Listen guys, one more point and we play corporate. [they get the last point, Jim and Dwight hug]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Settle down gentlemen.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Good game!

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Welcome to the 43rd Annual Company Picnic, everybody. Thanks for being here. Now, a couple of employees have volunteered to entertain us with a song.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [shouts from behind the trees] Uh, it's a sketch now.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay, introducing Scranton's Michael Scott performing with Nashua's Holly Flax! I have not seen this. [applause]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And now, presenting…

scenes.speaker: Both
scenes.line: SlumDunder Mifflinaire! [laughter]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [imitates Who Wants To Be a Millionaire theme music as both sit in folding chairs]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Are you ready to play SlumDunder Mifflinaire?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, I am.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: For one hundred dollars, where did Dunder meet Mifflin? A.) On easy street, B.) a tour of Dartmouth College, C.) they never met, D.) brushing their teeth?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ohh, I'm thinking… I'm going to say… B, tour of Dartmouth College.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: That is correct! [both run to another side of the stage, acting out a different scene] How did you know that?! [pantomimes electrocuting Michael]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [screams] Ahhhh!! Ohhh!! Ahhh!! I was there! Ahhh!! I was a tour guide at Dartmouth College!! Noooo!!!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [now pretending to be Dunder and Mifflin] Nice campus. Think you'll get in?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, I'm definitely getting in. I'm a shoo-in.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I'm Robert Dunder.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm Robert Mifflin. [pause to see audience's response] Ah, okay. [both run back to chairs]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Robert Mifflin had a great life. But unfortunately, had undiagnosed depression, which over nine million Americans suffer from and is very treatable. For two hundred and fifty dollars, how did he kill himself? A.) A rope, B.) a knife, C.) a gun, D.) brushing his teeth!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Two hundred and fifty dollars is more money than I've ever seen in my life. I will say, C, a gun. He shot himself in the head.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: That is correct!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I usually don't enjoy the theater, but this is delightful.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: The economic downturn has been difficult recently, forcing the closures of both Camden and Yonkers, to be followed soon by what other branch? For five-hundred thousand dollars, is it A.) Scranton, B.) Buffalo, C.) Utica, or D.) toothbrush!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I will say B, Buffalo! Final answer!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: That is correct!

scenes.speaker: Man from Buffalo
scenes.line: [over crowd of murmurs] What is he talking about?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [pantomimes biting off Michael's fingers, Michael screams] How did you know that?!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: David Wallace told me!!

scenes.speaker: Woman from Buffalo
scenes.line: David, is this true?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Uh, okay everyone, we're at a picnic today…

scenes.speaker: Man from Buffalo
scenes.line: Are we losing our jobs or not, David?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: They didn't know?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [whispers] I guess not.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I'm sorry, this certainly wasn't the time or the place to announce this sort of thing, but there have been talks about closing the Buffalo branch.

scenes.speaker: Woman from Buffalo
scenes.line: And?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: We're- we're closing the Buffalo branch.

scenes.speaker: Man from Buffalo
scenes.line: [over shouts of protest] You've got to be kidding me! You've got to be kidding me! We're the best branch in the company! I can't believe it. [Michael and Holly bow]

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: How could you possibly think that the right way to announce a branch closing was in a comedy sketch at the company picnic?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well… I didn't know they didn't know.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: What about the fact that they're here today? What about that? That didn't throw up any alarms? No, Michael needed a little bit for his comedy sketch, and he thought, "oh, this would be really funny."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Damn it, Michael, I told you that in confidence. Now I have to go over and deal with these employees and their families. A little boy just walked up to me and said, "is my daddy gonna have a job by Christmas?"

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, he's just thinking about his own gifts.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Maybe we shouldn't play due to the circumstances.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey, people need volleyball now more than ever.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How do you figure?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Because if we don't play, then the other team wins.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Dwight's right. Corporate deserves to get its ass kicked.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Let's do this.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [playing volleyball] Jim, come on! [Jim scores a point, Scranton cheers]

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Look who just woke up! [laughs, scores a point on the next play] I've been up for a while.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: It's six to six. It's a nail-biter. [ball hits Kevin]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Kevin! Now it's seven-six, or is that too much accounting for you?

scenes.speaker: Rolf
scenes.line: Here's an accounting question for you:

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [hits the ball over the net and scores a point] Yeah! Boo-yah!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [running for the ball] I got it!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Pam!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [falls] Oof!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You all right?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yep. No, no, no, I'm fine.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You sure?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, easy, easy…

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Woah, woah, woah, woah, you wanna get that looked at.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, no, it's fine. Just gimme a second.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: I don't know. You know, this is a company picnic, so technically that is a company injury, you know? Safest thing to do is get that examined, right David?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right, you know what? You're just trying to get rid of our best player.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Oh, Jim, you're putting a volleyball game in front of your fiance's health.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, uh-

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Look, seriously, I can move it fine. Come on, let's go, it's our ball. Let's go!

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Yeah, I don't think we can let you play with that foot.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [whispEring] Tell you what. I spotted a small hospital a few kilometers south of here. Get her back as soon as possible. I'll stall 'em.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: I guess that's it for you, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right, you know what? [picks Pam up and carries her off the court] Let's do this.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We'll be back!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh man, I am so mad that Pam got hurt! Argh!! Rrrraah!!! [kicks volleyball into the woods, calmly] I'll get it. [walks slowly toward the woods]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Probably shouldn't have mentioned Buffalo.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hindsight.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Should've had hindsight.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: How do you think it went before the Buffalo thing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think it went well. I think it was good.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: There weren't any laughs.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, it was a tough audience.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yeah, but we wrote it specifically for this audience.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Believe me, I have seen a lot of tough audiences in my time, and that was one of them.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Well, I'm glad we did it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Me too. [long pause] We have a lot of good material for next year's sketch.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I can't wait.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [on the phone] Yeah, she's with the nurse right now, so you'll have to stall a little longer… No, don't send in the subs yet… Dwight, I don't know. Think of something!

scenes.speaker: Nurse
scenes.line: To be safe, we should do an x-ray.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How long will that take?

scenes.speaker: Nurse
scenes.line: Oh, shouldn't be too bad, it's a slow day. So, no other radiation this year, no metal plates, no chance you're pregnant…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm sorry, can we just hurry this up? I've got a game to get back to.

scenes.speaker: Nurse
scenes.line: Oh good, because my next question was "do you have a game to get back to."

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: What'd you think?

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: I loved it. You know, there was a part near the end that seemed like that went on a little long, but…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well you guys should hit the road before… I close down another branch.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [laughs] Okay. So good to see you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good to see you. [they hug] AJ.

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: Michael. [they shake hands]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I didn't find a perfect moment, because I think that today was just about just having today. And I think that we are one of those couples with a long story, when people ask how they found each other. I will see her every now and then, and… Maybe one year she'll be with somebody, and the next year, I'll be with somebody, and it's gonna take a long time… And then it's perfect. I'm in no rush.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Dwight, come on now, it's time to put in the subs.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: Yeah, it looks like Pam won't make it back. Okay?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay. Fine.

scenes.speaker: Charles
scenes.line: All right! Come on.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Except, you know what? It's not fine. How many people need to get hurt before we learn a valuable lesson? One? Two? Three? Four?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, no, hear me out. Five? Six?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Seven? Can I finish please?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Eight?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [on the phone] Oh, Dwight, we're so close! Just buy us a few more minutes… Well, they just called me in for an update, so I'll call you right back… Okay… Okay, great. [goes into a private room where Pam and the doctor are, the voices are inaudible, but the camera can see through a window, Pam and Jim look in shock, they hug and Jim goes back out into the hall to call Dwight back, trembling] Hey, Dwight, uh… send in the subs! [laughs] Ohh! [goes back into the room to hug Pam]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [enters office, somersaults onto couch, kicks over painting and lamp] Parkour!

scenes.speaker: Dwight & Andy
scenes.line: [rush into office, Andy climbs on reception desk, Dwight holds video camera]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Parkour!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [walking on Pam's desk, then Jim's desk] Extreme! Parkour!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: This… is Parkour. [turns laptop to camera, shows Parkour instructional video] Internet sensation of 2004. And it was in one of the Bond films. It's pretty impressive. [Michael is shown climbing/walking on various objects in office] The goal is to get from point A to point B as creatively as possible, so technically they are doing Parkour, as long as point A is delusion and point B is the hospital.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [stands on his hands kicking open bathroom doors as Andy films, Meredith is seen applying deodorant in women's bathroom]

scenes.speaker: Dwight & Andy
scenes.line: [approaching elevator, as Michael films] Parkour! Parkour!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Andy! Leapfrog! [Andy leapfrogs Dwight]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Do me! Do me!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah! [Dwight jumps on Andy's back, riding him like a horse] Parkour! Parkour!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ow! Get off! Get off!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Andy & Michael
