scenes.line: [walking across cars in parking lot, Dwight filming] Parkour! Parkour!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [crouching beside car] Jump over the camera! Jump over the camera! [Michael feebly attempts to jump off car, gives double thumbs up to camera]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [standing on tractor trailer with Dwight and Andy, looking down] Okay, we all go together or we go one at a time.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Here it is, here it is… truck, to refrigerators, to dumpster, [camera pans to refrigerator boxes, then dumpster] 360 onto the pallets, backflip gainer to the trash can.

scenes.speaker: Michael & Dwight
scenes.line: [in unison] Yeah! Gainer! Woohoo!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [to Michael's camera] Hardcore Parkour!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Parkoooooour!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Let's do it!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [leaps from trailer, disappears into empty refrigerator box]

scenes.speaker: Michael & Dwight
scenes.line: [look down, appearing shocked and concerned]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [inside refrigerator box, sounding injured] Parkour!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [on telephone] Good. Excellent. Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Female Intern
scenes.line: [hands Dwight a cup of water] There you go. Is there anything else I can do?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [chugs water, throws away cup] Yes. Umm… see those files behind Kevin's desk?

scenes.speaker: Female Intern
scenes.line: [nods] Mm hmm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Go put them all in random order.

scenes.speaker: Female intern
scenes.line: [confused] Mm-kay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Then come back here for your next assignment concerning their order.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: This is the last day of our summer interns. It's been nice. We haven't had interns for a while, ever since Michael's Monica Lewinsky incident. [interns are shown gathered around Kelly's desk, one holding a box of tissues, as Kelly cries and wipes tears] He didn't do anything sexual. [female intern opens a jar of salsa for Michael] He just made far, far too many Monica Lewinsky jokes. [Meredith rubs her breasts into Maurie's back] It was just easier for corporate to shut down the program.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [to Oscar, motioning to male intern and female intern] Think she did him?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I bet there's something there. I was with them in the kitchen yesterday, and they were all too happy to be cleaning the freezer.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: If they get married before I do, I'm going to kill myself.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [entEring break room] Who's getting married?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Nobody.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: If somebody doesn't tell me, I'm gonna start screaming.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: It's Eric and Megan.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh! Hey, I hired them! Matchmaker! This place is like Spaniard Fly.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: They're not getting married. It's just talk.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did everybody know about this but me?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: There's nothing to know, it's just gossip.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [shaking head disgustedly] Okay… okay. [leaves room]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [talking head with Jim] We haven't told anyone I'm pregnant.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, with her being unmarried… knocked up by some guy, I mean the yakity-yaks in this office would have a field day.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, we don't want them at the wedding thinking Jim's being marched down the aisle by my dad with a shotgum.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wait, there's not gonna be a shotgun?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Nope.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No shotgun… 'cause that changes everything.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Can't back out now, Halpert.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What are you gonna do about it? There's no shotgun, so… free at last, free at last!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, keep it up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [approaches Dwight's desk] You'll never guess what I know.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [typing] Okay, let me finish this thought.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Eric likes Megan.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [still typing] He most definitely does. He's been asking her out repeatedly for weeks. She finally said yes. They went out on a group date the other night; apparently it went very well.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [annoyed] How do you know this?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [still typing] People tell me things. I guess I have a face you can trust. I think it's because of my low cheekbones. And… boom. [finishes typing, turns to face Michael] Okay, what is it, what can't I guess?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I hate, hate, hate being left out. Whether it's not being picked for a team, or being picked for a team and showing up and realizing the team doesn't exist. Or that the sport doesn't exist? I should've known. Poopball?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to Maurie, the Asian intern] Man, I know how you feel. Third wheel. I have been the third wheel so many times in my life. My mom told me something once that made me feel a lot better. She said "The third wheel is what makes it a tricycle."

scenes.speaker: Maurie
scenes.line: What are you talking about?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm talking about your group date with Megan and Eric.

scenes.speaker: Maurie
scenes.line: At Tink's?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes

scenes.speaker: Maurie
scenes.line: How'd you know about that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well…

scenes.speaker: Maurie
scenes.line: Did Stanley tell you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [confused] Stanley was on your group date?

scenes.speaker: Maurie
scenes.line: No, Stanley was with his wife. I waved at him, but he didn't wave back.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughs] Does anybody else know about this?

scenes.speaker: Maurie
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughs, looks to camera excitedly]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There he goes. There he goes. [Stanley gets up from his desk, walks into kitchen area]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So, what is the scuttlebutt? Anybody hear anything?

scenes.speaker: Dwight, Jim, & Pam
scenes.line: [stare blankly at Michael]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nothing? Well I got a little somethin' somethin'. I don't know if I should say…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Just keep it to yourself then.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stanly is having a midlife crisis.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Stanley's way past the middle of his life. Especially considEring his height to weight ratio.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well apparently, he and his wife were out dancing at a club for young people.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Teri's out of town, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Who?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Teri, Stanley's wife. She's at an interior decorating expo in Philly. Stanley hates crowds, kids, and music. I think you should check your facts.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [starts to speak, says nothing, walks away]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [entEring break room, to Maurie] You stupid son of a bitch. You set me up.

scenes.speaker: Maurie
scenes.line: What are you talking about?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stanley's wife is out of town.

scenes.speaker: Maurie
scenes.line: He was with somebody.

scenes.speaker: Eric
scenes.line: He was definitely with somebody.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, was he? Well who, his sister?

scenes.speaker: Eric
scenes.line: [chuckles]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [upset] I don't get it!

scenes.speaker: Eric
scenes.line: If that was his sister, then what they were doing was totally illegal.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Drugs?

scenes.speaker: Eric
scenes.line: Making out.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [fumbling for words] Mmm… okay. Uhh… hmm… okay. Never mind. Carry on.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [approaching Kelly's desk, whispEring] Stanley is having an affir.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: WHAT?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am very happy right now. Thrilled perhaps, to be part of the office, to be part of the conversation. When you have somebody's attenton, and their eyes are lighting up because they are very interested in what you have to say, [Michael is seen whispEring to Jim, then Pam] that is a great feeling, and I experienced that firsthand today. It is wonderful to be the center of attention.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [motioning to pad of paper with hangman game, spelling out "S_an_ey is chea_in_ _n _eri] That and that are the same letter.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Q.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No… no. He's holding a pencil. He could be doing a crossword puzzle with that pencil. What's that letter, right there? Same letter here and here. What haven't you guessed?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: T.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: T! Yes! Yes! That is a "T", and there's another one right there. Just sound that out. You're almost there.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [opening blinds as Stanley walks past] Hey, Stanley! Where you goin', big guy? Up to no good?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I'm meeting a client. Do you have a problem with that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no, no. I just had a quick question for you. I'm casting a movie and I'm looking for a woman who can dance, beautiful woman. Do you know anybody?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Goodbye. [walks away]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pays five million dollars. Nudity required.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [approaching Michael] You have to stop this.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [giddy, whispEring] Did you hear Stanley's having an affair?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I did. From you. You gotta stop telling people.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, okay, I get it. You feel out of the loop, and you feel sorry for yourself, and it's really sad because everybody thinks you're a loser…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Do you know if it's true? Do you have any idea? Because you might be ruining his life.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [stares at Jim silently, then walks away]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in parking lot, blocking path of Stanley's car] Stop. Hold up, hold up, hold up! No, no, no. Time to stop being polite and get real. [Stanley honks horn repeatedly] Stanley, are you having an affair?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [as Michael gets in car] That is ridiculous. Of course not, why would you think that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So It's not true. Okay, well… ahhh, those interns, they told me they saw you at a club, and they all said it was you, it was clearly just… racial profiling gossip.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [hits steEring wheel angrily] Damn! I told her it was a stupid idea to go up in that club.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [nodding] So stupid!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: It's just that… Teri's been traveling a lot…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know, I know.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: And it's been lonely.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, I bet.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Cynthia's been keeping me company. She was my nurse, when I was in rehabilitation. We used to go on these long walks on the treadmill… I didn't…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wait, hold, hold, hold… so it IS true?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Yeah, but Michael, I'm going to go break it off. That's where I'm headed right now. I swear.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh my God! Wait a second, do people often say they're going on sales calls and then go someplace else? 'Cause that's not cool.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I just need you to promise not to say a word about this to anyone. Michael, please.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [muttEring] I'm not saying… a damn thing.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I'm counting on you, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [looking afraid] You can count on me.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [sighs]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [entEring kitchen area] Oh, that smells good.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I might have extra, it just depends on how many I eat.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did you hear about Angela? That's pretty weird.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah… what do you mean exactly?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, the fact that she is apparently dating an 81-year-old billionaire. Owns a Quizno's on the turnpike.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Reeeeally.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uh huh. [gestures to Kevin to keep it quiet] Alright?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How do you un-tell something? You can't. You can't put words back in your mouth. What you can do is spread false gossip so that people think that everything that's been said is untrue, including "Stanley is having an affair." It's like the end of Spartacus. I've seen that movie half a dozen times, and I still don't know who the real Spartacus is, and that is what makes that movie a classic whodunit.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Kelly has an eating disorder?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: She always eats my lunch.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Anorexia. She's an anorexatic.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: We should do something.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nothing can be done, we just have to tell everybody and hope for the best I guess.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to Kelly] I'm worried about Erin, because she's not a very good worker. I don't know how long she's gonna last here.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. So… and Andy is gay.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Andy Bernard?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm hmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [whispEring to Meredith] Did you hear Pam is pregnant?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: She's gonna hate being a mom.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [making a cup of tea in kitchen area]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [looks at Andy and giggles]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [still giggling] Tea.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: So?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: You would.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [laughing] I like tea!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [sarcastically] Oh, I bet you like it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hahaha! I like it a lot! I love tea!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Do you like it as much as you like mens' butts?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: WHAT?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Because you're gay.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [serious] Who told you that? Was it Broccoli Rob? Someone from Chi Psi? Or did you run into someone from my high school?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: This is not the first time rumors about me being gay have come up. Twice before, actually. Just a weird coincidence… a little too weird. [chuckles nervously] Almost makes you wonder if it's not a coincidence at all. Whoa! Which it is, of course. [long pause] But it makes you wonder.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [to Oscar in break room] Did you hear the rumor about me? That I'm gay?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [nodding] I did. Yes.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: And?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Do you think it's true? Do you think that I'm… gay?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Are you attracted to other men?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [scoffs and chuckles] No! But, let me kick you a scenario. I'm at a beach cabana, and Brad Pitt approaches. He tries to lean in and kiss me. I would definitely resist, like at first. But if he was persistent, [long pause] I think I might give in a little bit, just to see what it… felt like.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [stares at Andy incredulously]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Would I push him away? How hard? Like, what if he's like really aggressive?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: If you resisted Brad Pitt a little bit, he would still… need to get to you?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It's not real Brad Pitt, this is like, this is my fantasy. Or it's like, not a fantasy, it's just… it's just a scenario.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Wow. I wish… I wish I could help you. I don't… you might be gay. You might be gay.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What exactly is my responsibility here? To comfort insecure heterosexual men? That can't possibly fall to me.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: How far along is Pam?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: A few months, that's why they're rushing the wedding.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [whispEring] Guys, guys… you can't believe everything you hear. Like Stanley, having an affair? That is crazy! It's just… there's no stalking it. It's a weird day for false facts. Let it go.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [with everyone assembled in conference room] Okay everybody, big day. Last day for our interns, a lot of other stuff… who knows what to believe? Dwight, the honors.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [giving envelopes to interns] Present these to the dean for credit. And, as a gift, I've attached my card. Call me any time of the day or night.

scenes.speaker: Eric
scenes.line: Why would we call you at night?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [grabs card from Eric, crumples it, throws it to the ground] Well now you can't call me at all. Problem solved.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to Eric] You're gonna regret that when you find yourself between a moose and her cubs.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Look at the intern to your left. Now to your right. [interns do nothing] One of you will do exceedingly well in business, just unlimited potential. One of you will make a living, and nothing more. And one of you [looks directly at Megan] will make a great mother. It's up to you to choose which you want to be.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [eating cake with Kelly] I am so happy you're eating again.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [mouth full of cake] Me too!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [to Jim] Tuna, how come you never try to set me up?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, I don't really do that. But Pam might have some friends, though.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Women friends?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Not guy friends?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you… interested in her guy friends?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No. I mean, for the record, I prefer women.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: But off the record, I'm kinda confused.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, the evidence is sort of stacked against me, I feel like…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well you gotta figure this out.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, right?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: How?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You gotta have sex with a woman.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Right-o.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And a man.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ohh…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And then compare.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Alright. [looks around uneasily] Well hey…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Congratulations to you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: On what?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [chuckles] Come on… little baby Tuna. Little junior toro.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [looks around room nervously]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [to Pam] Did you know a baby conceived out of wedlock is still a bastard?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Want me to say it again?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Why did that come into your brain?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [grabs Pam by the arm] Can I talk to you for a second?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [whispEring to Pam in corner of room] So, they know.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Who did you tell?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I didn't tell anyone! Who did you tell?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Nobody!

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [approaching Jim and Pam] Hey, did one of you tell Stanley I have asthma? Because I don't, and if it gets out, they won't let me scuba.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: If I can't scuba, then what's this all been about? What am I working toward?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [to Andy] What? You think I'm the voice of the Taco Bell dog?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [to Phyllis and Stanley] What are you guys talking about? I have a daughter. How can I be a virgin?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, has everyone heard a crazy rumor about themselves today?

scenes.speaker: Everyone
scenes.line: [in unison] Yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [entEring conference room] Yeah, yeah… you know what? Let's discredit these rumors.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, sure, but… who's been saying all that stuff?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's not important, Jim, I just think we shouldn't listen to any of that crap.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Sure, but we should get to the bottom of this. Let's pick a rumor and trace it back to the beginning.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I need to do mine first. Who's been saying that there's another person inside of me, working me with controls?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I heard that from… Andy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I heard it from Erin.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I heard it from Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [quietly leaves room]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [approaching Michael at elevators] Michael? [to others] He's over here!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [to Michael] Where are you going?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nowhere.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael… [leads Michael to corner of vestibule, then whispers] You told people I use store-bought manure, when I showed you where my manure comes from. Hmm? Hmm? [Michael looks nervously to camera as elevator doors open]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Don't get on it. [Michael inches toward elevator]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael, don't.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Don't… get… on. Do not.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Stay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Step away.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Come on, boss.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [reluctantly exits elevator]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to everyone, in conference room] Okay, I made it all up.

scenes.speaker: Everyone
scenes.line: [sighs in unison]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Even the fact that I'm gay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [relieved] Yes!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: But guys, I'm a victim here too, okay? People here have been saying that I'm a J. Crew model.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No. We heard that about Jim.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jim? No, no. I spread the rumor that somebody here was a J. Crew model, and I was referring to myself.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: How is that a bad rumor?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because a lot of people think that models, even though they're very attractive, are somewhat vapid. It's set our industry back quite a bit.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Michael, why? Why say all these things? Why make up an eating disorder, Stanley's affair, me being a spokesdog…

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [pissed off] You told everyone I was having an affair?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, okay… here's the thing. There was one true rumor out there today. I didn't want everybody to know what it was. So all of you are off the hook, except for this one person.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Well then, what's the one true rumor?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: We have a right to know.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Michael… am I gay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sighs] The one true rumor, and this is going to ruin this person's life, is that…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [interrupting] That Pam's pregnant.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I knew it!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I knew it! Her breasts were a tiny bit bigger. At first I thought "Oh, she has a new bra with padding." But then I thought "Pam doesn't need padding." It just didn't add up, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Congratulations!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: That's really great, you guys.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Don't vaccinate it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Who's the father?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Jim.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: How far along?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Four months.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Who's the OB/GYN?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Stop. Don't. Just…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright, alright… you know, this is not the truth, and you can't fall on the sword this way. The real thing is that Stanley Hudson had an affair.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nope.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes. Jim…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [arm around Pam] Thank you for trying to defend her. But actually, Pam is pregnant, and we can prove it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: If everyone would like to see proof.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay. [leaves room]

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Are we just gonna wait here? [Pam returns, displays sonogram]

scenes.speaker: Everyone
scenes.line: [gasps, then cheers]

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: It's true!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Look at that! [grabs sonogram from Pam] That is the inside of your vagina! [Jim takes sonogram from Michael]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [talking head with Jim] It's clear why we were trying not to tell people. That's clear now. [Jim nods, looking at floor]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to Jim and Pam] How long have you known about the pregnancy?

scenes.speaker: Jim & Pam
scenes.line: [look at each other uncertainly]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: A week? A month? A year?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael, we only told our parents last week.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did you pee on a stick?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I did. It was inconclusive.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You should've told me.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [exchanges looks with Jim] You're right. We should've realized that you are an equal part of this.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [phone rings, hits speaker button]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Michael, Teri Hudson returning your call.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [gasps]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [in disbelief] You called Stanley's wife?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, oh… yeah, a long time ago, just to make sure she was out of town. Oh… oh God.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Don't take it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, I have to take it, or it'll seem suspicious.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: If you talk to her, you're gonna tell her about Stanley, and that's gonna seem more suspicious.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, I can do this.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You can't do this.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, I can. I am going to tell her that I need to redecorate my condo, and I need her help. We will haggle about money, and then I will back down, and then I won't talk to her until this whole Cynthia thing has blown over.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That sounds terrible.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael, please don't.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [picking up phone] Hey, what up, Cynthia? [lowers phone, looking terrified]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [gets up to leave room, Michael gestures for him to stay]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hold on a second, Cynthia.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [hangs up Michael's phone, leaves room]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, it turns out that Teri was already suspicious, because she had caught Stanley and Cynthia a few months ago. So Stanley promised that he would stop, and he did, end of story. Well, not exactly. [camera pans down from Michael's office window to parking lot below, Stanley is seen destroying Michael's Sebring with a crowbar] Uhh, Cynthia kept calling him, she would not stop calling him, and she was in love with him. Oh, and get this. Cynthia, also married. So… you can't stop love, I guess [Jim is seen displaying fetus picture on his desk as Pam smiles] and quite frankly, I don't think you should ever try.

scenes.speaker: Maurie
scenes.line: [talking head with Eric and Megan] I learned that a company can describe their internship as "full of exciting experiences," even if that's a lie. There's no regulation.

scenes.speaker: Megan
scenes.line: I learned that half these people's email password is "password."

scenes.speaker: Eric
scenes.line: I learned that a ream of paper is 300 sheets.

scenes.speaker: Megan
scenes.line: I thought it was 500.

scenes.speaker: Eric
scenes.line: Oh… I guess I didn't learn anything.

scenes.speaker: Maurie
scenes.line: I learned that if you look even the tiniest bit like Jet Li, Michael will call you "Jet Li" all summer.

scenes.speaker: Megan
scenes.line: [raises hand] Julia Stiles.

scenes.speaker: Eric
scenes.line: [raises hand] Alan Thicke.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [knock at Michael's Office door] Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You wanted to see me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, Oscar come on in. Close the door if you would. Thank you, thanks so much for talking to me.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Yeah sure.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm going in for a procedure today.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Is everything okay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, it's routine. I'm just a little bit scared.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I'm sure everything will be fine. [pulls up a chair] What do you? What's the procedure, if you don't mind my asking?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is a colonoscopy.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: In your experience, what should I be expecting in terms of sensation or emotions? [Oscar looks irritated and frustrated] Is there anything I can do to make it more pleasurable for me or for Dr. Shaundry?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [sighs] Oh my God.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: My main concern, should I have a safe word?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Yeah. [Oscar gets up and walks out]

scenes.speaker: David Wallace
scenes.line: So Michael, do you think you can give me a run down on the Buffalo clients by Monday?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Abso… you know what? I'll do you one better, Sunday, Sunday night.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay, I will look at it Monday.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ho, Hol, hold on big guy, I'm gonna put it in the mail Sunday night and you'll get it Weds.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Okay, Jim you wanna hit the conference room?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sure.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, Good luck.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh right, this thing. I remember now. [whispers to Jim] What's this about?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ah, this is just me and David, if that's okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's okay with me but he's gonna want me in there.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: No, ah it's okay Michael. We got it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright, do you mind if it sit this out? I have so much work to do, I feel like I'm gonna blow my brains out.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: [nods] Okay. [Jim smiles and waves to Pam]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Am I worried that Jim and David are having a meeting without me? No, because we are the Three Amigos. And once in awhile one of the Amigos will go off… to the bathroom… while the other two have a secret meeting. [shrugs]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey let me escort you to your desk.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, it's just three or four steps but thank you, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You and Jim are close, huh?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, I think the pregnancy really brought us together.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, what do you think he and David are talking about? What do you…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ummm, I don't know.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, you said good luck to Jim as he walked in.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Did I? Doesn't sound like me, not very superstitious.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: If you are lying to me right now Pam, your baby is gonna come out a liar. That's how it works. They inherit things through the breast milk.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Please don't talk about my breast milk.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I just don't want you to lie to me. I don't want you to ever lie to me. Have I ever lied to you?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I just don't want you to.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I was rushing to fill an order. I put the ladder up to grab a box of three hole from the top shelf. Next thing I know, I'm on the ground and the ladder's on top of me.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: And that's how you broke your ankle?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hmmm, interesting. How did the ladder end up on top of you, if you fell off of it?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: This doesn't concern you man, you need to walk away.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh really, I'm sorry I thought this was a free country. I didn't know we were in communist Sweden.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: If we were living in Sweden, I wouldn't have to worry about this 'cause we'd have universal healthcare.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Nnnnn, that's not… okay.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Be quiet.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm talking about… hmmm.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I will send this off to corporate. Make sure you hold on to your medical bills. Feel better.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Thanks T-Man, later. [fist bumps Toby}

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: So long Darryl, feel better… [to Toby] He's lying.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: He has a doctor's note.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh? From who, Dr. J? Look, you really need to investigate this. People don't just fall off of ladders.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: A guy on my street fell off a ladder painting his house. It was on the news.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Since when have you known Darryl to rush to do anything other than to come up here for birthday cake? [imitating Darryl] Y'all having birthday cake?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: That's not a very good Darryl.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Please… and how many foremen do you know that pull boxes?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hmmm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It just doesn't add up.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, we did a little investigation and Dwight had a good point. The ladder didn't reach the top shelf. I don't know if I believe it, but I am a fan of the hardboiled detective novel. [impression] I'll punch you in da mush, see.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [walks into conference room on his cell phone, interrupting David and Jim] Uh huh, well if he doesn't like it you can tell that SOB that he is fired. Sorry, I'm going into a meeting right now. I will… I love you too. Bye.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Who was that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sorry about that. What'd I miss?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Michael, we would like to continue the rest of this meeting in private, please, if you don't mind.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do not mind! Yes, I do! No, I don't. Yes, I do! No, I don't mind. Catch you guys on the flippity flop. Oh this… call waiting. [answers his phone] Yeah, uh huh, well you tell the Mayor he just lost six votes.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [spying on David and Jim] They've been in there a while.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Can't be good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nope.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Think they're talking about me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, I think they're talking about me.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Yeah, that makes way more sense. Okay thanks boss.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What is Jim telling him? That I can't handle this job? That 's bull crap. That is bull crap. Although, it has been chaotic lately. Corporate shut down the Buffalo branch which left us to absorb all of their clients. I will tell you there has been work everyday. Had to come in on a Saturday. To retrieve… I left my cell phone here.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey Kelly.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Ugh, so jealous of your boobs.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank you. Um, listen I just wanted to confirm that you're not coming to the wedding, which is totally understandable and more than fine.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Is Ryan going?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't know, he hasn't RSVP'd yet.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We invited everyone in the office to our wedding. Even though we realized most people wouldn't be able to make the drive to Niagara Falls. [whispers] Which is why we're having it in Niagara Falls. [normal volume] Then Michael told everyone they could have Friday and Monday off, if they came. So now, people have to decide if they want to come to our wedding or have to work.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Here's the deal. I really want to go but I'm not gonna go if Ryan doesn't go, because it's kind of a waste of time. That came out wrong. It would awesome if you could try to get him to go because I'd really like to be there to support Jim.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What can I do for ya Hoss?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [staring into the conference room] How are your sales doin'?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: How are my sales doin'? Busted. My numbers are down a little bit and it's 'cause of the economy. You're not buying it, you're good. Okay the truth is, I have been having trouble focusing lately. I'm in this weird, flirty, nebulous thing with this cousin of mine and it's a total mind effer.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Again with the cousin.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, I'm sorry Phyllis, you explain this email, okay. "Hey Andy let's go visit grandma and then get drunk together, ha ha."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Shhh, I'm just trying to figure out what's going on in that room, okay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wallace had to show up on the one four month period that I'm completely overwhelmed.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know when they say it's so crazy it just might work? Well, I don't believe that. I say go for the air-tight plan and that is why I am having Andy wheel me into the conference room inside a makeshift cheese cart. It is just elegant.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in the cheese cart] Be my eyes.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You got it.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: What have we here?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, just backing up and turning around.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hey, we're gonna do this…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Dit, dit, dit, dit, it's not for you. [enters the conference room] Pardon moi, Messieurs. I took the liberty of preparing for you a cheese platter which I will place here on the eastern wall of the conference room.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Cheese platter?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oui, Oui, Monsieur. From the Wisconsin region, a nice firm cheddar. Also from the great state of Wisconsin, an aged parmesan. Here you will find a cheddar style spread which has reacted nicely with the air to form a light rind which I think you'll find both challenging and delicious. At that point, I would recommend you take a trip south of the border to the great state of Illinois where you will find this fine Bleu Cheese dressing. If I may be so bold, it's a lot of fun to let the goldfish take a little swim in the bleu cheese. Bon appetit.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Alright, well I should go. Thanks for this. You've given me a lot to think about. Please promise me you won't do anything until we speak.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, I won't. Alright, thanks for giving me your time, I appreciate it.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Thank you Jim.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Erin, is Michael around?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I think he's around here…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [crawls out of the cheese cart unseen] Hey, hey, you must have walked right past me. How you doin'?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Ah, yeah, could we talk in your office for a second?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, definitely.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [spying at Darryl's house] Sounds like a EMDP-40.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Nah, that's a GE. A P40 is much higher pitched.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You're into trains?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I have been my whole life.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Wow.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm rebuilding a turn of the century steam engine in my slaughter house.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: That's so cool.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Wow, I'd love to take a look at that.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, it's just a run of the mill slaughter house, but sure anytime.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, you know, 'cause of the trains.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wa… wa… wait , someone's coming.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Uhh, oh boy, oh boy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Here, get down! He's not using crutches! Get the camera!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Get over there! Get over there!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, worker's comp, my ass!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I can't believe this. [mistaking Darryl's sister for Darryl] Hey you, ass****!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Toby…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You gonna eat all that dog food yourself?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ooohhh… [crashes car into garbage cans] Oh man! You okay?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Just keep going.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey Ryan.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So, I just wanted to confirm that you're not coming to my wedding.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah, I might stop by.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It costs about $75 per person.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Okay, I once had a glass of Cognac that cost $77.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Can you just tell me now if you're coming or not?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yes, I'm coming to your wedding.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, Ryan Howard, yes.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Probably, yes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Kelly Kapoor, yes.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Are you sure you're okay with these new responsibilites?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Look who you're talking to.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I'm just trying to figure out the best way to utilize everyone's talents.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well I would say that my greatest talent is being the best man, woman, or child, to have ever run this branch, ever.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: What about Jim? Do you think Jim is someone who is ready to move into a management position?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [looks at Jim] Permission to speak on the record?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Please do.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jim is like Big Bird. He is tall and yellow and very nice. But would I put him in charge? No, I don't think so. Because Big Bird doesn't make the tough decisions. I… If I was gonna put someone in charge, I would put Burt in charge or I would put one of the real grown-ups in charge, like Maria or Gordon, maybe.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: I thought you liked Jim?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Very much, Jim is my best friend. But it's his performance report… right here. Now this was written by Toby, who we all know is extremely reliable.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: [reading performance report] "Constant office distractions, spends way too much time at reception, antagonizes other salesman, not at all what he thinks he is."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's not very well written, but you get the gist.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Is there anybody else you think could run the day to day of the branch?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I can just continue to run it myself.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Jim had an interesting idea to help you with this extra work load and it involved you being promoted to oversee all northeast sales and then Jim would be promoted to your position.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This was Jim's idea?

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Mmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow. Ummm, well I'd have to talk to my mother and my guy at H and R Block.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Ummm… okay, here's the thing though. The plan doesn't work unless we have someone to replace you. I was hoping… plus we have to worry about Jim, he has another job offer. We may have to replace him.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I didn't tell Michael because I thought he'd try to help. Example, he handed out Jello shots at the 23rd mile of the Steamtown marathon.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Jim can you walk me out to my car for a second.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sure.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [after talking to David, Jim looks dejected] I can't help but feel partially responsible.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [shakes jelly beans] Little pick me up? [Jim accepts] Oh those are the best. Little sugar rush.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: When you were in the office earlier talking to Wallace, did I come up at all?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well we did talk about how handsome you are.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Why don't we head in your office to talk?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh what a week, God. We said… I know there were certain things we said…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael, look I'll just be honest with you. Earlier today I spoke with Wallace about a promotion. I actually think that talk went really well. And then after he spoke with you, for some reason it felt like things had changed.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmmm, that's weird, that's weird… it's kinda weirding me out. Did you know that Lincoln's secretary was named Kennedy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael, did you say anything?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Tell you what, when you leave this office I am going to call Wallace and I am going to tell him that you should get that promotion.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You will? Wanna do it right now?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I tried to keep Michael in the dark. I should have known that he can do just as much damage in the dark.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I need to see your pupils. I need to see if they're dilated.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: If they were dilated…

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Toby! Dwight! Is that them?

scenes.speaker: Gwenneth
scenes.line: Definitely.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You come to my house, bust up my trash cans, call my baby sister an ass****, and told her to eat dog food.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We thought that she was you.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Why would you think a lady is me?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Are you… are you serious? Be… cause you look exactly alike. Am I the only one? Are you getting this?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: No, nah. I don't see it.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Here's what I'm gonna do, I'm calling corporate and I'm filing a complaint against both of you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Aww, Darryl.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: C'mon Gwenneth.

scenes.speaker: Gwenneth
scenes.line: Sad.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: [on phone] This is David.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey David, this is Michael Scott. [Jim pushes speaker phone button] Michael Scott here.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just wanted to talk to you about Jim Halpert. I understand that he did not receive the promotion. And I wanted to see what I could do to nudge you in the right direction.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: So, what, you're changing your mind about Jim?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Absolutely, [turns speakerphone off] not. [turns speakerphone back on] Like I said before, Jim is fantastic and he deserves this job.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Michael, it seems like you're cutting in and out… This is not what you said earlier.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wha… here's the thing, Jim is the best man for this job, I think you should give it to him.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Well, it doesn't change what you showed me in Jim's file.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, nnnn, that… that was an anomaly. That file had been falsified. Toby Flenderson is doing drugs.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Michael, I really don't know what's going on [police sirens in background] down there, but… oh, dammit, I am getting pulled over for talking on my cell, dammit.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey Darryl, look ahhh, we're here to apologize ahh…

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Cool.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wait! They're using the lift as their own personal elevator.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: He broke his ankle climbing over the railing and he lied about it because it was a misuse of company equipment, case closed.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Stupidest thing I've ever heard.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Really? Then why is there new wood only on one railing? Hmmm? We should check the security tapes Toby.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, I don't think there's any reason to check 'em but I suppose if we wanted to be really certain…

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Alright, yeah fine so whatever…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You really did it…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Now, I would like to file an official complaint to corporate because Darryl lied on an official form.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: And I'm telling them you guys sexually harassed my sister.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Phhhht. No judge is gonna believe that…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Ahhh, kay. Look, we could all file complaints against each other and just drown in a sea of paperwork, but you know, we can just move on with our… with our lives.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: So Dwight and Darryl came to an agreement that both would file complaints with corporate and now I get to do all this paperwork. We worked it out.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, hey Jim, it would make me feel really good right now if you would just punch me in the face. Alright, Just do it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: How many times have I asked you to put me up for a branch manager job.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I never recommended you because I didn't want to lose you and I didn't want to lose Pam, [starts to choke up] and now I don't wanna lose the baby.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So instead, you screwed me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's what she…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: David Wallace is calling.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Kind of in the middle of something here.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Should I tell him you'll call him back?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I, yeah… no, I'll tell him myself. Let's both.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [on phone] Hello.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Hey Michael, you got Jim there with you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, it's just us.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Actually, can you call Jim in? I want him on, please.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, oh, well here he is right now. [Michael knocks on desk] Come in. [Makes sound effects for door opening and footsteps and points to Jim to answer]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hi David.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Hey guys, so I spoke to Alan, we had kind of an unconventional idea, which I think is pretty cool. But it only works if everyone's on board.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well just as long as it means Jim becomes a manager.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: We were thinking of having two branch managers in Scranton. Both of you guys working as co-managers. Jim would handle the day to day and Michael you would focus on clients and big picture stuff.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow, that sounds pretty cool.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I like that, so manager and co-manager.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Co-manager and Co-manager. See, there are a lot of moving pieces and this is the only way I can sell it upstairs.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well that might be a little confusing for people because they know me as manager.

scenes.speaker: David
scenes.line: Alright, hey Michael can you pick up for one second. [Michael picks up phone] Okay look, I'm not going to force you into anything. If you're willing to lose Jim, fine, you just say so and we'll find another solution, okay. Is that what you want to do?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay people, listen up, I have an announcement to make, fraud was committed…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay everybody, I have an announcement to make… whoa do you have an announcement?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm… I was making it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Everybody, David Wallace and I have talked and we have decided to promote Jim to the position of co-manager.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Co-manager of what?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Of your butt, and your butt, and your butt, all of the Scranton branch butts.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What's happening to you Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What's happening to me? I am also being promoted to co-manager, we will be co-managers together. Jim Halpert, welcome.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [shakes Michael's hand] Thank you. [Dwight looks disappointed and angry behind them]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: AHHHHHHHHHHHH!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Niagara Falls in October? Pfft, hells yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Do you think that you could send in your RSVP card?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Nah, I'll just tell you now, easier.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, you have to choose a food option and there's information in there about directions and lodging…

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I'll just have whatever's fanciest, unless there's ribs. I'll just get the other information the day of, I'll text you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You are going to text me, the morning of my wedding.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Uh huh.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: To ask for directions…

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Right…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: And you will eat whatever is fanciest?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Unless there's ribs. [leaves]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Rude.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So rude, right?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Mmm hmmm.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [sits down] Oh my gosh, I have been chasing people down all day. It's incredible.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Pam, my bag was there…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [in Michael's office] Could you please sign my expense report?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No way, no how. Expense reports are a day-to-day item. That is Jim's now. I am exclusively big picture, epic.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [in Jim's office] Sign this.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ah, ah, ah. Where's the "please"? We're not animals.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Sign it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, not without a "please."

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Idiot.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [in Michael's office] I have a complaint about Jim.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That is not big picture.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I would like to file a huge, enormous, massive complaint about the tallest guy in our office.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: … Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jim won't sign my expense report.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That is not– okay– that is day-to-day.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, that is huge.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're trying to trick me.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: This has to do–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Get out, get out, get out, get out, get out.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [in Jim's office] I'd like to lodge a complaint.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm sorry to hear about that. Who is this about?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. Just want to let you know I take complaints very seriously. So… When did this happen?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: One minute ago.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. And how do you feel?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Angry.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right. Did he hit you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Did you cry?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Did you feel like crying?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm just gonna write "held back tears."

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wait, stop writing that. That is not true.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: If you stop crying, I'll stop writing it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm not cr– uhh!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I deserved that promotion, not Jim. Oh, man. Makes me want to put him in a triangle choke hold and force him down to the ground and just keep pressing and pressing. And then flip him over and then put him in a hammer lock! And he's gasping, he's panting! Every last breath! And the crowd is going crazy. And boom! I emerge victorious! [claps hands and stands up] Aha! $18,000 and a chance at the title! Ooh hah!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [at the door] Dwight, Jim wants you to keep it down.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Everyone, now would be a good time to freshen up, because I'd like everyone to meet in the conference room in five minutes. And I suggest that you bring a snack, because we may be in there for a while.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Can I talk to you in my office for a second?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmm, sure, but could I first talk to you in my office?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Can I also be a boss?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Look, it doesn't take a genius to know that any organization thrives when it has two leaders. Go ahead, name a country that doesn't have two presidents. A boat that sets sail without two captains. Where would Catholicism be without the popes?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I have noticed that we–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Welcome.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thank you. I've noticed we've been having a lot of conference room meetings.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And I'm wondEring if perhaps those are a bit, um–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Disruptive.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, I don't think they are. I think the meetings are very important.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, maybe we should talk specifics.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Let's do.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. Yesterday, we had a meeting about planets.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: N– well, to be fair, Jim… James… Jimothy… To be fair, Jimothy, the– ah, that sounds weird. Are you okay with being called Jim?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I am.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright. Jim, to be fair, the conversation wasn't about planets…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: At first, we were talking about introducing a line of toilet paper. And what part of the human body does one use toilet paper upon? So you draw a line from there to the other planets, and I think by the end, we all learned a little bit about how small we are.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes, I agree.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because it's a big universe, and we're all just little, tiny specks of dust.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I just think that maybe they're eating large amounts of the day.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what eats a large amount of the day are naps. You go to sleep, it's light out, you wake up, it's dark. That's the whole day. Where did that day go? I have no idea.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You mean on a weekend?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: How about this? I think our goal should be we don't have meetings unless they're absolutely essential.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright. No more meetings this week.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really? You just agreed to that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I can be very suprising.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What's going on?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I need to fit into my wedding dress. However, I'm also pregnant.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: You know, it's a myth that women have to gain more than nine pounds in a pregnancy. Look at these actresses. Some of them lose weight.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hey, did you guys register for wedding gifts?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We did, but mostly because people expect us to. We're also accepting other gifts not on the registry… However much.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's awkward asking people for money, but we could really use it. Why doesn't Crate & Barrel let you register for a toaster full of cash?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Perfect. I hate registries.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, good.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: My cousin makes the most amazing romantic birdhouse mailboxes. I know I shouldn't tell you, but you'll still be suprised when you see it. You're not registered for a birdhouse, are you?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, we're not.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Good. Good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm-hmm?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [walks in, see's Oscar, Stanley, Creed and Kelly sitting in Michaels office] Okay, I thought I saw people missing.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, just focus-grouping a product expansion idea to these folks. Got one of each.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really? Hey, Stanley, what was the last thing Michael said before I came through the door?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stanley, you don't need to answer that.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Stanley?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: "If you don't smell this, you're fired."

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, Michael, I thought we agreed to not take up people's time with meetings like these.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What do you mean by "these people"?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael, this is a conference room meeting.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, hey, everybody, I think that Jim has gone insane, because he thinks that my office is a conference room.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's not what I meant.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Listen, Jim, no offense, but when push comes to shove, what I want is more important that what you want.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I disagree.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What do you guys think? [all start talking at the same time]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Great. Guys, can I just have a moment alone with Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no, you don't need to go anywhere. Anything that Jim has to say to me, he can say in front of these types of people.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That is not what I said, and, also, I am co-manager, meaning you are not the only manager anymore. I am also I co-manager.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That is not what Wallace told us.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's exactly what Wallace told us.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That is not the way I heard it.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I love rivalries– Michael or Jim, Paris or Nicole, Heidi or L.C. It's so much fun. But I guess if I'm really thinking about it and answEring your question honestly, I'd have to go with L.C. Heidi's a bad friend, and her skin is terrible.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is one thing, me giving you the co-manager title. It is another thing, you bossing me around.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm not bossing you around. I'm trying to do my job, which is sharing your job, so maybe we should just call David Wallace.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no. No, we will not call David Wallace. [Michael pulls out his cell phone] I will call David Wallace.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: David Wallace is on line two for you guys.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Or David Wallace will call us on line two. Why don't we just–

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, David. You got Jim here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey David, this is Michael, senior co-manager.

scenes.speaker: David Wallace
scenes.line: Hey guys, um, I'm calling, because, unfortunately, we will not be able to give out cost of living raises this year, and I know people expect it. However, there just is only a small amount of money for each branch, so we're leaving it up to the managers to decide how to distribute it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Got it, Dave. Sounds like your classice big-picture decision.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Which will clearly affect the day-to-day well-being of our employees.

scenes.speaker: David Wallace
scenes.line: It's probably a little of both.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Which is it more of?

scenes.speaker: David Wallace
scenes.line: Excuse me?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: David, I know that I'm very new at this, but I have a very good perspective on how things work.

scenes.speaker: David Wallace
scenes.line: Wait, I'm sorry. Michael, are you– are you texting me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I thought maybe we could talk after this is over.

scenes.speaker: David Wallace
scenes.line: Look, I need you both to take care of this. This is not going to be a problem, is it?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nope, not at all.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, it will not be. I am on top of it.

scenes.speaker: David Wallace
scenes.line: Very good.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright, thanks alot, David.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Talk to you later– [Jim hangs up] Okay, you didn't let me say good-bye. [sighs, and claps hands once] Alright, I am looking forward to this.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You don't have to lie.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I hate the fact that we have to do this together. I think we work better separately. When I am irritated and I look at you, I don't see you anymore.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All I can see is how big and gross the pores on your nose are.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright. Let's get started.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Hey, why haven't we ever, um…

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: We have.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know, there's no easy way to do this. I say we add 1.5% to their paychecks and don't say anything about it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Do you mean, like break-in in the middle of the night and change the numbers on payroll?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, we can do it during the day. It doesn't have to be that dramatic, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. You know what would help is a pros and cons list for our options.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jim, don't take this the wrong way. Are you gonna take this the wrong way?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's hard to tell so far.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You use your brain too much.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm sorry, are you advocating that I use it less?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sometimes the smartest people don't think at all.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You just came up with that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: As I was saying it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. Okay, so for the 1.5% increase, pro– everyone gets a little bit.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in nerdy voice] Con– you look like a nerd.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Con– no one gets as much as they did last year.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pro– you get to share your pros and cons list with the other nerds.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pro– no favoritism.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Con– you unzip your pants, and you find that there's a calculator down there.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I've been studying Michael for years, and I've condensed what I've learned into this chart– [pulls out a pie chart] How Michael spends his time. As you can see, we have procrastinating and distracting others, and this tiny sliver here is critical thinking. I made it bigger, so that you could see it.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hey, Pam, I heard that you were registered, but I didn't hear where.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't think we registered anywhere. We just want cash.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Like money? Like you– you want my money?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Will you take a check?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Cool. In the memo line, I'm gonna write, "To love's eternal glory."

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Wait til' Monday.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Is this what I've become? Materialistic? Shallow? I feel horrible. [looks down at the check] oh look! "Mrs. Pam Halpert!" That's the first time I've seen it in writing!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know, the more I think about it, the more I think we should give it to the salesmen.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That will not go over well.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I know. I just think it seems smart to keep the salesmen happy right now. 'Course I know that this might come off as biased, so you know what? Let us…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, my God! Are you gonna make another pro and con list? I'm gonna kill myself.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm not gonna let you stop me from thinking.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No! I could not do that, Jim. I can see it in your crusty little eyes that you are going to make everything perfect. If I can just think this through, if I could just think it exactly right, I can make this perfect, and then I can go down every avenue, and every avenue off of that avenue, and then another avenue.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And then another–

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Look, you have a lot of strengths.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, I do?! Tell me what they are.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think that you are able to take constructive criticism very well.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ha! That– I am not known for that!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: But there is a reason why I'm here!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes! You went over my head to Wallace!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, it's because you also have a lot of weaknesses, Michael!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. Well, why don't you tell me what those are, Jim? Why don't you enliven me?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I don't think you're good at making tough decisions!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: At thinking out the options, and then stating that decision very clearly, especially when it's an unpopular decision.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, here's a tough decision for you. You suck! You suck! Is that clear enough for you?!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: But maybe I'm here for a reason, because I might have some good ideas, too. I've been sitting out there, and I've been learning a lot, and maybe I can just bring something different to the table.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, Skippy, here we go. Why don't you run yourself out there and tell them? [laughs] You call it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [leave the conference room to address everyone]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to the camera] This had better be terrible.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Could I have everyone's attention, please? I have some tough news, so I'm just gonna give it to you straight. Truth is, we only have so much money for raises this year, so the simple fact is some people will get raises, and some people won't. Now, what we've decided is, we are gonna give those raises to the sales staff.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Wait. Seriously?!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Look, you guys are smart, so I'm just leveling with you. I'm just trying to treat you like adults.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Thank you, Jim, for thinking that we're smart people.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: But, I do not understand. If we're such smart adults, then why don't we get raises?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Excellent question, genius. It's because Jim wants to give the raises to his friends and the people he sleeps with.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ooh, easy. That's not it at all.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Well?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really what it is, is about the money the sales staff brings into the office.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [walks in from shopping, with bags in her hands] What's going on?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Jim is only giving raises to the salesmen.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: What the hell?! Why are you being such a jerk?!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Hold on, Kelly. Would it help you to know that Jim thinks you're smart?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: No! [put's down her bags] How is that gonna repair Ryan's car?!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: This is ridiculous! How could he do this to us?!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, Dwight, you know what? You'd be getting the raise so–

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What about all these people, huh?! How is it fair to them?!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Exactly!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Totally!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: We work just as hard as the sales people. We deserve raises.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yes. They don't get 'em, if we don't get 'em!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: My kid needs shoes! You want to tell him he doesn't get shoes?!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Her kid needs shoes, Jim!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: What the hell?! [everyone complaining at Jim]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow! I'm just gonna rewind and back off a bit, so… [imitates a tape rewinding and chuckles, Michael comes over by Jim laughing]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That was good! That was good! Okay, all right. Well, we all know it's hard to be a boss, right? You know what? Look around you. These are your best friends. These are the people who will open their hearts to you. They all have heart-ons for you [someone growns in disgust], and that is a gift. So in terms of gifts, we should be giving each other gifts. Angela, yes, lend Oscar a cup of sugar. This–

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: What are you talking about Michael?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: We just need to hear your plan for our raise.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: My plan– a man– panama.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That's not how that goes.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: You're not saying anything. At least Jim was being direct…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thank you, Meredith.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: …when he was telling us his dumbass plan.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: We would just like to know what's happening. Are we getting a raise, yes or no?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright! Let me get this clear! Does everybody want a raise? [all say yes] Alright, everyone wants a raise, so what we're going to do is go into here, and we will not come out until we do.
