scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Again, that gives us no information.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: This isn't a game, you know? It's our livelihood!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What about a raise based on merit?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Rank each person individually?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm-hmm. Piece of cake. Ryan, obviously the best.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [sarcastically] Well, obviously. Too bad he's a temp and doesn't count, so let's get started. [starts to write on a piece of paper]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Are you making a–

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nope. I'm numbEring the paper.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [everyone talking to the camera] Just–

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah, I don't understand how they can even consider giving money to some people and not the rest of us.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It's not like we're not gonna see the checks. We're in accounting!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I am so pissed at this company!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [out the side of his mouth] And Jim!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Yeah. Who said that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I think it was Creed.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to camera] It's going really well, actually.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to camera, holds up a bean] Each Boston Baked Bean represents half a percent raise. We each got 24 beans, so the idea is, you place the bean on the picture [walking around the table] of who you think deserv– who's that? [picture that Michael drew of toby, looks like a monster]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Toby.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He's not a part of this. You know that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just wanted to draw a picture of him.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, your move.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright! Who to pick? [walking around the table] Who to pick?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Here we go.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I… will skip a turn.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, you're gonna still have to play that bean. You know that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I need more time.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Wallace sent an e-mail about a meeting next week. He wants you both to respond. [Michael and Jim leave, Dwight sneaks in]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: People are starting to notice how terrible Jim is. It's great. Eventually, they'll rise up and revolt. My only hope is that they do it sooner rather than later. If the people here were our founding fathers, the Revolutionary War would have been delayed ten years, because Stanley Washington was napping, and Phyllis Hancock was still signing the declaration, and Kevin Jefferson was distracted by a butterfly.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Come on in. [everyone looking around at all the pictures and beans on the table] That's right. Come in, feast your eyes. They determine our worth by putting beans upon our faces.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What the hell?!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Things were not this bad when just Michael was manager.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, what are you guys doing in here?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: What does a bean mean?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Why aren't there any beans on this very old, frizzy-haired picture of me?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Michael, what does a bean mean?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Jim?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I was just trying to be unbiased.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: What does a bean mean?!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Someone please explain it to Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Why can't you? My time is just as valuable as yours.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Not according to the beans.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: This is how you make this important decision?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: There's no way that Stanley gets more beans than me. [starts to take Stanley's beans, Stanley swats Andy's hand with his crossword puzzle] That is ridiculous. This is how it works. [everyone continues to argue]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: It's not so much that I might not get a raise. It's just demeaning!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Thank you! That is exactly– by the way, I would also like a raise.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah, I would, too.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Are we idiots? [gets up, starts walking around] What right does Jim have to claim authority, hmm? Is he as good a salesman as I? Is he as matronly as Phyllis? There are moments where we can affect change. For a few seconds every decade, we exist, and these are those seconds! Let us storm his castle! Come on! Tick– let's get him. Tock– let's get Jim! Tick– and drag Jim out of his office! Tock– take his keys away from him! Tick– that's a clock! The time is getting very close! It's now or never! What say you?!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I say no.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, I mean, what do you say to my plan? [all groan] Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [leaving his office, hurrying to Jim's office]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: What does a bean mean?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in Jim's office] How you doing?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, on a scale of one to ten, I'd say I'm about a four.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, what are you usually?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Six. You?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Usually a ten, but I'm feeling like a zero.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I mean, a performance-based raise sounded like a good idea, right?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know, I know.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We tried to find the fairest way to do it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, we did.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I just– what?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um, nothing. I just… I used to have to do this part alone, and it was the worst. I have something I would like to give you. [leaves office]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Michael!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Michael!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Come on! This isn't fair!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to camera] Michael's my only friend left in the office. Except Pam… I think. Is she still upset?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [at Michael return to Jim's office] Michael, you cannot just keep avoiding us like this!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Michael give Jim a "World's Best Boss" mug] Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're welcome.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What's in here?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Gin. [toast, sip]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ooh!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [someone knocks] Just pretend we're not here.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Heard you guys are looking for cash for the wedding?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, I mean, if it's all the same for you.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Question for you. Would you guys rather have $100 now, or $5,000 a year from now?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: $100 now for sure.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Because you just give me $50 to cover the broker fee, I put in a hundred of my own money as the gift…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah. No, no, I'll um– the hundred. I'll just take the hundred.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Instead of $5,000 a year from now?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How sure is this?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: The guy has an algorithm to determine the winner of any given college basketball game.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm sorry. You guys have probably noticed my stomach's a little more sensitive lately. So, if you wouldn't mind wearing a little less perfume… and if your lunch is especially pungent, maybe have it in the break room?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We would really appreciate it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Pam is constantly throwing up because of the pregnancy. If she eats something the fetus doesn't like she is screwed. It's amazing. A three ounce fetus is calling the shots. It's so bad ass.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Phyllis, if you could switch to a different soap, just for a month or two? Yours is kind of perfumy.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Now this is getting ridiculous.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, gee, I'm sorry. I guess I missed the meeting where we all all voted for you to get pregnant. No! I reserve the right to peel my hard-boiled eggs at my desk.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: All morning I look forward to my afternoon cigars and I'm not stopping for anyone.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't think I'm asking for too much. I guess it's just the end of courtesy in the workplace.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [Dwight peels a hard-boiled egg at his desk, sniffs it and takes a bite; Pam stares at him, picks up her trash can and pukes into it] Watching people get sick always makes me sick. And… frankly so does talking about it. So… wow… [Andy, Phyllis, Meredith, Erin, Oscar and Angela all proceed to throw up in various places while Creed looks on eating a bowl of noodles; Dwight stares shocked; Pam wipes her mouth with a satisfied look]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [standing next to a car decorated for leaving a wedding] What do you think? I spent all morning on it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It is really special.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, but aren't you supposed to do that to our… no. It's great.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's just a really important day for me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, congrats.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Dunder Mifflin Scranton will be closed today and Friday for a company wedding in Niagara Falls. So, please leave a message and we'll get back to you as soon as possible. Have a great day.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Believe it or not, Kevin, fire crackers are in the don't column.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: So… you're going to provide them, then?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. This is a fire cracker free wedding.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: What the hell?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Come on. You've got to be kidding me.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ok. All of these things are important to remember but the most important thing is no one say anything about my pregnancy at the wedding.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Absolutely. 'Cause not everyone knows and some people may be offended.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Decent people everywhere will get offended.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, we're thinking of my grandmother who we haven't told and is very old-fashioned.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Well, you're lucky you have a grandmother. Some of us have to be our own grandmothers.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's nice.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You know, Angela, you don't have to come to the wedding.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Really, Pam…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes she does. Yes she does. We're all gonna go and we're gonna have a good time. [hugs Angela]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Ow! He pinched me!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Next time we're all in this room Jim and I will be married.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We'll see.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank you, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Good-bye.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: See you later. [others say good-bye]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And, hey, don't embarrass me when we go to Niagara.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What happens in Niagara, stays in Niagara. [laughter]

scenes.speaker: Michael

scenes.line: It's not a good idea. There's no such thing as a good hairpiece.

scenes.line: I invented a device called 'Burger on the Go'. It allows you to obtain 6 regular size hamburgers, or 12 sliders, from a horse without killing the animal. George Foreman is still considEring it. Sharper Image is still considEring it. Sky Mall's considEring it. Hammacher Schlemer is still considEring it. Sears said, 'No'.

scenes.line: [talking to an attractive woman] Toy Story, Finding Nemo, Up. I ball the entire time. I can not watch Pixar.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.line: Drop this one. Abort.

scenes.line: Why?

scenes.line: Oh, my God. Twins. I'm sorry. You understand. Nice to meet you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Aren't they magnificent?

scenes.line: They're men, Dwight.

scenes.line: I love finding a good set of twins.

scenes.line: Lame! What else you got, Andy?

scenes.line: How about a little bit of this.

scenes.line: Oh yeah. What else you got?

scenes.line: What else you got?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Did someone change my name to Baskin Robbin? Because I feel like a banana split. Woo! [Andy does a split and screams out in pain]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: What else you got?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: It's gonna be fine. It's gonna be fine. Pam's here. [knocks on Pam's door] Pam? [knocks again]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I was dancing and I did a split and I landed on my car keys in my pocket.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I tore my scrotum. I need you to take me to the hospital.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Andy, I am getting married in 8 hours.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Everyone else is too drunk. Just don't let me die here.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [on the phone] Hey, hey! Where are you? Can you take Andy to the hospital?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [over phone] What?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: He tore his scrotum dancing.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [over phone] What?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: He is in my room icing his balls.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [over phone] What?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Please stop saying what. Can you take him?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Look, I would so take him in any other circumstance, but I'm pretty certain I'm completely wasted.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Your brothers took you out drinking?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [over phone] Is that Pam? Hey, have her come out! Have her come out! It would be like Coyote Ugly.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's Michael. You're out with Michael?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [over phone] And Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [over phone] Hey-O!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pam, it just happened.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, fine. I'll take him.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I love you. Okay, I gotta–I gotta go!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [over phone] I love you! [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Are you pushing me off the phone?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. Let's talk for a long time.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Goodbye. [hangs up phone]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmm! It's after midnight. [points at Jim]

scenes.speaker: Michael & Dwight
scenes.line: You're married. [hugs Jim] He's married!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Congratulations.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's not how that works.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh my goodness.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh my God. You're not going to be able to talk back.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You'll have Pam to answer to.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: She'll be sitting home saying, "Jim… take the baby to the zoo cause I want to sit at home and eat bon-bons." [Dwight laughs] "And… and clip my toenails."

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: "Jim… hey why don't you braid my hair. I want to watch TV."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Now you sound like Kermit.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Are you sure this is the right way?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Nope. I, like you, have never been here before.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, at least slow down a little bit because every little bump in the road is major pain on… my scrotum.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Look, I'm not the one who asked you to do a split when you've never done one before.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I was trying to liven things up a little bit. I was kinda doing your job so–

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: My job? My job is to get married in the morning. That's my job.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well it's also to make sure that we have a great time at your stupid wedding, so–

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [Pam swerves the car back and forth] Ow, ow!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [snickers] I spent the night with the bride the night before the wedding. Ah yeah. She stepped on my hand on her way to the bathroom.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Andy, did I dream that you were crying through the night?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No. No that was real.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [folding his pants on top of the ice machine, man walks in with ice bucket] Why don't you take a picture. It'll last longer. God. Can't I get a little privacy?

scenes.speaker: Hotel Employee
scenes.line: [Kevin rings bell at the front desk] Good morning. How can I help you?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I left a pair of dress shoes in a bag outside my door last night to be cleaned at polished, but they haven't been returned yet.

scenes.speaker: Hotel Employee
scenes.line: You must be Mr. Malone. One moment please.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Hotel Employee
scenes.line: [whispers to manager] Sir. It's the man with the shoes.

scenes.speaker: Hotel Manager
scenes.line: Mr. Malone. Your shoes are gone.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: They were stolen?

scenes.speaker: Hotel Manager
scenes.line: No. Destroyed.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Hotel Manager
scenes.line: The bag was opened by our shoe shine and the smell overcame him. I too smelled them and made the choice that they must be thrown away. Incinerated actually.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: But that was my only pair of shoes.

scenes.speaker: Hotel Manager
scenes.line: It became a safety issue, sir.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Well… well damn-it.

scenes.speaker: Hotel Employee
scenes.line: I can offer you a complimentary breakfast.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [walking out of hotel room with a woman] You have everything?

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Hmm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Cell phone? Charger?

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Yeah. So you sure you don't want breakfast? It's the most important meal of the day.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It really is. I'm not hungry. I ate a whole bunch of sunflower seeds after you went to sleep. And besides, I wouldn't want to take you away from Pam on the morning of her wedding. She needs you Isabel.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: That's really sweet, Dwight. So I'll see you at the wedding?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You know it.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: K. [they kiss]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, get out of here.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Bye.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [passes Isabel] Hey, good morning. [to Dwight] It's about damn time. I haven't gone to the bathroom in a day and a half. [walks into hotel room] Oh my God, Dwight. This room is a pit.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [lays on bed] Really? I hadn't noticed. Too busy knocking boots.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [watching Dwight eat breakfast] How can you eat like that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm ravenous after a night of love making. You?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, I'm hungry, but I'm not going to make a pig out of myself.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey, what was she like?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: She was cute. You know? She was hot. She was very hot. She made love like a tiger.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Brides side or grooms side? Or townie?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: She was from Europe.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No kidding.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uh-huh.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I bet she had hairy armpits.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Isabel was nice, but I hope she doesn't think this is going anywhere.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wait a second. You're not into her? Are you kidding me?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: She's Pam's best friend. You guys could double date. Swap maybe?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh please. Put a gun in my mouth.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No… you're crazy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Look. She's a dental hygienist from Carbondale and she makes love like one. She's a bumpkin. Pass.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: She's– okay. Do you know how hard it is to be a hygienist? You have to take x-rays. You have to scrape the plaque off of people's teeth. You have to tell kids when to spit and make sure they're not scared when the dentist comes in. It– it–

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You should ask her out.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [stands up and walks away] I already have my European girlfriend.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: If your hat hits me in the face one more time–

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: That's funny. Your wife loved this hat the last time she saw it. [glares at Stanley's date]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [sees Kevin's toupee] Oh my God.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Oh…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oscar. Angela.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Are you in a lot of pain?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh cause of last night? No way. Reports have been exaggerated. Weddings make me very emotional. I um–I just have that side to me.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: People say you cry all the time.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well that's not–

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Crotch injuries are the worst. You don't need to tell me.

scenes.line: I wasn't telling you.

scenes.line: Is there still something there?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Excuse me?

scenes.line: It didn't get torn off?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No, it didn't–nothing got torn off. Who told you that?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I may have told some people that. I'm nervous. I'm about to get married.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: If you want to sit on this– [hands Andy her wrap] I was thinking the wood might be too hard on your damaged penis. Make it softer.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It was my scrotum. Um, and it was. Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, here we go. They asked for cash, but you know… I give them cash every week, so– how much cash does a person need? I have taken it upon myself to do something a little more special. I have painted a portrait of the two of them from memory. [holds up painting] And I have another one of them in the nude. But that one is for me.

scenes.line: I got them a set of turtle boiling pots, a shell hammer and bibs.

scenes.speaker: Penny
scenes.line: Is it zipping over your belly? Don't squish the baby.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank you weirdo.

scenes.speaker: Pam’s Mom
scenes.line: everybody see Kristie's stupid blonde extensions? It's like they were made from a plastic broom.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, here I come. [walks out in her wedding dress]

scenes.speaker: Pam’s Mom
scenes.line: Oh darling! You look beautiful.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thanks mom.

scenes.speaker: Pam’s Mom
scenes.line: Oh, I hope he deserves you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: He does.

scenes.line: Are you sure? Remember you don't have to do this. You don't.

scenes.line: Mom, you're totally projecting. You're being a drag.

scenes.line: Can you come here please?

scenes.line: Is this allowed?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No. No, but I'm allowing it. Just come here.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [talking to a woman] That was an intelligent comment.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Hello stranger. How do I look?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh. Fine. Isabel, [holds out hand] nice to see you. What do you want?

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Um… [shakes head] nothing. Anymore.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [turns back to other woman] So, uh tell me again the difference between Filene's and Filene's basement.

scenes.line: [to Isabel] Hey, hey… He's not sitting with me either. Where are you sitting? You need a seat buddy?

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: I'm standing. I'm a bridesmaid.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, I wish I was a bridesmaid. Where am I gonna go?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow. You look–

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Terrible.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So beautiful. [Pam's starts to cry. Jim pulls up chair to sit next to her] Hey–

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: My veil tore. I knew when we were getting married and I'm five months pregnant that I'm not going to be able to wear the dress that I always wanted or high heels–

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [takes her hand] Hey. You look just as I imagined you would. Pam, you're so pretty.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [sighs] Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And who cares? It's a stupid veil, right?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, this was the one thing I was supposed to be able to control, was this veil and– [Jim cuts off half his tie]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: There. Now we're even. [Pam laughs and mimes taking a picture, they kiss]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [sighs] Everyone's driving me crazy. I know way too much about Andy's scrotum. [Jim chuckles] And my mom won't stop freaking out about my dad's new girlfriend. [sighs] This is supposed to be our wedding day. Why did we invite all these people?

scenes.line: I think Pam ran away because she knew deep down she wouldn't be a good wife.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.line: [to Kevin who is bouncing up and down] What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I'm trying to decide if I have time to pee.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: How long do you take to pee?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: The peeing is fast, Oscar. It's getting my tie back on.

scenes.line: [to Pam's mom] Hey. Hi. Do you–would you have a snack in your purse? You're a mom. I just figured you might have–

scenes.speaker: Pam’s Mom
scenes.line: Oh, yeah–[hands Michael a snack]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh! Eww… apricot. Do you have any of the Very Berry or Ocean Splash or–

scenes.speaker: Pam’s Mom
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh… okay. Were you saving it?

scenes.speaker: Pam’s Mom
scenes.line: Oh, no, no, no. That's okay. I was just–I've had a very rough weekend.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm sorry. [puts food in his mouth] Ugh. Apricot. Made of real apes.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Do you think they canceled the wedding?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Relax. You'll get your shot at Jim. Those two treat the whole office like a 1970's key party.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: my weekend was bad so far.

scenes.speaker: Pam’s Mom
scenes.line: Oh–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I came here hoping to meet somebody. You know, as you do at weddings. End up going to sleep by the vending machine. It was loud, but it was warm.

scenes.speaker: Pam’s Mom
scenes.line: Oh that sounds awful.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And… and the love of my life is dating somebody else.

scenes.speaker: Pam’s Mom
scenes.line: Oh–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is a terrible year for love.

scenes.speaker: Pam’s Mom
scenes.line: Yeah. Guess it is.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm thinking about having my sperm frozen.

scenes.speaker: Tom
scenes.line: Excuse me, are you Michael Scott?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Um, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Tom
scenes.line: Heard you might have a whoopee cushion on you.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Sisters in the can and we totally want to get her when she comes back.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, wow. That sounds hilarious. I do actually. [pulls whoopee cushion out of pocket and hands it to them] There you go. Use it in good health.

scenes.speaker: Tom & Pete
scenes.line: [laughing] Yes!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Whoa, whoa. Wait a minute. What is the etiquette on taking the gifts? Can you only take your own back or is it a whatever you can carry type of thing?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Anyone have anything they want to trade for a toaster?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh, oh, does it have slots for hot dogs?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Who would want it?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Guys, maybe we should wait a little more time before we start grabbing boxes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Toby.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'd like to lodge a formal complaint against Jim for making us wait for over an hour.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [sighs]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [looks over and sees hole in his present] Crap. [sees turtle on the ground, goes over and picks it up] Come here you.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well I guess this weddings not going to happen. I wonder if this is it for them. [Jim and Pam walk in laughing]

scenes.speaker: Pam’s Dad
scenes.line: Hey. What happened?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Where were you guys? Do you know how long I've been waiting here?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well we are here now, so let's just–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [walks up] Yes! Yes! I have so much joy… in my heart… right now. How do I look?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You look great.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You look great.

scenes.speaker: Tom
scenes.line: [looks at Jim's cut tie] Wear a tie much?

scenes.speaker: Penny
scenes.line: [music starts playing and people start dancing down the isle] I begged them not to.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Penny
scenes.line: I know you specifically put this song on your Do Not Play list.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes I did.

scenes.speaker: Penny
scenes.line: I'm sorry.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [smiles] Go ahead. I think it's your turn.

scenes.speaker: Penny
scenes.line: Wait, what happened? You're okay with this?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, I'm okay.

scenes.speaker: Penny
scenes.line: Okay then! [takes flower girl to dance down the isle]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey Pam, did you see this? It was on You Tube.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Saw it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I bought those boat tickets the day I saw that You Tube video. I knew we'd need a back-up plan. The boat was actually Plan C. The church was Plan B and Plan A was marrying her a long, long time ago. Pretty much the day I met her.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: What an awesome party. The best wedding I've ever been too. I got six numbers. One more would have been a complete telephone number. This was epic. My Kleenex shoes were a huge conversation piece, but man my dogs are barking. [sticks his feet into the hotel ice machine] Whoo. My feet were so sweaty I can't even feel the cold. What a lovely hotel.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The fundamentals of business. The funda-mentals of business. "Mental" is part of the word, I have underlined it. Because you're mental, if you don't have a good time. You have to enjoy it.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well the "fun" is in it. [conference room group chimes agreement.]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Get out.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [halfway out] Yeah, I know.

scenes.line: Mmhm.

scenes.line: Mmhm.

scenes.line: Mmhm.

scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.line: Mmhm, I hear you. The truck.

scenes.line: Okay, well.

scenes.line: I can be very very persistent.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmhm.

scenes.line: Yeah, buy my insurance or I'll burn your warehouse down!

scenes.line: Exactly.

scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.line: It's, it's a completely different name!

scenes.line: Okay too many different words coming at me from too many different sentences.

scenes.line: Hello?

scenes.line: Look, We're in Puerto Rico, so-

scenes.line: Pam, I'm sorry–

scenes.line: It's Grotti. He's following up.

scenes.line: That's bad.

scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.line: That's bad.

scenes.line: Okay, I'm calling the police.

scenes.line: All right.

scenes.line: Shh!

scenes.line: You know what?

scenes.line: That's not gonna happen.

scenes.line: That's an exaggeration.

scenes.line: That's how it works!

scenes.line: Dwight…

scenes.line: Wait let's hear him out, this is interesting.

scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.line: Let him know you're not the typical kind of guy that he can shake down. That you're stubborn. That you might even be a little bit dangerous.

scenes.line: [snaps fingers] I like this plan. I'd like to officially withdraw my plan.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hold on, hold on! Just-

scenes.line: No, no, no. My plan is out! We do this the hard way.

scenes.line: All right. I will meet with him, but I'm not going alone.

scenes.line: Hello.

scenes.line: That's fine.

scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.line: No. That… I, I think that we should let the criminal use the card a little longer.

scenes.line: No-

scenes.line: Have a nice day, and thank you!

scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.line: If the salad is on top, I send it back.

scenes.line: This constitutes identity fraud.

scenes.line: What's that supposed to mean?

scenes.line: Why would I love jail?

scenes.line: Because… You would love it.

scenes.line: Maybe we have a plan for you?

scenes.line: Yeeeeah.

scenes.line: Yes I can.

scenes.line: No, no no, no. Come on. I'm sorry, we're having our salad.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay!

scenes.line: Thank you so much, I really appreciate it.

scenes.line: Hey, do you need any help?

scenes.line: I'm sure he can handle a simple jump-start. Now come on, sit down.

scenes.line: He's a good mechanic.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, okay okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: So we're choosing…

scenes.line: Yep, all right.

scenes.line: Check out Dental?

scenes.line: Black goes on the red. With the… If we… Positive… Mo- it being a motor drive, it's probably down.

scenes.line: He seems bad at this.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You want to do this junior? I didn't think so. Sorry. It's kind of a long day at the… mechanic store. [Andy places connections wrong, smoke and explosion set off] Aaaah! You got a leaky spark tube.

scenes.speaker: Woman
scenes.line: What?!?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: So your car's totaled. Uh, you're just gonna want to get a refund on that. Or my guy could do it. He's great. But uh, I can't do that for you. I work exclusively on motorcycles. [Andy walks away, woman is exasperated]

scenes.speaker: Grotti
scenes.line: Now if you could just sign this letter of intent, I'll bring this back to my boss, and we can get this in motion. [Andy clears throat loudly] You okay, Pat?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah. Just thinking about how, uh, I had this car, this Italian car, and I was driving it, and it kept telling me how much it needed oil, but I wouldn't give it any oil. And then, one day it exploded and it killed everyone and that's what I'm afraid of.

scenes.speaker: Grotti
scenes.line: Aren't you a mechanic? Why wouldn't you put oil in the car?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It was before, my tech- my technical training.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Don't do it!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Do it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Don't.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Just do it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.line: Look Mike, I don't know what your friends are telling you, but you have to decide for yourself. Are these guys gonna take care of your things if you die tomorrow?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I don't understand, why would you buy a policy?

scenes.line: It's just the cost of a cup of coffee an hour.

scenes.line: You were man enough to back down Michael, I'm proud of you.

scenes.line: I had to make a snap decision Dwight.

scenes.line: It wasn't a snap decision, you were sitting there for an hour.

scenes.line: Do you know what "snap decision" means?

scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.line: It means like this. [snaps fingers]

scenes.line: Just get in the car.

scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.line: Oh thank God.

scenes.line: It wasn't easy. I had to tell the hotel it was a medical emergency. I chose massive coronary, cause you told me that your Dad had a bad heart. Listen man, I, I got a problem, I think I'm in trouble with the mob. Or a major insurance carrier.

scenes.line: That sounds bad.

scenes.line: Yeah, I know and you usually can get out of stuff like this, so I'm turning to you my friend.

scenes.line: Okay!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All you're gonna need to [faking a bad connection] and- it- and then go to–

scenes.line: Jim? Are you?

scenes.line: And then you'll be saved.

scenes.line: Just [drops] and then you'll be saved.

scenes.line: No! God! I missed, I missed the important part again!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: A- ah–

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No! Oh my God!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And you'll be saved.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, Jim please, repeat what you're saying! I can't understand you!

scenes.line: I [drops out] at the Bermuda Triangle. An- M- please don't call again.

scenes.line: Jim?!? [dial tone] Oh my God.

scenes.line: Hey uh, question for you. I recently purchased some insurance that I can't afford given my present salary. Is there anything accounting-wise I can do to sort of make it all go away?

scenes.line: Accounting-wise, no. But phone-wise, just call up and cancel it.

scenes.line: Oh no. Um. What about this Cash For Clunkers thing?

scenes.line: Just- no. No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right. Well, it was a thought. Thanks.

scenes.line: We have let Michael down, and it's 85 percent your fault.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: He's alive. So you're welcome.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Not on the inside he's not. Look at his life! Broke! Living in fear! No friends, dead end job.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, some of that existed before.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Not the living in fear, that's new.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You're right, that is new.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes. He's got to stand up to this mafia guy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well I don't see that happening.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Me neither. Not the way things are now. But what if Michael felt no fear toward the mafia guy?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Are you saying-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That we surgically remove the fear center from Michael's brain?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What is wrong with you? I am talking about convincing Michael that the guy's not mafia!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That seems a little far-fetched.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well more far-fetched than a mobster walking into a paper company for a low-level shakedown? And that happened.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael. Incredible news. Grotti is clean.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. He's not. He's just good. Nothing sticks to him. You still don't understand how this works.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No, Michael. What we're trying to say is, we made a mistake assuming he was mafia. I have a buddy who's a Fed, and we did a background check on the guy. His background is perfectly clean.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's true, he's clean. I have a couple of friends still on the force. Checked with them. Ran his Fed friend up the flagpole to make sure he wasn't on the take. Turns out he's a totally lovely guy. Sweetest guy on the force really.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Class act. Boy scout.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: But Grotti acts like he's mafia though.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: He's trying to intimidate you to close sales. He's just a pushy salesman.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: And he made us all look like chumps!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [grunts]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: If there is one thing I hate more than the mafia it is a liar. I wish the mafia would go out and kill all the liars. Bury them in my yard. And I wouldn't tell the cops a thing. Not that I would be lying per se. But I would just get really quiet, all of a sudden.

scenes.speaker: Grotti
scenes.line: This is Grotti.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is Scott.

scenes.speaker: Grotti
scenes.line: Oh! Great. Michael, I'm finishing up your paperwork right now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh really? Is that supposed to scare me?

scenes.speaker: Grotti
scenes.line: I, I thought you'd be pleased.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well you thought wrong. Because I am not pleased. I'm actually kind of PO'd.

scenes.speaker: Grotti
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think you know exactly why, because you were trying to scare me into buying insurance.

scenes.speaker: Grotti
scenes.line: I don't get it. How was I scaring you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think you knew exactly what you were doing. And frankly I think you were being a total and utter jerk.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Whoa. Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You suck!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay that's-

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And I'm not gonna buy your stupid insurance.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's good, let's wrap it up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How about that? The only person that actually needs insurance is you, if you show your face around here again, got it?

scenes.speaker: Grotti
scenes.line: Look, Michael, when we all calm down here, maybe at some point in the future, you change your mind, why don't you give me a call?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Doubt it. [disconnects call]

scenes.speaker: Dwight & Andy
scenes.line: [relaxing] Oh man.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What a tool. [Dwight and Andy exchange looks] What?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Next time you look in the mirror, you're gonna be looking at a guy who stood down the mafia!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. What do you mean?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We just told you he wasn't mafia, so you wouldn't be scared.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You successfully backed down the mob!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You made the mafia apologize to you! You made the mafia be polite!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh man. I should be mad at you guys. But I'm not.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So I looked him in the eye and I said, "Not today Grotti, Not today. And not tomorrow, and not the next day. Or the day after that. And you can tell all your friends that if I see them, then they're already dead." I said something like that.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Very close.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Just to be clear, he backed down an insurance agent from Mutual of Harrisburg.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Erin?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yes?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Coffee?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Not from the kitchen. Stop and Shop. If it's not Stop and Shop, I send it back.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Large. If it's a medium I send it back. If it's an extra large I send it back.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: How do you return coffee?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Go. Any questions?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [on phone] Are you kidding me?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hi Pam, is Jim there?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Listen our credit card has been cancelled and we have to deal with that, and I really can't handle the fact that you're calling us here!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Okay, that sounds good. Um, I'll let you go, just -tell Jim, that I said hi.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh I will. I will Kevin. I will make that my top priority.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Cool. Okay. [Pam hangs up] Bye.

scenes.line: They have no idea what happened.

scenes.line: They're back!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oooh yeah… [people chuckle] Jim and Pam!

scenes.line: How was Puerto Rico? Was it so romantic?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It was.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It really was.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really was.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [voice cracks] I'm so happy for you…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Puerto Rico was awesome.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh my gosh. The honeymoon was great. We met this other couple at the resort, Frank and Benny. We hung out with them a lot.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [goofy voice] Frank and Beans. [laughs] Always makes her laugh.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [goofy voice] Frank and beans!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Is there someone there? Who is there? I hear voices, is somebody there?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Is someone there? I can't see you because I'm blind.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Its Jim and Pam, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [gasps] It is?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: They're back? Oh! Oh! Oh, Pam! [reaching out with hands at chest level]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nope.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And oh, Jim…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hi, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, I haven't see you since my accident that I had when I fell- I fell into the pool of acid, eyes first. Blind guy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Blind-guy McSqueezy. How do I describe it? It is a character I've been workshopping whose lack of vision gets him into all sorts of trouble. The women in my improve class absolutely hate him. [groans]

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: So what'd you bring us?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Some candy.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: What else?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's it.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Oh, 'cause you spent so much on the wedding.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [behind Pam, acting out blind-guy, groaning]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's good to be home.

scenes.line: This conversation has two items on the agenda.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Do we have a conversation scheduled?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Number one, do not leave your things on my desk. It's not some kind of personal pen receptacle for you. I don't care how high they promote you, which brings me to item number two… I never formally congratulated you on your promotion, so I'd just like to say… [high voice, holding up wooden mallard] con-quack-ulations!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow, that's… really thoughtful of you, Dwight, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [duck voice] You're welcome! [quacks, laughs]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I inserted a listening device into the belly of the mallard. Now I can observe Jim, trap Jim, and destroy Jim, just like in the Bavarian fairy tale. Only this time, the mallard skins the toad alive. And of course in this version you lose the whole veiled critique of the Kaiser thing.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm sorry to have been bugging you all these years.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's a real handsome duck.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Mallard. Okay, I'll get out of your hair.

scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hi!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Uh, we brought back some Puerto Rican candy.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Coco Leche! That's my favorite!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Awesome! I'll leave it up here so everyone can enjoy it.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, um, let me just check with Michael first.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [laughs] I think it'll be okay.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [laughs] I think it will too, but I'll just check with him, though.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Great.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oops, sorry. [slides candy back to Pam] Oops.

scenes.line: I have recently taken a lover.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, that's great. Congratulations. Who's the lucky lady?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pam's mom.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pam's mom, Helene. Remember from your wedding?

scenes.line: You're messing with me.

scenes.line: About what?

scenes.line: You did not have sex with Pam's mom.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, big time.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What kind of car does she drive?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: She drives a green camry.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [expletive]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And the seats go all the way down. All the way down.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh my God. [Michael bangs the table] Oh my God.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughs] What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, never tell Pam, and secondly-

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, good, a pact. A pact. Although I may have to break it tonight when Helene and I tell Pam over dinner. You alright?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh my God.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [walks in] Hey, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Not now, Toby, my God!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Oh, Jesus!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Get the hell out of here, idiot.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: What did I do?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, as far as dinner tonight, cancel that, and please, for both our sakes, never, ever, ever see her again.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I think you're underestimating Pam. I think more than anything, she wants me to be happy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, not more than anything.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, I have a good thing with the mom-

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Don't call her "the mom."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: She's right on my way home from work.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Then take a different way home, man!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I di- alright, I'll take surface streets, its- the last thing in the world I would want to do is upset Pam.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, so we're good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Can you change my dinner reservations from four people to two?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Sure. Oh, is it okay if I put out some candy that Pam brought back from Puerto Rico?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sure. Thanks for asking.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Pam, we're all set. [Pam places candy on Erin's desk] Yum.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Frank and beans!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Frank and beans! [both laugh] So what'd we decide for Michael, the bottle of rum, or the seashell alarm clock?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know what? Can I have the weekend to decide?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Bottle of rum it is. [takes package out of bag] Alright, shall we?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know what, I am really slammed, trying to catch up on everything here and I know that Michael's slammed too. So, maybe we should do this when things are a little less crazy.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Come on, it'll take two seconds.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, it- [high-pitched feedback as Jim starts to leave, feedback changes as he moves, turns over the mallard to see the listening devics, sighs, places mallard back on the desk]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [unwraps rum gift] Oh, wow.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [giggles]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That is amazing. I feel like a real Puerto Rican.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Michael, you're all set at Botticelli's. I changed the reservation to two people.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Erin, look. [holds up parrot rum bottle]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Fun!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow, Botticelli's, that sounds like a special occasion.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, no, it's nobody.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [laughs] I don't know. I think Michael has a date.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [chuckles] Hmm… no.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [laughs] I think you have a date.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Come on.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, I think we should just drop it… 'cause obviously he doesn't want to talk about it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sighs] I don't deserve this, guys.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes, you do.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, I don't.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Just take the parrot.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [long exhale]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, back to the old grind.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I was probably going to break up with her anyway.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, that's too bad.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Don't-

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Pam, it is very complicated. There are a lot of moving parts here.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sounds complicated.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, but I mean, if you really like this person, then you should see where it goes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You want me to be happy?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Of course.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Part of the problem is, she is the mother of a close friend of mine.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: More than a friend, a co-worker.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh! Gossip, who is it? Who is it? Who is it, Michael? …Who?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, no, no, no, no. Oh, no. Oh, my God! Oh, my God! Nooooo!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That could have gone one of two ways, but I never expected her to get upset.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [screams out in the parking lot, Michael watches from his office window]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [to Michael] You seem tense. Hey, you want me to give you the chills?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: There's an egg on your head and the yolk is running down, the yolk is running down…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sighs] Feels good.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: There's a knife in your back and the blood is gushing down…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm sleeping with Pam's mom. Sometimes, dinner.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: …the blood is gushing down, the blood is gushing down… You know, I really would have appreciated a heads-up that you were into dating mothers. I would have introduced you to mine.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [outside, on cell phone] How could you do this to me? He's my boss! How many times have I complained about him to you? No, I am not being dramatic, you are being crazy!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [singsong voice] Who wants a hot chocolate?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [sighs] Oh, so Dwight gave me this wooden mallard as a gift, and I found a recording device in it. Yes. So, I think if I played it just right I can get Dwight to play out the plot of National Treasure.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You need to be more upset about this. She's your mother too now. Your mother is sleeping with Michael Scott.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Andy, can I talk to you for a second?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Sure thing, Tuna Boss.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [holding up a sign that reads, "Dwight picked the wrong day to put a wooden mallard in my office"]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [in Jim's office] How may I be of service to you?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I am gonna need your advice [starts playing loud opera music, everyone can hear it, Creed starts crying] I was thinking about getting this opera for Dwight's birthday, what do you think?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [both look at Dwight, Jim waves] This aurea is a joke.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What are you thinking?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I was gonna go with this one.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [both look at Dwight who is standing right outside the office] Let me tell you something, if you respect him at all, you will get him something better.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Andy gets up and leaves the office] The Nard Dog… what was that all about?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I know, right?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What were you talking about in there?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Trust me it would only make you mad. [opera continues, Dwight looks at Jim standing outside his office, waves, Jim waves back]

scenes.line: [in the conference room leading a meeting] Due to a certain recent incident, corporate has asked all the branches to come up with ideas as to how we can better communicate with our communities.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Is this because of the 60 Minutes segment about working conditions in our Peruvian paper mill?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That was a hit job. If you read the Dunder Mifflin press release it clearly states that they had absolutely nothing to do with that particular cancer cluster. So if there is a lesson to be learned here and I'm not sure that there is, it is that in order to help our communities, we need to put other people's needs ahead of our own.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Haha! Ha ha ha.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And whoever comes up with the best idea gets a $50 gift certificate to the restaurant of his or her choice. [everyone claps and makes comments]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Who wants to help the world one step at a time? [Dwight raises his hand] Alright, good.

scenes.line: Volunteerism is important. Every weekend I volunteer at the local animal shelter and they need a lot of help down there. Last Sunday I had to put down over 150 pets all by myself.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright, that's…

scenes.line: Alright…

scenes.line: I have a way to make Scranton a better place, you could leave it. [laughter]

scenes.line: Okay, I'm out of here, [pretends to leave] see you later guys…

scenes.speaker: Various
scenes.line: Get out and stay out, bye…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, oh no here's an idea… conservation…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I love it, conservation. Let's start by conserving our time and stop having these stupid meetings. [stands up and cheers] No more meetings! No more meetings! No more meetings! No more meetings! [Stanley cheers her on in the background]

scenes.line: Anybody else? Who else has an idea?

scenes.line: I have some ideas about conservation…

scenes.line: Yes! Angela! Please…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Michael leaves to answer his phone] Can you hold down the fort? [on phone] Hey boo!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Thank you. Sure well first of all I think that we could totally…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [on phone] What's it… why are you crying?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes! I think we should look into that. If you could just speak up louder…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [to Angela] Shhhh…

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Well, for our profit…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [to Angela] Shhh…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [on phone] No, no, no, I'll talk to her. I will… No… nobody talks to my baby that way… uh ah… yeah, I'll let you know how it goes. Alright, by pickle.

scenes.line: I'm sorry, I was told I had the floor.

scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.line: Hold on, hold on, what's going on?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nothing… nothing at all… it's all good!

scenes.line: For trying to find happiness in the arms of a lover?

scenes.line: Don't call my mother your lover.

scenes.line: Yes! That's what I'm talking about.

scenes.line: Alright, in my defense…
