scenes.line: [he hits his head on the desk after ducking out of the way from hiding behind a plant] Ow.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Kev… Nice. Going.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Well…

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Knock knock.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, hey, Isabelle.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Hey. Pam, she's gorgeous. Can I hold her?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes. She was a little fussy earlier, but she's totally quieted down. Here, let me just, uh, let me just burp her. I don't want her to spit up on you. Come here, sweety… Oh, my God! Wrong baby!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wrong baby! This is not our baby! Sshh.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, my gosh.

scenes.speaker: Kathy
scenes.line: [waking up] Oh,has she been fussing long?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, not at all.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Perfect.

scenes.speaker: Kathy
scenes.line: I was out like a light… Oh, she's not hungry…

scenes.speaker: Nurse
scenes.line: How's it going?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, I feel like she needs to eat, but she won't latch on, which is weird, because the other baby di…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ha ha ha.

scenes.speaker: Nurse
scenes.line: Bottles are fine. A lot of babies grow up using bottles. So are you excited to bring your baby home?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We definitely are. At 3:00, right? You said we could stay until 3:00?

scenes.speaker: Nurse
scenes.line: Yeah, you can. It's 2:35.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Half hour.

scenes.speaker: Nurse
scenes.line: Twenty five minutes. And you're all set with the car seat?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes, car seat's right there.

scenes.speaker: Nurse
scenes.line: That bottom part needs to go in the car.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Newsflash, the whole thing needs to go in the car.

scenes.speaker: Nurse
scenes.line: Ha ha, be back in twenty five minutes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Or it could be a half hour, if you need it to be… Can we get a late checkout? I don't… I don't think she heard me.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: [entEring the Halpert house] Hello? Dwight? What, what are you doing here?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Isabelle. Hello… Yeah, the uh, kitchen was disgusting, so…

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Wow, ha. New cabinets.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yup.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: All I did was bring macaroni and cheese… Where's the fridge?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, it's… In the backyard. I'll take this.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Oh… Well, I'll let you get back to it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey, listen. I know that I'm an adult, but maybe I could come by sometime for a teeth cleaning. You know, just for fun.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Well, adults are supposed to go to the dentist, too.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Are they now? Ha ha, how some people spend their money, right? Ha ha.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Yeah…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Alright. I'll call you, kid.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Do that.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you really sure we should be leaving?

scenes.speaker: Hospital employee
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: But you hear the baby crying, right?

scenes.speaker: Hospital employee
scenes.line: Mm-hmm… Where's your car?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, it's in the lot.

scenes.speaker: Hospital employee
scenes.line: Oh, a lot of fathers bring their car around.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right, okay. Yes, that would be the smart thing to do. Uh, Pam, I will be right back.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, please hurry.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Erin, uh, I need you to send this fax immediately. It's really important, so I'm going to stand here and wait for the confirmation.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Okay, good.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: The fax says "Erin, will you have dinner with me?" from Andy, and the number is our office fax number.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: It's busy. Why don't I keep trying, and then I'll give you the confirmation in a bit?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Sorry, that's unacceptable. I need you to send it immediately, or you're fired.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [tearing up] You can't talk to me like that. I didn't do anything wrong. I've been having a tough day today.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, God, no. I'm… Just read the fax.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You read the fax.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'm… I'm asking you out.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, my God. That's amazing. Let me just fax this, and I'll check my planner.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: So, it's a date.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yes. Do you have a day in mind?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, what day? What day?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Everyday is fine. Or…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, that, what's that one?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Thursday?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay. Let's do it.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Hospital employee
scenes.line: Would you like me to help you up out of the chair?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, yeah, sorry.

scenes.speaker: Hospital employee
scenes.line: Yeah, we just got a lot of discharges today.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, alright, thanks… Okay, do you want to eat? You want to try eating? Okay… Okay, let me… Just you and me. Come on. There we go… Yeah… Oh, yeah. Like that. There we go. You got it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Five tickets on the windshield… Hey.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hi. We did it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You used my move, didn't you?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I used a variation of your move.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [smoking a cigar] There is no greater feeling than when two people who are perfect for each other overcome all obstacles, and find true love. And that is what I thought that Erin and Kevin were going to find today… I think I'm going to be sick…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Two forms of ID, please.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: And now you, two forms of ID, please… Alright, all is in order. I just need your signature… What is it?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Nothing.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Alright. How would you like to celebrate?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Just pour yourself a cup of apple juice. I feel sick… [Jim and Pam walk in to their house with the baby] I couldn't find the iPod… Give me a couple days. I'll be out of your hair.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello hello. Top of the morning to you! Ooh ooh! Green M&Ms! Nature's Viagra! [Grabs and pours Kevin-esque scoop of M&Ms into his coat pocket] Two of my favorite joke areas combined. It'll be a good day.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I don't want to bring my friends, why can't it just be the two of us?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Because it's St. Patrick's Day, people go out in groups.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Well why don't you invite your friends?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Why are you being so weird about this?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Stop fighting. Just on St Patrick's Day, okay? Just one perfect day a year. No hassles, no problems, no kids.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Why no kids?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Yeah, where are your kids?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Nope. Nuh -uh. Not today!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is St. Patrick's Day, and here in Scranton that is a huge deal. It is the closest that the Irish will ever get to Christmas.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Welcome back, "Dad!"

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, thank you!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Welcome back Tuna!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey… [reveal Dwight's Mega-Desk]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Very good. Okay. Will get back to you right away on that, thanks.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What do we got here?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Mega-Desk.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Of course.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Command central.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hm hm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Surveillance, gaming- and business.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. [Pulls desks apart] Just gotta…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay. Come on! Jim!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Dweedle Dee and Dweedle Dumb-ass have been away on maternity leave. Now Dweedle Dumb-ass is back, and we have a problem. Yes, getting hooked on Mega-Desk was my own damn fault. But … I don't care about assigning blame. All I care about is Mega-Desk. That is all I care about. Getting. More. Mega-Desk.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh, I love this, so much fun! There's such team spirit in this room! 'Morning Darling!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Morning!

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well, this is my last day at the Scranton branch for a while. But I'm leaving it in the very capable hands of some of the loveliest people I've ever had the pleasure of knowing. Oh I'm gonna miss this place. And the snow! Hoo, my dogs love peeing in that snow! Makes me think they're onto something.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh good morning sweetheart.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Morning, honey-pile.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: I'm sorry but is that a gift I see in your hands?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is. This is a little something for you to remember your time here in Scranton by.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: [pulls out glass cube with coal.] Is that a lump of coal?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes it is!

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Have I been that naughty?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no no- that is a good gift actually. Buildings here in Scranton are literally powered by coal.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Err, thank you very much. We, we don't get to see much coal in Tallahassee, I'm used to alligators, and some of the worst Chinese food you've ever tasted.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm, that sounds great, actually.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well, if you ever get down in my neck of the woods, you got a place to stay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: When you work for Sabre, only one thing matters. And I don't care if you're a loser, or you practice bestiality, if Jo likes you, you are in. And I am in!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Erin go braugh!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Andy go braugh to you! Nice kilt!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Thanks. It's actually my sister's old field hockey skirt.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Erin and I have our first date tonight, and it has to be perfect. Why? Because according to "How I Met Your Mother" that's the date that your kids are going to wait patiently to hear about, and you better have a good story for them.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. [re-enters bullpen from kitchen.]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Great.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Thank you. [hangs up phone]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No-no-no-no-no.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh come on. Come on. Five more minutes? Five more minutes of Mega-Desk? Please?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [swats over various photos and knickknacks, points at paperwork] Is this yours or mine?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: They say that no man is an island. False! I am an island and this island is volcanic. And it is about to erupt. With the molten hot lava of strategy!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Good Lord! [Photo of Cece on Jim's desktop] I can't believe I'm missing this.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's kind of like that lip thing she did last night, like a half snarl, half smile? I get the sense that she's very ironic.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. Love you. We'll talk soon. [hangs up phone]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Must be amazing being a father right, a miracle of life?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It is. Big time.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ah, that baby is just discovEring the whole wide world right now.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pretty amazing.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What up is, what down is, who Mom is, who Dad is. Must be tough being here with all that going on.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh it's tough being here for a lot of reasons.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I mean, you're here at work, and the baby thinks that the refrigerator is its father.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Is that what happened to you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'll tell you what happened to me. I didn't see my father for the first two years of my life. I thought my mother was my father, and my wet-nurse was my mother.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's a common mistake.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Turned out fine for me. But Mose? Oh. Same story, different ending.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Hey! [Erin sneezing at desk] Are you sick?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, no I'm fine, I just have a little indigestion.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: In your nose?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yes. [Angela returns to desk and puts embroidered breathing mask on]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I'm a little sick but I don't want to miss my date with Andy. I'll get better. Whenever I'm sick it goes away within a few hours. Except once, when I was in the hospital from age three to six.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Now, after all the talking I've been doing. It's your turn. This is a town hall meeting. I want to hear what you all sound like.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That is a great idea JB.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Thank you. You know I get way too many ideas from the top. Now I want to hear your ideas. I mean, did you guys know that Liquid Paper? That wasn't invented by some fancy engineer. No, that was created by a lowly typist.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Jo, I have an idea, for suntan lotion – soap.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: You know it doesn't have to be an invention.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I have a question.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oscar, homosexual accountant.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: In the training manual it says, that there is a minority executive training program in Tallahassee?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: I am so proud of Sabre's "Print In All Colors" initiative. Any Sabre employee of color, is welcome to apply. [Kelly applauds] Daryl?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Daryl. Mellow, soulful, smart for warehouse…

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Okay hush now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: The Sabre shipping method could be more efficient. Combining inventory systems makes sense on paper, but printers and paper ship differently. It'll be faster to deliver them separately, instead of waiting on everything to come in.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: But you wouldn't need more trucks?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Not at all. There's a way that it can be scheduled. I sketched this out downstairs.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh look at you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Look at that picture that you drew. Nice job! We're very proud of you. You know what, we're gonna tape that up on the refrigerator in the kitchen.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: [Looks over his proposal] I like this Daryl. I like this a lot. Maybe you should be doing your sketching upstairs. Would you like an office up here?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Are you serious?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Yeah. Take Jim's old office.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Um. I set my stuff up in there. So… just give me a few minutes to clean that out for you.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Yeah, I want to hear more from you.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Absolutely.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Okay. Any questions? Anything on anybody's mind? I'm leaving tonight, this is your last chance for a while!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh no! Say it's not so, Jo, we're gonna miss you, we're gonna miss you so much!

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Yes, well okay. Florida ain't that far away.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I am heading down there.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well, anytime now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How about July 4th weekend? [Reveals paper ticket]

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh honey you didn't buy a ticket?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I did!

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh honey. I'm not home, very often. And uh, me and my relatives, they take up the guesthouse. I think you should check with my office, before you book any dates, okay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what, in the spirit of full disclosure, I have actually reserved a bunch of different seats on a bunch of different flights, but there are a couple of flights that only have two tickets left, so I think we should pull the trigger and –

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Enough!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right, everybody, just try to put a brave face on.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Let's follow the chain of events. Jo likes Michael. Jo invites Michael to house. Jo doesn't like Michael anymore. Hmmm.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [singing] Moving on up, to the East Side, to the deluxe apartment in the sky…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello. I want you to stop what you're doing right now. You are stressed, and I'm taking you to lunch.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: No, that's very generous of you, but I'm all set.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No is not an option.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Yes it is.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right. Well if you need me, I'll be on the other side of that wall. Knock once for yes, twice for no.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: How many knocks does it take to get you to do some work?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughs] I'll be over there.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And I'm actually pleased to be able to offer you printer cartridges and toner now.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Whispers] Oh Jim, Jim! Sorry to bother you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: My headphones are broken.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Can I listen to my music at a low volume?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah that's great. Great.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay? [Unplugs cord, sings] "The cat's in the cradle and the silver spoon, little boy blue-"

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Overlapping] When's the last time you upgraded your printer?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: "- and the man in the moon. When you coming home Dad? I don't know when-"

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Whispers] Please stop that!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: "-But we'll be together then-"

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Can you grow up?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: "-Dad, you know we'll have a good time then."

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Turns off Dwight's music] Whether it's this time or next time.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [Vocalizes and continues song] "The cat's in the cradle and the silver spoon"

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [On business call] Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Andy & Dwight
scenes.line: [Singing, Dwight supplies beats] "Little boy blue and the man in the moon."

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, we definitely can talk about it in the next–

scenes.speaker: Andy & Dwight
scenes.line: "When you coming home Dad?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know, can I call you back?

scenes.speaker: Andy & Dwight
scenes.line: "I don't know when-"

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That would be great, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Andy & Dwight
scenes.line: "But we'll get together then, we're gonna have a good time-"

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [On phone in hallway] No, I know I need to work, I just- I feel weird not being home.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I am not surprised that Dwight's using my baby to steal my desk. I'm a little surprised that it's working.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: This fax came for you. [Coughs]

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh no no no! Are you feeling ill?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Uh…

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh no honey, if you got a bug, I want you to go on home. I can't have you getting Callie and Jo Jr. sick. These dogs have got to be in a commercial with Dwight Howard next week.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh! No. I feel like I could lift a car.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Yeah, but you sound like death, girl. Now why don't you go on home and take care of yourself and get in bed. And shred that and have them send me a clean fax, okay?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Well… [Jo closes door on her]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: She should go home. It's not the end of the world. We'll go on our date next week. She's still gonna like me in a week. Right?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Yes?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I was just working at my desk and I wanted to run some new leads by you. [Turns feint]

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh! You're sick! [Andy coughs] Dangit! That's exactly why I sent that receptionist home.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No, no, no, no, no.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Get everybody sick in the office.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I have some good ideas…

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: We don't need any heroes here honey. It's time for you to get on home now.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You sure?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: You'll probably feel better once you get some pants on. Come on.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Very nice.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Not bad, huh?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: A real Hoop Dreams story you got there. Oh man, you seem to have caught Jo's eye. How'd you make that happen?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I impressed her with my good ideas.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hm mm. Seriously, how did you do it?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I made a suggestion at the meeting that was good. You were there.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How do I put this delicately? Does her family owe your family something, in terms of a past injustice?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Now Mike, I have to ask you to leave, so that I can learn about this tiny television.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. All right.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Hey there.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey there. So I think I'm done. Gonna head out. Unless you want to chat. Like we were doing earlier.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well there's chatting time and there's working time. I'm still on working time.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm? Well, the clock says chatting time, so.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well, if you feel like you've done a solid days work…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Right. What?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well I mean, if you can put your name on this day, and be proud of the amount of work you've done, then, by all means, you should toodle on home.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm. mm. Oh well.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Anything else I can help you with?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no. That's super-clear-ish. [Exits, closes door, takes off coat.] Nope. Nope. Nope. Nope.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Just because Jo has no life, does not mean that the rest of us don't have lives. Oscar has a life. I think Ryan has a life. This is outrageous.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey Pack-man.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Hey what's up, Butt-plug?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How you doing stud? You already there?

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Dude, I've been here since three! I've boot and rallied twice.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How's the lady situation?

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Fat and ugly. You might actually have a chance.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ah damn. That sounds great. Unfortunately I am stuck here, because my boss is making us work late.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Oh here's what you do. Hike up your skirt and pull out your tampon, borrow some balls and come meet me!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. Maybe next year.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Maybe next "queer." Hey ladies, who wants some bangers and mash?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [Opens door, surprised] Oh! Andy!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hi!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I'm in my jammy-jams!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That's okay, I'm in my "worky-works." You look amazing!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, thanks. Come in!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Hey! Me and Creed are in. Are you guys in?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh I'm in.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I'm in.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: All right. [The four of them get out of chairs to run out, Jo exits her office. They retreat.]

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh, you don't become the most powerful woman in Tallahassee by slacking off. [Scoffs] You do it by working hard. Or marrying rich. I did both!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ah. Got a little client meeting at Shanny O'Gannigan's tonight. It shouldn't go all night long, so if you'd like me to, I could swing by your house so the baby can experience a strong male presence. [Jim is silent] No? Nothing? Okay. Have fun working. [Whistles "Cat's in the Cradle" song]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hi there Jo. Sorry to interrupt. Um, this evening [phone rings] I have…

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Hello?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey Jo, it's Jim Halpert. I actually scheduled a meeting at 7:30 with a very important client. And it's so weird, because we never have meetings after 5pm. But I was hoping that maybe just this once, it would be okay.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well sure. You know, you go ahead and push some printers.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know I will. And by the way, seriously, we never, never do this!

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Sorry Sugar. What'd you want?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well, you see, I actually do have a meeting. With a client. I'm just gonna reschedule for next week.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [pops back into Jo's doorway] Thanks again by the way.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Hey! What are you fellas doing up here?

scenes.speaker: Warehouse Guy 1
scenes.line: We're here to bust you out!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I wish, but uh-

scenes.speaker: Warehouse Guy 1
scenes.line: Dude! Your shirt tucked in?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Oh. Yeah, um, I must have did that when I was in the bathroom. All right then, uh, let me get to it.

scenes.speaker: Warehouse Guy 1
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Warehouse Guy 2
scenes.line: See you later.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Your hand's cold.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It is? I'm sorry.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah, have some more blanket.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay, thanks.

scenes.speaker: Reid
scenes.line: What's up?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Whoa!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You're awake. Andy, this is my brother, Reid.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I didn't know you had a brother.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: He's my foster brother.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, any brother of Erin's is a friend of mine. Nice to meet you. Andy Bernard. [They shake hands]

scenes.speaker: Reid
scenes.line: Cold hands. [Takes spot next to Erin on love seat]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Are we rotating seats, or?

scenes.speaker: Reid
scenes.line: Oh yeah, you're the guest. Take the easy chair, best seat in the house. Plus, you don't have to sit next to this big dork and her smelly feet.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hey! My feet aren't smelly, they smell like roses. Smell them! [puts her feet in his face]

scenes.speaker: Reid
scenes.line: Ooh! [Erin giggles]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: So, how does the whole foster sibling thing work? Do you guys share one parent or-?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: None. We were in the same house from ages ten to twelve. And then from fifteen to eighteen.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: All right. Formative years. [She laughs]

scenes.speaker: Reid
scenes.line: Nice skirt.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, it's a kilt.

scenes.speaker: Night cleaning crew
scenes.line: Oh! Sorry! Sorry, sorry. [They retreat. Pan around office still full with staff.]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yes, I'm anxious to get off work. But let me be clear. It's not to celebrate St Patrick's Day. It's so I can protest St. Patrick's Day.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Overnight all my damn bags home. I'm carrying nothing but my Sable gloves. I've had it with Homeland Security. And I want you to put all those tracking numbers in my Blackberry.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How late do we have to work tonight?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: You never know with Jo. Sometimes we're here til midnight. Sometimes she doesn't show up for three days.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why does she do that? Why doesn't she just tell you what your schedule is?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Yeah, that would be awesome. I could get a girlfriend. Wouldn't have to go to Amsterdam seven times a year. But uh, I'm young, right? I will date when I'm dead! [Laughs]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do I really want to turn out like Gabe? Twenty-six. Single. Tied to my desk. No life, no family. I want to have been married by the time I would've turned thirty. That's just – that's just depressing.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello Jo.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Anything I can do for you Puddin'?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There is, as a matter of fact. It's getting sorta late. It's 8:30. And it's St. Patrick's Day, which is a world ethnic holiday. So I have decided I'm going to dismiss my employees.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Hmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm thrilled with the work they've done today, both quality and the quantity. Great performance, Very, very solid all the way around.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: All right then.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. Happy St. Patrick's Day. [Starts to leave office] And also, I would like to say that I will be canceling my trip down to Tallahassee. Although I do look forward to our professional relationship.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: I look forward to that too.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ooh. It's coming down out there.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yes. Thank you, for coming all the way here.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No, I-

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I'm so sorry I was so sick. [Andy leans in. She leans in. Reid appears in background. Erin kisses Andy on the cheek.]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ah. Oh great, now I'm gonna get sick. [They both laugh]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Excuse me, excuse me. Hey guys!

scenes.speaker: Meredith, Creed, Oscar, & Matt
scenes.line: [cheEring Michael]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Drinks are on me!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: No! No, no no! Put your credit cards away. Drinks are on us!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh -hoh! All right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did I mess up my career today? My future prospects at Sabre? I don't know. There is a chance. Yes. I tell you I love my job. But Jo wants me to put on a show for her, and pretend to work late? Nah. I spent all day, trying to make her like me, and I forgot to ask myself something:

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. We should be able to have that right over to you by Monday. Yeah no problem. [Reveal Jim behind Quad-Desk] Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What the hell is this?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: This is not Mega-Desk.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, it's not. They call it Quad-Desk.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's ridiculous, this is made up of three desks.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh my God. We're going to have to re-name it then aren't we? [Dwight's phone rings. He crawls into nook under Jim's Quad-Desk]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hello, Dwight Schrute?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey Jim, Jim. Come here. [holds up photo] Do you know who that is?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Look at him. Look at him – t-shirt, jeans…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Is he you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughs] I am flattered. That's Johnny Depp.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Where did you take that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: In my condo complex.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh my God, that's right. I read in People magazine that he was looking for a two-bedroom condo in Scranton.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am flipping out, man. I mean, you remember my idea for the fourth Pirates movie.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sure. That they should do one.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [feigning accent] Hey, Jim, Jim – where, where do I find the Black Pearl?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Who's that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Captain Jack Sparrow. Captain Jack Sparrow, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: John Dillinger.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. I'm Captain Jack Sparrow.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Captain Crunch.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, okay. Screw you, Halpert. You know, it's not easy getting excited about stuff. Remember how you felt when you thought you'd seen Roger Clemens?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: At the Yankees game. Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. Well, it wasn't him.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I had a little better reason to believe that… You're right. You're right. Well, you're not right, because Johnny Depp…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know, I know.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: …in your condo complex.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know! It also explains why the name on his mailbox was M Shulman.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: M. Night Shulman?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [speaking at a staff meeting] First up, the lost and found has gone missing. It itself is lost, so please, try not to lose anything until we find it. Ah, pet day. If you don't have a pet, please don't feel like –

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: When are we getting to sales topics?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, what about those leads? Did you hear anything from corporate?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ah, yes, the leads. The leads that Sabre has spent $50,000 to get from a market research company… are not here yet. But will be… [muttEring, people rise to leave] No, no, meeting's not over.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: But is there anything relevant to the sales staff here?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No sales topic per se.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well then no Andy Bernard per se. [Andy and others begin exiting the room]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Sorry, Michael, I got calls to make.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I would like your undivided attention, please.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You couldn't handle my undivided attention.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Over the last few weeks, things have been changing here. Sabre says it is our duty to support the sales team and the salesmen are letting it go to their heads. I think it's kind of screwed up, because the way this place used to work was:

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Listen, Michael – about what happened earlier.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: When I was asking about the leads.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: M-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: … is there any news on the leads?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Is that all you have to say to me?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah. You got any news on the leads? … Okay, I'll tell you what. I'm going out on a very important sales call. You get any news about the leads, you try me. All of my numbers. All six of my numbers, okay? Including the car phone! [leaves office] Alright, Dwight out!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Salesman is king. As the best salesman, I am king of kings. Oh, you say Jesus is king of kings? Well. What does that say to you about how I think of myself?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Hm-hm. Do you not answer e-mails anymore? Because I've e-mailed you four times asking you to come to my desk.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Honey, if I don't have time to answer an e-mail, I definitely don't have time to walk over to your desk.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow, wowie wowie. Congratulations. It's a big cheque. [Jim stands in corner, texting]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, sorry, wait one second.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stop sexting Pam. I'm trying to congratulate you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: This is actually a big potential sale, so…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You writing your memoirs over there?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You writing your name over there?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, it's a pretty big check.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's good. You know, with the kid.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. Don't gloat. Here's the thing. This kind of money can corrupt people.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright, here we go. [taps page] Michael…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm just saying, that –

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael – [Michael signs] Great.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [on phone] Very nice. Let me just, let me just write that down real quick. [motions to Darryl] Pencil? Can you give me that pencil? Hang on Teddy… [covers phone] I'm making a sale. Sales.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: There's other pencil's in this office.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Give me that [wrestles with Darryl, Andy falls over chair and to the floor]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Honey and jelly sandwich time. [removes lunch from fridge]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, you got to be kidding me. [holds up squashed sandwich] Look at that. That's –

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I know who did that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You saw who did this and you didn't stop them?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Didn't have to see. It was sales. I can feel it. They are out of control.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The sales department smashed my sandwich.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yes. All of 'em. Together. It's a conspiracy. Listen to me, Mike, you gotta do something about them.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You don't get it.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You need to get back on top.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's what she said.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Something came for you, Michael. [hands him a parcel]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thank you very much.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What'd you get?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ah, just the stupid leads.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: About time.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Me likey!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Finally, Michael. Hand 'em over, numbnuts. [Michael stares at her incredulously] But seriously. It's your job to give us those leads.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright. Then I guess I should give them out. Hold on. You know what I'm thinking? I'm thinking that I have something that you want. You guys are acting like you own this place. And you don't. Not even Sabre owns this place. It's a rental. I'm kind of sick of the attitude around here. I'm sick of the cocky walk, I am sick of you throwing your paycheck in my face, I am sick of your uppity attitude, Jim… I think I am not going to give these to you. [Angela, Kevin and Oscar applaud]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: We need those leads, Michael. It's our job Michael. Michael!

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: [on phone] Michael, we spent a lot of money on those leads. You have to give them out.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Then we are just rewarding their bad behaviour. Okay. Just – imagine that instead of going to jail for murdEring someone, you got an ice-cream cone. If that were the case, then in the summertime, everyone would go around killing people for the pleasure of an ice-cream cone.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Michael, I don't want to incentivise murder. But – we've tried to make it clear that our policy emphasises sales staff –

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: They act like I have no power.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: But you do. You are in charge –

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: – of supporting the sales staff. You are required to hand out those leads, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmm. Well, if that is what I am required to do, I will do exactly that.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Okay, good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Exactly that.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Exactly that.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Why do you keep repeating – [Michael hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello. May I have everyone's attention, please? Gabe has instructed me to hand out the leads, so I'm going to give the leads to… King Creed! [hands him a lead]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What are you –

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: – and to King Meredith! [hands her a lead]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: They aren't salespeople!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And to King Angela! [hands her a lead] Because today we are all kings. And queens [pats Oscar's shoulder].

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What the hell do you think you're doing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm giving them the leads, Phyllis.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So I'm going to go ahead and save you some time, and tell you that no-one's going to go along with this. But you knew that, right?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright. So why don't you just give me my share of the leads, and I'll start making some calls?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. [passes Jim some index cards]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, alright.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ahh, these aren't leads. What are they?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, right, those are clues. And within each clue is a lesson. You learn a lesson, and then you find a lead. The leads are scattered all over the industrial park. I am trying to make your kids respect you. Because a father needs to respect his boss, and kids don't respect the father who doesn't respect the boss. Do you understand that line of logic?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I don't think you understand –

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I do understand it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [holds up card] This one's a map.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Or is it?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh, how the tables have turned. I see you got my e-mail.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Are you gonna give me the leads or not?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I'll give you the leads. But you know what? It's going to cost you some clerical work [hands her a mountain of paperwork]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What are these for?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It doesn't matter. Fill them out. All of them. Then when you're done, you can watch me shred them.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I want to watch the Kardashians! I don't want to watch boring –

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: It's my –

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: The Kardashians is a good show.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: No it's – how would he even know the Kardashians?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: It's about a family. A real-life family.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: No, Stanley, do you –

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [over phone] Hey baby, what's up?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I am currently reading incoherent riddles on blue index cards to find vital information that Michael has hidden all over the office. How are you?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Nothing but vomit and diapers over here.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh my god, I couldn't envy you more.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Having a baby is as exhausting as they say it is. Having two babies [holds up index cards] – that's just unfair.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: How about this one – 'When arrogant salesmen are mean to my face, a certain manager will go to his moppy place.'

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: He means his mopey place, it's under that streetlamp that he thinks was in Casablanca.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I love you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Today I turned an office crisis into a teachable moment. [cuts to Jim fishing one of the leads out of a catEring size tin of Ravioli] A lesser manager would have screwed this day up royally [clue next to Jim reads:

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey. I guess you probably won't give me your leads since I'm a jerk salesman.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah. I basically wish you were dead. [grins] I hid the leads.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Where?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [mimes zipping mouth and throwing away key, Andy begins to walk away] Colder. Colder. Warmer. Warmer. Colder. Colder. Warmer. Warmer. Warmer. Hot. [Andy hovers his hands above her chest] Hotter. Pretty hot. Lower.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Are you…

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Lower.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Are you sure?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Lower [tilts head toward her desk, then flips over her keyboard, revealing the leads. Andy scratches his head, recovEring]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What are you doing, idiot? [Jim is crouched down, peEring under a car]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Michael's stupid scavenger hunt.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Scavenger hunt? Here. I can solve it. Give it. [grabs card] 'The treasure you seek is in the parking lot under the first president.'

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [taps car] Lincoln.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The prankster is getting pranked. Ha ha.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [holds up the retrieved lead] It involves you too.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The leads are in?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael? Michael, you were supposed to tell me when the leads came in.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, bigshot, 'If you want to find your leads, go to the man who never breathes'.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Kevin! Damnit [runs over to Kevin's desk] Kevin, give me those leads. Where are they? C'mon –

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: You are never going to find them.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Really.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I'm going to enjoy this.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [begins to strangle him] Gimme the leads. Where are my leads?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [muffled] I'm still enjoying it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Where are they?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Turn the trash. Turn the trash.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Turn the trash [releases him – Kevin coughs] It's code. Alright, Meredith, take off your dress.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [stands up and reaches for her buttons] Okey-dokey.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No, dear god, no, it's in the trash can. In the kitchen.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: It's coming off anyway.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [dashes to kitchen, overturns the trash can, tastes the bin liner] Clean sack.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: What –

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I emptied it in the dumpster. With Toby's baba ganoush.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: If we don't patronise the only Syrian restaurant in town, there'll be nothing left but pan pizzas and make-your-own salads.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [dives into dumpster, rattling noises then he emerges] It's empty!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wait. What day is today?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Um, tonight is Ghost Whisperer. So, Friday.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh my god. Oh my god [takes off running] oh my god, no, no no, hey, hey [chases after garbage van] wait, wait!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. You know what, let's just go to the dump, start looking – Ryan, c'mon, shotgun in my car –

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Michael, why would we all go to the dump?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why? Because I am not going to call Sabre and say, 'Hi, you know those very valuable expensive leads that you gave us earlier today? Well, because of a screw-up by a staff member, they're now in the city dump."

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Not your staff, Michael. You.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, that's not the way it's going t sound. Here's what we're going to do. We'll go to the dump, we'll look around, then we'll all go out and get pizza, maybe catch a movie, late-night drink, some more pizza, call it a night. What do you –

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Does it have to be pizza? Could go for a, falafel?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I'm not going. You did this, not us.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, no, you encouraged it. You were complicit [looks to Jim for vocab-reassurance] Complicit. You were all successories!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: That sounds fun, mucking around in the dump. Wish I could go.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You can.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I can't. You know that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay fine, I get it. I'll just go by myself.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'll go, Michael. You'll just screw it up.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [looks around dump] This place has gone to hell.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know, Dwight, there was a time when you'd be pinching yourself to have the opportunity to look through a dump with me.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, well, the acorn becomes the oak.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah. Sometimes the acorn just stays the acorn. If you don't believe me, look in my gutters.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [to Oscar] You're adorable. You need to go for it. [Jim enters the break room] I'm going to be, like, mad at you if you don't –

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Phew! Can't wait for this day to be over.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Just all the – drama.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: What drama?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Between the – us and you guys. It's unnecessary, right?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: So unnecessary.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, good, phew, thank god you said that.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I mean, if the salesmen weren't acting like such a bunch of stuck-up losers, then this day wouldn't be so bad – did you ever think of that?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I have new baby pictures.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Don't use your cute baby to make us like you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: She's wearing a onesie [holds out his cell phone, Oscar leans in but Kelly grabs his arm]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: If we act nice now, then we're rewarding them for treating us poorly.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Didn't we kind of start it?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I think you're remembEring that wrong?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I don't know about this. I mean, I think we should hold our ground. The company's changed, and if they don't like it, they can leave. I mean, a lot of their work can be done from India.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Can we at least all agree that this is uncomfortable, and may be heading for something bad?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: All those who agree, say aye [all present – Stanley, Andy and Phyllis – raise their hands] All those opposed –

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I don't think we need opposed.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [kicking through rubbish at the dump] You've changed, man.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, why, because I have a shot at a $100k commission?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Since when do you care about money? When I first met you, you were a wide-eyed innocent.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey. There is nothing I can do about my wide-set eyes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, I'm talking about your personality, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: When I first met you, I had a lot of job offers. And I had an offer from Ivan Schartsky. The Ivan Schartsky. And if I'd assistant managed him –

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Assistant to the managed him –

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, that's low! I would be number two right now at Home Depot!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay? Because they promote from within. Instead I had to follow you – you, going nowhere.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You think you would have done better without me? Really?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I hitched my wagon to a horse with no legs.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow. Ohhhkay. Man. When I think about all the time I wasted being your friend – I shouldn't have been hanging out watching karate movies with you –

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Kung-fu movies!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what, I should have been doing? I should have been out at bars, finding my soul-mate, finding my wife, making babies –

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Nice babies you're making with the floozies at the bars.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's my wife you're talking about, man.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Your made-up wife? Who doesn't exist? [Michael picks up a piece of metal and hurls it at Dwight, who sidesteps] You watch it!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: If I wanted to hit you, I would have hit you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Don't do it [lobs something at Michael]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No no. You just made an enemy with the wrong guy, Dwight. [they throw volleys of rubbish at each other] No, time out, time out. [Michael inspects a box, then hurls it at Dwight] Time in!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No! [lunges for a large wooden spool]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't even think about that [Dwight begins rolling it towards Michael, as he reaches him Dwight kicks it and falls backward. The spool comes to a halt in front of Michael, and Michael pushes it towards Dwight.]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [kicks spool] Stop it, get out! That's my spool.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What's the least we can do to make this okay?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'll text Pam. She's really good at this stuff.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: And I'll text Erin. She's really good at this stuff too.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I guess we could give them some of our new commissions.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: That is a dangerous precedent.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pam texted back saying we could give them all iPods.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh, if they don't have an iPod by now they really don't want one.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright. Then we're back to cash. And I got to say, if giving a small percentage of our commissions is going to smooth all this over, I'm for it.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Okay, fine. Cash it is.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Erin just texted me back. 'People love shells from far-away beaches".

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, Dwight. Here we go [picks up a sink, spills dump juice on his pants] oh god.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh [half-heartedly throws something]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We're never going to find those leads, are we? [they both sit on the edge of a claw-footed bathtub]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [surveys the mountains of trash surrounding them] Wow. Amazing, isn't it. No other animal on earth could do this. Maybe beavers. But not like this.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: So how about, guys, one percent commission a month instead of two, what do you –

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, we agreed, two percent for the quarter. Okay [others enter] Hey everybody!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [stares at the table filled with treats] Nice spread. We get it. You eat like royalty.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, no – this is a representation of how we feel. And how we feel is:

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This [picks up racquet] Why would somebody throw that out?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey [holds up an old sweater] You know who'd like this? Phyllis. Purple, much?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, she does – she loves purple. [Dwight sniffs it] Does it stink?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah [puts it back in the bath tub]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Know what would be a great picture here? Just this whole dump, and in the middle, one flower. That's it. And the caption would read:

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [drives into office parking lot, honking horn. Enormous purple object strapped to the roof of their car] Woo hoo!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Good news that you found our leads?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No! Better!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We have an awesome bean bag chair that's perfect for the break room. [reaches out the window and pats it]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yuck. I'm not going to sit on that disgusting seat.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, damn right you're not. 'Cause it's for me and Michael only [they both cheer and high-five]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [at dump] It's freezing out here.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [strips off jacket] Go on. I have warm blood. [tries to drape her small jacket across Andy's back]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh wow, thank you. You're the nicest person I've ever met. [Andy and Erin kiss]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Michael grunts and strains while doing push-ups] Breathe. Work your core. Come on.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How many is that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Not counting the last one, 25.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Count the last one.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ok, 25 and one girl push-up!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, new record!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, what did you do today?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I made a sale.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, yeah, sitting on your big fat butt. Alright, that is the number to beat.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: What do we get if we do 'em?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: My respect. [everyone returns to work] Okay, I'll make it a little more interesting. Anyone who does more than 25 push-ups –

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: And one girl push-up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Gets to go home. [everyone starts to do push-ups] Ooh! I say 'dance,' they say 'how high?' Here we go. Oh, no. No, no, no. Butt to high. [steps on Angela] Disqualified!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Ow!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What do we got? Creed, disqualified.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [from desk chair] Oh, come on!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: 19. [grunts] I had a really hard work out this morning.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Stanley straining and breathing heavily] Oh, wow, that is adorable!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Ten…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, I'm betting one more.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Eleven, wow!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good.

scenes.speaker: Everyone
scenes.line: [chanting] Stan-ley! Stan-ley! Stan-ley…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright, alright. [chanting continues]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Essentially, what we have here is one of those stories where a mother lifts a car to save her baby.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, it's not exactly fair. He's got all of his weight that's helping him go down.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: 25. Yeah! Come on, you can do it!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: One more, one more! [cheers and applause]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You okay? You okay, Stanley?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Excuse me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow. [applause]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Hey. Matt, right?

scenes.speaker: Matt
scenes.line: Hey, Oscar. You're here early.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I always come in at 7.

scenes.speaker: Warehouse Guy
scenes.line: No, you don't.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Well… Hey, uh, are you doing anything later tonight?

scenes.speaker: Matt
scenes.line: I don't know. I'm free. If you hear of anything going on, let me know.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Yeah, we talked this morning and we talked at Christmas. So, a little momentum there. [tries to open door, locked] Just a couple of hours to kill before work.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Hey, what's up?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Hey, nice office.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Thanks, it's cool. So…

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You know what we haven't done in a while? Happy hour. Upstairs, the warehouse, everybody just going out for a drink.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Has that ever happened? Ever?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Didn't we? I think we did.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You want me to invite Matt?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Yeah, the whole gang, Matt included.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Look, just be straight with me, man. You can be gay with Matt, just be straight with me.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: So happy hour.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Happy hour. My pleasure.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: So what do you think?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hmmm, I saw a new drink on TV I'd like to try. I'll ask Bob.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah, I love going to bars with Bob. I tend to wear something low-cut, get men to flirt with me, and Bob beats 'em up. What?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: A bunch of us are talking about happy hour.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I would love, love, love to go. Only problem is, Pam's at home with the baby and I think she wants a night in.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, baloney.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Good one.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ring her up.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Absolutely, I will do that right now.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I gotta tell you, this baby is amazing. She gets me out of everything. And I – and I love her. I also love her, very much.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So some of the co-workers were thinking of going out tonight, but I told them-

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [on phone] Yes! Yes! I would love to!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ha! Knew it!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [through phone] It's been so long since I've been with adults. I am so excited to see everybody. Creed, Ryan. Oh my God, Stanley! Stanley's going to be there. Yes, oh my God!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I did not see this coming.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Erin, I need you to fax this and get me a confirmation, pronto. [whispEring] Are you going later?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Sure, if you are.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Talk to me that way again, and I'll cut your face off.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Whoa.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: We recently struck up a romantic relationship. And, um… but we're kinda keeping it quiet for now 'cause it's still kind of a new thing. It's a little delicate, and we just don't want all the drama.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Exactly.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, cause when everyone knows- [knock on window, open blinds to Kevin giggling and making sexual gestures] That's actually pretty funny, but in general, you know.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Quiet.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey, boss man.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: A bunch of us are going to get some drinks, you in?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ladies and gentleman, it is quitting time.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'm sorry, I meant later.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, yes. Sure.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: For happy hour?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, I got that.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Trying to get a head count.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am in.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: All right, yes! It's a deal.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's a deal.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, hey, I invited my friend Julie.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I want her to meet Michael.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: They're both single, I have a sense they might-

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You've been gone for a long time.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It is not that. Kevin! Oh!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah! [hugs Pam]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, how are you?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh, I missed you so much.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Aw!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Waaah! [starts to make crying baby noises]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: When a new mom hears a baby cry, her you-know-what's fill up with you-know-what, and then her shirt gets, you know… that would be funny.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, wow, I cannot believe this is happening. This is everything I dreamed. Oh, my God! [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Easy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's not a birthday, it's not a good-bye party…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, hey, Pam and I are gonna go play pool with one of her friends, and we need a fourth.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sucks to be you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Would you like to be our fourth?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That would be sublime.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: So, the guy shows me the deck he's built. And I'm like, 'I'll call this a deck if it'll make you happy, but this is just a porch without a roof.' [laughter, Oscar looks toward door] It was ridiculous man, it was like-you could maybe get two chairs on the thing. Two lawn chairs.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: This is my friend Julie.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello, how are you?

scenes.speaker: Julie
scenes.line: Good. Hi.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What is a nice girl like you hanging out with these bums for? [Julie laughs]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Julie laughs at everything.

scenes.speaker: Julie
scenes.line: So you work with Pam and Jim?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, no, no. Pam and Jim work for me. And if they win, they are fired.

scenes.speaker: Julie
scenes.line: [giggles] I should hope not.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. No, not really. Not really, but they better not win.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, Isabel, you made it. Oh, my goodness.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Of course.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You want to play pool?

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Um, I'm gonna do a lap. See if I know anyone.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: And then they said the most ridiculous thing about Anderson Cooper, which I do not have the decency to repeat, but trust me when I tell you that-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hold that thought. Well, well, well. If it isn't Isabel.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What's a girl like you doing in a place like this?

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: A girl like me is why a guy like you comes to a place like this.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ooh, I love repartee.

scenes.speaker: Isabel
scenes.line: Do you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Usually means there's a battle scene coming.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So, what do you do?

scenes.speaker: Julie
scenes.line: I am an ESL teacher.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Julie
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: See, I didn't think you could teach that. I thought that was something you were born with. What am I thinking right now?

scenes.speaker: Julie
scenes.line: Are you thinking that I said 'ESP?'

scenes.speaker: Michael

scenes.line: [as Cookie Monster] Yum, Yum, Yum, Yum, Yum, Yum.

scenes.line: They're making fun of Cookie Monster. I get that. But in a strange way, it feels like they're making fun of me.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [again on laptop as Cookie Monster as he shows Gabe the video] Oscar, did you eat some of my M&M's? The level…

scenes.line: This is violent and offensive.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Thank you. [computer continues] It really makes me self-conscious about my voice.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: It's awful. [reaches for tissue box, hands it to Kevin]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I'm not crying.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: You have some food on your face.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [on computer as Cookie Monster] Do my hands feel sweaty to you? [Kevin grabs a tissue and wipes his mouth]

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: The beginning here has been a little bit of a fiasco. Either they don't respect me or they respect me too much. And some of them still think that I'm the I.T. guy. This Cookie Monster thing is an opportunity to show people that I'm an authority figure.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Hello, everyone. If I might have a moment of your time. It's come to my attention that people have been watching and laughing at a hurtful parody video. It is now forbidden to talk, joke about, or e-mail this around.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: And that's straight from corporate. So not to be scary, but yeah, I would listen to me. And that's all. Ciao.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in his car with Erin driving to lunch] Would you mind if I listen to my book on tape? I'm kind of a bookworm. This is the novelization of the movie Precious based on the book Push by Sapphire.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I was thinking it would be fun to talk on the way over. So what decade would you have chosen to be a teenager?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [shakes head, annoyed] I don't know.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I would have chosen the 1490's.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ahhh.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: 'Cause America was discovered.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Right. [sighs]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [at lunch] And then my last job was at a Taco Bell express. But then it became a full Taco Bell, and I don't know, I couldn't keep up. My favorite part about being a receptionist is that I get to have my own desk. In my Foster home I never had a desk. [Michael keeps moving around, very clearly bored and annoyed]. So it's like… I don't mean that I didn't like my foster home. I did like it. I just didn't have a desk there. Did you have a favorite age? Or month?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: An age or month?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah, like a favorite month. Like I like April when I was seven.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I've been trying. I've been trying to keep it going. Erin is just weird.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: How many pillows do you sleep on at night?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So how are things going with Andy?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: He's the best boyfriend in the world. Tell me about him before I met him.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, let's see. Um… Andy. Plays the banjo.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah I love that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Other than the fact that he dated Angela, I don't think he is a snappy dresser.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't think he is the best dresser. Reminds me of Easter.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Sorry. About Angela? Did you say he dated Angela?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm-hmm. You didn't know that? Oh.

scenes.line: Here we go. Hot plate.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Hayworth’s waiter
scenes.line: And your salad, miss.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Why wouldn't he tell me that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know. Probably didn't want you to have a mental image of him having sex with somebody else.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: They had sex?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: They were engaged, so… [Erin looks shocked] Okay, you know what, sir?

scenes.line: Yes?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, I asked for pickles with my burger. And there are only, like five or six. Could I get some more pickles?

scenes.line: Of course. I'll get you a bowl of pickles.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Uhhhh, they were engaged?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mm-hmm. Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [face looks disgusted, moves around uncomfortably] Uh-oh…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well…

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [moans, pulls hair over her face]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What are you doing? What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: In the Foster home, my hair was my room. [exhales, prolonged exclaiming]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, okay. You know what? You know what? You know what? Everybody's looking at you right now.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [breathes heavily, groans]

scenes.line: [turns to other restaurant patrons] I'll have what she's having!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in Michael's car] Did you have a… did you like your lunch? Did you have a good lunch? Did you like that? Did you enjoy your food? It was good. I liked my lunch.

scenes.line: What's up?

scenes.line: Her milk is coming in. She's getting uncomfortable.

scenes.line: Dwight, don't be gross.

scenes.line: No, no, he's right.

scenes.line: Really? Fine. Let your breasts explode. Three squeezes and I would drain you.

scenes.line: Relax?!

scenes.line: God, Oscar, will you keep your pants on? It's easy.

scenes.line: You know what, I think we can all agree that Angela's not so great, so…

scenes.line: I am saying the exact opposite. Angela is fantastic.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. No. No.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Specific shout-out…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stop talking.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ok. As some of you may know, I have a very special connection with Secretary's Day in the form of that 115 pound moonbeam over there named Erin Hannon. To a lot of you she may just be the person who brings you your fax comformations. But to me, she is my girlfriend… in addition to being the person who brings me my fax comformations. scenes.line: Oh God.
