scenes.line: Can we talk about this in private?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I don't want to be in private. Is it true or is it not?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Who else did you sleep with? Did you sleep with Phyllis or Kelly or Pam? Maybe all together?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, no never.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Did everyone know? Was I the only one who didn't know?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah pretty much.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Who are you?! I don't know you! [pushes someone away to leave]

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I should probably get involved in this, but I think my energy is better spent on the Cookie Monster issue.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Erin, you know, if I had been engaged to anyone before you, I would've told you.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: So if you need anything, I'm right over there.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [imitating Cookie Monster] "Hey, Erin, You look delicious. I mean, beautiful."

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Ok. Ok there. I heard that. So I'm sorry, Pam, but that's it. I'm going to have to suspend you without pay for two days.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What? What do you mean, suspend me?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think you need to go a little easy. You can't just suspend someone form work.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Yeah, you're right. You know what? Um, you're suspended too Jim. [Dwight starts to clap] Ok fine. You too Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wait, What? I was just slow-clapping your no-nonsense decision-making.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I don't want to hear it. Suspended.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: "C" is for suspension.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Why would that be something to talk about on Secretary's Day?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Andy, she's not the easiest person in the world to have a conversation with. All right? And besides, who doesn't tell their girlfriend that they were engaged to someone who works four feet away from them? That's like… that's like Mr. and Mrs. Smith crap.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I was going to tell her, just on my own time.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what, I resent the implication that I would keep that secret. Everyone here knows that I can't and won't keep a secret.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Who cares? I mean it's not like I killed someone. Big deal right? This can blow over in two seconds. She never asked me. So, if you think about it… I probably should have told her I guess. Everybody does stupid things.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Psst. Hey. Erin.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You want to talk to me, come to my desk.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: You embarrassed me earlier.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh. Take it up with the chief of police.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: You think I want people remembEring I had sensual relations with Andy? It's the kind of thing you wish you could have annulled. I want to throw up just thinking about it.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I want to throw up just thinking about it.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: You are throwing up for the wrong reasons!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [standing behind Erin] I don't think this fax is going through. Is there a different… I can just put it through again, you know.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey. You know I was engaged before Jim.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah. And he worked here too.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: It was Andy, wasn't it?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, no it wasn't Andy. It wasn't. It doesn't matter. It's not about who you've been with. It's about who you end up with. Sometimes the heart doesn't know what it wants until it finds what it wants.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I hope you find what you're looking for.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank you. [kisses Jim on the cheek]

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: [talking on the phone] So I can reprimand them but I can't suspend them. Oh I can't do either. Uh huh. Fair enough.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [answers phone] Hey Toby.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I called Tallahassee. He can ask you not to come in, but he can't dock your pay. That's not legal.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Very interesting.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Yeah, I also learned some interesting things about how they structure…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [Gabe walks in] Thanks Toby.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Hey everyone. Hi. Quite an afternoon, huh? Cathartic in a way. I'm glad I got to share it with you. It makes you think about what's really important. [Pam hands Jim a note] It's not about showing you're in charge or flexing some sort of authority. It's about forgiveness. And yes, I'm talking about you three in this desk clump right here. I think that, if you were to apologize to me, then I would revoke your suspension.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't think an apology is enough. I really think the only way for me to learn my lesson is to take my suspension.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And I got to take this bad attitude, and I got to go home, and I got to adjust it. And I hope the suspension does that.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [gets up and walks towards Gabe] Prideful idiots. Watch how it's done. [Jim and Pam get their things together and start to leave] Gabriel, I apologize.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Great.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [gets on one knee] I kneel before you.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Guys, I would even take a contrite look as an apology.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Humbly taking your hand upon which I kiss to show my contrition.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: [following Jim and Pam to their car] Guys, to err is human. [trying to block their car]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Trust is the most important thing to me. Is your name Andy Bernard? What's your real name? Lionel Frankenstein?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Will you stop walking for one second? That's it. There's no other secrets. Ok? I mean yeah, my chest is not naturally hairless, and my parents pay my credit card bill.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: How long were you guys together?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: A year.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: A year? You were together for a year?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah but that's it. Now you know everything about me. I promise. And if I think of anything else…

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I think I have to be on my own for a little bit. Like the girl Precious in Precious. Based on the novel Push by Sapphire. Ok?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I didn't see that movie.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: [walking back into the office] That was ugly. I'm sorry you had to see that.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Do they still get paid?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: It's tacky to discuss finances. It's best to pretend that this never happened.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Sounds like they just got to go home with pay.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Pathetic.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Can I buy everyone coffees? [everyone shakes their heads] [in Cookie Monster voice] "Or cookies."

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What was that? Are you kidding me? Was that an impression?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Alright.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [imitating Gabe] Uh guys, I'm now going to apologize for the mess that we're in because corporate told me to. I just want you to know that I laugh like a crazy person.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: You got to be able to laugh at yourself. I'm one of the gang.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: "I have to go back to the zoo to the stick insect exhibit."

scenes.line: "Ciao" Right? "Ciao. I say Ciao because I'm fancy from Tallahassee."

scenes.line: [sitting on bench outside groaning]

scenes.line: Erin?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh. Sorry I thought everyone was gone.

scenes.line: No, no, I was just watching Cookie Monster. It finally downloaded. Mind if I sit down?

scenes.line: I can't trust Andy anymore.

scenes.line: Oh. Yep. I'm sorry about that. I feel… I'm sorry I caused that thing.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: It's Andy's fault.

scenes.line: Well, yeah, yes. But I still feel sorry. You know what, I wouldn't worry about Angela. She doesn't hold a candle to you, Erin. She's old enough to be your mom for one thing. And she's, like, three feet tall. And she wears pioneer women clothing. And I don't think she's ever pooped in her life. And Andy, you know, come on. Andy, his butt looks big in those khakis.

scenes.line: Oh, I like his butt.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You said butt.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You tricked me!

scenes.line: Ahh! You said it! You know who you would love? Oh, this guy in my neighborhood, Tom Dizemore. This is him:

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Sometimes telling someone something is hard. Well, at least someone made her happy on Secretary's Day.

scenes.line: Hey Kevin it's Oscar. I'm looking at the sheet you sent me. And I can't seem to find the column for shipping cost.

scenes.line: I made the most brilliant retaliation video. It's awesome.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I don't get it.

scenes.line: Yeah, I mean, the Count has a very distinct voice.

scenes.line: That would have been funny.

scenes.line: [walking up] Oh, oh, I was just watching that. Did you do that, man? "Oscar. I am the Count." Nailed him. Nailed him. [Gives Kevin a fist pump] Good work Cookie Monster.

scenes.line: Buenos dias, Miguel. [phone rings] Hello, Dunder-Mifflin.

scenes.line: La telefona.

scenes.line: "Intercourse to completion. Five individual times rendered at my discretion?"

scenes.speaker: Lawyer
scenes.line: Look, I don't think that's actually legal.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Agreed. [shakes hands with Angela]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Five times for $30,000? Not a bad stud fee. Better than most horses.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: But not in your bed. It's lumpy.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Those lumps are cats, and those cats have names, and those names are Ember, Milky Way, Diane, and Lumpy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Fine. Five times. [signs contract]

scenes.speaker: Lawyer
scenes.line: Look, I can't legally watch this unfold. It's coming a little dangerously close to prostitution.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I want eye contact.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Do you understand how rare is that in nature?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I'm not some farm animal. [Dwight smirks at the camera]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Great game, coach.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Shh! Okay, all right. Don't, don't.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You guys are awesome! Best game I've ever seen in my life.

scenes.speaker: Shane
scenes.line: Yeah, right. You must be rootin' for the other guys.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ha. The other guys can go die.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [whispers] Okay.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Baseball! Go talk to him.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. God. You go talk to him.

scenes.speaker: Shane
scenes.line: Let's go.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Shane. Great game man!

scenes.speaker: Shane
scenes.line: Do I know you?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No. Uh, just big fans. Both of us.

scenes.speaker: Shane
scenes.line: Are you somebody's… parents? Oh, are you guys… Kenny's dads?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ha. No. No. But we're gay for baseball. [chuckles]

scenes.speaker: Shane
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: But I have a wife, actually, who I really love a lot.

scenes.speaker: Shane
scenes.line: Okay. Let's go!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah. I am so into the institution of marriage.

scenes.speaker: Shane
scenes.line: Whoa!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I mean, isn't marriage the best, you know? Two good people finding each other, getting all committed to each other. So you love baseball. What else do you love? Let's round you out as a person.

scenes.speaker: Shane
scenes.line: Hey, I'm really sorry, I'm just trying to… focus here on the game.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I get it, man. I love it. That's what makes you a good coach. You know, but as a fan, it just helps me enjoy the game better if I know the coach loves his wife.

scenes.speaker: Shane
scenes.line: Of course. Okay? I gotta… get back to this.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Of course.

scenes.speaker: Shane
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: But real quick, I want you to meet my associate. Sheldon!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Come on, get over here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm good. Oh, my God.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Get- Get over here. Sheldon, say hi to the nice coach.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sorry. I got some stomach cramps.

scenes.speaker: Shane
scenes.line: It's all right. It's all right. Keep it going.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, that was not at all what I expected. Hoo hoo! Whoo. My heart's still racing. I just looked a man in the eyes and I shook his hand. All the time I was thinking, "I'm sleeping with your wife." And you know who does that? James freakin' Bond.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, orange slices. There ya go.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Thanks, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't thank me. Thank Dylan's mom. Here you go! Oh! Ooh Hoo Hoo Hoo hoo!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Why would you throw something wet at me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You love it. There ya go.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Now, were those for the team?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Uh, no, they didn't say team. They just said coal Hawks.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't think those were yours to take.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, then it wouldn't be the first time I stole something away from Coach Shane.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I just wanna go on record as saying that I do not condone this affair, and I went so far as to force Michael to confront the victim of his behavior.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Did you talk to him?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I did.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You talked to the man whose wife you're having an affair with.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Wow. That is crazy.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Was there a fistfight?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. We just talked. He's very nice.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: And it didn't change your mind.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It did not.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Michael, that's awful.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Isn't it?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm awful, aren't I?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah. That's pretty bad.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm an awful guy! Ooh!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: How can you live with yourself?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am what I am, Oscar. And I want what I want. And right now, I want a piece of cake. From now on, when I'm hungry, I am going to eat whatever I am hungry for.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: That is a dangerous game, friendo.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Well, because I thought that it was a book about Anthropology the store.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I don't know why you were in that part of the bookstore.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: 'Cause it's next to they baby section, okay?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: All right, that makes more sense. You should have said that at the beginning when you said, "I read a book about anthropology."

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I don't really know why you're screaming at me right now.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I'm not scream– I'm not screaming.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: That's Meredith's cake. It's her birthday.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't care. I have an appetite for life! [eats cake] Mmm. Mmm! Oh, god. That's Lemon.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Good for you, man. Good for you.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: He takes what he wants.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: You know what? I think you're attractive, and I wanna sleep with you.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: What about Kelly?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: You read my mind.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [quietly] Is this a joke?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: It's hard to live that way man. You gotta really not care what people think about you. I-I don't know how you do it, Michael, I-I-I can't be that cold.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You'll learn, baby. You'll learn.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [pressing buttons to start microwave and moves towards his crotch] I am an honorable man, and I will honor the contract. But I don't have to give her the good stuff. Schrute sperm are strong, [banging on his crotch with drum sticks] but they're no match for a grown Schrute man. [drops yellow pages against his crotch] [screaming] [chuckling] Let's see what she gets. [bouncing crotch on bike and crashes into glass door] [thud] Aah!

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [Michael leaving copy machine] Uh, boss, we're out of paper.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, I noticed that.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Are you gonna add any more?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nope.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: He don't give an "F" about nothin'!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have got big balls.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't think I'm gonna make it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [yawning] What about an energy drink or something?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [shakes head] It gets in the breast milk. If I drink it, Cece drinks it six hours later.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, it doesn't mean I can't drink it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, it does and it doesn't.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Probably shouldn't tell you this, but a lotta guys in the warehouse work multiple jobs, so… we have a place.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: A place?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: A restful location. Talk to Glen. He'll take you up in the lift.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You sleep in the warehouse?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Lightbulb's burnt out, so it's dark. And the heat from the backup generator keeps it nice and warm. Sometimes I think about it when I'm trying to fall asleep at home. But as far as the rest of the office goes, it doesn't exist, okay?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: For your signature. [drops document on Michael's desk]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. [Phyllis avoids looking at Michael] Phyllis. Okay. Look at me. [continues to look away] Phyllis, look at– [Phyllis turns to leave] okay, that's… [chases after her] All right, all right. You know what? I'm sick of this. I'm sick of the little disapproving head shakes. If you think that's going to have any effect on me, it will not. I am going to leave right now and go to a motel to meet Donna.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Why not your condo?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because a motel is dirty and it is sexy. Like me. And like Donna. And frankly, the stuff that we're into isn't very condo-appropriate.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Oh, Michael, will you drop it? Everybody's spoken their mind, and no one's changing their mind.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, Morgan Freeman-narrating-everything.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Do you want someone to stop you? 'Cause no one's going to.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nobody better try to stop me. Good. [leaves the office. door closes]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I could have stopped him.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Are you warmed up? [outside sliding door in warehouse]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: God, Angela, why is that always my responsibility? [zipper sound]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: What did you do to yourself? [camera pans to Jim and Pam laying down in restful location]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Never mind. Just never mind.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Well, it better work.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, it'll work. [Jim and Pam look shocked and disturbed] Mm. Stop kissing me. It's not in the contract.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [driving in car; returns to office; grabs ice cream out of freezer] How do I feel about breaking up with Donna? Good. Moral. I feel proud. [beeping; cut to Donna who is waiting in the parking lot of the motel] Like a grownup.[Donna receives text from phone] That was not easy because I really liked her a lot. And I'm a little bit emotional right now because I know that I absolutely made the right decision. [Donna has disappointed look; cut back to Michael in his office opening ice cream] At the end of the day, we have to do what's right. And it was either living with myself or… being happy. And I picked… the… former.

scenes.speaker: Reporter
scenes.line: Michael Scott?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes?

scenes.speaker: Reporter
scenes.line: Do you wanna make a comment on the rumors?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sighs] Umm… I have done some very bad things, things of which I am not proud. I would like to publicly apologize to… the coach and the players. And I vow to never listen to my bodily instincts ever again.

scenes.speaker: Reporter
scenes.line: I'm talking about the Sabre printers that catch on fire.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh. Okay. I was talking about… what do– what? What's going on?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [on Youtube video] There is nothing wrong, nor will there ever be wrong with any Sabre printers. Case closed. [phone rings, Michael picks it up] Michael Scott, as seen on TV.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: [high-pitched voice] I saw you on the news and I want to pinch your tiny wiener… [normal voice] It's Packer!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: OH! Pack Man, I thought you were a girl!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Apparently, there are allegations that Sabre printers can cause a fire. So they asked me to give a statement to the press. I'm like, what? All right. So I do it. It's on TV last night. And it's in the paper today. And it's online. And then I call Froggy 98.7, the request line. I talk to the host about it on the air. It's like, come on, people, enough.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Everybody, we are at DEFCON 5. I am officially the second-most watched clip of the day on the WBRE news site.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What's number one?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, that teacher who was wrongfully accused of being a pedophile. Now, we cannot let the pedophile win again! I would like you all to go to the website and watch my clip eleven times.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So instead of working, you want…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes. Come on! Get it up! That's what… let's do it!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh, did you see this report that the zoo got a baby otter? It's on the same site!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Awww, it's kissing its mommy!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Please.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Michael, you have to see, this is like, the cutest thing ever.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really? A baby otter? Okay, um, count me in as who cares. It's not even that interesting a baby otter, it can't even stand up. [looks toward computer] It's trying to stand up… [choking up] there it goes.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Howdy. I hope I'm not interrupting anything.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jo! We were not expecting you!

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: 'Course you all, no doubt, know why I'm here.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Turns out our printers are famous. They're all over the news. It's an interesting story. Cheap foreign printers attacking innocent Americans. Well, actually the, the real story isn't quite as racy, but uh… let's give it a go.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Jo, I think that I know what happened.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: I'm not sure you do, teddy bear.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Well, now I think I might not.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Not long ago, we discovered a defect in one of our printers, so we got a software patch and fixed it right up, just like that. I don't know how it works. But just as we were about to send out a letter to our affected customers, giving 'em free toner, and we keep 'em, happy, but somebody here, they liked that first story better. The one where we lose half our clients for no damn good reason! Whoever it was who talked to the press, they should come forward, please.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jo, Jo, I can assure you it was no one in this office.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Can you now?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Absolutely. Anyone who talked to the press, please raise your hand.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [quietly, to Andy] Put your hand up, Norma Rae.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: If you say anything, so help me God, I'll break off the temples of your glasses and stick them in your eye sockets.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: So unfair. Even if I thought that our printers killed baby seals, I would not be a whistleblower. The Bernards, for generations, have silenced whistleblowers. It's how we made all our money. Woody Guthrie wrote a song about us. [sings] Old Mr. Bernard, old Mr. Bernard, who have you silenced today?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: [as Gabe hands out forms to everyone] It's a little form, says "I did not do it."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There is no reason for anyone here to sign this, because I know everything there is to know about these people. I know when their birthdays are, I know what their favorite kind of cake is, I know what color streamers they like…

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: All that's just birthday information, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, yes, but it shows a bigger picture.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Why don't you come with me? We'll start out with the honcho, what'cha say?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: When Mama was working as a prison guard and something went missing, she'd ask one question:

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: So say we catch this whistleblower, what do you think I should do with him?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We should give him a one-way ticket to Montego Bay, where they keep all the al-Qaeda.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Uh, that's, uh, Guantanamo Bay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes. You put them in jail for a long time, you put them in jail for as long as you can.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well, I guess we're all right, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I want these people to really pay, I want them to suffer. I'd prefer it if they died, 'cause it's not right.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Nick
scenes.line: Hey Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey, IT guy.

scenes.speaker: Nick
scenes.line: Mind if I get in there for a second?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, sure thing, go ahead.

scenes.speaker: Nick
scenes.line: Just one… [Dwight pushes Nick's neck to the desk and pushes his arm up] Gah! Ah! Dwight, what the hell?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Apache persuasion hold, that's the hell! What are you doing to my computer?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: The lawyers are searching our hard drives for information on the leak. Thanks a lot, Big Brother.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You're with Big Brother? Okay, go ahead. I got nothing to hide.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Wait, are they searching all our computers?

scenes.speaker: Nick
scenes.line: Yeah. [Kevin runs to his desk] I already got to yours, Kevin. [Kevin runs back]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No, that's cool. Sometimes… sometimes I run. I'm a runner.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Everybody knows it was Andy, and it is not fair for us all to take the fall for his big stupid mouth!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ridiculous, Angela. And like I'm going to believe one of his spermed lovers.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Look, he's been complaining about this for a while, it's not crazy.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Okay Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hold that thought. I don't want to waste your time, and I wouldn't dare waste mine. I didn't do it. Now, I don't know exactly who did it, but I have a list right here… [hands Jo a piece of paper] You should fire the following people.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well, I'm inclined to believe you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why would I disparage a company that has made me rich beyond my wildest dreams?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Yeah, I noticed you've had a great year. Good boy… you turning that money into more money?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Are you referring to alchemy?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: I don't like to tell a man what to do with his money, but if you ain't investing in property, then you're dumber than a dummy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm not dumb. I'm smart.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well, buy property. That's my advice.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Is there something that you would like to say to me?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: About talking to the press?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I, I didn't know. I didn't do that!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay? I, I… didn't do it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't believe you.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I swear on the graves of my parents who aren't even dead yet.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's a little much. All right, all right, all right.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I don't care, that's how much I swear!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, I believe you, I believe you.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I don't know who's giving Darryl any crap. He was more bothered about it than me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did you tell anyone outside of this office that the printers were catching on fire?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah, I did. I, I was talking to this girl at a bar.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, no, no, no…

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I think she could… sense my sadness, and I, and I found out too late that she… she's the copy editor at the Trib.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh my god. Was she cute?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, god, Darryl!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I basically swore up and down that none of my employees did it, and then I find out that one of my best ones did. And now he's probably going to get fired for it. And if that is not poetic justice, I don't know what is.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Sounds like you were as blindsided by this as I was.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, that's…

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: And we didn't find anything on your computer.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Good.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Except this. [hands stack of paper to Toby]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Oh, wow, this is, uh, just a mystery novel that I've been working on.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: I know what it is. I skimmed the first chapter. I'm just curious, why would a man who hates people want to have a relationship with a maid?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Oh, uh, I don't know, uh…

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: The way I look at it, there's only one of two reasons. He knows a secret about her that she doesn't know herself, or he wants to use her services to mop up after a murder.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Oh… yes.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Write your own damn novel.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It was me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What was you? You were the leak?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay. I'm talking to this woman at daycare…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh-huh.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: She's telling me about all her amazing trip to Vietnam, I have nothing. I tell her our printers catch on fire, spontaneously!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Why'd you do that?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Her husband's a reporter.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So now everyone hates Andy, and it's this whole mess, and I don't know what to do.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, just relax. Just need to relax.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I could tell Jo… or I could tell Michael.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: This is a very good idea. This is good. Let's get all the bad ideas out now. Flush them out.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You leaked it?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't know what to do! Do I go tell Jo, or – I don't want everyone to keep blaming the wrong person!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know what the best plan is, Pam. Oh god… my mind is going a mile an hour.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That fast?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Two whistleblowers… two! I always thought Darryl and Pam might get me fired for something I said.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [Michael knocks on Pam's desk] Yeah? [Michael points at Pam, himself, and Meredith, mimes drinking, driving, then points to his watch and holds up five fingers] I weirdly know exactly what you're saying to me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So see you in Meredith's van in five minutes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, you didn't need to actually say it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [in Meredith's van] I have never seen so many parking tickets.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: All right, this is just messed up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, you know what's messed up? This situation all up in here is what's messed up! We need to brainstorm, we need to get out of this! Brain hurricane. Come on, think.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What do we got?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Um…

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [opening door] Hey guys, sorry I'm late.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We're not going for yogurt.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's okay, she's cool, she also whistle-blew.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Guys, I couldn't help it, it is so boring where we work. I mean, it's as interesting as a morgue. It might be less interesting than a morgue.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey, hey, it's as interesting as a morgue.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Of course I'm the leak! I think I Tweeted it! I can't control what I say to people, I spend the whole day talking! I mean, I video chat, I Skype, I text, I Tweet, I phone, I Woof…

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Woof is a site that I'm launching to be the last word in social networking. For just $12.99 a month, Woof links up all your communication portals so you are always within reach. It's part of the dog pack, as I call it. But, look, why tell you when I can show you. [types on his phone] I just sent myself a Woof. [fax machine makes noise, several windows pop up on computer behind Ryan with accompanying sounds, including barking]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [on phone] Ryan, you have a Woof on line 1.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Thank you, Erin. Woof!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, here's what we do. I say we just smash all the computers. We destroy the evidence. No evidence, no case.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wouldn't we get fired for smashing all the computers?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No. Okay, not all the computers, just our computers.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: That idea sucks.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't think that's a good idea.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just don't say no.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Michael, you know you don't have to turn us all in. All you need is one scapegoat.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Uh, if you turn me in, I'm turning in Darryl.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's just what we need, another black man in prison. You know, let's just…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Nobody's going to prison, okay? Um… all right, Michael, you need to convince Jo to go easy on us. And then we'll all confess once we know our jobs are safe.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. You can count on me.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [sees Toby banging on the vending machine] Let me give you a hand.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I'm hungry.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ready? [they pull the vending machine towards them; Dwight's phone rings] Got it? Oh shoot. Got it? [walks away, opens phone] Dwight Schrute.

scenes.speaker: Realtor
scenes.line: [on phone] The property you're looking at is in great shape. By the way, it has a very spacious basement office.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Basement office? You mean like a lair?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey Jo.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I was thinking about our little leak problem. I was up all lunch thinking about what we should do to this individual. You know what I think we should do? We make 'em come to work, and we work 'em, and we make 'em sit next to all the people they screwed over. And, and we pay 'em but we make 'em feel like they did something really wrong. The one question I have is, do we give them a Christmas bonus? I say yes, it's Christmas, but right after they're back in the thick of it.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Michael Scott… what do you know?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It doesn't matter what I know.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: If it doesn't matter, then tell me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Because I want to deal with it the way I deal with it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, deal with this. [crosses arms]

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Empathize with me for a moment. I came up here with a big problem, and now I got a branch manager who's giving me the silent treatment… Speak to me… speak. [Jo's dog barks] Come with me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: [as Michael and Jo leave] Are you leaving? Oh, am I… should I continue with the investigation?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Are you going to kill me?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Hahahahahaha.

scenes.speaker: Realtor
scenes.line: [on phone] I just need you to come by later and sign a few forms.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Realtor
scenes.line: What time works for you? [Dwight looks across the street] Mr. Schrute, what time works?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Cancel it. I want you to make an offer at seventeen twenty-five Slough Avenue. Make 'em an offer they can't refuse. No, on second thought, low ball them. Don't call me 'til you have it.

scenes.speaker: Realtor
scenes.line: But… [Dwight closes phone]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [on Jo's jet] Are we going some place far away? I know you said no questions, but… I have an early dinner that I need to get to… with the Chief of Police.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I'm very relieved to learn it wasn't you.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: All right. Uh, Stan, you're up.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: It wasn't me.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: What a rich timbre your voice has. Okay, I am prepared to conclude the investigation. And… you did it. [nods at Andy]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What? Based on what?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Uh, just all the evidence. And it really seems like it was you. Can we all agree to say that it was Andy for now, and sit with it, see how it feels?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: All right. Sounds good.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Guys, I think that seems a little unfair. I mean, I feel like we don't definitely know it was Andy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah. You know, I mean, for all we know it could have been… Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have rights.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Let's just talk.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am not going to tell you anything.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Honey, you don't seem like your normal self.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I'm going through a little bit of a rough patch.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Mama Jo knew there was something up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Whole year, actually. My favorite restaurant closed down.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh, I hate that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And my new favorite restaurant sucks… I bought a video camera last year, and I was looking at the tapes, and there were only like twelve minutes that I felt was worth taping the whole year. And most of that was just birds in my condo complex. What is that? … I miss Holly.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Who's Holly?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Holly Flax from the Nashua branch. Best HR rep that Dunder Mifflin has ever seen. It's not been a blockbuster year for me financially. My Blockbuster stock is down.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Well, I think that the real question is:

scenes.speaker: David Wallace
scenes.line: I may have heard from an old client, and I may have immediately started spreading the news to other clients and potential clients, yeah. But I'm not here to talk about that. I am here to talk about Suck It. Suck it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Gabe, I told you all about the printers.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I mean, it could be you, Gabe. I mean, that's the point.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes, it's totally obvious.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I think we all can agree that it's either Gabe or Angela. [flips a coin] It's Angela. Get her, boys.

scenes.speaker: Nick
scenes.line: Hey guys, uh, sorry to interrupt. I just wanted to say goodbye to everyone. Through Teach for America, I'm going to go down to Detroit and teach, uh, inner city kids about computers.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Uh, not now.

scenes.speaker: Nick
scenes.line: Oh yeah, it's just that my friends are in the car waiting, so I thought I would…

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [quietly] Phyllis, what's this guy's name again?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I don't know, is it Shadow or Garth, it's something weird, I…

scenes.speaker: Nick
scenes.line: My name is Nick.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Okay, well, Nick, we're in a meeting.

scenes.speaker: Nick
scenes.line: Okay, look, I get it, people. I'm the lame IT guy, and everybody hates me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, listen man, you can't take it personally.

scenes.speaker: Nick
scenes.line: You called me man? I just said my name just now, did you forget it already?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No… sport.

scenes.speaker: Nick
scenes.line: You, you guys have fifteen parties a week, you can't learn my name?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey IT guy. Here's the story, champ. None of us have spent a lot of time getting to know you, okay? We liked the last guy, Siddiq, because he kept to himself, and we also thought he might have been a terrorist. You know what, I'm going to leave you with one other thought. Inner city kids use computers for two things, games and porn. So good luck wasting your life, lurch.

scenes.speaker: Nick
scenes.line: Thank you so much for that. I saw all your hard drives, and guess what? [gestures to Ryan] You're not a photographer. [gestures to Kelly] And you definitely can't fit into a size two. Darryl, man, you're on Facebook. Why you been telling people you're not on Facebook? People want to be your friend, man! All right? And you. [points to Andy] This guy, you're the one who told the press. You wrote an e-mail to the editor. I saw it, and I also saw a QuickTime movie of your little printer fire test on your hard drive. This guy's the snitch, he's the snitch. So that's it, check it out. [gives the finger]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You're going to believe that guy?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: When I was growing up, there was nothing better than being a big old business tycoon. And I thought I'd break that glass ceiling and be a hero to all those little girls out there… and they'd make a Barbie out of me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hmm, hmm.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: I, did I sell cheap printers? I do. But if I have to go out there in front of the press and make one of them public apology recalls, I mean, it's all I'll ever be remembered for. Nobody will want to play with my Barbie.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know, I would be willing, under the right circumstances, to do that for you.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh honey, surely you don't want that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I, I surely do, and don't call me honey. [Jo laughs] You were playing too.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm about to buy this building, you know.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: You don't say? I own a one-eighth share in a rental property down in Pittston.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well, I'm one-eighths proud of you… enjoy that chair for now… 'cause pretty soon, you will be on your feet, at Buckingham Palace.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey Phyllis, have you seen my bag?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [points to the ceiling] You deserve it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Look, I didn't want houses and schools to burn down, and children to die. Does that make me a hero? I…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [offscreen] No, it does not!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, it doesn't make me the worst guy in the world, either.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It does!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Andy?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I wanted to say that I think it was very brave of you to go to the press.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh, thanks. Yeah, you know, just seemed like the right thing to do.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to press] We at Sabre have betrayed the trust that we have built with our customers. We regret our slow response and our lapse in candor and judgment. At this time, we are issuing a full recall of all Sabre GH400 printers. We will not rest until this problem is solved. There will be no questions. Are there any questions?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Hey, I appreciate you reading that statement. You looked pretty up there.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That was fun.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: I hope your rough patch ends soon.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thanks. Today helped.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well, give me a shout if I can brighten your life.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. Hey, you could transfer Holly back from Nashua.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Let me see what I can do.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [to Toby, who's filming] You fallin' behind.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [jumps in front of camera] Wuphf.com!

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Ryan, we're doing the dance!

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: This is how you build a business. This is how you make it in this country.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [Bluetooth rings] You got Creed.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: -and you jump in front of them.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: You make it so hard to love you sometimes.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Still behind.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [closing door] I said I didn't want to be on the internet!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Go, go, go, go!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [performs magic-tricks while lip-syncing]

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: Streamers! [everyone throws streamers in the air and starts dancing]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hiya! Ha! [climbs on Phyllis' desk and starts kicking things off, bites off the head of a stuffed animal]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Dwight! [Dwight pulls out a hunting knife and jumps off desk]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Are you crazy?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [song ends] Toby, how did we do?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, that was better.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Whoo! We did it! [everyone starts cheEring]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I suppose summer had to end sometime. It's sad, though, because I had a great summer. I got West Nile virus, lost a ton of weight. Then I went back to the lake. I stepped on a piece of glass in the parking lot, which hurt. That got infected even though I peed on it. Saw 'Inception.' Or at least I dreamt I did.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Brocolli Rob, obviously, will be there.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yes, of course.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: And JC. We call him Blorville, because he looks like a black Orville Redenbacher.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Who's the guy who invented the peanut?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Hey, guys.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Sorry, didn't mean to interrupt.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Not at all.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I'm gonna head back to Siberia there. Ciao. [he and Erin kiss]

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I started dating Erin this summer. It has been, in a word, exquisite.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Gabe is awesome. He has accomplished so much career-wise and height-wise. Thank God he's my boss because I would not have said yes to a first date if I didn't have to, but… it's been great.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Am I angry that Gabe stole my girlfriend over the summer? No. I've been through anger-management, OK? So right now, I am sitting on a nice beach at Cape Cod, gazing out across the whitecaps. Oh, look, it's a humpback whale. How pretty. He's eating Gabe.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [goes to change thermostat as Dwight puts a locked cover over it] Hey. What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: From now on, if you're hot, sit on an ice pack.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Well, what if you're cold?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Like you'd ever be cold, Kevin. Stop asking me hypothetical questions, OK? I'm too busy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Dwight, I don't know if you heard, but we're supposed to be drinking out of weird backpacks instead of cups, like regular people. Oh, you did hear.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [drinking from Camelback] Jim, you have one job to do. And you do it forgettably. Those of us who are busy require hands-free hydration.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Dwight Schrute, star salesman, beet farmer, bed-and-breakfast proprietor, aspiring freelance bodyguard. Add to that list owner of this building. Then burn the list.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: This summer, I did the minority executive training program at Yale. You guys, I'm, like, really smart now. You don't even know. You could ask me, "Kelly, what's the biggest company in the world?" And I'd be like, "blah blah blah, blah blah blah blah blah blah," giving you the exact right answer.

scenes.speaker: Luke
scenes.line: Coffee Monkey's arrived.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: The coffee's supposed to be here at 9.

scenes.speaker: Luke
scenes.line: Here you go, Big O. Tiny. [hands Kevin his coffee] Darryl Hannah.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: It says decaf. You get me decaf?

scenes.speaker: Luke
scenes.line: Ooh, yeah. Must've been some sort of mix-up there. You could just drink it, or I could drive all the way back?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: My summer, I, um, blew out my knee playing softball. Ended up watching CNN most of the time. I don't know how we're going to get out of Afghanistan. I hate the new assistant. He's only been here for a week, and I hate him.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: New guy sucks. Calls me the Nard-Man. I'm the Nard-Dog, okay? Nard-man is my father.

scenes.speaker: Luke
scenes.line: My name is Luke Cooper. I love cinema. My favorite movies are Citizen Kane and The Boondock Saints.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That kid is the worst. Needs to be fired, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: He's not the worst, okay? He's not the worst. You know who's the worst? That intern we had a few years ago. That guy-remember? Eeeh! That face, how ugly he was? He was the worst. Good worker, though. [starts drinking coffee] Ah! It's not cappuccino.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: He messed yours up to.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: He's got to go, Mike.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's just coffee, guys! But, yeah, I'll look into it, okay?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow, that's a lot of keys.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The bigger the key chain, the more powerful the man.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's right. The janitor said that. By the way, the raccoons are back.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Where?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think they run through these panels and then down under the map. I wouldn't know for sure cause I don't have a trained ear. That's why I have to use one of these. [pulls out stethoscope]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Give me that.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yep. Wait, and this. [hands Dwight a hammer]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Go get 'em.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What happened to me this summer? Dwight bought the building, so actually, this has been the busiest summer of my life.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Jim quietly takes Dwight's keychain and starts adding keys to it, Pam giggles] Hey, what's so funny over here? Ha. Very nice. Give me my keys. [removes keys and throws them at Jim] Ha. Ha. Not. Funny. Jim.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Sorry.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, no. Don't worry about it. I was just gonna put a couple keys on it every day until Christmas. Then his pants would have fallen down, which was a little gift to me, but…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It was really funny.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, it would have been. So unprofessional, Mrs. Halpert.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I love you.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Luke? Luke!

scenes.speaker: Luke
scenes.line: What's up, Venus?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Did you send those samples to Justin at Lehigh Motors yesterday? Because he didn't get 'em.

scenes.speaker: Luke
scenes.line: Uh, if you asked me to do it, I'm sure I did it. Yeah, strawberries are ripe.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Hey, turn off the Chumbawamba and scram, twerp.

scenes.speaker: Luke
scenes.line: You don't have to yell.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, rude. Luke, I want you to go to the supermarket for me.

scenes.speaker: Luke
scenes.line: What for?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: To get some ice cream for everybody. It's national ice cream afternoon. Great.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And another thing I did this summer, I hired my nephew.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Having Luke here is a pretty big deal for me, because his mother, who also happens to be my half-sister, kind of cut me off from that side of the family 15 years a- 14. The last time I saw Luke was the opening day of 'Ace Ventura II' and that was '95, so yes, 15 years on the dot. Anyway, I lost him in a forest.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't bother Luke.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Why is there a circle with a line through it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That means don't. Haven't you seen Ghostbusters, Pam?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah, but it's like you're saying we should bother Luke.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, it… Yes, okay, right. [erases don't] All right, yep. My bad. I got it. Here we go. [writes "Don't" in front of symbol]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Don't don't bother Luke. Got it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Come on. Okay, um… [draws a circle around "Don't" with a line through it] That's as clear as I can make it.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hey, why can't we bother Luke? He deserves it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because I don't want it getting back to Sabre that we're yelling at assistants. I think it would reflect poorly on us.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Who's gonna tell on us? Gabe?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: That'd be hilarious. Uh, "Jo, they're creating a hostile work environment. Stop 'em."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nope, it won't be Gabe but actually, there is somebody in the office that is very, very close to Luke.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: How close?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, Dwight, he wiped his butt. Is that close enough for you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight

scenes.line: [laughs] Oh, you are funny, Michael. You–people, people don't give you enough credit.

scenes.line: You're gonna lose all of our money.
