scenes.line: I have no feeling in my fingers or penis. But I think it was worth it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [dumps the remainder of the snow in his bag on Jim, then rests his foot on Jim and raises his arms in the air] Haahh!! [runs off]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Um, I was laying on the ground, defenseless, and uh, he just kept throwing 'em until he exhausted himself. And, uh, [cell phone chimes] then… [reading text message] "How 'bout icing it? lol. Dwight."

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hello.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Is there any way I can get a hand with these, please?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I'm really sorry, I can't help you. I'm waiting for my boss' pretty friend to arrive.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There she is. Hey. Erin, would you help her, for God's sake?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, you're Holly! Of course. Sorry.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [weak Clint Eastwood accent] Well, well, well, if it isn't Michael Scott. You old bastard.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [imitating her accent] Well, I never thought I'd see your face around these parts, you old bastard.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Well I did show my face around these parts, you old bastard.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [as Curly] Why, you're some sorta wise guy, huh?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [as Curly] I most certainly am.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nyuk, nyuk, nyuk, nyuk!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Unnnnnnngh!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [as Homer] D'oh!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [as Marge] Oh, Homey. [they both laugh]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay… Holly's back.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hi. Hi. Oh… [they hug]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [in monster voice] Oh, huggy monster!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh no, not the huggy monster! I don't wanna die! I don't wanna die! I don't wanna die! [both sigh] Wow. Well, everybody, you remember Holly.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Did you bring us anything from Nashua?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, yeah. I brought um, some maple candy. But I have to admit, I got a little hungry on the drive, and I ate some of them.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's adorable.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Would you put those out?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: To throw out? Or put out, like, six pieces for everyone?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, it's so nice to be back. It looks beautiful in here. Super classy. It's like a party for limousine drivers.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, you came on the day of our Christmas party.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, it's fabulous. I love what you did.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Isn't it wonderful? We love it here. Don't you love it? All right, let me show you to your desk. [in a stereotyped Mexican accent] I show you to your desk.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [in the same accent] Watch out for my guns they're both loaded. [makes gun noises]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What kind of guns do you have? Six-shooter?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Aww…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: It's a pea shoot…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is weird. I can't believe you're here. This feels like you never left. Doesn't it?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yeah, kind of.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, and you have a Woody. Bah! [the both chuckle] Oh, I love toy…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: AJ gave me that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, that's understandable. Still raw. Woody your favorite character?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Mmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know who my favorite character in Toy Story is? Andy's mom.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because without Andy's mom, there's no plot. And without any plot, there is no movie.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: That is a really good point. AJ said he hadn't seen any of the Toy Story movies.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're kidding me. Ahh!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: No. I know. I was like, "What? Are you serious?"

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What a douche bag!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Get a life!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Get a… yeah! Good riddance.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: We sat down and we watched them all in one day.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Now he's the biggest Toy Story fanatic ever.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good for him.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Next day I found him in my bed.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really? That's creepy. How did AJ get in your house?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: We live together.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, you do?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: He had a little note pinned to him that said, "You've got a friend in me."

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [fighting back tears] Yeah, Randy Newman's the best.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yeah. I love him.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Me too.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [singing] Christmas tree, Christmas tree. Won't you be my Christmas tree.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, how about this one?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ehh, seems a little full of itself, right? Kind of a pretty boy? What if we got a really beat up one, like on Charlie Brown. And we just loved it for what it is?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Maybe. I mean…

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [on the phone] I just, no, she be talking to your mom or something. This is my daughter too, Justine! You seem to think, [Justine hangs up] oh… pick a damn tree already.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Um, hey, Darryl, listen, it's none of my business, but if I couldn't have Cece for Christmas, I'd be really upset too.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I don't have kids or anything, but if my grandmother ever dies, I'm going to kill myself.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Jada don't want to spend Christmas with me. She told her mom it wasn't as much fun. And how could she say that? You know, I took her to the toy store to buy her own presents.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well Darryl, no kid wants to buy their own Christmas presents.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Her mom wants me to take her to mass. I guess that's something to do.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, you should have her mom do the boring Christmas stuff on her time. You should be associated with the fun parts of Christmas.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: How do I do that?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Bring her to the party. Yeah, we'll have Santa, and we'll play games with her. It'll be a lot of fun.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You'll be Mr. Christmas by the end of the night.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey guys, the tree's here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Nobody hug me, I'm covered in tree sap, so…

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Why would someone hug you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey there, Jada. Nice to see you again. I'm Santa Claus. Welcome.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Are you serious?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It's a sophisticated take.

scenes.speaker: Jada
scenes.line: He doesn't look like Santa Claus.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: No, he doesn't. [to Michael] I told her Santa would be here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, well, I was told that Holly would be here, single and ready to date. And we all got misled.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Who told you that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nora Ephron, in every romantic comedy ever made.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: So is it an open relationship?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, God, no.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Well, you're almost 40. Oh, do you not want kids?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, I want kids. I really want kids. But AJ and I are practically engaged. We talk about spending our lives together.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: So where's the ring?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Kelly! Um, how are you adjusting to the move?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Nobody cares about that. Look, you have to make him commit, or kick his butt to the curb.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You guys, I don't think any of us are really qualified to be giving Holly personal advice about her love life.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah, I mean, maybe Holly's not in any position to be shooing guys away.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I don't get it! I'm sorry. I just, I don't get it!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Okay, listen, I'm gonna tell him that if he doesn't propose by the end of this year, we're over.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow, an ultimatum.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It doesn't really seem like you.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: That is a great idea. Ultimatums are key. Basically, nobody does anything for me anymore unless I threaten to kill myself.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [turns in Pam's chair with a Pam wig on and laughs maniacally]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Don't. Stop, Dwight! [Dwight pelts Jim with snowballs] Dwight, stop! Dwight, stop!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, no. Oh, no!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Stop!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, no. Yes, taste my wrath!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. Okay. Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Huh? You like that?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Seriously!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Huh?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. Okay. [Dwight throws another snowball and laughs maniacally]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes, I have a wig for every single person in the office. You never know when your gonna need to bear a passing resemblance to someone.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I just want it to stop.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So, cool right?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: There's no connection between the origin story and the quest.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: We need to know who Jimmy Halpert was before he was bitten by the bear. Otherwise, it's the bear's quest.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, well, I just sorta meant, like, cute, right?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Well, did you come here for help, or did you come here for me to tell you how great it is?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I mean, help, if it's something simple, like add page numbers or laminate it or…

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Well, it sounds like you know what you want. [Pam walks away] It's also a little derivative of a serias called 'Bear Man'. Did you look that up?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Oh, Jim. Hey.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Toby.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: There's this female uh, uh, stenographer at the courthouse…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No way.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Who looks exactly like you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's increadible.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Yeah. No, it's uncanny.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know what's crazy?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I can't reconnect with you right now. Hold on one second. [he hurls a snowball at Dwight with a lacrosse stick, misses, and shatters a window, everyone gasps] Excuse me. [clears throat]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I guess there are just some people who you stay together with when you transfer, and some people you don't. And that's just the way it is. And I can be mature about that. [clip of Michael throwing Holly's Woody in the trash and pouring coffee on it]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It's so cold. Even with my coat on.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Maybe your senator boyfriend has a blanket in his car… for screwing Americans.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Yet another opportunity where a blanket would have come in handy.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: You guys, this has to stop. Someone could have really gotten hurt.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What if Meredith was taking her smoking break below that window? You know what would have happened? The shards of glass would have shaved her face right off. And, yes, it might have been funny. But it also would have been incredibly tragic.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I could not agree more. And just want to state for the record that I am intending to sue Jim for acute psychological distress.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What are you talking about? You're the one terrorizing me.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: With snowballs, Jim? With fluffy little snowballs? No. I thought we were just playing.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Dwight's right. What you did was dangerous and inappropriate. I'm really surprised at you guys. Last time I was here, you were both best friends.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All this arguing reminds me of a very funny story. You see this on my desk? [he holds up a toy taxi cab] Know who gave me this? My girlfriend Tara, who lives in New York City.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wait, what girlfriend?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I haven't told you about her.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I find that unlikely. You email me when you get a new zit.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm a man in my mid-40s and I still get zits. I think that's pretty interesting. But you know what? I am not on trial here. The Scranton strangler is. So, anyway, we have this great weekend, and she drives me to the airport, and we get to JFK, but I am flying out of LaGuardia. So we laugh and laugh and laugh, and then we spend the rest of the day walking around Slo-mo, drinking latte. And at the end of the day, she gives me this, and she says, "Michael, maybe next time, you should take a cab."

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I didn't know you had a girlfriend.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I do. She is.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did you see her face? Well it seems to me that there is a person sitting out there in the annex that still has feelings for Michael G. Scott. And it ain't Tara.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: So you went homemade this year.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yup.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah. Money problems, is that what this is about? I mean, oh, dear, I don't think we can help you out.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, no. Jim had a great year, actually. I just wanted to get your opinion.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Are you good at homemade?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Look at this.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [walks in with a dirty Woody] Who did this? It's obvious to me I'm not welcome here, but somebody better tell me who did this, or else I'm leaving.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Well, I don't think Erin seems to like you.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: That's not true. I don't know her enough to make a decision even.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What happened? What happened? Toby, what did you do? I think Toby's very jealous of all the attention you've been getting.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: No, I would never ever do anything like that. But it does seem like something you would do.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, really? Turn it on me. Well, isn't that nice? Thank you very much.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Wait, wait, guys, listen. Toy Story is all about toys that come to life when people aren't looking. You don't think… it's not possible… that Woody did this to himself.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is Christmas.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No, it really seems like something Michael would do.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmhmm. Mmhmm. Well, the fact that you would think that points to the possibility that it is probably not me. And that I have been framed.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Why would anyone frame you for that?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, I'm sorry, why are we discounting this whole "Woody came to life" thing so quickly?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ahhhhhh! [laughs] Surprise! It was part of the party. Pretty funny, huh?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: You think this is funny?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughs] I don't. But someday I think we will laugh about this… when we tell our kids…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yikes. [everyone gasps]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh no, that's, that's not happening.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Dear God in heaven.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: All right. Shh. Okay, you know what? Holly, I didn't mean to do it. It was an accident. An accident borne of jealous feelings.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Michael, you have to let this go. I'm with someone else. I don't feel that way anymore.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, really? You certainly seemed jealous when I told you about my fake girlfriend. That's what Jim and Dwight thought.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, hey, hey, hey…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, fake girlfriends are always wrong.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: You made up a fake girlfriend to see if I'd get jealous? And you destroyed a gift my boyfriend gave me? What is the matter with you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: When you got transferred, and I drove you up to Nashua, you said, "Michael, I love you, but I can't do this." But then, with this other guy, you don't have any problem with a long-distance relationship, do you? And you know what, that is what is the matter with me.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Michael, I'm sorry.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And we did this whole stupid party for you.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [blocks Holly's path] No.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: You guys, it wasn't my fault.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh, nothing is ever your fault! Just like when you ate those maple candies that you brought for us!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I really think you're better off.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmm. Erin, would you do me a favor and find my street clothes for me, please?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah. Is she an amazing cook or something?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [walks over to his desk and sees a present sitting on it, reading the note] "Hey, Pickles, Merry Christmas. Open immediately. Love, Swiss Cheese." [opens the present and a snowball shoots out at him, everyone laughs] Damn it, Dwight!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Didn't think your affectionate nicknames would be your undoing, did you, Jim? Let that be a lesson to you all.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: So do they bring in food, or do you get to go out?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: No, they bring it in.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: You lucky son of a bitch.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I have been trying to get on jury duty every single year since I was 18 years old. To get to go sit in an air-conditioned room downtown, judging people while my lunch is paid for… that is the life.

scenes.speaker: Jada
scenes.line: Daddy, I'm bored. Can I read my book in your office?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Sure, sweetie.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Jada, Darryl, I'm so glad I found you guys. A grinch stole the star from on top of the Christmas tree and is hiding it in the warehouse somewhere. You want to go help me find him?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, my goodness.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I am the mean old grinch. The little girl who wishes to win back the Christmas star must first succeed at these challenges.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Ohh, that sounds fun and Christmasy, you mean old grinch!

scenes.speaker: Jada
scenes.line: What kind of challenges.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Wahhh…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Something like an obstacle course, Mr. Grinch?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No. You must answer topical political questions. How many congressmen is the state of Pennsylvania guaranteed? And what other state has the equal number?

scenes.speaker: Jada
scenes.line: I don't know.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Do you know the other state?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Maybe the grinch hid the Christmas star, and we could ask for clues, and he'll tell us if we're hot or cold.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: The star has been hidden. Is the little girl hot or cold? Well, it turns out she's burning up because the star is right behind her ear! [pulls star from coat and pretends to find it behind Jada's ear]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: And the game's over seconds later.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I'm so glad you could come.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: It's nice. I know.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Hey everybody, this is my boyfriend, Senator Robert Lipton.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Senator, it's an honor. I'm Angela's friend Oscar.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: Oscar. A pleasure.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Robert seems great. He's very handsome, firm handshake, he's gay, good sense of humor.

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: Hi.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hello.

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: I'm, uh, I'm AJ. I'm here to see Holly. It's kind of a surprise.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I know who you are, and I think you should go.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I bet you didn't even bring us anything, did you?

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: Was I supposed to bring you guys something?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: What? AJ!

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: Surprise.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: What are you doing here? Oh, my God.

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: I wanted to see you. How are you?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Wow! Nice.

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: Oh, God, you look great.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh… when did you get here?

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: Just now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: Just now. Hey, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nice to see you again, AJ. Welcome.

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: Pleased to see you. Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good trip down?

scenes.speaker: AJ
scenes.line: Yeah, it was great.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good, good. Good to see you. Have fun. Enjoy the partay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am dead inside.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: What do you want, baby? We got some granola, got some cupcakes, chips, apples, pies…

scenes.speaker: Jada
scenes.line: You have a whole room of vending machines?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [chuckles] I know. Isn't it something?

scenes.speaker: Jada
scenes.line: I can't decide what I want.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [handing out vending machine items to everyone] Merry Christmas.

scenes.speaker: Jada
scenes.line: Merry Christmas.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jada
scenes.line: And Merry Christmas.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jada
scenes.line: And Merry Christ… mas.

[headlines of Michael Scarn's success are shown as well as an article reporting the death of Michael's wife, CathErine Zeta Scarn] He was once the best secret agent in the business. That was years ago. Where is he now? Well, that's also an interesting story.

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: [Dwight Schrute dressed as a butler. Speaks in slow, deep voice] Master Scarn.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I play Samuel, Michael Scarn's robot butler. I wanted Samuel's voice- [robot impression] to be like this! [normally] But Michael thought that Samuel should be a very advance android, almost indistinguishable from a real person.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight does not play a robot.

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: [crashes cymbals by Michael's ear]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [lying on bed with a bottle of alcohol] I'm up.

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: It's the president. He needs you for a mission.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Tell him I'm retired.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's Goldenface.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Goldenface, this makes it personal.

scenes.speaker: President
scenes.line: [Darryl, sitting at a desk in the Oval Office] Scarn, you're right on time. [cheEring from the office]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I gave up a lot of weekends because I thought it'd be good for my daughter to see a black man as president. Even in a silly home movie. What a stupid waste of time.

scenes.speaker: President
scenes.line: It's your old enemy, Goldenface. He's after the NHL All Star Game. He's hidden a bomb somewhere in the stadium. Scarn, this one is personal for me. I own the stadium. I can't see it blown up. It's my retirement plan.

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: We have to search the stadium.

scenes.speaker: President
scenes.line: Not so fast, Goldenface has taken all the concession stand workers hostage. Scarn, will you find these hostages, and save the game?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [holding a quarter up] Heads I do it, tails I don't. Best out of seven. [flips the coin] Heads. [flips it again] Tails. [President winces each time he says tails]…Heads…Tails…Heads…Tails. [flips one more time and the quarter spins around on the table. Michael looks at it] Well, it looks like there's going to be a clean-up on aisle five.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.line: Well, the hostages were scared.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [as a hostage] Don't you guys get it? Nobody's coming for us.

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: [Jim, with his face painted with metallic gold paint] Oh someone's coming alright, the only man who would care. [Goldenface turns in his chair, holding a golden gun] Michael Scarn. See I'm gonna lure him here, then I kill everybody, then… I'm gonna dig up Scarn's dead wife, and I'm gonna hump her real good. [malicious, deep laughter]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I did not love the dialogue. Or the character. I took the role to impress a receptionist who will remain nameless.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.line: [scene shows Michael Scarn driving through the rain] Well, the All Star Game was three days away, so naturally it was all sold out. The only way Scarn was getting in was in a uniform. Just one problem with that, Scarn didn't know a hockey stick from a Slim Jim. So he went to meet with the famed trainer… [Michael stops the car and gets out] Cherokee Jack.

scenes.speaker: Cherokee Jack
scenes.line: [Creed wearing a tunic and carrying a mop, standing with Michael in front of an ice rink] Mop the ice.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm not here to learn how to mop, I'm here to learn how to play hockey.

scenes.speaker: Cherokee Jack
scenes.line: Mop it. [A montage of Michael mopping the ice awkwardly and using an ab-cruncher, and slowly getting better. After a little while, Cherokee Jack Slams a hockey stick on the ice to stop Michael, then offers it to him] Now take this.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What am I supposed to do with this?

scenes.speaker: Cherokee Jack
scenes.line: Mop. [a montage shows Michael sliding around the ice skillfully and hitting the puck into the goal]

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.line: Well, Michael Scarn was quickly becoming one of the hottest hockey players in the country.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [Ryan is acting as an official for the competition taking place. A line is formed in front of a line on the ice. Standing behind it are Michael Scarn, Oscar in a blue full-body suit, and a mysterious man in a hockey mask] Each year, the National Hockey League selects one civilian amateur to play in the All Star Game. It's down to the three of you. The final test is speed skating. [holds a gun to the ceiling] On your marks, get set…

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: Die! [The masked man pulls off the mask to reveal that it is Goldenface]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Michael and Goldenface skate around the rink, Goldenface shooting with a solid gold gun, Michael with two pistols. Michael is out of breath at the end of the race] Nice try Goldenface, but you forgot one thing, to kill me.

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: I wasn't trying to kill you, I was trying to slow you down. [Ryan is seen placing a medal around Oscar's neck]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No!

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: Oh by the way!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: How's your wife doing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [begins to cry as Goldenface laughs]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Congratulations.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Hey, you came in second. Not bad either.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am sorry that I have to do this… [starts choking Oscar to death with his towel]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Huh…[muffled screaming as he slowly chokes, and eventually dies]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm so sorry. I'm so sorry.

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: I'm intercepting a name. Jasmine Winsong. She works for Goldenface. What I can't figure out is, who is the Funky Cat.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Not who, what. The Funky Cat is the hippest Jazz Club in town. [stands up with his cup of tea and walks by Samuel, pouring his tea all over him]

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: Oh-[starts to freak out, but the scene is crudely cut short]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: He cut the part where my circuit board malfunctioned! What was the point of spilling the drink on me?

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [acting as a jazz singer at the Funky Cat, singing] They call me Jasmine Winsong.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [walking into the Funky Cat] Bingo.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: He finished his movie? [frantically trying to open her car door, as if trying to get away from the camera crew] No kidding. Wow, that's great. Yeah that's good for him.

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [singing gibberish while laying on the piano on stage]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [pulls out a recording device from his pocket and clicks it on]

scenes.speaker: Jan
scenes.line: [michael pushes the backwards button on the recorder] The hostages are under the stadium. [An assassin with a golden tie shoots her with a tranquilizer and she falls]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jack Blaise.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You have to let us go Goldenface! We have families!

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: Ha! This is gonna show them [cocks his golden gun] that I mean business. See ya! [points gun to Toby the hostage's head, shoots and Toby's fake head explodes, the shot is shown repeatedly]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: By far and away, the most expensive shot in the movie. But, it was integral to the story.

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: Ha! [kicking open the gate in the stadium where the hostages and Goldenface are]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Michael Scarn!

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: Sorry about your friend, Scarn!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The joke's on you Goldenface, that man was a wanted animal rapist.

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: [gives Michael a disgusted look]

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: We've searched the whole building, Goldenface, where is the bomb?

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: Hm?

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: We've searched the whole building, Goldenface, where is the bomb?

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: Hm?

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: We've searched the wh- ok…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: He said, where is the bomb?

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: In the puck! [tosses the puck to Michael]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why are you telling me this?

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: Because I'm going to kill you. [takes out golden gun] Unless! You forgive me for murdEring your wife. [distraught, memories of him and his wife are shown on the puck in a dreamy haze]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey Goldenface.

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Go puck yourself!

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: [dodges the puck and shoots at Michael]

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: Noooo! [jumps in front of Michael to receive the bullet]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That was not scripted.

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: [re-cocks gun and shoots at Michael, who looks shocked and scared]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: More Tylenol.

scenes.speaker: Helene
scenes.line: [as a busty nurse] You've already had four.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Looking at her mother on screen, horrified] Oh God… [looks at Michael] So good.

scenes.speaker: Helene
scenes.line: You're lucky to be alive.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It'll take a lot more than a bullet to the brain, lungs, heart, back, and balls to kill Michael Scarn.

scenes.speaker: Helene
scenes.line: Let's just make sure that everything's… Working properly… [leans in closer to Michael and the heart rate monitor, which was beating steadily, now beats very quickly]

scenes.speaker: President
scenes.line: You just said the bomb… is in the puck?

scenes.speaker: Michael & Samuel together
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: President
scenes.line: Is that where you hid the bomb Goldenface?

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: [walks into the Oval Office with an accomplice, Troy]

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: But why would you blow up the stadium? You OWN the stadium!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: For the insurance money! I knew it all along! [the President, Goldenface, and his minion pull out automatic machine guns] You will never get away with this! [takes a painting of Abraham Lincoln and awkwardly smashes it on the President's head, runs out of the office as Goldenface and his minion shoot at them]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Where had I gone wrong? All I wanted was to start a family with my beautiful wife. But somewhere along the way, things got messed up.

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.line: It wasn't easy for Scarn to admit that he had lost his self-confidence. And he hadn't of course, He just wasn't using it right now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in a bar] Beer me Billy.

scenes.speaker: Billy
scenes.line: [Andy as a bar tender with a Brooklyn accent] You don't looks so good, what's got ya down?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I got problems Billy. Big problems…

scenes.speaker: Billy
scenes.line: You got problems?! My TV don't work! I pay thirty bucks a month for the damn satellite what's-a-whosit, I can't even get the damn game! Now you tell me, what's worse than that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughs to himself] Don't ever change Billy. Goldenface is going to blow up the NHL All Star Game tomorrow.

scenes.speaker: Billy
scenes.line: I see what you mean about problems. I know what'll cheer you up. That table of bachelorettes over there bought you this drink. [a table with Meredith, Phyllis, Karen, and Angela all say hey to Michael]

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Ever banged an entire bachelorette party, baby? [winks]

scenes.speaker: Karen
scenes.line: Why are you singling my line out, like, a million years later?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm too depressed to save the big game Billy.

scenes.speaker: Billy
scenes.line: I'm gonna cheer you up, the only ways I know hows. [to a small boy in overalls] Hey kid! Hit G-9 on the Jukebox!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No Billy, I haven't done that dance since my wife died.

scenes.speaker: Billy
scenes.line: There is a whole crowd of people out there, who need to learn, how to do The Scarn.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [A funky beat sounds from the Jukebox and Michael starts dancing poorly] Well my name's Michael Scarn and I'm here to say, I'm about to do The Scarn in a major way. [the bachelorettes and the others in the bar stand up to join him] You jump to the right and you shake a hand and you jump to the left and you shake that hand. You meet new friends, and tie that yarn, and that's how you do The Scarn! [doing the actions he says to] You jump to the right and you shake a hand and you jump to the left and you shake that hand. You meet new friends, and tie that yarn, and that's how you do The Scarn! You jump to the right and you shake a hand and you jump to the left and you shake that hand. You meet new friends, and tie that yarn, and that's how you do The Scarn!

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: [as a drunken man in the bar] If doing The Scarn is gay, then I'm the biggest queer on Earth!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [cracking up at the stupidity of it, the rest of the office besides Michael and Holly are concealing their laughter. Pam Is trying to quiet Jim up] Sorry.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [turns off the movie from the remote, the office complains]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm sorry, I'm really, really sorry. I think I was just relieved, to see that Michael Scarn got his confidence back.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Yeah Michael the movie is amazing!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: It's like one of the best movies I've ever seen in my life.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: You should enter it in festivals!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Or carnivals!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to Holly] Well that's a… pretty good reaction. [Holly nods] Pretty cool, right? Did you like it? Did you like that?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Uh… which part?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. [Stands up and leaves the conference room to the dismay of the office] No, it's not good enough. It's not good enough…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Some people are really popping on screen!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hey! Good movie.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmmm, good? Everybody out there says it's great!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I loved it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Did you? What did you love about it?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Uhm, I loved that you got to work together with all your friends. Isn't that great when you can all work together like that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no. Holly, this isn't Ocean's Eleven, where you get together with all your friends and just have fun and don't care about how it turns out. What'd you really think, honestly.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Uhm…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Is it, is it because you're afraid of where this is gonna take me? See, because I need you… to keep me grounded.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Not worried about that.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [angrily] It was eleven years, okay? This has been my dream for eleven years, and if you don't think it's great than you're basically saying that you don't believe in my dream.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Wha- It's your dream and you never even mentioned it before!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I talk about a lot of things, Holly! I was eventually gonna get around to my dream! Obviously! Eleven years I could've been working on the Scarn Nebulus.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Well why do you have to make a movie at all?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Because, if I don't have this, what do I have? I have nothing.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Really, you can't think of anything else that you might have?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I have my book on business, Somehow I Manage. I have my HBO comedy special, Here I Go Again dot-dot-dot. But you know what? When I think about it, when I really think about it, none of those things are as real to me as my movie.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I'm real.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, you're a real pain in the ass. And I'm gonna go watch the movie with people who think it's great! And I'm sorry I called you a pain in the ass, I'm angry, and I love you.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I love you too.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am a huge Woody Allen fan. Although I've only seen Antz, but I'll tell you something. What I respect about that man, is that when he was going through all that stuff that came out in the press, about how Antz was just a rip-off of A Bug's Life, he stayed true to his films. Or at least the film that I saw which again was Antz. The thing is… I thought Bug's Life was better, much better. Than Ants. The point is, don't listen to your critics, listen to your fans.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Who likes Threat Level:

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: Michael! You have to get to that puck before halftime! Or the whole stadium will explode!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know, it's a good thing my trainer and mentor is here to cheer me on!

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: Cherokee Jack? Michael he died.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [crying] This one's for you Cherokee Jack. [Michael skates into the rink of an already in-play match]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We filmed this during an actual Scranton High School Hockey Game, trying to qualify for states.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [he office shushes Michael to hear the movie better] That's fine, it's great!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no! Actually it's really screwed up because they [chuckles], they were trying to qualify, they were disqualified, they had to forfeit the game. Undefeated season. That's why there were so many people there. [Michael stands up, clearly realizing that his movie is not as great as he thought]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Why is your face gold?

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: Why do you care?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm just making conversation.

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: I worked in a gold factory, we had a boss, who only cared about money…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hey…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hey, I'm sorry. It is good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No it's not. [kisses Holly while smiling] It's not. But, they really seem to be enjoying it.

scenes.speaker: Hostage
scenes.line: Please Goldenface, let us go!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [ees Cherokee Jack from a confusion of heavenly light and smoke] Cherokee Jack.

scenes.speaker: Cherokee Jack
scenes.line: I want you to take all of your frustrations, with women, the system, with everything. Take it out on the puck. All on the puck.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughs at the stupidity]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [skates forward, hits the puck, and stares in wonder as it flies by]

scenes.speaker: Samuel
scenes.line: Yah! [kicks open the gate to save the hostages, hostages rejoice as Samuel unties them] [the puck is seen flying into space and it hits a satellite, Billy is at his bar and his TV suddenly turns back on]

scenes.speaker: Billy
scenes.line: Hey! We got sports games again! [people at the bar cheer]

scenes.speaker: Goldenface
scenes.line: [seen at his house counting his money] Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha! [The puck lands on his lap] Oh-[A large explosion blocks out his words] [The office cheers at the ending of the movie, Michael Scarn holds up a trophy]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in Scarn manor] Some breakfast for me [shows a plate of bacon and eggs] and some breakfast for you. [pulls out an oil can and oils Samuel's circuit board on his back]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh yeah, I guess I did let him be a robot.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [phone rings] I'll get it! Man I love being retired! Scarn here!

scenes.speaker: President
scenes.line: [on phone] Michael, it's the president.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hello sir.

scenes.speaker: President
scenes.line: I need you for another mission.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ugh… [after a little thought] I'm in.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [the office cheers] Whoa Whoa Whoa! Isn't the president evil?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh yeah! [laughs] Yes he is!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No no, he's doing it to catch the president!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no Dwight. He's just being stupid. [the office laughs]

scenes.speaker: Narrator
scenes.line: [in Stanley's voice, a chair is shown with a gray haired head sticking above it] Well, Michael Scarn was back in the game. And I bet you're wondEring why do I know so much about Michael Scarn. [the chair revolves to show Michael Scarn, gray haired, talking with Stanley's voice] Well because I AM Michael Scarn. [applause]

scenes.speaker: Rapper
scenes.line: [Andy rapping to a montage of scenes from the movie] Ahhhh, yeah! Threat Level Midnight! Makes all the girlies feel alright! From Madonna to Madelyn Allbrite, Threat Level Midnight! It's a threat, a level, a level level threat. He's the greatest hockey-star I ever seen yet. Threat Level what? Midnight! Threat Level who? Michael Scarn! Threat Level why? Apartheid! Gotta fight it, Free Mandela! Peace I'm out!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I have the best survival stock shelter in north eastern Pennsylvania. But everything has a shelf-life. So I must eat and replace everything that's about to expire. It's nice not to have to plan my meals.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: You're eating eight year old tomatoes?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: They're still good for another week.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: You know, I think I have some type of cheese in the back of my fridge you might like. [Jim smiles]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I've got some cheese you might like too. In between my toes. [all laugh]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hardy har har. Okay picture this:

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: I really though I was becoming too much of a womanizer. I realized I had shirts in five different women's houses.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Still not seeing the problem here.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: All right, truth is I gotta couple love bumps on my ding-dong so, game-over!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It was the best of times, it was the awesomest of times. And now Packer wants to come home. And ohh, look who's here to sign off on it! My boo, Holly.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [walks into conference room with Michael and Todd] Hi!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hi. [Holly and Michael kiss]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: You must be Todd.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: [shaking Holly's hand] Whoa! I'm sorry, Michael. I thought we were meeting Holly today, not Jennifer Aniston!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [laughs oddly] Very funny. Okay let's get started.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: After you!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, Michael! This'll be just us.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, yes yes yes yes. Just so you know, he's at his funniest when you've given him five shots.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And it also helps if you've had five shots.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I already have.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Whoa!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to Michael] Why is Packer back?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Is Packer here?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why's he talking to Holly?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [peEring into conference room] Don't know, don't care.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [to Todd] Michael loves you, and your sales speak for themselves.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: [excitedly] Oh!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sees Holly and Todd shaking hands in the conference room] Yes! The Pack is back! Ladies and gentlemen, I would like to introduce you to a man who needs no introduction, probably because most of you have done it with him. Just kidding he wouldn't be interested in any of you. In all seriousness, Todd Packer, is a permanent salesman at this branch. And I would like to invite you to welcome him with open arms.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What!?

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: It's great to be among friends, but until then, you suckers will do!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Nice! We got burned!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You did! You got burned, because Packer's back! Packer is turning in his car for a desk. He is turning in his condoms, for a condominium! Although he's probably going to have to use condoms from here on out.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [seething] Holly, you approved this?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yes I did, I think Todd's gonna make a great addition to the staff.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You did approve it?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: What don't you understand about the word approved? It seems some of you don't know what the word approved means.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I have very little patience for stupidity.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [walking in with Gabe behind her] Sorry we're late. Gabe fell in the shower.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I'm such a klutz!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah, it took the fire department forever to get there. [realizing there's a new computer at her desk. Gets very excited] Oh my God, where did this come from?! Who did this?!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I got Erin a new computer, because the one at reception sucked. I should know. And I don't wanna say the other one was old, but its I.P. number is one! [laughs sheepishly] Right?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Thank you Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Awwh, you're welcome. [they hug] My pleasure.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Pam walks over to him and smiles excitedly while bouncing, Jim imitates her] Can I do something for ya?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I just helped someone out. It feels good.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nice. You know, I cleaned our daughter for like, an hour at four a.m. this morning, so…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So you know the feeling.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Special delivery for Dwight K. Schrute.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I didn't order anything.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And I don't have anything for you. But I do wanna talk to you about something. We have been thinking about where Packer should sit… And we can't just sit around and wait for Creed to die.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well there's a lot of seats in the annex.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So you wouldn't mind permanently relocating, so that Packer can take this desk here. [Jim looks appalled]

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Thanks man, it'd mean a lot.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I have been sitting here for ten years, Michael.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: well I was there for twelve years. Plus my name's carved under the desk.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No it is not.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Is too!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Grunting as he crawls under Dwight's desk. Dwight follows] Let's look at this.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Check it out!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I don't wanna move desks!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't be a baby! Okay! There it is. Packer was here and so was your mom! [Todd starts humping Dwight and Michael who are still under the desk.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Do I have any say in this?!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No!

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: [grunting while humping Michael and Dwight] Don't even watch, Halpert!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [in the annex, moving into his new desk. Holds up a red tray with rocks on it] Hey, who's dirt box is this?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Oh, that's our Zen garden.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What do you grow in here, bullcrap? [puts the tray into the garbage]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [walking into the annex with Jim] Hey, um…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Hey, what's up guys?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Don't what's up us! You think you're so cute, with your pretty blonde hair!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Whoa, pull it back. Uhm, why did you hire Todd Packer?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Uhm.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: He's seriously awful!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Michael's recommendation was glowing! And, honestly, he's been nothing but nice to me!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: That's how he gets you to take off his panties.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Pam starts nodding in agreement] Why are you nodding?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: United front…

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Okay, look. We can't fire someone because we don't like him.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Right this isn't the U.S. Government.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: What are you referencing?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [seems unsure] Everything… Everything.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Do any of you have any concrete complaints about something he's done?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I mean he humped Michael.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Well if that's the case, I guess I've gotta be fired too. [all groan in disgust]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [looking at his computer, gasps] Hey! Hey you guys! The Armeth Regado video is up, gather around! [no one moves] Check it out! This guy's on a full beam reach. [watching a sailing video on his computer] They're hiking out like mad! Lock 'em up! Lock 'em up! Nice job! Ughh. [computer is frozen, taps the top of it] This computer's a hunk of jjunk.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hey sailor! Come watch it over here! [pats her new computer]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Where did you get this?!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Pam gave it to me!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: This is a sick computer! Gwen Stefani has this computer! [to Pam, in a fake British accent] Uhhh, Pamela! What does a guy have to do to get, ahem, one of them?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You have a computer Andy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, but if you donated my computer to Africa, it would become world famous as the slowest computer in Africa. So…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ok, but listen. We just don't have the budget for it. Okay? Reception needed a computer so we got one.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well Andy's desk needs a computer. And, I mean, it's just kinda a coincidence that I work there, but…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes, but Reception is a one person department. If I get you a new computer I have to get one for everyone in sales. For Dwight, for Stanley, it would be crazy.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: So something good happening to Stanley is crazy now?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'm not asking for one, I need it.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: If you're just handing them out, I want one too.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Phyllis, no body is handing anything out.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: See, this is what I'm talking about.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What are you gonna play mange on faster?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Sorry Andy.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Hey what's going on you guys? [walking into the kitchen with Holly, Dwight, and Kevin, with whom he fist bumps] Yeahh! Three muska-queers!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [giggling] Mean but good!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: So, Todd, this must be nice for you getting off the road. You get to spend some time with your daughter.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: I don't know, I love her and all, but she turned into a bitch. Mostly she's great, but some days she acts like her mom. [Holly is un-amused]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Well, some girls go through a phase.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hey, your life is so insane! You should write a book!

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Since when did you learn how to read?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I do know how to read though!

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Yeah. You know how to read… a menu!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [Todd leaves. Kevin laughs uncertainly] He's right. I mean, I could lose some weight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Kevin, in sumo culture, you'd be considered a promising up and comer.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [walking through the office, notices Andy with Erin's computer set up at his desk] What the heck! Why do you have Erin's computer!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It's crazy, right? Erin just wanted me to have it, so we switched.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What? Erin is that true?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [nods] I just thought, he really needed a new computer, and he knew so much about that one.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Erin, it's not up to you. This computer was for reception! Okay? It's not yours to give away.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Pam, when I'm freaking out, I just sorta step back and-

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm not freaking out, Andy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: -take a few breaths, and then I ask myself:

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: [to Jim] So you two are married to each other now, right?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: That's sweet. How's the sex?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [continues working]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [walks towards Todd] Hey Packer, I made you some hot chocolate.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: 'Cause I wanna let bygones be bygones. Show you I'm cool. You're the new guy. It's cold out. I made too much. I got this awesome hot chocolate recipe from my wife.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's a lot of reasons! [suspicious]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Drink it!

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: I think I'll pass. The only hot chocolate I'm into is Viva A Fox. [winks]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [interrupts Dwight trying to force feed Todd] Can I talk to you a second?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So, this hot chocolate thing.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: None of your business.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, you know you can't actually poison him.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It wasn't poison Jim, it was a laxative. People take laxatives all the time. This is just, a lot more of a laxative. Let me handle this.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I really think we should join forces on this one.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Really.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What do we think, what would drive him crazy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I know.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Here we go.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Pepto-Bismol, in his hot chocolate.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You've gotta stop with the hot chocolate stuff. I was thinking we can jam his drawers, so they only comes out two inches, then he can see everything in them but he can't get to them.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [mocking] Ooh does Edgar Allan Poe know about that one? So sinister! That wouldn't annoy a person at all! Where do you come up with this stuff?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay! Well this isn't my best, but call Froggy101, say that we're the tour manager for Justin Bieber, and we're giving away free tickets, we give him a number to call for the tickets, and it's his own number.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Who is Justice Beaver?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He… It's a crime fighting beaver.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why don't you write up your best forty ideas and e-mail them to me. Can you do that?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Absolutely, I'll e-mail you a hundred.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, write up your list of one hundred, edit it down to your top forty, then e-mail it to me, and I'll read it over.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Pam. Can I talk to you in private?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't know if there's really a private place in this office.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well they put a sign-up sheet on the conference room and I signed us up for three mods. A mod is five minutes. And it started two minutes ago.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [looking confused] You did that?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Can we talk about this in the meeting? Because we're a little late.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay. [walks to conference room with Andy and stares at the sign up sheet with wonder] When did people sign-

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Mind if I close the door? [after shutting door in the conference room] What you did out there, earlier, was totally un-cool.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well what was I supposed to do, let you walk all over me?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You humiliated me in front of every body!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, well I didn't think about it like that. It's just, I can't do anything about it. I can't replace that one unless that computer breaks.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I mean, it's pretty broken already.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, well if it breaks all the way I can get you a new one.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [looks at her knowingly] Pretty sneaky sis. [knocking on conference room door]

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [walking in] Hey cats, we got a jazz session in mod six, nine, and twelve. [Pam and Andy exit as Ryan and others holding saxophones walk in, Pam looks at the sign up sheet in awe]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [to Jim, the two are alone in the annex] There are over four hundred of these! [indicating a packet of paper]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah I couldn't cut it down.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: They're all good. So good! Number three:

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [Andy is seen clicking random things and warning boxes pop up. He pours coffee on his keyboard, puts bologna with mustard in his CD drive, and many other computer harming things] Allow all cookies? Why certainly! Pop-ups? Yes please! Bit torrent streaming from a Somalian music website? Yeah! Why not? [mock baby voice] Oh I hope you don't get sick Mr. Computer. [computer voice] Why are you doing this to me Andy? [normal voice again] Because I hate your programs!

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: [at Hank's with Michael, talking to Hank] And a '76 that's good to boot, I like that. [Hank smiles]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And you made Hank smile, that doesn't happen often. You're very charming. That is something you should take upstairs, and use on people that really matter. [Hank looks irritated again]

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't know, Holly mentioned that there were some complaints. And that you had said some things about Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Holly said that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: She was laughing hysterically that whole time!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I guess you said something weird about your daughter?

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: She asked me, Michael! It would've been rude not to answer.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You've been on the road a long time. And you've been an outdoor cat. And now you have to be an indoor cat, so you can't be peeing all over the walls.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Michael, can I open the kamomo with you. I've been on the road too long. But, I wanna connect with my daughter. And it's not right to call her a bitch in front of strangers.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No it isn't.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: You're right. I gotta watch my behavior.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah, a little bit.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Don't give up on me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I won't.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Michael and Todd are walking into the office] Okay, every body. I need you to see this. Because maybe there is somebody here that you all underestimated, who will surprise you. Todd Packer, is going to apologize. Kevin! Front and center, come here.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I got a lot of numbers here to put together.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Kevin, we know that you are just trying to save face, we know that you are hurt and embarrassed.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: That's silly. If anything, I should be apologizing to Packer. Because we all know I can dish it, as good as I can take it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, sweetie, no. You shouldn't be apologizing to Packer. That doesn't make any sense. You ready for this? You ready for this? Gentlemen, start your engines.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: I'm sorry if you were offended by my comments earlier.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Well, like I said, I wasn't offended, but I'll stand here for the big show.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Kevin, do you accept the apology?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Don't do it Kevin, that's the fake kind of apology.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, go back to the annex.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: This is textbook. It's so uncool. Ryan does this to me all the time. Like it's some offense to have feelings. Don't do it Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [muttEring] Sometimes you over react.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Michael how's this supposed to work? Packer's gonna keep saying terrible things, and then he's just gonna make half-assed apologies. And we're back to square one.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Okay. You want an apology? Here it goes. Kevin, I am so sorry. You are skinny, and you are a genius.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That-That was maybe too much. Packer is a survivor of divorce Stanley. Packer doesn't speak with his child, Meredith. Packer never lived up to his parent's expectations, Andy. [Andy looks confused and shrugs] Angela loves pussy cats, and Packer loves-

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [cutting in] No! Don't!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I was going to say dogs! Okay, you know what, this is over! Apology has been issued! And we're through with it. Packer will be here until the day he dies, just like the rest of us!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [in a car with Andy, by the dumpster you can see a new computer box] So listen, we have to really scuff this up.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No no no no no! We can say that the previous owner was a neat-freak. Or an elegant old lady and she just kept it around in case her grand-kids came to visit, but they died and they never came, I think I'm gonna make myself cry.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Andy, this is the deal we made.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [watching Pam scrap his computer] That's probably good. That's enough.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We should break this hinge maybe.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Let's not go crazy.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Well thanks, will do.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [using fake Southern accent, on the phone with Todd Packer, Dwight is also with Jim] Absolutely, now when you get down there, Jo's a little bit, uh, forgetful. So she may have locked the gate, but what you're gonna do is go ahead, hop it, and just head back to the pool. [Michael walks in on Jim and Dwight]

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: That sounds weird.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It is weird! Look at you, perceptive. Now I know why Jo's kept her eye on you!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [also In southern accent] And you make sure to get down there and check out that Harry Potter World.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [trying to stop him] Whatever you wanna do in your spare time is up to you!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Harry Potter World is supposed to be faaantastic!

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Apparently, as soon as corporate found out I wanted to come in off the road, Jo offered me a cushy new job in Tallahassee. And here's the best part. I'm a huge alligator nerd. I can name you every genus, every sub species. Also I'm a huge boob nerd.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Check it out and have a free butterbeer on us. Keep the receipt and we'll get ya' back!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [trying to hide from Michael what they're doing, he picks up the phone and talks directly into it] All right, so just pack your bags and, uh, be sure to bring those swimming trunks! Bye now! [hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I cannot believe this, you're sending Packer to Florida? Why?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He's a jerk.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: He took my desk.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, so you're tricking him into flying to Florida?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It wasn't my first choice, Jim had so many better ideas.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You have to tell him. You have to tell him what you did.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, no, no. That is not part of the plan. That is actually anti-what we're doing.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: He is my oldest friend, I am going to tell him.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wait! Why don't we come up with a plan we're all happy about? [Michael leaves]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [plugging in new computer, acting to make people think he got a bad computer] Pam, how is this thing even any better than my old computer?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Come on Andy! I mean you said you wanted a new computer and this is the best I could do!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Where'd you even find this thing, like, in the corner in the warehouse?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes, I found it in a shelf in the corner of the warehouse. [Darryl gives the camera an odd look]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: All right, well thank you for my garbage computer. [Andy turns it on and looks amazed, clearly happy with it]

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: [walking into Michael's office] You're looking at the new face of corporate. Gonna put the "ass", in Tallahassee!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes, about that.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Well we gotta go out and celebrate, tonight!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well… I don't know if that's a good idea.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Do you have a ball and chain?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, nothing like that at all.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: Listen, I'm gonna tell you something that none of these people have the stones to tell you. It's your girlfriend, man. She's uptight.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sorry?

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: I know this stuff can hurt, but I wish someone had said something to me about my ex-wife. All I'm saying is about a month or so, meet me down in Florida, I'll introduce you to all the local [spanks the air] talent.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [thinks a moment] Sounds great.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: It's gonna be so good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That is. [Jim sees them and looks happy] It's gonna be awesome. I think you're really going to enjoy it down there.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I'm sorry about your friend.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nah, he's an ass.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [Brooklyn accent] You ahh.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [imitating] You ahh.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: What ah you wicked smaht?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No you ahh.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Who ahh?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [kisses her and speaks normally again] You ahh.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: So this new computer you found in the warehouse.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yep. Lucked out.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah, you really did. 'Cause I know every INCH of that warehouse.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yep, super lucky.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Maybe you could go back down there and see if you can find me some extra sick days.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [hesitating at the bribe] Yeah. You know what , I think I saw ONE sick day down there.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Really? 'Cause I think maybe I saw five.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Three. [Daryl nods]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm full on corrupt!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey Oscar, big Will and Grace fan huh?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: No. Everybody assumes I am. I always get them as gifts.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dunder Mifflin is having our first own garage sale. Like many Americans, we realized we had a lot of things that we really didn't need. And 10 cents of every dollar is going into the party fund so we can throw parties for ourselves.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: People! Look alive. It's showtime. Doors open in 3…2…1.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, yikes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's cold Dwight. Just shut the door and let people come in the front.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's good that its cold it will drive business inside.

scenes.speaker: Pam

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Congratulations!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Thank you. So guys, guys, guys. We're moving to Colorado.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: All of us?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wait, what?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Holly has to go back to Colorado. I'm going with her. I'm leaving.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Kahlua Sombrero, please.

scenes.speaker: Waiter
scenes.line: All right, so just you tonight?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Actually, I am meeting somebody, but I'm a little bit early. Leaving my company. After 19 years.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I'll drink to that. I'm starting at a company this week.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, really?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: To begginings and endings.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And to middles, the unsung heroes. And to moms.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: The moms and the troops.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Do not tell my fiance I'm drinking on a Wednesday.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [laughs] I won't… I don't know her.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm moving out to the burbs… actually, I'm moving further than the burbs, I'm moving to Colorado.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Colorado! The sunshine state.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yep. Don't mess with Colorado.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Doing some skiing?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no. I don't want to end up like Sunny Bobo.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Well that's just good sense right there. Everyone I know who skis is dead.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know, I would like to try the luge, through.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Try it once, you're hooked. That's my guess.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's what I've heard.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I'm an olympics nut.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh yeah? Me too. Summer or winter?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo/Michael
scenes.line: [in unison] Summer!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [holds out fist] Knuckles! Actually, I gotta come around and give you…

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: You know, it's funny, I tried to get an animal olympics going.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Really? What happened?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: You know, life happened. What are you gonna miss most about Scranton?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh… wow. The mountains. Where things are.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: That's the way it goes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Man, he is late. I'm gonna call him. Do you mind? I'm sorry. [calls Deangelo, Deangelo's phone vibrates]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Excuse me. Hello? You running late?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, I'm here. I'm right… I'm at the bar.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I'm at the bar too.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You are? What bar?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I'm at the bar. The bar that's located in the lobby of the hotel.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I… do not see you.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: How long have you…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm been here about… gosh, over half an hour.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Ok, me too.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo/Michael
scenes.line: [looking up from phones in unison] Sorry…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What're you wearing?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I am wearing a grey suit, red tie.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Are we both at the right place?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Which place?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I hear your voice.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I hear your voice, I see your lips moving.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I see your voice in the phone. Oh, man! [holds out hand] Michael Scott.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Deangelo Vickers.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Wow… that is insane! [laughter]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: That is insane, that is the right term. Let's get some Vodka up in this cranberry, and one for my friend.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [entEring Dunder Mifflin offices] Here we go! Are you ready?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I am ready.

scenes.speaker: Michael
