scenes.line: Alright! Here we go!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is it. What do you think?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Oh, she'll do. She'll do just fine.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I am very much looking forward to tommorow. It feels like the culmanation of a lot of hard work, a lot of good fortune…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [pops up from below camera, and runs out of room]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Did that? Did that just happen?! [runs after Michael] We should… we should write a movie or something! I'm serious!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Michael is leaving. And apparently they've already hired a new manager. And we're meeting him today. It's a lot to process. Paperwork wise.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [wearing wig] Nope! It's not Ashton Kutcher. It's Kevin Malone! Equally handsome, equally smart! [winks]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, everyone, as you know, one of my favorite things is fanfare for it's own sake. So, without further ado, let's start clapping! Presenting Deangelo Vickers!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [blinds roll down, Deangelo waving]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Come on out!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Hello! [opens door] How are you sir?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am well, sir, how are you?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Can I just say, I am so excited to be working here. Little bit about myself, I love the American Southwest, for starters. You may call them Arizona, New Mexico, Nevada, Utah, I call them heaven. I have a peanut allergy, something I live with, it's a part of me. I've learned to cope with it. What else, I'm just as comfortable at the ball game as I am at the opera. I was a-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Did I want to be made manager? Sure. A great opportunity squandered? Absolutely. A crushing blow? Yes. Will I get over it? No. But life goes on. Not for me.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [drops papers as Deangelo walks by] I'll get that you guys. Don't… it's just… you know…

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [picks up paper] I'll help you.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Oh, hi! [obviously flirting body language]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Hello!

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Have we met before?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: No, not officially, actually, I saw you walking out of the bathroom before.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Well, I guess I'll go back to my cave. It was really great meeting you.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [offers Kelly the papers as she walks away]

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: And that is what you call a meet cute.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And we talk for like 20 minutes, no clue it's Deangelo the whole time!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Kind of embarassing.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yeah, that story makes you sound stupid.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I happen to like the hilarious hijinx I get myself into. There he is! Deangelo, I was just telling them about last night, when we met. Remember that? That was crazy!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Oh. [chuckles] That was… let's see, where's my replacement? Where's the guy I'm replacing? Why don't I look to the left? He's sitting right there! [office laughs]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh yeah… I know… that's what I was just saying… that's what…

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [silences Michael]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That exact situation is why I always carry around some of these. [holds up 'Hello, my name is…,'] nametags. Just in case. Because sometimes you just need to I.D. yourself.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [laughs] Office funny guy! Always glad to have an office funny guy around!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I wasn't even trying to make a joke. But I guess I've always been sorta quirky, offbeat, a little twisted.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is Jim and Pam, aka Jap. What started as an affair has blossomed into a family before our eyes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, it wasn't an affair.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes it was.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: But, no, but we are a family.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [points to picture of Cecelia] We made that.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Cecelia.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Well, congratulations. I have four kids of my own.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Really? Oh, my gosh! We just have the one, but she poops for four. [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Uh oh. Someone started off on the right foot with the new boss!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, they don't ever talk about careers that were made because of unplanned pregnancies.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Thanks for meeting me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Are you kidding? I'd come anywhere to see a turtle? Where'd you find him.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: There's no turtle, Michael. I just wanted to get you here.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know me very well, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's because I'm your right-hand man, Michael, but I can't do it again. I can't do it again for a whole new guy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Now I'm gonna have to go online and look at turtles or I'll be off all day.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I want to be manager. I just don't understand why I wasn't even interviewed for the job. What's wrong? I was totally qualified, you were pushing for me.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: That apple looks delic!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I do a lot of portion control. I try to keep my daily calor intake under 1200. [laughter]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Deangelo, you're going to starve to death. [laughter]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So you decided to have an orgy and not invite me? I call the middle!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: It's cool that you like the southwest. It's one of my favorite regions.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: It's one of my favorite regions? Did I just sound totally lame? No, I sounded good.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I love the desert. It's one of my favorite ecosystems.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Here's the great thing about the southwest; there's so much more than desert. Along the north rim of the Grand Canyon is a forest as lush as you've ever seen.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Burnt! It's lush, dummie. Hey, Deangelo, what do you think of bald people? I hate them.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Deangelo, I forget, did you mention you like politics?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I did not.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Cause I was thinking that you should meet my boyfriend, he's a state senator. I really think the two of you would hit it off. He's a great person to know.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Sounds very interesting, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Dunder Mifflin, this is Erin. Ok, let me transfer you.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Why do you use your name when you use the phone?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, that's how Pam does it. I just copy her. She's sort of a living legend.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Try it without using your name.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Dunder Mifflin, this is… oh, I like it!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Dunder Mifflin, how may I assist you?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, assist.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I sorta like the old way.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I just prefer it without the name and I thought- I've got to start doing some managing at some point.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know, I know, I'm sorry, but if it's not a big deal we should just-

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: And it really isn't.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Is that good?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah, ok, good.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Well, I'd like to change it, actually.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, whatever. Whatever you think will work.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: What do you think?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I think a change would be nice.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You can do the old way or whatever you think would work. [phone rings]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [whispEring] Change it.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [picks up phone] …I'm so sorry. Sorry. [hangs up]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Hey, funny guy. Wanna have a little mid-day lawl here. Make me laugh, huh? What you got? I can't even look at you.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Here we go… ok… what do African Americans call… [laughter]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Deangelo, did you order a barber?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Oh, yeah. Put a pin on that, kid. Can't wait to hear the punchline.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Finish the joke, Andy. What do African Americans call?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I… don't know. Help me.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [a barber enters the office for Deangelo] That is so badass. So hardcore.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah, real cool. Real power move.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I saw a hawk today. Just sitting right there on the overpass. Looking at me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to Erin] Shave me. [walks into office with Deangelo] This is going to be funny! Looks like we are going to be shaving buddies!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Ok, alright! I love it! I love it! Michael, this is Reggie. He is the #1 yelp reviewed shaver in Scranton. It's not even close.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: And this is Erin and she is going to shave my face. Here we go. [Erin puts too much shaving cream on Michael's face, none on the neck]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Alright. This is how we do it. Feels nice, doesn't it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It really does. This is luxery. Here we go. Ah, that is nice.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You wanted to talk to us Deangelo?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Ah, yes, please! Just cozy up there. Just thought we could have some rap sessions with smaller groups.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, we don't really do rap sessions. We kinda do… [Erin shaves Michael] god… we sorta do more of like powwows or-

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Ok, then, powwows then, fine.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's-

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, Deangelo, my mom just sent me this picture of Cece, it is so adorable.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright, wait, little bit of backstory, she loves dogs. She calls them 'da-das'.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Da-das.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And what happens here is-

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: You know what, enough about your baby, ok? I'm sorry.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We were… I think she was just trying to-

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: No, no, no, I know what you're doing. Just quit it. I want to hear from the rank and file. How can I be the best manager for you all? What can I do better?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what, everybody? You have to be honest, here. You can't say that everything is perfect. So, you know, come up with something.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Well, Deangelo, I'd say communication could be improved. People stopped reading memos, so everyone marks them urgent.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ok, you know what, I mark it urgent A, urgent B, urgent C, urgent D. Urgent A is the most important, urgent D you don't even really have to worry about.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Michael, can you stop talking now? I need to shave your lips.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't shave my lips.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [Andy walks into room] What's up?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I don't mean to go into a rant here, but…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I wrote the perfect joke. Topical, edgy, funny.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: …I saw this thing on the news. Democrats want electric cars. Republicans don't. I'm thinking, 'how crazy is it that we have a car debate going on in a city known for gridlock.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Let's not talk politics in the office, ok? I like you better as a funny guy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [leans on table] I wasn't taking a position. It's just one of those things where- [table collapses under Andy]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [laughter] Now that's funny! That's funny! You walk much?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, right, I mean- [walks into door, jokingly]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Little click…

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [pushing box into office] Deangelo, this box came for you.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Thank you. That's my stuff. Yeah. Michael, take a look at this.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Need a hand?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Oh, that'd be great, thank you Stanley!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know, this office sort of has a perfect Feng Shui to it, so… you know, let's not go overboard with the re-decorating, and I'm still here-

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [holds up painting of desert to office, who are impressed]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I still have to look at this stuff, guys.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: So this is a ten-gallon hat, huh?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yep, ten-gallon hat. Technically, it only holds about three quartz. Little factoid.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Interesting.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Deangelo's great. I love the guy. But I'm not sure he's a great fit for the office. And also, I'm not sure if I love the guy.

scenes.speaker: Darryl’s sister
scenes.line: [holds out cowboy boots for Darryl]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Cool, cool. Alright, see you later.

scenes.speaker: Darryl’s sister
scenes.line: Hey, hey, hey! [holds up set of pistols in holsters]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: No, I'm good. Keep them.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Hey, funny man! Whatcha got for me? Make me laugh?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [mimes using a rope to pull himself forward to microwave] Let's see if they have my favorite teas in here… [throws tea packets into air, puts hand in unplugged toaster, pretends to be shocked, takes container of cheese-puffs and throws them into air, pours hot coffee on his pants]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [laughs] Drink some soap!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [drinks hand soap]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [laughter and applause]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I guess this is my life now.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: How do I become a manger at Sabre?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: First thing's first, thank you for coming here directly. I know you could have called Tallahassee but they would've just looped back to me, so, it's cool you recognized my role here.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I left a message at corporate.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Ahh. There you go. Get a recommendation from Michael. That'll put you right on the shortlist for next time there's an opening.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Can't you just use the recommendation you already have on file?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: What recommendation?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: From when he recommended me to replace him.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: …I'm sorry, I never know how to act in these awkward-type situations.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Best whale watching:

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Deangelo! Wanna meet Cece?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: That's a cute baby. Very cute baby. Adorable. Very cute.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thank you very much.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: See, we knew it! If he just met her, he'd understand.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We're back in! Right?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I swear, that baby could be the star of a show entitled 'Babys I Don't Care About.'

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is six a.m. [DeAngelo yawns] and we are about to go house to house to give everyone their Dundie Nomination Certificates. Just like the Oscars!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yes, and this happens every…?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Every year! This happens, you have a lot to learn my friend. [DeAngelo laughs]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Well, you know, why don't we try it, and if it goes good it'll be part of my tradition.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why do you always say that? You're gonna love it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [arriving at the first house] Alright let's go! [DeAngelo runs in the wrong direction] This way, this way! [Michael knocks on the door]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Surprise!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Congratulations!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yep, okay…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You and Pam have both been nominated for Dundie Awards!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [holds up a camera and DeAngelo meows] Here we go! Have Pam come down.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No she doesn't wa- She's not here.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What's going on?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Stay in bed!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [next house] Congratulations!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Have you lost your mind! Get off my property before I call the police!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We got it.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Uh, leave it at the door or…?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah that's fine.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [next house] Hey Toby! You suck! [throwing eggs at his house]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Is this an employee of ours?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [giggles] Go go go go go go!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [arriving at a dumpy looking, unkempt house] I've never seen this place in the daylight.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: It reminds me of Katrina.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Here we go, alright got it? Set? [the door is ajar, Michael knocks lightly] Hello? [turns around to see Meredith walking towards her house]

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I'm so busted! Walk of shame!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Do you usually leave your door unlocked? And ajar?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Ahh, Nice! I got a Dundie nomination!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes you did. That's right! Congratulations Meredith. We should head out.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: No no no! You guys stay! No no no! I have Vienna Sausages and I have napkins. [walks into her house] Let me fix you breakfast!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [whispers] I'm not going in there.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [quietly shuts the door] Go.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [walking into the office] Good morning Erin.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh hey, didn't see you.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You have big plans for tonight?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I don't know, maybe volunteer at the shelter, or go to bed, or… I don't know. Maybe I'm going to the Dundies!! [Flashes her Nomination Certificate]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You are getting so funny! [Erin giggles] Very good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: The Dundies are my baby, and they need to go on. When Larry King died they didn't just cancel his show. They got Pierce Morgan to come in, and do his show, and, that way, Larry lives on.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Anything can happen at the Dundies! [DeAngelo laughs] They're like the Golden Globes but less mean. And I just want all of us to have a good time!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Just a little announcement folks, remember, the Dundies is a black tie affair.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Black tie optional.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Every day is black tie optional!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: A la, tonight we will be hosting at Louie Volpies!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Nice! [rest of the office looks excited]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I love their breadsticks!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, their breadsticks are like crack!

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I love when people say like crack when they've obviously never done crack.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well the breadsticks are like what then, Ryan, what can I use?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I don't know, something from your world. The breadsticks are like scrapbooking.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You're right, you're right. I'm a middle class broad. [Jim does his "Jim face"]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Shh, shh! Okay, okay. Everybody's right. They're like breadsticks on steroids. Right?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah that's great.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So as you know, the Dundies are my legacy. So I'm going to need to train a replacement. So this year, I have decided to have a co-host. [Dwight looks suspecting] And that person is [he and DeAngelo roll their tongues as a drum roll] DeAngelo! [all applaud]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Always the padawan, never the Jedi.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Thank you Michael, uh, but I will have to pass.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Think of it as part of your training.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Not much of a performer, unless you count singing in the shower. Boy, okay…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [smiling] Okay, well we'll work on it.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [whispers to Michael] Michael, I'm very, very bad.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You are doing it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [all in conference room] Guys! I want you to help us work on some banter.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yes! I love banter. But I hate witty banter.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Here we go! So, DeAngelo! You and I have a lot in common. You lost two hundred pounds, and I lose my car keys every morning.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: That is true, we do share some similarities. I know how you can fix one of those problems, for me it was portion control. For you, you need a key chain. Maybe one with a-

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [cutting him off] Okay, okay. You know what, I didn't actually lose my keys…

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: This did not happen.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmmmkay. There needs to be what you call a rat-a-tat. And right now it's all rat and no tat. Ryan come on up here. Tap DeAngelo out. Just watch this. Okay. [Ryan stands next to Michael up front] Ryan how are you today?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Why don't you ask my therapist, my mom certainly pays her enough.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [very excited] There you go! Lovely! Regis and Kelly! Nice! Use that as an inspiration. Just be funny.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Uhhh, you sir! [points to Jim] Are we having fun tonight?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Having a great time.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Oh good!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thanks, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Where were you on September 11th?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No! God! [Jim looks at him oddly]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: This is so weird! If I'm conducting a meeting, good to go. But if I think of it as a performance… I-I fall apart. Obviously.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Why don't you think of hosting the Dundies like you're just running a meeting.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no, no! This is the performance of your life!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Why don't you just, privately, in your own head, think of it like a meeting.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Jim, please no loopholes.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Mike, why do you have to control how he perceives it in his mind?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: This is my last Dundies ever, if I want mind control over him, is that too much to ask?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [laying down, Michael is sitting on DeAngelo's stomach bouncing up and down in Michael's office] Me mo. Me mo.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good. Good. Good!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Meee Mo, Mee!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Now, tell me something terrible that happened in your childhood.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: When I was very young, my mother divorced my father and I had to go to court and choose between them.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [getting off his stomach] Too personal. I don't wanna hear about it. [picking up a portable tape player] Let's try this. Put these on. [DeAngelo puts the headphones in] I am going to turn this on, and turn the volume all the way up. So you can't- [DeAngelo winces] That's right, you're not going to be able to hear yourself. Read this, [gives him a card] and make it sound perfect.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: THE DUNDIES ARE-OW-ABOUT COMING TOGETHER! AND RECOGNIZING, THE ADOMINABILITY OF THE HUMAN SPIRIT! [Jim comes and closes the door]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Say it with an accent!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [bad Australian accent attempt] THE DUNDIES!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [also in a poor Australian accent] The Dundies!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: THE DUNDIES!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Jim and Pam are walking outside] I just don't understand the desire to push sweet potato fries on me, and not just regular fries.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah… [they see Erin eating in her car, and ducking when they see her. Pam knocks on her car window] Hey, Erin, everything okay?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Get away from the car, he's gonna see you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Who's gonna see us?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [desperately] Just get in! Get in! Just get in!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Get in the car? [Jim and Pam get in the back seat]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Please! Sorry. Get in. [Jim and Pam are confused and worried] Sorry sorry sorry.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What's wrong?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I eat lunch in the car now. It's my alone time. It's just nice to have some time away from Gabe.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Why don't you wanna eat lunch with your boyfriend?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I, really don't like spending time with him.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Don't you think it's better to tell him the truth now? You know, rather than waste more of his time?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think I'm gonna go.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think you got this. Kay? [Erin nods] Alright. Feel better!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Thank you Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm sorry, that just wasn't interesting to me.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I can't just dump him Pam, I'm not like you, I can't be mean.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wait, when am I…? You just have to be clear and firm. You know, just tell him you don't love him. Just be honest with him. [Erin nods]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [standing by the Louie Volpies entrance greeting people and giving them menus]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [walks in] Hi!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Appalling. [Meredith walks in] Eye sore. [Jim and Pam come in] Surprisingly adequate! Okay everyone! The activities commence in four seconds!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: DeAngelo, Jo's on the phone for you.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Hello?

scenes.speaker: “Jo”
scenes.line: [Michael dressed as Jo Bennett, using a bad Southern accent] DeAngelo! We're in serious horse manure here! The Dundies are tonight! And we ain't got no host!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Oh no!

scenes.speaker: “Jo”
scenes.line: Luckily I have someone for you!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Billy Crystal?

scenes.speaker: “Jo”
scenes.line: Better.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Neil Patrick Harris?

scenes.speaker: “Jo”
scenes.line: He's in Little Shop of Horrors on Broadway. Now we need Michael Scott! The best darn Dundies host on both sides of the Mississippi! [everyone in the audience is laughing]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Ughhh, I gotta find Michael Scott! And then I gotta, [Russel Brand impression] Get Him to the Dundies!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [in the office near the accountants] Hey, can you help me find Michael Scott Angela?

scenes.speaker: “Angela”
scenes.line: [Michael is wearing a blond wig, talking in a high obnoxious voice] My boyfriend can, he's a state senator.

scenes.speaker: Audience
scenes.line: [laughing]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Mmhmm.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh wait, he can't help because that title has no meaning!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [laughing]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Try Jim DeAngelo, he'll be able to help.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Jim! Do you know where I can find Michael Scott?

scenes.speaker: “Jim”
scenes.line: [Michael is wearing a wig that is very close to Jim's actual hair, and he is wearing fake earrings, and speaking in a punk-ish deep voice] I totally don't know where Michael is, dude, hey you wanna listen to some records?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [shaking head at the camera]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: No one is listening to me! And I'm running out of time!

scenes.speaker: “Phyllis”
scenes.line: [Micheal dressed as Phyllis, pretending to knit] Well, what are you talking about? [cracking noise] Ohh! Ohh! [falls onto the ground] I've fallen and I can't get up!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Maybe I just need to look into my heart. [in the bathroom in front of the mirror] DeAngelo, where is Michael Scott. [his reflection in the mirror turns around to reveal that it is Michael]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm here. [DeAngelo gasps and turns around] In a good way! I've been here the whole time.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: The analytical part of me wants to examine it, but I know it has no content.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ladies and gentlemen, please stand up for you co-host this evening, Michael Gary Scott. [Michael comes running up to stage as people applaud] Please remain standing for your other co-host, and new manager, DeAngelo Jeremitrius Vickers! [DeAngelo presents himself, and changes his mind and runs off] Was that part of the…?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in the bathroom] DeAngelo, what are you doing? There's a live audience out there!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Go do it by yourself, get Ryan.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, Ryan would never do it. It's too on the radar. Look, look. The boss, hosts, the Dundies! It's sort of our perk!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: This was not, part of the job description!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Listen to me, you're not doing this for me, you're not doing this for you, you're not even doing this for them!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Who am I doing this for?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [slaps him] You're doing this for all those kids out there, eating off the Louie Volpies kid's menu, wondEring: Does it get better? What I want you to do, is I want you to say: It's showtime. Get out there.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I can't. [Michael slaps him again]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Say it.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Stop, hitting me.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You can do it, just say it.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Hit me again. [Michael slaps him once more]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Now hit me. [DeAngelo slaps him] One, two, three.

scenes.speaker: Together
scenes.line: It's showtime.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright, here we go.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay! Okay! Sorry about the delay everybody! But we were at the DMV waiting in line. [everyone laughs]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Fall asleep right after sex. Huh guys?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nope, go back to the script.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: There are a lot of great salesmen in this office, but one of our great salesmen is also a great dad. And a close personal friend of mine, Jim Halpert! Best Dad Dundie! [Dwight plays a celebratory honking noise on his keyboard]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow! I do not parent for the award but I gotta tell you It feels pretty good. Uh, Cece, if you're watching this at home it's way past your bedtime, by the way how'd this get televised?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well done.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I don't know maybe being a good dad is just all in your own compass. I don't know, I don't know. Thank you!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright. [all applaud Jim]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You didn't think to mention me huh?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Didn't I?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Which moves us to, Best Mom Dundie. [Pam gets ready and Jim smiles at her] I guess we all kinda consider her a mom around the office. Meredith Palmer!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [jogs up and makes out with Michael, who is unwilling] Tell ya one thing, I'm not gonna be a good mom tonight! Whooo!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Excuse me, can I get a photo of the Best Mom and the Best Dad please?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I gotta go do this.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [annoyed] Why?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Big smiles folks! There they are.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Year after year, I catch a lot of flak on this particular award, because year after year I present this award to a guy instead of a girl. Hottest in the office goes to, [Ryan stands up] Danny Cordray! [Ryan quickly sits] Danny couldn't be here tonight…

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: How do I feel about not winning Hottest in the Office this year? Uhm, I'm very relieved. How do you, how do you judge something like that? What is the criteria even? It's, it's so subjective.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stanley Hudson is a grump, everybody knows that. [Stanley looks angry] But did you know, that Stanley Hudson is also the face of a debilitating disease known as diabetes. The Diabetes Award goes to Stanley Hudson! [Stanley slowly walks over, angry] Come on up here you sick bastard.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I have diabetes too. You don't see me making a big deal about it.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: They say he's going to be my right hand man, adlib masturbation joke. [realizing he wasn't supposed to read that directly off the cue card, speaks quietly] No, I hate this, I hate it so much. [loud again] Dwight Schrute! Please accept this promising Assistant Manager Dundie. [people clap as Dwight takes the microphone, he is obviously unenthused] Thank you, thank you so much. I would like to thank something that we, uh, take for granted in our daily lives. And that is the humble trashcan. [Creed nods] This is for you trashcan! [walks off and throws the Dundie into the trashcan]

scenes.speaker: Manager
scenes.line: [the manager of Louie Volpies approaches a giggling Kevin, who is coloring with crayons on the tablecloth] Who gave you those crayons?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I brought them from home! Do you have a red?

scenes.speaker: Manager
scenes.line: This is a cloth tablecloth! You can't color on it!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh really? [camera shows that Kevin has drawn a house on the tablecloth.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know, herpes affects one in five sexually active adults? [manager looks up, angrily at Michael] Pippy Longstocking, Ronald McDonald's wife, Ron Howard, Ron Weasley, what do thay all have in common? Red heads. Erin Hannon, come on up here and receive your Cutest Red Head in the Office Award! [Erin looks thrilled and walks up to the stage]

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: That is bull! [throws her Dundie]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Thank you, thank you! This is the first award I've ever won in my entire life. [Gabe and Andy smile at her] People are right about the Dundies, they are magical. But, I don't feel it. And I think that's because I'm not with the right person. Gabe, we should break up.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I'm not attracted to you. I just, I cringe when you talk. I have to be honest. Right, right Pam? [Pam looks very awkward] Thank you for hearing me.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: [stands up and walks to stage, takes the microphone] Well, this is embarrassing, um, I'm obviously really angry at Erin. It's that quarter life crisis everyone's been talking about. [Jim is looking wide eyed, jaw dropped] Alright I'm gonna go. [Dwight plays cricket noises]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [escorts Erin off stage] There you go.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Damn that was cold.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: It is difficult to recognize the person who will be replacing you. But he is a good guy, so the Michael Scott Award for Best Dundies Host goes to DeAngelo Vickers. [DeAngelo jogs up and takes the Dundie and tries to go back to his seat]

scenes.speaker: Audience
scenes.line: Speech! Speech! Speech! Speech!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Hold on, hold on one second. [puts on the headphones and turns the volume up all the way] I WANNA, I WANNA, I FEEL TRULY BLESSED! UHHH, TO BE WORKING WITH ALL OF YOU! BEFORE THIS ALL STARTED, FUNNY STORY, I WAS IN THE BATHROOM, VOMITTING, AND VOMITTING IN THE MEN'S ROOM!

scenes.speaker: Manager
scenes.line: Okay, okay. [trying to stop him from offending other people in his restaurant]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: THAT'S WHY IT'S BEEN SHUT DOWN FOR MOST OF THE EVENING…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [stopping Manager] DeAngelo is expressing himself. [manager pulls the microphone cable, everyone can still here DeAngelo.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: This is truly special, for me! And uh, anyway. It's so much lighter!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, we're done! That's it.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Michael, are we?!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We're done. We're done!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Outside of the restaurant, obviously sad] So that is how it ends. My last Dundies ever. I was hoping it'd be more like Godfather Three. That rapped up the whole franchise in an extremely satisfying way. But instead it is like Godfather One! That was, very confusing, had maybe three big laughs. Oh well…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Michael, we were thinking maybe we could keep this thing going!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I know I'm the cause of this royal screw up but I would like to see this show go on.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no. You're being too hard on yourself. We had a very truncated rehearsal time.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Let's grab some ice cream, go back to the office, and finish what we started. [others nod in agreement]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So what you're saying is you kinda like it? [Phyllis impression] I've fallen and I can't get up! [normal again] That Phyllis bit, that was pretty good.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I don't know that we need to dissect it all now, but-

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That got a big laugh.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That did. Pretty huge laugh.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [to Stanley, who is cracking up again] You were laughing right?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I was.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [with Dwight and Michael outside Michael's car] You know what, I have to go to the bathroom.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: We're really close.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I can just run over to the gas station.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: We should just wait here and not get good seats in the conference room?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That's true, we wouldn't get seats together.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Okay, fine I'll hold it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in the car] You know, despite a couple hiccups, I think that went very well.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I thought it was the worst Dundies I've ever been to.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Man! Maybe you should have won the Kind of a Bitch Award.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Gladly! I'd accept that award, because a bitch, is a female dog!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [as Michael pulls over and stops the car] Please don't stop so suddenly, the seatbelt is pressing on my bladder. Why are you even wearing a seatbelt, you're sitting in the backseat, baby.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What is your problem?!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I just don't see a point in the Dundies! Okay? The jokes are terrible, the venue is bad, the fashion is boring.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay! That, that is unfair! The clothing was safe, but tasteful.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: And next time, why don't you pick a co-host, that doesn't have microphone-a-phobia!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [very uncomfortable] Look, what ever you're going to do, how long is it going to take? Ballpark. 'Cause I just, I gotta make a decision here. [gets out and slams the door]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: He is in an all-out sprint.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in conference room] Here… [Andy walks in] Okay! By his own omission, this person actually tried marijuana in college, so the Doobie Doobie Pothead Stoner of the Year Award goes to, Andy Bernard! [Andy walks up]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: A lot of people I'd like to thank, but I think we all actually wanna thank you Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, okay. [nods to him]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I mean, we actually all really wanna thank you, for everything.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [starts playing the tune to Seasons of Love while Andy sits down]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh my God, something's happening.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [singing] Nine million, nine hundred eighty six thousand minutes! We actually sat down, and did the math.

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: Nine million, nine hundred eighty six thousand minutes! That's how many minutes, that you've worked here.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: In costumes!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And impressions!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: In meetings.

scenes.speaker: Erin & Kelly
scenes.line: And cups of coffee.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: For birthdays!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: More meetings and-

scenes.speaker: Women
scenes.line: E-Mail forms you made us read.

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: Nine million, nine hundred eighty six thousand minutes! That's like watching Die Hard, eighty thousand times!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: You hit me with your car!

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: You helped me get off drugs!

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I watch you when you sleep.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I forgive you for kissing me!

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: Remember to, call. Call. Remember to, call. Call. Remember to, call. Call.

scenes.speaker: Kelly & Erin
scenes.line: Call, text or e-mail, or call.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [falsetto] Measure your life in love!

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: Remember to call, remember to, call. Remember to call.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [choked up] Yeah, okay. [pauses, then takes a deep breath] Well this is gonna hurt like a mother[bleep].

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [recall to Dundies at Louie Volpies] Every day, millions of Americans suffer from extreme repulsiveness. Someone in our midst, is bringing that problem to light. Toby Flenderson, please come up here and accept the Extreme Repulsiveness Award. Oh that's so mean!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No it's not.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [Toby is shaking his head, no] It's his last Dundies.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You gotta play along man.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Come on Toby.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Here he comes! Alright! You deserve it! [Toby comes up and take the mic]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I really disagree with this. I think it's kind of hateful. Though I am a little happy right now to have a platform to talk about the outcome of a case I was recently a juror on. The Scranton Strangler. That man's being put to death. I was part of the verdict, and I'm not so sure he's guilty any more. [Dwight plays a clip from the song Oh Yeah:

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sitting on the roof of the office building] Well, I'm moving to Colorado to start my new life with Holly. Just up here, getting used to the altitude.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [walking up] Michael?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I've got a treat for you!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ahh, thank you. Like a butler.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Colorado specialty, Rocky Mountain Oysters.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Michael takes one and bites] Oh, these do not taste like oysters.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [angrily] That's because they're Not oysters, they're bull testicles! I cut them off fresh this morning! [Michael spits it out] Hah!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sick freak! What is wrong with you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What is wrong with you? I'm the sick freak? After what you did? You expect to be buttled? You didn't recommend me?!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I don't own Dunder Mifflin, okay? [Dwight scoffs] The job was not mine to give. [sighs] Look, I need your advice on something. I am told that there are bears in the Rockies.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Where did you hear that? Obvious XM Radio?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, I was just thinking that maybe I should keep a salami in my pocket…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Great idea.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: …in order to feed the bears.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Especially if you think that life would be better without Legs!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How do you mean?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Black Bears can smell a salami at five miles Michael, what are you thinking?! And they run faster than a horse, so if you were thinking about outrunning one on a horse I would try a cheetah. You, in tight pants, Michael, are a salami to a Black Bear. Do you understand? [Michael nods in agreement] You're like a giant walking salami!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, so no salami in the pants. How about a pepperoni?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Any kind of meat that you can possibly name!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [with Michael in his office] You're not gonna take all these toys are you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hm?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I mean you don't have a job lined up, so it's not like you have a desk to put 'em on.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well I have interviews.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: That's nice. [reaches and a grabs a toy truck] How 'bout that truck? Can I have this little truck? I was thinking I might… glue a stapler on top. Or put a hole here, stick pens in it. [Michael gives an obviously fake smile] You okay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yes. Yes, you know what? Take my favorite truck. Sure.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: You know what? Uh, it's your last couple days, I'm gonna get out of your hair.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh you don't, that's-

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I will be in the break room.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: That sounds good. Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Dead man walking.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sad? No, no, no. I don't leave 'til tomorrow, so… Tomorrow I will be a wreck.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: [sees Andy walk into the Men's Room and follows him in] Stay away from Erin! [cornEring him in the bathroom]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I'm your boss!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Why don't you, uh, stay away from me?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: No, I'm gonna stand where I want. Okay? You don't wanna get on my bad side! I've seen some horrible things! I own over two hundred horror movies!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay! That's so weird! Just go away!

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: No! You go away! [storms out, toilet flushes, Jim exits the bathroom]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [weak] Hi Tuna.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So you guys are filming people when they go to the bathroom now?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [in the conference room with Pam, Angela, and Meredith] How about cupcakes?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Please.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What's wrong with cupcakes?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Everything.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [walking in] There they are! Party Planning Committee together again!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well we all wanted to plan your goodbye party. We thought this would be easier.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We thought.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It's an experiment.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: The three of us have all been chairmen before.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So this is the dream team.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [walking up behind the glass] Hey! What are you saying?!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: The dream team… and Meredith.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [to Michael] We decided on the ice cream. Mint chocolate chip, your favorite.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmm!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah that was a surprise…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know what, I'm thinking maybe we should get ice cream that everybody'll like. How about vanilla? Let's get vanilla.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [surprised] Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Tomorrow I want everyone to have a good time. No drama. And as for today, just a typical day. Alright?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Should we get toppings?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What do you like Pam?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [confused] What?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What kind of toppings would you like?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hot fudge?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sounds good. Fudge it up! [all seem surprised at Michael's behavior]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [holding up his "World's Best Boss Mug"] I bought this for myself. And yesterday, they gave me this. [holds up a Dundie that reads, 'World's Best Boss 2011, Michael G. Scott', throws his mug into the garbage can and places his Dundie at the front of his desk] I still need something to drink out of though.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [pulls out a list of everyone in the office, then puts it back in his jacket] Attention everyone, before I leave tomorrow I would like to reveal a secret I have kept for over twenty years. A secret about Phyllis.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Please Michael.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: When Phyllis was in high school, she was so… cute. [Phyllis looks relieved] And she still is.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I thought he knew about the baby I gave away.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [holds up mittens she's knitting] Look Michael, it's a going away present so your hands won't get cold.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ahh.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: It's almost done, but you can't get them wet, and they can't be dry-cleaned either. You have to hand wash without water, wring-dry gently, and use a hairdryer on cool.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [hesitantly] Sounds great, I just think it's great. Oh, I have gifts as well! [goes into his office and comes out with a bag] And I will start, by giving the first gift to Phyllis! Phyllis, you are shy and sweet, and you don't often speak your mind, but you should. Because you have great ideas. So Phyllis, I am giving you this, so you can always remember to speak your mind. [presents to her a mouth wind-up chattEring toy]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: It's cute. [plays with it]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Stanley, you love your Sudoku and your puzzles, I bestow upon you, my felt. [gives Stanley a small felt table] May you never lose the fun loving quality in life.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Where's the rest of it, it's got no balls.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Well, okay… And Andy, Andy who needs confidence that he is a great salesman. I give you, my clients, our ten most important accounts. [other salesmen look outraged]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Wow.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [angry] Yeah wow!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You know I'm the worst salesman here right?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: But you're the best salesman, on the inside.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What does that even mean?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You sold us all on Andy, a product that nobody wanted.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'm gonna lose 'em.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're not gonna lose them.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I promise you that I will.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Just do your best! I have faith in you.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [as Michael walks away, Stanley whispers angrily to Andy] Gimme those clients!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [to Dwight] Do you believe that?!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I've given up expecting Michael to do the right thing. Or the decent thing. Or even the comprehensible thing.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I used to be obese. Once you've conquered obesity, everything else is easy. Life literally moves in slow motion. I'm not saying I'm superman, but, let me just put it this way. If I were shot in the head, I'm pretty sure everything would be fine. I almost welcome it. [winks]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Kevin, I have something for you.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh! [Michael unrolls it to reveal it is a caricature of Kevin as a pig eating pizza]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You know who that is?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [rips the poster in half] Don't be a caricature Kevin, never be a caricature. How did that feel when I tore that up?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Better…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Good, stand up. [Kevin does so] You will be thin. You Won't drool over pizza like an animal anymore.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: But…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You will find love.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Michael, I'm pretty much okay with who I am now.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Don't be. You should never settle for who you are. [moving on] Oscar, Oscar, Oscar! Oscar, you are-

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I just lost Porter Hardware! I just, I lost 'em!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [quietly groans] Okay, you know what? Just do your best buddy! Okay, Oscar, you are very smart, and you have a gigantic education. And, I think of you as my scarecrow, because you gave me a brain. So that's why I made you this. [takes a sack tied in the upper middle making a crude head, with a face drawn on, obviously the product of poor craftsmanship, Oscar pretends to like it]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Thank you Michael. It's beautiful.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughing] It looks like a [more laughing] It looks like it was made by a two year old monkey on a farm! He just accepted, accepted that I put all this work into it! [laughs more] He has the lowest opinion of me, of anybody!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Was it just me, or did you think that we were going to have sex at some point?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It was just you…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: How would you have wanted to do it? Okay, okay. You know what? Inappropriate. I am engaged happily, and you have landed yourself a Senator.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: State Senator.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmhmm, bravo!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Brava!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: You wanna see some pictures? I just got these.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sure!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Uhm, these are, okay this is us at the theater. And antiquing! Oh, rollerblading.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Who's that? Who's that guy? [points to second guy in the pictures]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh, that's Thomas, Robert's aide.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I guess this could be the one, huh?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yeah. [Oscar shakes his head no]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [walking into the kitchen, DeAngelo is using the coffee machine to cook chicken covered in melted chocolate] Hey.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [hurriedly, while hiding the chocolate covered chicken] Hey!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'm going to be dropping out on one of our biggest clients this afternoon and I could use some back up.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Let's rip it up homes. [smacks top of the door frame with his hand, leaving a chocolate hand outline]

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: [Andy walks by with DeAngelo, says quietly after he leaves] Walk away bitch.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [Michael is leaving the accounting area] Oh Michael! Where do you want your last pay check sent?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: My last pay check?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You have an address yet in Colorado?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What town do Holly's parents live in?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I'm not sure, um, Mountainton?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Sounds beautiful!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [Michael sits alone eating at the back of the kitchen, Pam comes in with Jim, Creed and Kevin] You should do more stuff like that.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I'm going to!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to Michael] Hey! It's almost your last day, come sit with us.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Nah, I'm almost done.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You sure?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So I'm going to Carbondale this afternoon to get a new bulk shredder.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Finally! That old shredder sucked.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's a good shredder, it just keeps breaking.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah, it won't shred magazines.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's not supposed to shred magazines Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I know…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Did you break the shredder Kevin?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No, it's just… that old shredder sucks. [Michael looks tearful] Just get one that'll shred magazines.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't think any of them are supposed to shred magazines.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [crying] I can't do this. All the channels are gonna be different there. I'm not gonna be able to find my shows. I'm not going to start improv at level one, and I don't think my credits will transfer. Ugh, and you know what? I just figured out where I was supposed to go to vote. [picks World's Best Boss mug out of the trashcan and puts it back on his desk] I gotta call her, and I'm going to tell her, that I cannot come. [dials on his phone]

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [on phone] Hello there!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Hi. What is the name of our town?

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Boulder. Is something wrong? Are you okay?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, no. I just needed to hear your voice.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [Yoda voice] Oh you mean this?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughing] Yes. [Olive Oyl impression] Yes my hero!

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: [deep man voice] I'll pay the rent! [Michael laughs] Okay, my mom's looking at me and she has no sense of humor. It's a joke mom!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [laughing] Ohh, I miss you.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: Well I'll see you tonight. I'll pick you up outside baggage claim.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. I'll see you tonight. I love you.

scenes.speaker: Holly
scenes.line: I love you too.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [hangs up and composes himself] Yes, so I know I told everybody that tomorrow is my last day, but I'm, I'm gonna be leaving tonight. I head to the airport at four. [looks at the list of members of the office, with some names crossed out] And I have said goodbye to half of them.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well you know Michael, I have a brother in Boulder. Rory Flenderson. You should look him up.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [grimaces and nods, Toby nods back at him] Okay.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [smiling] Okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [walks over to Kelly] Kelly! Kelly? Kelly.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [doing make up and irritated] What?!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: If I just went away right now, would that be the best gift that I could give you?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Yes! Please! Please go away! And stop using that weird slow voice.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in Ryan's office, which is illuminated blue] She was once my girl, and she is your girl now.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Wow. [camera pans over to show that the light is from Michael's St. Pauli Girl Sign, hanging in Ryan's office]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: This is… totally unnecessary.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You're not prone to seizures?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [in conference room with the party planning committee] So Michael said we can do whatever we want cake-wise. What do we want?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [quickly] Erotic.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: See? This is what happens. You can't let a stray dog into the house.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hmm, let's hear here out. I would like to hear more about these cakes. [Angela and Pam look uncomfortable]

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I know these Ethiopians that run a cake shop.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Good God…

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: They make these cakes, they're wild! I mean, they show everything!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't, I don't think we sh-

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I know what you're thinking, but it's not just black, they do it all. And the women on these cakes, they're not just guy's fantasies. They have real, full women. It is refreshing.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [stopping her] Okay, don't turn this into some feminist issue.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: As a person who buys a lot of erotic cakes, it feels good to be represented on one.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You know what, I think we should get some other input.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I think we should do cupcakes. I am one of the few people who looks hot eating a cupcake.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah, cupcakes. That's what I said.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No! I'm not cleaning up a bunch of uneaten cupcake bottoms! You know, we don't really care about your opinion. You're just a tie-breaker.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sees Pam walking towards the door of the office] Um, Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, hey Michael! I'm just going to go to Carbondale to price some shredders. I'll see you later.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [disappointed] Okay… [Jim is confused]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [walking into the women's bathroom, Gabe storms in after her] Gabe!

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I need to talk to you!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You can't be in here. This is a lady's room!

scenes.speaker: Abe
scenes.line: Erin, I respect your privacy, but I will follow you in here everytime you go if that's what it takes. [Creed walks out of one of the stalls]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hey Creed.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Not cool man. [walks out]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I really think you should leave.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Someday, you are going to tell our grandchildren about how their grandfather won you back in a women's room.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Can we talk about this later, I have to go.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Just read the letter under your windshield wiper, it explains everything. Quick one. [leans in for a kiss]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Gabe!

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Okay… [walks out embarrassed]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [on video cam with his brother] Here's the thing Rory, I knew you guys would hit it off in an odd way.

scenes.speaker: Rory
scenes.line: I can bring him a welcome basket. I'll surprise him.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Do- Well you should give him a little time to settle in. But-

scenes.speaker: Rory
scenes.line: Does he like jams? My shelves are over flowing with preserves.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, no. He hates jams.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [walking into Darryl's office] Darryl!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I would like to give you, the only copy, of Somehow I Manage. [hands him a thin black folder] Unfinished. If there's anyone here who can finish it, it's you.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: That's sweet Mike. Let's see here. There's a chapter, called Gum. With one sentence. Everybody likes the guy who offers him a stick of gum.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Mmmhmmm. It's true. Darryl, I have one last wish. I would like to use the bailer.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: No. Can't let you do that Mike.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No problem. Worth a try.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in warehouse] Darryl said I could use the bailer because I'm leaving.

scenes.speaker: Warehouse Guy
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [picks up a basketball and dribbles it away from the basket] Alright guys, well… see ya later warehouse. Catch you on the flippity flip. [throws the ball behind him and misses the basket, tries and misses several more times]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [in car with Andy] okay, so what's our approach? You a veteran? Do I have a month to live? You gonna get married tomorrow? What? [Andy stares blankly] Hmm?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I thought we'd just talk about our customer service and exceptional paper quality.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: That's stupid. [laughing. Nervously, Andy laughs with him]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [joking] What do I know?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [still laughing] What do you know? We gotta get psyched up! Okay? Guy? Let's get psyched! Is there an animal shelter on the way?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [confused] Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Awesome! Ani Ani Shelto! Here we come. Do you know how to high-five?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: 'Cause if you do now's the time.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [going for it] Alright.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Not while I'm driving.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [still trying the backwards basket] Catch you guys- [forklift drives in front of the camera] Catch you guys on the filippity flip. [misses and picks it up again] Flippity flip! [misses again and grabs it back] Flippity flip! [makes it in, gets excited] Really? [composes himself] Okay, see ya guys! [walks away, containing his self-pleasure]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [at the animal shelter with Andy] You know how I met Jo Bennett? And got started on my ladder of success?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No. I don't.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [hands Andy a dog] I'm walking along, out of work. Again. Thinking to myself, 'I only have enough cash to by a sandwich, or get drunk. And I see this guy trying to steal this lady's dog! So I grab the dog. He runs off. She's so grateful, she hires me.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Awwhh, wow.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Gimme that dog! That's not your dog! [takes the dog from a confused Andy] Yeah! Again.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, okay…

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Gimme that damn dog you f***ing thief! Don't ever do It again! [Andy nods modestly] You hear me?! [Andy nods again] You feel that energy?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Mmhmmm.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Wooo! Yeah! [parades in circles with the dog, pretends to whack Andy with it] [giving it to Andy] Okay, again.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I know that Gabe is young, and hot and everything. And he's begging me to reconsider, but I… I just think I'm in love with someone else.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Kevin?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Andy.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Ahhhh…

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I wish I knew who my birth mother was, so she could just tell me who to choose.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Maybe neither.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I'm not attracted to Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Erin, listen to me. You shouldn't rush into this. At all. And you know why? Because you are beautiful. And you are fun. And you are smart. [Erin is smiling] And when the right guy comes along, you'll know it. You will. [kisses her head] And you know what? You don't need a mom. Because you have my number, and you can call me anytime.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [nods] Extension 147.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: N-

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I know.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay. [both chuckling. Michael leaves Erin, looking thoughtful]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [on the phone] You want the 27-26 or the 27-30?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Phyllis. Phyllis, are my mittens done?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: No. [trying to finish her sale when Michael hangs up the phone] I'm on a sale!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Listen to me. It's two p.m. From now until four, your priority is knitting. Knit like the wind.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Okay… [Jim gives a knowing look to the camera]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Dwight, I will be leaving tomorrow. [pulls out an envelope from his jacket]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: So I wanted to give you that. [hands him the envelope] It's a letter of recommendation. [Dwight looks eager. Michael nods to him and walks away]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: This is gonna be good. [eagerly reading the letter] To whom it may concern. [off to the side] Good, real personal. Thanks Michael. [reading again] The dictionary defines superlative as:

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [opening his trunk excitedly and gets out his paintball gear, takes his gun and looks for Michael, gives up, Michael jumps out of the dumpster shooting, they shoot each other, yell, laugh, and taunt, having a great time]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in the office, crosses Dwight off his list. He has paint in his messed up hair, and is containing his laughter]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [giving his and Andy's pitch to a client] I would just like to start off saying, I have not worked with Mr. Andy Bernard for very long, I can say, is that he is no Michael Scott. I can't sit here and tell you he's gonna be a success. I can't sit here and tell you that he's even the best man for the job. [Andy looks awkward] But I can say this:

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Michael walks into the office, still a mess] Ahh, what happened to you?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: You should see the other guy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [smiles knowingly]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [looks at the clock to see it is three o'clock] Jim where is Pam?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uhh, she's still pricing the whatevers. The shredders.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: But it is already three o'clock! [Michael leaves, Jim gives a knowing look to the camera]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [walks into a movie theater showing The King's Speech]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [in his office talking to Creed, Gabe, and Meredith in that order] Whether you're scared of dying, or dying Alone, or dying drunk in a ditch. Don't be. It's going to be okay.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Yeah I was tripling up. There's not enough time in the day to have a special moment with everybody.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [Gabe is still standing in front of Michael's desk] And you, why are you still here.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: [sounding hurt] I'm either going to quit today, or stay to make sure that Andy's career is destroyed.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No, you are not going to quit today. For goodness sake, this is not going to be your last day in the office. Everybody gets dumped Gabe. Can I give you a piece of advice? [Gabe nods] A little cover-up on your Adam's apple will make it appear smaller, and make you look less like a transvestite. [Gabe looks awkward and Michael winks]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [walking out the client's room with Andy] That is cold sir! Absolutely cold. You know what? It was a complete waste of my time.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh DeAngelo, I'm, uh. I forgot my bag, so I'll meet you in the car.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [grumbles] Okay whatever.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [walks into the client's office again] Sir, I'd just like to apologize, for that. I could tell you that he has a steel plate in his head, or that he's crazy, but the truth is I think he's just a terrible salesman. And I want you to know, that if you re-up with us, anything you need, day or night, I will be the one to take your call.

scenes.speaker: Client
scenes.line: Keep talking.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [on his phone waiting for Andy, next to their car] Yes. Okay, alright. No, well thank you! Alright, take care. [hangs up] You'll never guess, we did it!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [laughing] Hey! [they hug] Good job boss!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: We did it!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [standing in front of his office, sees that it is three forty five] Okay, everybody come on. Conference room five seconds! Let's go! Hurry up, let's do this! [Dwight runs into the conference room. All others follow]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Yes, what is this about?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: What is this meeting about?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Mmhmmm.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay, here we are in the conference room. Once again. And I just wanted to call you all here, together, because I have something important. Well there's two things actually. Okay first, I would like a whereabouts on Pam. [Jim looks regretful] And secondly, Phyllis how are those mittens coming? Because I would actually like to bring them home and pack them. I'm leaving for the day at four.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: They're almost done but my knuckles are swelling a little and-

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [cutting her off] Well power through the arthritis Phyllis you can do it!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Is that it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Umm, hmm?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Is that it?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [the office looks up expectantly] Ummm… Hm… No. [changing his mind] No. There's a special guest that I would like to invite to say one last goodbye. So here he comes, he's coming right in. [walks out and then back in, now using a Vietnamese accent] Oh hi everybody, it's Ping! [the office groans] And I'm here to say goodbye to all you wonderful people! Thank you everybody! You've been so wonderful! [only Kevin is laughing. Stanley tries to leave. Michael hugs him] I ruv you all! I ruv you very much!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, can I talk to you for a second?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Sure. [Ping accent] Be right out!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [brings Michael into his office] So I've been meaning to tell ya, I wanna take you out for lunch. For your last day.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [sad] Ohh…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What do you think? Tomorrow? Lunch, you and me?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [holding back tears] Okay…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You're not leaving tomorrow. You're leaving today right?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Maybe.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow, so that's it huh? Just, four o'clock and you are gone for good.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Why am I so sad? Am I doing the wrong thing?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Absolutely not. It's just that sometimes… goodbyes are a bitch.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [pulls out a recorder and speaks softly into it] T-Shirt idea, goodbyes stink. Okay, alright. So. James Halpert. [starts to cry] You started with this company, as a fine young man…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know what I think we should do? I think we should just save the goodbyes for tomorrow. At lunch.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Oh, okay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And then tomorrow, I can tell you… what a great boss, you turned out to be. The best boss I ever had. [Jim is holding back tears too]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [hears a taxi honking] Oh shoot! That's my cab.

scenes.speaker: Jim
