scenes.line: Alright.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Alright.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Listen Michael, I really… I did text Pam, but…

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I know, it's okay. Just, give her a hug. Alright?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [shakes Michael's hand] I will see you, tomorrow at lunch.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: I am looking forward to lunch. And hearing about what a great boss I am.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [chuckles] You got it.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Okay… [crosses Jim off his list] Phyllis.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh no, they're still not done.

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: No no no, let me see. [picks up the mostly knitted mittens] Oh Phyllis, nice try. I love 'em. [waves goodbye to her with the mittens] [Michael begins walking out the office, he takes one last look at all his friends to see them working, and Jim looking back, teary eyed]

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [drinking from Michael's World's Best Boss mug] See ya tomorrow boss!

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Later guys. [leaves the office]

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: Got almost everybody. So… Holly's my family now. [you see video of Michael getting into the cab, and driving off. As the cab leaves, Pam drives in] She's my family. The babies that I make with her, will be my children. The people that you work with, are just… when you get down to it… your very best friends. They say, on your deathbed, you never wish you spent more time at the office. But I will. Gotta be a lot better than a deathbed. [You see Michael getting out and entEring the airport, and going through security] I actually don't understand deathbeds. I mean, who would buy that?

scenes.speaker: Michael
scenes.line: [putting his shoes back on, talking to the camera crew] Well, I guess this is it. Hey will you guys let me know if this ever airs? Thank you. Alright… Oh! [pulls out his mic from his shirt] This is gonna feel so good, getting this thing off my chest. [he hands them the body mic, when he speaks it is inaudible now] That's what she said! [waves goodbye and walks off to his gate, halfway there Pam comes running up to him and they hug for a while. They say their goodbyes to each other, and Michael walks off for good]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [watching Michael's plane take off. Crying and has smeared make up on] No he wasn't sad. He was full of hope. About Colorado, and he was hoping to get an upgrade as an award's member. And he said he was just real excited to get home and see Holly.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [all are in the conference room for Michael's party. Michael isn't there. Jim gives the camera a knowing look] Well if he's not gonna make it at least we should go ahead and eat the cake. [Kevin nods] I for one love the corners. [cuts a corner piece, picks it up with his bare hands, and takes a bite] Why'd I just do that? It's not even that good. I don't even want it. I had cake for lunch. [throws the piece in the garbage] No, you know what? I've been good. I deserve this. [grabs a piece from another corner. The office groans] What am I doing? [chucks it into the trashcan] Come on DeAngelo! [DeAngelo tries to lick the cake, everybody yells no]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [to Jim] Uh oh… [Jim, tearful, nods]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: So, coasting time is officially over. Big changes are comin', and they're comin' fast. If you don't like 'em, this is called a door. You can walk right through it. Alright. I'm not here to be your friend. I like my life outside of this place. I live to leave at 5. Change number one:

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: They are trying to figure me out. And I don't like it. Once they figure me out, they start to tell me what I want to hear. And I need to quickly figure out who's a good worker and who is simply a good mind reader. Because as soon as I'm hearing what I want to hear, I'm not gonna care.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Change two, Toby, you're gettin' a new chair.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Don't thank me! Hey, don't thank me, guy! Okay? And I don't care if you like it.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: These sound like good ideas, why wouldn't we like them?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I don't care what your favorite flavor is. Here's a bowl of ice cream. You either like it or you don't. [Andy nods] That's my attitude right now in this room, that's my attitude on Ice Cream Thursdays. Alright? Clear? Any questions?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: This all sounds great to me. [hesitates] But I could see how some people might think that they're bad. I don't know what to think.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: That is a s– astute observation, Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Kev's got me pegged. [chuckles]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: It blows away Vermont in the fall.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Snap, for real?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Good morning, Deangelo.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Hold on.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [continuing to talk to Darryl] And if you're really serious, you should go in the spring.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Because of the flowers.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: No. Because the entire state smells like Earth.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dogwoods, or just the Earth.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yes, Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, well, good morning. I think I have good news for you today. I found your new executive assistant. My friend Carla. [looking at resume] She's got great experience. We even considered making her Cece's godmother, but she had this boyfriend at the time– but here's her resume.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Put it with the rest.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [entEring his office] Hey dudes!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh my God, he hates me!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No he doesn't. You just get so nervous and hyper around him.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I know.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Every time there's a silence, your brain's like "Heh-heh-huh-huh" [imitating crying].

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Is that what he tells you at your little inner circle meetings?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Careful. There is no inner circle.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, there's an inner circle. Oh yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: There is no inner circle. Deangelo just prefers to delegate a few things, to a few guys.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Jim only says that because he's in the inner circle. I also say that because I am also in the inner circle. Did you get that, Ma? Your boy, Kevin Malone, is IN the inner circle! [thinks] Which doesn't exist.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [holding two cups of coffee] There he is! Got ya coffee. [offers cup to Dwight]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, wow, thank you. That was so kind of you. [throws cup in the garbage]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Not a coffee guy, I take it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's just that I own the coffee shop. So, once you've seen sausage being made, all you want to do is make sausage, because it's so much fun.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Listen. I've got a sixer. "Automatic for the People" on the jukebox. Let's hit the park after sundown. Come on! Pick up some sausage if you want.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I think you'll find what you're looking for [points toward Oscar] over there.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: No matter how many times I reach out to Dwight, he doesn't seem to want anything to do with me. It reminds me of my relationship with my son. Except there, I'm the Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Who's the biggest client in the state? I say we go get 'em, whatever it takes. Huh? What do you guys say?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Right! Or my other idea, 50,000 tiny clients.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah, I say we just go for it!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [shoots mini basketball at hoop on office door, misses badly] Is that ball lighter than usual? Is that a Chinatown knockoff?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's Toys R Us, I think.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: No, that's definitely a knockoff. You can feel the center of gravity's off. Feel that. [throws ball to Gabe] What do you think?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: [holding ball in open palm] Oh, yeah, totally. Jim, you got ripped off big time.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [calling for the ball] Deangelo! [shoots and makes it] See what I did there? That's what you need to do. [makes shooting gesture] It's that little English. The British are coming.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Deangelo's open!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Hey Ry. Your department's killing it, baby. [puts arm around Ryan]

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hey hey, my pleasure, my treasure.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Keep it up.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: The problem with having "It" or "the X-factor" or whatever it is you want to call it, is that it's impossible to put into words what you're bringing to the table. So to make things simpler for Deangelo, I just, without lying, strongly implied that I'm Kelly's supervisor. It's not even that much of a stretch. She pretty much does whatever I say.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry…

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Why should I pretend that you are my boss?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Because what would you have done in that situation, Kelly? I'll tell you what I would have done for you. I'd lie for you.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Yeah, but you lie all the time. You lie for no reason. Ryan, you just like to lie.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I'd die for you too.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: You really would?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [hears Deangelo entEring] Hey, Kelly Kapoor, if I don't have those call logs on my desk, we're just gonna have to evaluate your future at the company!

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Sure thing, Mr. Howard.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Woo. Glad he's not my boss.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [whispers to Kelly] You're the best. Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: You know I have a cousin who cracked the secret formula for a certain popular cola that I shall not name. So I've never had to buy it. True story. I just drink my cousin's.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Congratulations on your one cousin. I have seventy. Each one better than the last.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: You know what… straight up, why don't you like me?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm just not a suck-up like everyone else around here. Okay? I do my job well, so why don't you just leave me alone and let me do it. Okay?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Ohhhh no.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Okay? I'm gonna win you over.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No you're not.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yes I am.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Oh yes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yes. Yes-yes-yes-yes-yes [starts to run out of the break room] yes-yes-yes-yes-yes-yes-yes-yes-yes-yes-yes-yes!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [looking at resume] Uh oh, this former administrative assistant misspelled "administrative" and "assistant."

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: The winner:

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Sorry gang. Thought my juggling stuff was in the trunk of my car. It's not.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh no, do you think it was stolen?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I gotcha covered, boss. Used to play with the parabolas myself. [opens desk drawer and takes out balls] Got some extra balls! [throws them toward Deangelo, who dodges them] Hey-hey-hey-ho!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Sorry, I never touch another juggler's instruments. You know, we're all here, I've got the music cued, why don't I just do my routine without the juggling balls? [starts to play "Wake Me Up Inside" by Evanescence] Prepare… to go into the danger zone. [begins pretend juggling routine]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh wow, you weren't kidding.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: No. Never. Can someone please throw me a fifth ball? If you dare! [Kevin pretends to throw ball] Incoming! And we're on! Remember, nothing's impossible! Phyllis, where's Phyllis?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [raises hand] Here.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Do you believe in me, Phyllis?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Because I believe in you.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [pretending to bounce balls off Phyllis at close range] Feel that connection? Don't move your head. Please. Thank you. Oh! Big hand for Phyllis! [clapping] That took a lot of guts! [finishes routine] Ho! I'm Deangelo Vickers, thank you so much, hope you learned something.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Didn't drop a single ball!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [imitating Deangelo's pretend juggling routine] Look. I'm juggling eggs and bowling balls. I'm juggling with one hand. No hands.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What could he possibly stand to gain from a fake juggling routine?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What could he possibly stand to gain from a real juggling routine? How can you keep defending him?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He's good at his job. And I like working for him.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Of course you do, Jim. You're a man. Deangelo is a huge sexist.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Whoa, whoa, whoa. I think if he was sexist, I'd be able to tell. I took a crapload of women's studies courses at Cornell. And I wrote my own companion piece to the "Vagina Monologues" called the "Penis Apologies." So I know a thing or two.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Okay. Then how about I'm the head of the Accounting Department, but he only ever talks to Kevin? What about Pam and Kelly? Also department heads. But has he ever met with you or even asked you to do anything?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: How could I not see it? You're so right.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [to Jim] Why don't you talk to him about it?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And say what? "Hey Deangelo, are you shy or just a sexist?"

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Why don't you just tell him how his actions are being perceived by the women in this office?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mmm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: And if he doesn't listen, then he can kiss his penis goodbye. Snip snip. Am I right, girls?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, you got a second?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yeah, I got tons of time. This job's a joke.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: So what's up?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Umm, really, it's nothing, I was just talking to Angela, and she was —

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [opening door to Deangelo's office] Hey, saw Jim come in. We meeting?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yeah sure. Let's make it a meeting. [Darryl, Kevin, Gabe enter office]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: If it's alright, can I just have like one minute alone, just to go over —

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: What's the big secret? Why are you even whispEring? Come on, it's the guys!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I know. [Gabe and Darryl stand on either side of Jim with paper and pens in hand] Just the guys. Well, maybe that's, uh, part of the problem. I think…so what happened was, I was talking with some of the department heads. Uh, some of the female department heads.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Uh-oh. Right?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hot!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Maybe there's a vibe out there, with certain members of the office, that you are…a little sexist, or —

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Damn!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Whoa. Whoa. Wait.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Are you serious? Who feels this way?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh. Like nobody.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Umm, Pam?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It was —

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Was it Pam?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: That sounds like Pam. You know how she gets. Deangelo, she can get really bitchy. [begins bad imitation of Pam] Kevin…

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Guys. Hold on. Doesn't matter who, okay? I'm just happy that Jim brought it to my attention because honestly, I had – I had no idea.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's awesome.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [on phone] Mom, Ryan's taking us out to dinner tonight. No, no, he's not going to stand us up like he did last time. He won't ever stand us up again.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [joint talking head with Kelly] So I am the new customer service supervisor.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: When Deangelo's around.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: And I am also a very dutiful boyfriend when —

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: All the time.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: All the time.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Erin, do you mind running down to the lobby and bringing up my brand new executive assistant?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Absolutely.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, who'd you end up hiring?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Oh, I'm glad you asked, Jim. Because apparently there's a rumor running around here that I am a sexist. I can't work here effectively if you guys think I'm something that I am not. I am not a sexist. Raise your hand if you have a vagina. [Deangelo raises hand, Kelly and Pam sheepishly raise hands] Raise your hand if someone you love has a vagina. [Deangelo raises other hand, along with rest of office] Yeah, yeah. Okay. Just about everyone. What about Deangelo's hand? Oh wow. He's got 'em both up. [Ryan raises both hands] Yeah. Uh huh. [others raise both hands] Yeah, so it bothers me when I hear that there's gossip around here that I treat women lesser than men. Okay? Frankly, we all look a little ridiculous when that happens.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I'm not a feminist, but I think that the men in this office are being given chances that the women aren't.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Dwight, what's your take?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What's the argument here? NBA, WNBA. One is a sport, one is a joke. I love sports, I love jokes. Room for all.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Man, you're smart. [Erin arrives with new executive assistant] Oh, hey! Hi! Hello. Welcome. Uh, everyone, I'd like you to please welcome Jordan Garfield. This is everyone.

scenes.speaker: Jordan
scenes.line: Hello.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So, Jordan, uh, where did you work before? Uh, a law office?

scenes.speaker: Jordan
scenes.line: No, Anthropology. We don't have this in that size, pretty lame.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Lame? You worked at Anthropology?

scenes.speaker: Jordan
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: That's like my dream job. How did you even get that job?

scenes.speaker: Jordan
scenes.line: Well, I umm –

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: You chose this job over that job?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Okay, okay, back to work, Kelly, we have a lot to get done today.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So, umm, is this your first office job then?

scenes.speaker: Jordan
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yup.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: No corporate experience whatsoever. I didn't want anyone with any bad habits.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [heading into Deangelo's office] Jim, you coming?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh yeah, did he text us?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah. [Jim looks at cell phone as Dwight's phone vibrates]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [holds up phone and looks into Deangelo's office] No!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Jim, what are you doing? Get in there. This is not the time to take a stand. At least he likes one of us.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He didn't text me. [Andy's phone chimes]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yes! I'm in.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Andy, what are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'm going in, into the belly of the beast. Gonna infiltrate and change from within. [joins the group in Deangelo's office] What's up, mancave! [makes barking noises]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [to Jim] Just go in. Just go in, he probably forgot to text you.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Internally, for office use [Jim quietly enters Deangelo's office and sits down] where do we get our paper from? Do we go –

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to Jordan] Don't worry, the first day's always the hardest.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [staring at Jim] Hey Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Can I help you?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nope. Just… [Deangelo continues staring at him] Okay. [gets up and leaves office]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: So, he kicked you out of the inner circle, huh?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, there is no inner…circle.

scenes.speaker: Jordan
scenes.line: Dwight? Deangelo wanted me to ask you if there's anything I can help you with.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Really? Anything.

scenes.speaker: Jordan
scenes.line: Do you need anything?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Deangelo, tell your whore to leave me alone.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay, I do not want to waste your time, so I will keep this br-r-r-r-r-r-ief. Now, word on the street is, Mercy Hospital, back on the market. Deangelo would like you to put together a sales pitch for next week. Deangelo has also recently learned about the Barnacle Project. Which is a non-profit organization based in Mystic, Connecticut that assists in the scraping of barnacles —

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So this is my life. Until I win the lottery [laughs]. Or Pam finally writes that series of young adult books.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So one afternoon, while walking home from school, quirky 10th grader Becky Walters finds a wounded Pegasus in the woods. And she becomes…The Horse Flyer.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hey! Kelly, that's the last time I'm gonna talk to you about your paycheck! Okay? We pay you a fair salary here, and if you're only here for the money, maybe you shouldn't be here at all.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: No one likes a money grubber.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I'm sorry, Mr. Howard, I apologize for grubbing for money. I can't do this. I can't do this. I'm sorry. I just can't do it. Deangelo, Ryan is not my boss. Okay? Frankly, he hasn't had a real job here in years.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Ohh.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Oh, that's hilarious, Kelly.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: No, he's just a big fraud, Deangelo. He's like Rango. He doesn't work here, basically. Just like the way Rango didn't save those animals. It was just a big misunderstanding.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Is this true, Ryan?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I did not see Rango.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Okay, I don't have time for this he said-she said.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: He's not saying anything!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: It's too murky. I like Ryan. You seem kind of hysterical to me. Ryan's your supervisor. Let's just leave it that way.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: That's not fair, I mean, I've been working here for such a long ti– [Deangelo walks away]

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [sighs] Oh, close call! Okay, why don't you just finish this up and leave it on my desk and I will see you at your place around 2 am.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [knocking on door to Deangelo's office as loud yelling comes from inside it] Hey! It sounds like you guys are having a lot of fun, but it's really loud, and some of us are trying to work, so do you think you could do it a little more quietly?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Well, that's gonna be tough, because we're getting a dunking clinic from Magic Jordan himself.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [chuckles] Oh, you mean Michael Jordan?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: [laughs] Total brain burp.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: I'm no MJ. I can do his dunk. From the free throw line.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Whoa.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Daaamn! Mad respect for my brotha!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: The man is paying me to take Chinese. I will say what I need to say, and soon, I will say it in Chinese.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, well it's just really loud.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Okay. We'll keep that in mind. Alright, ladies, back to the game.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Do it!

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Jim! Come on in.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You're back in.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know what? Instead of a game, why don't we do an exhibition? I'd love to see that dunk of yours.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yeah, we'll set that up one day.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Today. Now, maybe. 'Cause we have a hoop downstairs and a real ball, so you don't have to mime it.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yeah, I don't know.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Why not?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Only because no one has called NASA to request a liftoff. [laughter] Let's go downstairs! Okay? Let's do it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Pass. If I wanted to see a pissing contest, I'd lock Mose in the chicken coop.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Damn it, Dwight! Enough! Get your ass downstairs or find a new place to sell paper! [Dwight immediately gets up and walks out]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, a little about me. I respond to strong leadership.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright, there you go.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Seems a little close, you sure that's the real foul line?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: 15 feet from the baseline, so, you need me to move it in?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Nah, that's 15. Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: And uh, you know what, to make it interesting, Jordan, why don't you sit underneath the basket?

scenes.speaker: Jordan
scenes.line: Seriously?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Yeah, come on. I'll dunk over you. Best seat in the house.

scenes.speaker: Jordan
scenes.line: I don't, I don't think I can do that. I'm holding your jewelry.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Right. Yeah. Okay, fair enough. Kevin, you do it.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yes! Okay. [sits down in front of basket]

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Someone want to sit in Kevin's lap? Angela?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Oscar?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: No thank you.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Okay, Jimmy, this is for you. Show you that anything is possible.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Fantastic.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: Alright?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yup.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: This is also for the troops. [backs up, bounces ball, starts running, jumps, lands in front of Kevin, jumps again, pulls himself up by the net, dunks ball, hangs on rim] Doctor is in! [hoop starts to fall] Ahhhh! [hoop crashes down on Deangelo]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [ambulance pulls away in parking lot] Now what?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [Deangelo enters office in hospital gown with bandage on his head] Deangelo?

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [speaking gibberish] Tablab.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh my God, are you alright? Erin, will you call 911 please?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Who should I say is calling?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Erin.

scenes.speaker: Deangelo
scenes.line: [lots of gibberish] says to bartender [lots more gibberish] Droswip. Droswip.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Droswip, yeah. I get it. Okay, we're gonna get you to the restroom.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We could get Deangelo flowers.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, you can't get flowers for someone who's in a coma. They'll wilt before he wakes up.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: That's true.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All in favor of the baskets full of chocolates, teddy bears, and balloons? [all but Dwight raise their hands]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wait, wait. All in favor of the knapsack filled with canned goods, chainsaw, gasoline, and emergency radio in case he wakes up post-apocalypse? [Dwight raises his hand]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nope. Baskets have it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So as it turns out, unless you're a young child or a prison inmate, you don't need anyone supervising you. People just come in and do their work on their schedule. Imagine that – people like us allowed to sell paper. Unsupervised. [Darryl, Phyllis, Stanley, and Oscar are working while Andy and Ryan play on a foosball table] And yet, somehow it works. It must be because the stakes are so high.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [on phone] Well, I really appreciate the offer, but I'm just happy the way things are. Okay. Thank you. [to Pam] That was Jo, asking me if I wanted to take over as acting manager while they find a replacement. I told her… I don't want to mess this up, right? There's a consensus, people are happy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [on phone] Dwight Schrute. Yes, I would. Thank you. [hangs up] Jordan, gather my things from my desk. [Dwight walks to the manager's office, rubs the door frame, sits at the desk reverently]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wait…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What have you done?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Mose… you'll never guess where I am right now.

scenes.speaker: Mose
scenes.line: Aaaaahhhhh!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Can't stay there all day.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm coming.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Do I at least get to go with you in this fantasy?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You'd slow me down.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Dwight has been acting manager for three months now. No. A week. Just feels like three months. Let's see, we all have to punch in to a time clock, which is very old, very strong, and has a slot about the size of a finger. [Jim puts a pencil into the time clock and pulls it out broken in half] We were all given new business cards big enough to set us apart from the competition, which is how I learned that our titles are all now Junior Employee. Our lunch breaks are staggered to prevent wasting time. Mine's at 10:30, and I find that the first hour of the day goes by a lot quicker than the second seven hours.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Stop stalling! Come on.

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: I pledge allegiance to the flag of the United States of America, and to the republic for which it stands, one nation…

scenes.speaker: All but Oscar
scenes.line: …under God…

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: …indivisible, with liberty and justice for all. [Kevin finishes behind the rest of the group]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Amen.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Excellent. Morning announcements! There's been a problem with some people sharing copier codes. Your copier code is a distinct 21-digit number that is unique to you, and you only, okay? Don't share it. [Kevin looks exasperated] Jo Bennett, our CEO, will be here today for a high-level meeting involving Gabe and myself.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Ooh, about what?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's on a need-to-know basis.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I thought I needed to know for your calendar.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [quietly] General meet-and-greet. So I expect you to be on your best behavior, which means none of you will be insubordinate, nor will you foment insurrection.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Question, if we already fomented insurrection, may we be grandfathered in?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Define foment.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You define foment.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [clears throat] Please take note of the new color-coding system.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [surprising Kelly] Aha!

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Oh my God, what is wrong with you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Gotcha! Why are you late?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: It's none of your business, actually. It's very medical and personal.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: All right. You stop me when I reach the diseased area. [Dwight points to her legs and slowly moves his finger up, stopping at her mid-section]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: In fairness, Darryl did tell me that joke, so…

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh! Darryl's funny.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I know, right?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Hey, Andy?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Can I talk to you a second about these client memos?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Sure. What's going on? [in room with Gabe]

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Are you still in love with Erin?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Because I am. I need to get her back. [crying] I can't be alone anymore. Andy, do you like being alone with me right now?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No, this is horrifying.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: No. I don't like being alone with me either, okay? I have to get her back. Are you still gonna date her?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: We're just friends, okay?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Do you promise that?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, fine, I promise. We'll never date again. Can we go outside now?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: No, just give me a second. I don't want anyone to know I've been crying.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [seeing the Join the Fist flyers that Jim is hanging] Hey, hey, hey, hey. What do you think you're doing? What's this? What's the Fist?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, it's just a social club. You know, like the French Revolution, or the Black Panthers, or communism. It's just a club. Guys talking, you know.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You expect me to believe that you're starting a rebellion?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nope. Social club. God, I hate when everybody calls us a rebellion. [Darryl enters and brandishes his fist, Jim returns the gesture]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, you know what? I would love to join The Fist.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And we would love to have you. But not today. Unfortunately, it's a bad day, what with Operation Overthrow and everything, but I have noted it. [Dwight tears the sign down, Jim hangs two signs in its place]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [inputting numbers into the copier and holding up the line] One…

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [refills his coffee near a sign that reads "Honor System:

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Pam, I have to show you this video. You're gonna love it. It's Beyonce falling with a fart mixed in. [buzzer to indicate a blocked web site]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I will never be happier than I am right now. I will also never be less happy. I will be at my current maximum happiness for the rest of my life. Because I am manager of the Scranton Branch of Dunder Mifflin. Acting Manager.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [looking at empty vending machine] No food now? Someone has to do something about Dwight!

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: He put some snacks in the freezer for us.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You mean the frozen mice for the piranha?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: No. The blueberry Slurpee pouch.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: He means the ice pack.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [on phone] 2:00 should probably be okay. I can either take your number or – [Gabe ends the call]

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I'm sorry. This can't wait.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: He's just gonna call back.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Erin, I am in love with you. I don't believe in much, okay? I don't believe in horoscopes. I don't believe in Christmas. Uh, uh, I sure as hell don't believe in God. [Erin and Angela both look taken aback]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [quietly] What?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Or maybe there's a God. I don't know. I mean, it's just not a guy with a long white beard. [Erin looks shocked] Or it could be. I mean, it's possible that that is exactly what – what God is. But for all of the disbelief [phone rings] I believe in us. I believe in love. You have made me believe that for all of the hokum [phone continues ringing] out… there… uh, do we not have voicemail?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Dwight doesn't trust robots to give us our messages.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Well… it's just… [ringing] it messes up my rhythm.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I'm taking a break from dating. Gabe was a great guy with so many wonderful qualities, but it was a challenge being touched by him.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow, you've really embraced the whole Bond villain aesthetic.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ah, Jim, Jim, Jim. The gun is a Beaumont-Adams. Jo collects them. I thought we could have some nice small talk about it. And the piranha's a rescue.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And the desk.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The desk is a replica of Uday Hussein's desk. I saw a picture in Newsweek. Listen, I'm a very busy man. Let's get right down to business.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jo is coming later today. I cannot have a subordinate trying to make me look stupid. Okay? I need you to promise me that you'll be on your best behavior.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I promise…d other people that I would be on my worst behavior. And I gave them my word, so…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Don't make me fire you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You can't fire me. You're acting manager. Not office manager. So you have no firing powers.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Don't make me pre-fire you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You wouldn't dare.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Watch this. You're pre-fired. And when I'm promoted, you'll be full fired.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [quietly] If you get promoted, and if you haven't fallen in love with me by then.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: If I had thought that there was a real chance that Dwight would be permanent manager, I would have pre-quit. And you might be saying to yourself, "Well that's pretty premature to think," but I always say, it's better to be pre-pre-preprepared.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: How you doing, Jordan?

scenes.speaker: Jordan
scenes.line: I'm good.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Everyone here thinks that you're a joke. They think that you were hired because of your good looks, which won't last long anyway. As your pale skin and severe bone structure imply, you'll age swiftly and poorly.

scenes.speaker: Jordan
scenes.line: Why are you telling me this?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Now I want you to find out what people are saying about me, things they don't want me to know abou-[Dwight opens a box and sits down in shock] Ohh… it's a holster.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [walking around the office with the holster around his waist] Yep. Yep, yep, yep. Lookin' good. [grunts] Ohh… [stretching out his arms to better indicate the gun and holster] Oh, what a day. What a day.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dwight, are you carrying a gun?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The holster was a gift from my great-uncle Honk. Um, I don't know. I guess he's saying that he's proud of me.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Dwight, guns make me really uncomfortable.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The gun is just an accessory to the holster, okay? I can't walk around wearing an empty holster.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Why do you need to wear the holster at all?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why do you need to keep wearing those booby shirts all the time?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: You could put your cell phone in it instead.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Uh… hello! [indicates his phone clipped onto his belt]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: You could put a banana in it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why would I put a banana in my holster?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: In case you weren't hungry now, but you got hungry later.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dwight, no gun, okay? Don't make us call Jo.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay. All right. Fine. Everyone calm down. Someone get me a banana. Sorry I freaked you guys out – aah! [Dwight goes to flip the gun and it fires near Andy's ear, making everyone jump]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Andy!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Aah! Aah! It's so loud!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: My God. There is a hardwood floor underneath this carpeting. Why would they do that?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [trying to find a pitch] Eeeeeeee… There's like this crazy ringing going on. I can't – eeeeeee… I can't find perfect C.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Okay, everyone make a list of what's lost for the insurance. I lost a necklace, a ring, a painting-

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Hey, what happened?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Dwight went on a shooting spree, and then he shot Andy in the head.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, no, no. All we know is that a gun fired. That's all we know! No. That's not true. Actually, we heard a loud noise. Later, a hole was seen. No one saw the bullet leave the gun.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [scatting off-key] Something's definitely wrong.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I'll look on WebMD. What are your symptoms?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh, everybody. Oscar found a reason to look on WebMD.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [buzzer to indicate a blocked site] Firewall.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I can't reach Jo. She must already be on the plane.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, why are you calling Jo?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I think I should go the hospital.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I'll go with you.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: No! We really shouldn't be without a receptionist. Now more than ever.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I'll take him.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Thank you, Darryl. [Andy limps out of his chair and leans on Darryl for support]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: What's wrong with you?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It's my ear.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay, sorry.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [excitedly] Oh, I should get the accident report binder. I've never used the gun violence forms before.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I'm gonna keep trying Jo.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, everyone! Conference room, right now!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [enters with a cowboy hat, speaking with a Western accent] Yee-haw! Whoo-hoo! [imitates gunfire] Howdy, partners! It's me, Gun-Safety Dwight! And I'm the rootin'-est– [removes hat] I can't do this. Um, look. Obviously, a gun went off under my watch, and I'm launching a full investigation.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: We all saw you do it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Really? You did? What hand was I holding the gun in? What did Andy's tie look like?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Navy blue. Little red anchors.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I have no way of knowing if that's true.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I am supposed to collect eyewitness accounts. Who saw Dwight do this? [all raise their hands]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, really?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Would you consider this a terrorist incident?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: I felt terrorized.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Come on.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Oh, there's a whole 'nother terrorism booklet for that.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I just really, really think we should handle this internally.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Dwight, why is it on us to protect you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Because you guys are my best friends, and I mean that. Managing you for this last week has been the greatest honor of my life. And if you ruin this, I will burn this office to the ground. And I mean that figuratively. Not literally. Because you guys are so… so important… to me. I love you guys. But don't cross me. But you're the best.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey. [Erin gasps] We're back.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: There he is! Our hero! [Both Dwight and Erin move to hug Andy] You look fantastic. How you doing? Here, tell us your war stories.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, I burst my eardrum. Doctor said it could take weeks to heal.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Did they say what caused it? Because I know you like putting Q-tips deep into your ear canal.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: How's your hearing?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Temporary deafness in one ear. It was both ears. I couldn't hear a thing Darryl was saying while we were in the waiting room.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I was talking like this. [mouths words while pointing to his ear] I don't feel good about it, but he just kept calling himself a gunshot victim and it got to me.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Dwight, I would like tomorrow off so that I can go on my American Idol audition.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: American Idol? What? No.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Okay. I guess I can just not go. Do you guys wanna hear my solo?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [singing] Why did my temporary boss go on a shooting spree?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, fine. You can go on your singing audition.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Okay, well, then I want an extra vacation day.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Pet Day! I want Pet Day back – no dogs.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Put back everything in the vending machine except the fruit.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I put everything back in the vending machine.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Put everything back in the vending machine except… the fruit.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You have to get rid of all your weapons. All of them. Including killer fish.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, is it my turn? Ooh, I'm on the spot. I don't know. Um… you know what? I think I'm good.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Thank God.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nope. When Jo's here, can you work in "Shagadelic, baby," at least three times in a conversation? Oh, and when I cough can you do jazz hands?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What's jazz hands?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [quickly shakes his hands back and forth]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Fine.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [leaves the men's room with an empty fish tank after flushing the toilet]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [after entEring the men's room] What the [bleep] is that? [runs out of the bathroom] Oh, my…

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Hey, all! Cornelius, Bobo, have at it. Nobody let my dogs hump each other. They don't seem to know they're brothers.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hello, Jo. Welcome. Well, shall we begin?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Slow yourself down there. Just like a man. Wants to jump right into it while I still got my socks on. Jim Halpert – the only man that ever turned me down.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I don't know about that. Just wasn't for me. But let me assure you, Dwight is firing on all cylinders. Right?

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Well, some pretty big shoes to fill. I was sorry to hear about Deangelo. He was a good man. Tragic. [Jim coughs]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [does jazz hands, Jo notices and eyes him oddly] Well, what can you do? Life.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: We have to clean this up now!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: She had so much –

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Hey, guys.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Hope I'm not interrupting anything.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No! [Erin and Andy laugh]

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Hey, Andy, did you tell Erin about our conversation earlier when you said you would never want to date her again?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh…

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I just thought that it was so interesting that you promised that.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Did I say that earlier? Yes, I did. Because you, Gabe, were crying…

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: No, I was not.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: And sobbing uncontrollably. Yes. Uh-huh. You were in hysterics. And my maternal instincts kicked in. Is it actually how I feel? Yes. Or no. That is… between me and my diary.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oscar, can you print out last year's sale statements?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hey, Dwight, gimme a back massage.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, Kevin, come on.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: My back is sore, Dwight. Massage it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Kevin, not now.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hey, Jo!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, okay. Shh! [Dwight begins rubbing his shoulders]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No, under the jacket.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You're kidding me. [reaches under Kevin's jacket] Oh God, what am I touching? It's moist.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I don't feel anything.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, it's so wet.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Push harder, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I can't. I can't push harder!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Go a little higher. There you go. Nope, higher. Higher. [Dwight has positioned his feet on the filing cabinet behind Kevin and is kneading his back horizontally]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, how's that?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Knead it. Knead it like a pizza.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm kneading it!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Don't eat it.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Dwight! Walk me out. Let's talk soon. And stay on top of these people. You gotta admit it – it's nice to have a little power, eh? How's it feel?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jo… I accidentally fired a gun in the office today.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: What?!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I am telling you this because I care too much about this job to be blackmailed into doing it poorly. All I've ever wanted was to be manager here. And if you feel that you cannot promote me over this one accident, I understand. But if you think that extortion is worse –

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Shooting is worse! Are you kidding me? It's not even in the same – you shot a gun? What is wrong with you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It was a Beaumont-Adams, if that helps.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Beaumont-Adams is a girl's gun. That just makes it plain stupid.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I take full responsibility.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Who else would be responsible?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Pam made me put a banana in my holster.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You shot a gun off –

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay. Did I make a mistake? Yes. Do I regret the decision that I made? Yes.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Oh, stop asking yourself easy questions so you can look like a genius.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Got it.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: I love you, Dwight. But you don't fit this job.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [on the verge of tears] Jo, please… I will –

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: No, child. No. It's over. Now I gotta find a replacement for my replacement.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: You three are my search committee. You're in charge of finding me my next manager. All righty?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Till then, we need a new acting manager. Now, who's got the most experience in this office?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Uh, well, we probably don't want to go just on seniority.

scenes.speaker: Jo
scenes.line: Who is it?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Dwight. What's up?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Shut up.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, you do know that Jo was right to take the job away from you, right? There's no debating that. But, I will say… in your one week, every single one of the orders went out on time. And I think that is shagadelic, baby. [Dwight sees Creed claiming the desk in the manager's office]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [giving Kevin numbers for the copier] Four, one, seven, one…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Another one?

scenes.speaker: Darryl & Angela
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Seven, two…

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Could you turn the volume down on the beeping?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Six, nine, shut up, Oscar. Eight…

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Nine first.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Nine, eight, five…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Three, zero, zero. Again, zero. Four, six…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Nice.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Two, one…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh, I hit three. I hit three.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: God!

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [drives up to the entrance of the building, his license plate reads "NEW MGR"] It's a beautiful morning at Dunder-Mifflin, or as I like to call it, Great Bratton. [gets out of car, tosses his keys toward a nonexistent valet parker] Keep it running.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Do I love being manager?… I love my kids. I love real estate. [slowly getting more excited] I love ceramics. I love my job. I-I love wrestling.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [to Jordan] Find out what language this is. [speaking in strange language]

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [running a meeting in the conference room] Okay, team building! On this side of the room, Stanley, Phyllis, Jim, Ted, Elroy, [camera switches to show only Meredith and Kevin have attended the meeting, Jim walks by and sees this] and this side of the room, Pam, Meredith, Phyllis, Creed…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He never called a meeting.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [pointing at a whiteboard with BOBODDY written on the left side, vertically] BO-BODDY! BO-BODDY. What does the first "B" stand for?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What are we doing?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: We're making acronyms. Okay! What does the first "B" stand for?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Um… Business!

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I like it! Business! Good, Kevin! [writes after the first B, I, Z, N, U…] All right! The "O"…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We need a new manager.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [conducting interview] Your paper experience is very interesting. Do you think you could use that experience to inform decisions here?

scenes.speaker: Fred Henry
scenes.line: Absolutely–I, yes. In fact, I actually have a three-step plan that I believe could effectively double your profits.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Fred
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [waiting for Fred to continue] …What is it?

scenes.speaker: Fred
scenes.line: Nice try.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I'm sorry, what is your three-step plan?

scenes.speaker: Fred
scenes.line: Well, I mean, I can't just hand you my plan. I mean, if you guys give me the job, then, then you'll get the plan.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Well… it's an interview, and we don't know that you really have the plan.

scenes.speaker: Fred
scenes.line: [speaking faster] Well, I'm not gonna just make up that I have a plan. I got a plan. Believe me, you guys want it. You're in paper, right?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: How would we know that, if you don't…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You could just be saying it to get the job.

scenes.speaker: Fred
scenes.line: I guess I could be, if I was… who would do that?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: How about this. Why don't you give us a part of the plan, and that way we know you have it.

scenes.speaker: Fred
scenes.line: Tell you what. I'll give you part three of part two. Not gonna give you a whole part.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Fred
scenes.line: Color-code sent documents, TM.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Did you just trademark that…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [confused] W-What?

scenes.speaker: Fred
scenes.line: That's a verbal trademark. That's an agreement.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We are the Search Committee, hand-picked by our CEO, and tasked to find this branch's new manager. Not everyone we meet will be good, but someone's bound to be, right? [Andy, Kelly, and Darryl are each dressed up in suits for their interviews, Andy is also wearing an "Andy for Manager?" pin on his jacket] And, to be honest, I think a lot of the decent candidates are right here in-house, so, I'm not too worried. But I'm really excited to spend a lot of time with Toby and Gabe. [quietly] Did you know that Gabe's last name was Lewis? I had no idea.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [in elevator with Phyllis and Darryl, all three are smiling, to Darryl] Good morning.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Good morning.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [also to Darryl] Good morning.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Good morning.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Did you have a nice drive in?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I did.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I have a solid relationship with Jo, the company's owner. I have management experience. I have a good friendship with Jim, the head of the Search Committee, and it doesn't hurt that I'm… [in Oprah-like sing-song voice] bla-aaack!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [puts up a poster in the break room with "IF YOU ARE ON THE SEARCH COMMITTEE PLEASE CONSIDER ANDY" on it in bold lettEring]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [commenting on the poster] It's good. I really hope you get it!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: The manager job? Nah, I'm barely interested. I just can't not go for it. You know, it's not the Bernard way. We give it the old college try, and then, in defeat, we show grace.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Still, I'd really like to see this office with you in the boss's chair.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Don't even… [getting really happy and excited] EEEHHHH!!!!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You in the boss's chair!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: EEEHHH!! No. Hehe.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: In my family, you don't really go out and get things. If you want something, you write it on a list, and then the housekeeper goes out and gets it, on Wednesdays and Fridays. So, I don't know, I guess you could say this job is on my list, and… [awkwardly smiling] we'll see what Rosa comes back with.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [checks to see that she is alone with Phyllis] Did you hear anything?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh, I'm sure they'll let us know when they get the results. [Erin crosses fingers and smiles excitedly]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: It turns out that Erin was born in the basic time and region that I gave away a child.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: So, Phyllis might be my mom. I mean, the chances are tiny, but…

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: But, probably not, I mean, it was a big year for babies. Porky's had come out.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah. I'm sure I was just another Porky's baby.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Mm.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: But why not find out.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [to Dwight, who is reading the want ads] Should you really be so blatant about that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: They won't make me manager, and I won't settle for anything less. I've gone about as far as I can here. That's obvious. Time to take my talents elsewhere.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Are you really going to apply for work at Scranton Breadworks?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Bread is the paper of the food industry. You write your sandwich on it.

scenes.speaker: Warren Buffett
scenes.line: Can you do any better on salary?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Unfortunately, that range is set at corporate.

scenes.speaker: Warren Buffett
scenes.line: What about mileage when I use my car? I mean, gas ain't cheap, you know.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Heh. We think that 25 cents a mile is pretty generous.

scenes.speaker: Warren Buffett
scenes.line: How about 27? And uh, when I make long-distance calls, will they be monitored or is it on the honor system?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [on phone] Okay. [hangs up, smiling] How odd, a very unusual phone call from the Senator's office. The Senator wants me to have lunch with him at The Botanical Gardens.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: The Botanical Gardens, Scranton's hidden gem. Don't eat any berries you don't recognize.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: How will your experience selling refinery equipment translate to our smaller scale here?

scenes.speaker: Robert California
scenes.line: You don't work in sales, do you.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Uh… Human Resources.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: You see, I sit across from a man. I see his face. I see his eyes. Now, does it matter if he wants a hundred dollars of paper or a hundred million dollars of deep-sea drilling equipment? Don't be a fool. He wants respect. He wants love. He wants to be younger. He wants to be attractive. There is no such thing as a product. Don't ever think there is. There is only… sex. Everything… is sex. You understand that what I'm telling you is a universal truth,… Toby.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Okay, I-I am, I'm almost a little concerned that you might be overqualified for the position. [Robert and Gabe chuckle at this, then Gabe stops chuckling] Do you, um, do you think that you are?

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: Do I look like someone who would waste my own time?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: No. [Robert then nods his head at Jim]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Can you… [seems intimidated, clears throat] You are a man of great confidence. Could you speak a little more to that, and, what the role of confidence… would be… in a dialogue with a subordinate?

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: Will you be heard? Will you have a voice? Will I steamroll over you? Do you feel heard right now, Jim? Do you have a voice, right now? You can answer me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: That was your choice, not mine. The fallacy is that it is up to the steamroller. It is up to the object… whether it will be flattened or not, and I can tell from the small interaction we've had already, you won't be flattened by anybody. Do you agree with me, Jim?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: [more emphatically than Jim] Yes. You do. [nods at the Search Committee, then looks over at the camera with a smirk on his face]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Robert leaves the conference room and looks at the others in the office as he grins at the camera and leaves] He creeps me out. [Toby nods] But, I think he might be a genius.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [Jim points at Darryl to be the next interviewee] Good luck, Darryl.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [pats Andy on the back] Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Think about it! What other mammal, besides humans, drinks the milk of another mammal? I mean, you don't see a bear drinking raccoon milk.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Jim and Gabe laugh, Toby smiles and nods] Oh.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: So this is cool. I think we make a good fit. [stands up]

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Oh? Uh… we haven't started the interview yet. Were you–were you joking?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Uh… [looks at camera] yes?! I was. [sits back down] Little joke!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: So, how would you go about settling interpersonal conflicts within the office?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I thought that was your job.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, it's one of my strengths, but it's the manager's job.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, for instance, how did you deal with it when two warehouse guys got into a fight?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I'll answer that, Jim. I would use it as an opportunity to teach, uh, about actions… and consequences… of actions. [Jim and Gabe stare at Darryl]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [noticing Erin in the background leading a black man dressed in a suit through the office] Who's that?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [ignoring Darryl's question] So I think all we need is a resume, and we'll be good right?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I… I just thought you knew me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, it's no big deal, just something that looks like that. [shows Darryl a resume] Cool? [goes to put the resume away]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Let me… [Jim shows him the resume again, Darryl looks at it a little longer this time] Oh. Cool. [Jim gives Darryl a thumbs-up, then looks at the camera as Darryl gets up to leave]

scenes.speaker: Merv
scenes.line: [at the cafe on the first floor] Did, uh, you just interview?

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: Ohh, unfortunately, yes.

scenes.speaker: Merv
scenes.line: What do you mean?

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: That business can't attract anyone. It's awful up there. Those people seem like they're in prison, waiting out life sentences in a… dying industry.

scenes.speaker: Merv
scenes.line: Place must be horrible. I don't know if I want this job. [gets on elevator]

scenes.speaker: Merv
scenes.line: [in elevator] Well, if I get this job offer, and then I know that I'm gonna take it, and if I take it, I know that I'm never gonna quit, and then 25 years are gonna go by and… I'm gonna die here.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What makes you feel qualified to judge a place after a mere interview? [Robert stares at Dwight] What are you doing…? [Dwight sits up abruptly] Stop trying to figure me out.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: I just did.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You can't.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: It's done.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, it's not.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: I know you now, your nature. I'm done. Not worth continuing. [at the same time, Dwight says:

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm gonna prevent inferior men from sullying my place of work with their weak, passionless leadership. Do you see my hat? No? That's because I just threw it in the ring.

scenes.speaker: Merv
scenes.line: You guys pay for relocation, though, right?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Well, why would you need relocation, if you already live in Scranton?

scenes.speaker: Merv
scenes.line: Well, I'd want to move further away, you know? Just… I don't want any chance to run into my co-workers outside the office.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Can I ask why you're leaving your current job?

scenes.speaker: Merv
scenes.line: [pulls out a tupperware from his briefcase and takes out a tupperware] I'm leaving my other job because they were all jerks, really. [opens tupperware] You know, all of 'em. You had your jerk-wads, and your jerk-offs, so, just between the wads and the offs, I just… I had to get outta there. [begins eating sandwich]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Is this a bad time to be doing this?

scenes.speaker: Merv
scenes.line: I'm having a bad time. [chuckles]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I'm sorry, if we did something to upset you, I'm sure it was inadvertent.

scenes.speaker: Merv
scenes.line: [continues to chew, slower and slower, appears confused] Wait.

scenes.speaker: Merv
scenes.line: Oh, why did I believe that weirdo in the lobby? These are the nicest people I ever met.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [limo driver lets Angela out of the limo at the office parking lot] Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [looking at an engagement ring on Angela's finger] It's gorgeous, Angela.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Yeah, I actually know about nice rings and it is gorgeous.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [looks at ring, whispEring] Wow…

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: It's a little flashy. I mean, what am I? Naomi Judd?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Tell us the freaking story!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah! Tell us a story.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Okay. He took me to the replica of Monet's Japanese bridge, and then he put this flower behind my ear, which normally, I would hate, 'cause it's so civil rightsy. Then he got down on one knee, and he said, will you be a Senator's wife?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [laughing] Oh-ho-ho! He talked about himself in the third person?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yes, Pam. Not everyone is as informal as you and Jim. [imitating Jim's voice] Oh, hey Pam, dude, whatever, wanna marry me? [Erin, Kelly, and Meredith laugh]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's not accurate.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Then I saw flashes. Reporters were there. They always find us. And everyone was crying, even his aide. [camera pans and shows Oscar in disbelief]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Angela's engaged to a gay man. As a gay man, I'm horrified. As a friend of Angela's, horrified. As a lover of elegant weddings, [smiles] I'm a little excited. [expression becomes serious again] But overall, horrified.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Andy? You all set?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay, guys, it's time. It's pep talk time. Tell me what I need to hear.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Are you sure this is a good idea? I hate to see you disappointed.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [grunts] Augh.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I think Andy should be the boss. He's just so great. If I'm being objective, then Darryl, of course.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: So, Andy, what improvements would you make as office manager?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: For starters, I really think we can streamline communication around here… [gets cut off by Gabe]

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Whoa! That's a very heavy accusation to level against Toby.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I wasn't acc-, accusing…

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Well, Toby's in charge of Human Resources, that would include communication. I think that Toby's done a fine job.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Right! I really wasn't trying to insult any, anyone.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I didn't think you were.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I have two relationships with Andy. I have a personal relationship, and I have a professional relationship. Personally, yeah, I think he's a rat, and I think he's responsible for the demise of my relationship with Erin. Professionally,… he broke up the happiest couple in this office!

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: How many windows are there in New York City?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Critical thinking. Common, on-the-spot question asked in an interview.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay. Let me think… are you counting car windows?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: No… How far away is the Sun?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [happily] Uh, 93 million miles.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to Gabe] Is it?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah! And the diameter of the Sun is 870,000 miles, which makes it 109 times wider than the Earth, and… [Gabe looks visibily annoyed] 333,000 times heavier than the Earth,…

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Shut up about the Sun! SHUT UP about the SUN! [slams fist, hurting his hand]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [alone in his car] I am unhappy with the confusing and, at times, confrontational nature of that meeting. I wanted it to go better. I WANTED IT TO GO BETTER!!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [on phone] Yes, there used to be a paper clip that would pop up and say "Looks like you are writing a letter or resume. Would you like help? I believe his name was… [looks embarrassed at camera] Clippy.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [on phone] First of all, I want to thank you for your years of patronizing our company. I've got some bad news. We're going out of business. [covers phone, whispers to Pam] Saving face. [uncovers phone] Yep, yep. I understand that. Basically everything is falling apart here. Pam looks around the office and realizes only she has overheard this]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How is this on me?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hang up. [Creed hangs up] Corporate needs you to find the differences between this picture and this picture. [shows Creed two similar-looking photos of some building] Intel has told us there were at least seven.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [takes the pictures] Okay I already see one, gimme. Okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: They're the same picture.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Well, I manage my department, and I've been doing that for several years now. And, god, I've learned a lot of life lessons along the way.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Your department's just you, right?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Yes, Jim, but I am not easy to manage.

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: Great! [to Jim and Toby] Um, can we just… [does a "wrap it up" motion with his pen]

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: What was that?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: We just have a lot of serious candidates to get through today, so… [nods]

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: [getting upset] Am I not a serious candidate?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: What do you want me to say? I mean, there's a line of qualified people out there. We have a video CV from England. [to Jim and Toby] Are we all just gonna pretend to– okay. [to Kelly] Um, what are your weaknesses?

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I don't have any, assh***.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [comes in, slapping some papers on the table] I want an interview.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [walking with Jim in the parking lot] How's the family?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Good!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Good. They good?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What's your daughter's name again? Peepee?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Peepa.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Peepa, how is she?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Great.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Great! Oh, that's great… We never were very good at small talk, were we, Jim?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Now, listen,…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You're not getting an interview, Dwight. The whole point of this Search Committee process is to prevent hiring someone like you ever again.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, I know why you're saying that, Jim, I really do, but think of it this way. The hand that reaches from the grave to grip your throat [motions to grip Jim's throat] is the strong hand you want on the wheel.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [pulls Dwight's arm down] Okay. That's vivid.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm going to make you an offer. Okay? You even do so little as grant me an interview, I will guarantee you your dream work life. Okay? You roll in at 10 a.m. to your own private reserved parking spot, pick up your daily free coffee from Dwight's Caffeine Corner, unlimited sex breaks for you and Pam…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yikes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Erin will eat garbage for your entertainment.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, you know how I like taking bribes. [both smile]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ha ha! [pats Jim on the back]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Unfortunately, Jo also took the job away from you because she doesn't trust your judgment. So how would that look for me, if I recommended you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Fine. I'll do it without you, but you'll regret this.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Let me get that for you. [runs ahead to open the door for Jim]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay. [looks ashamed]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Pam… I think Robert is gay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
