scenes.line: I know, I'm coming, I'm coming, I'm coming, I'm coming, I'm coming.

scenes.line: This is my treasures, no they're my treasures!

scenes.line: You're a hoarder. My god!

scenes.line: No I'm not, I'm gonna sell it on Ebay! No no no, you be careful. Be careful.

scenes.line: [laughs while spray painting "Jim is Awesome" on his own car, talks to porcupine in carrier] What are we gonna do with all that bonus money, Henrietta? Huh?

scenes.speaker: Andy

scenes.speaker: Robert

scenes.line: Honestly Erin, I don't know what I'm doing. I… I just… I don't know. Thank you.

scenes.line: Andy's confused. That's not what I was hoping for, but it's not so bad either. I can live with confused. I get confused. I totally get confused.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: To madness.

scenes.line: To madness.

scenes.line: To madness. [Robert laughs]

scenes.line: Yes! Woohoo! Bravo!

scenes.speaker: Jim

scenes.line: Yes, that's it. Push yourselves, boys. It's not a party if you don't do something that scares you. I need a breather. Oh. Oh. You two keep going.

scenes.line: Hey, he's asleep. We can just leave.

scenes.line: So leave.

scenes.line: Two pools. A divider. A bridge. Good choice. It says everything about everything, right Robert?

scenes.line: What's the water like?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Nice.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh, it is warm.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, Dwight.

scenes.line: Uh huh.

scenes.line: That feels so good!

scenes.line: Yeah…baby.

scenes.line: [grunting] Hey, Andy.

scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.line: Dwight gives the best back massages.

scenes.line: Yeah, it sounds like it.

scenes.line: Hey, have you ever been checked for scoliosis?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I don't know, why don't you check me Dr. Shrute. [laughing]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, seriously. Your spine is jacked. It's like the devil's cursive.

scenes.line: You mean more like dangerous curves…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You'd be like 8 feet tall if this thing was straightened out…[pushes Erin back to floor]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Ow!

scenes.line: You date a guy, you find out he was engaged to your coworker so you throw cake at him. It's over. You start liking him again so you ask him out with a puppet show. He says no. Then he follows you home to make sure that you don't kiss somebody. Then he ignores you at a pool party? Am I right ladies?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Erin helps Dwight stretch his inner thighs] Yeah. Oh, yeah. Oooooh, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: You guys ready?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Bring it on guys.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah…

scenes.line: Let's go before I vomit. [Erin and Dwight enter pool]

scenes.line: Ready?

scenes.line: I'm ready.

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: Whoo!

scenes.line: Alright! Here we go.

scenes.line: Ok.

scenes.line: RAHHH!!!!!!!

scenes.line: Yeah, come on!

scenes.line: Hey! High-five!

scenes.line: I get that.

scenes.line: To the shame room! [raises bottle]

scenes.line: Mineral-ey.

scenes.line: Val, I need the space.

scenes.line: I can't promise what I'm going to do or not do.

scenes.line: Promise me that-

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Obviously I'm going to clean up.

scenes.line: Stress is like the uptight mayor or a town who's saying, "Hey, we're uptight, you can't dance," and then you have to be like, "Oh yeah, Mayor Stress? Well watch this!" And then… we dance. Oh how we dance. [dances to Kenny Loggin's Footloose] Sex also works.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey! Tuna! He's back.

scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, look at this. [hugs Jim] Tuna wrap.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [grabs Jim's wrist] Hand roll.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.line: How was jury duty?

scenes.line: It was pretty uneventful, actually.

scenes.line: Can't believe they let someone like you serve on a jury. Makes me question the whole judicial system.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: What was the case?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, hit and run.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Ooh, "the case of the hit and run," that's exciting.

scenes.line: Did you send him to the slammer?

scenes.line: Nope. Not guilty.

scenes.line: Of course you found him not guilty. [mocking voice] "Oh, he apologized and I just really want him to like me, mm."

scenes.line: We're best friends, actually. We're going wine-tasting next weekend, if you want to come.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Not coming, have plans.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.line: I did get called in to jury duty. And they released me around noon, so, didn't think it was worth it to come back to work for a half day. And then the next morning Pam was a little overwhelmed with the kids so I took an extra day to help out. And then three other days happened.

scenes.line: Ah! Angela had the baby!

scenes.line: Is it black? 'Cause that would be hilarious.

scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: You know.

scenes.line: Oh, I'd love to but, um-

scenes.line: Well Kevin and I have to go, Accounting is its own little family.

scenes.line: Yeah, Oscar's the dad, I'm Oscar's dad and Angela's my mom.

scenes.line: Everyone, our very own Angela-

scenes.line: We all got the email, some of us are going to go visit.

scenes.line: Oh, I am so in.

scenes.line: Mine was actually a pretty boring case, so-

scenes.line: Yeah, you owe us. I had to stay until six twice to cover for you. My wife got to the TV first, had to sit through damn Rizzoli and damn Isles.

scenes.line: Yeah, my car got smashed visiting one of your clients and I had to have it detailed and they took my meter change.

scenes.line: Wow, I'm really sorry.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.line: I never considered that my week off would make everyone else's job harder. The least I could do is give them a good story.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [demonstrating with napkin holder and salt shaker] So Phyllis, he was here, and then the car came and did- he was like that. Yeah, so it had to be a double backflip, actually.

scenes.line: Oh man, Ernesto's. That was our favorite restaurant too.

scenes.line: You mean food truck. Ernesto's was a food truck.

scenes.line: Toby, shut your hole about the empanadas. Nobody cares about the empanadas.

scenes.line: I was in Los Angeles last year. Jim tricked me into thinking I'd won a walk-on part on NCIS, but that's not important. While I was being kicked off the lot, I saw food trucks everywhere. Everyone in Los Angeles eats from them. And nobody calls them restaurants.

scenes.line: [whispEring] Guys, I don't know how many of you have seen- Gabe? Bring it in. I don't know how many of you have seen a premature baby before. It's going to be really tiny, so please don't say anything offensive.

scenes.line: Kevin!

scenes.line: You warned me not to say anything if it was tiny, Oscar. But you didn't prepare me for a big, giant, fat baby.

scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.line: Yes, he's substantial.

scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: And the victim rode his bicycle into the left hand turn lane but the perp was already in the left-hand turn lane?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: See, that's what I'm having trouble with, because the fact is, you never said he was on a bicycle. [villainous laugh] Busted, Halpert!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, wait, wait.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes! Andy, get out here.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. I never said he was on a bicycle. I just said I wasn't listening to you.

scenes.line: I am making a citizen's arrest. You have the right to remain silent. You have the right to beg for mercy. You have the right to request judgment by combat. Dwight's rights.

scenes.line: What's up, gangstas?

scenes.line: Jim was lying about jury duty. He was lying the whole time so he could go do yoga or go canoeing. I don't know what this pervert likes. Fire him!

scenes.line: Dwight, not everything is a conspiracy theory.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I have Jim on the record saying that the vic-

scenes.line: No. Dwight! I have me on the record, saying to you, take a chill pill.

scenes.line: I don't- I don't need to take a chill pill.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Here, right there. [mimes giving Dwight a pill and a glass] Down the hatch.

scenes.line: I really don't want to take the chill pill. [mimes taking pill]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, okay. [sits, exhales] But let's just say that Jim was lying about jury duty. You would have to fire him, right?

scenes.line: That's good enough for me. [exhales again]

scenes.line: …and Pam was just going crazy, trying to take care of Philip because Cece has been out of control recently, and- look, Andy, it doesn't matter. The truth is, I just feel terrible lying to you.

scenes.line: I feel terrible getting lied to. No one's ever lied to me before.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. I think the best thing to do right now is just come clean and tell everybody the truth.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No, not after what I told Dwight about firing you. No. Here's what we're going to do. We're going to have ourselves a good old-fashioned cover-up. Have you ever heard of a Connecticut cover-up?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Do you know why you never heard of it?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Covered it up.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you sure you can keep this under wraps?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: My nickname was actually King Butt, because I had a king-size butt.

scenes.line: [pulls food truck up to where Dwight and Nate are standing] Where you want I park?

scenes.line: Okay, everybody, gather 'round. Got a real special surprise for you. [indicates Ernesto and assistant who are carrying empanadas]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Ernesto!

scenes.line: Hola Toby! [mimes choking]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Yeah, hey.

scenes.speaker: Ernesto
scenes.line: Como esta? [speaks Spanish]

scenes.line: Uh, I'm going to say "I" when I'm talking for Ernesto, so instead of "he says blah, blah, blah," I'm going to say "I say, blah, blah, blah," but that's for him. Anyway, it was something like, "He remembers Toby." [makes face] "I remember Toby."

scenes.line: Okay- oh, Jim. Hey, this guy look familiar?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh-

scenes.line: It's the empanada guy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: The empanada guy!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, Toby! [bleep] Damn it, Toby! No, I wasn't asking you. [sighs] Ask him if he remembers Jim. [Nate asks Ernesto a question in Spanish]

scenes.line: No.

scenes.line: He says, "No."

scenes.line: He says, "No!" Boom!

scenes.line: Yeah but who remembers all their customers? I mean, I can name like three of our clients.

scenes.line: Okay, he remembers Toby, the most forgettable man in the known world. [Ernesto says something in Spanish]

scenes.line: Ah, he doesn't want any trouble, he sees lots of people, they come from all around to eat his delicious meat pockets.

scenes.line: Uh, you guys are going to love these. So, empanadas on me. You guys gotta try them.

scenes.line: Usually I'm a burrito guy, but if you won't tell, I won't. Wink, wink.

scenes.line: Great. And while we're enjoying these delicious empanadas, Jim, why don't you tell us your story again?

scenes.line: Why? Everybody's heard it.

scenes.line: Walk us through it. What time would you get there every morning?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey, Murder She Wrote. How about we drop the whole 'Murder, She Wrote' thing, okay? Jim was at the courthouse for jury duty every morning. How do I know? Because I drove him there.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Why? Why? [looks at Jim]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Because my car broke down.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: His car broke down. So he called me, 'cause I live near the courthouse.

scenes.line: Wait, wait. You live by the courthouse. So you drove from near the courthouse, out to Jim's house, and then back to the courthouse?

scenes.line: Thirty minutes out, thirty minutes back, easy hour. And I would watch that cute little tushie scurry up those courthouse stairs every morning and that was that.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [to Ernesto] I'm sorry, do you have any American Mexican food?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: We're getting buried out there. What was that stuff about the car breaking down?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I think you handled it pretty well.

scenes.speaker: Andy

scenes.line: You're so ignorant. You barely know what you're talking about. That is so ridiculous. You really need to read a couple books.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What's a book? [giggles]

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: On my God. You're so embarrassing. My mom would say the best stuff, though.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [ahem] You can… [slightly effeminate] You can do it Ryan.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: And you know that I'm capable of this.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You're the only one who can do it, s-sweetie.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: What did you think of the presentation?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I thought it was great, sweetie. I would just fix that one —

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Oh! "Fix" means you hate it! I knew it! I need something to drink!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jim, get him a water.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: No, not a water. A sports drink. I hate everything in that fridge. Not red! Get me something yellow or green from a nearby store. Not red!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why are you just standing there? Go to a nearby store and get him a yellow or green sports drink!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Now, if your attacker is willing to defile a corpse, you better stop playing dead right away and just make it known that you're alive.

scenes.speaker: Lady
scenes.line: Forgive me for interrupting. I believe my daughter had an altercation with somebody here, some fancy gentleman with a squeaky voice?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [deep voice] I think you guys might have the wrong Office.

scenes.speaker: Girl
scenes.line: That's him… the guy I hit.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You've gotta be kidding me.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Poor Andy! First you got beat up by a gang, and now she kicks your ass?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: No, Kevin — [sighs]

scenes.speaker: Lady
scenes.line: What about the lady you hit with the pine cone?

scenes.speaker: Girl
scenes.line: There. That chubby one.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I just had a baby.

scenes.speaker: Girl
scenes.line: Yesterday?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow.

scenes.speaker: Lady
scenes.line: Apologize.

scenes.speaker: Girl
scenes.line: Sorry I kicked your ass in front of your "thin" girlfriend.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How 'bout we wait til next year after you have your kid?

scenes.speaker: Lady
scenes.line: You know what? Tiffy's going to college.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [deep voice] Listen, I don't know what you guys are talking about, but I guess I'll just accept your apology so we can get on with our day.

scenes.speaker: Lady
scenes.line: God bless. Friend of mine uses your paper. You do good work. Bye bye.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Bye.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: So, Toby, I think we should do a different self-defense seminar — "How to protect ourselves against tiny little girls."

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: There's no shame in getting beaten up by a girl. My ex-wife used to demolish me.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: No, there is shame in it, okay? We have to draw the line somewhere.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Oh my God, I think I see the imprint of a ring pop.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh… [Kelly laughing]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Have you seen Erin?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I'm on break.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh God… Hey no! Where do you think you're going? You've gotta stay for the big presentation we've got this young wiz kid — Ryan. He's like an even more handsome Bill Gates.

scenes.speaker: Blogger
scenes.line: When's the presentation?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's moments away. Just stay here!

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [on phone] Hey Uncle Lucas, it's your nephew Ryan. Honestly, I could use a prescription for ritalin right now. Well, I know you did one for Aunt Carol. Oh, so it's different because it's your wife? Well, that doesn't make any sense to me.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: How you doing?

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Don't talk to me right now. I'm sorry. I- I know you're my boss, but seriously, you need to get the hell out of my face. What I don't understand is… [voice fades]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [to Dwight] Your little man is unraveling. Now go and fix it.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Sorry about kicking you out. It's just, we don't want our brand associated with death.

scenes.speaker: Old Lady
scenes.line: It's okay. I'll go to the Costco and search for handsome men.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You're not married yet?

scenes.speaker: Old Lady
scenes.line: [laughs] Oh, I was. My husband was my best friend. He passed away.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: My best friend was my boss, Andy. We dated for a while, but since then, he rejected me, and we're not really friends.

scenes.speaker: Old Lady
scenes.line: Someone rejected you? With that body and those bazongas? Forget him!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah! Forget him! And you should forget your husband.

scenes.speaker: Old Lady
scenes.line: Well…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: How long has he been in the bathroom?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: About ten minutes.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jeez! What's he doing in there? [cell phone vibrates]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oops, that's my phone. Am I allowed to answer it or are you gonna freak out?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Are there any bloggers around?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's Ryan. "I'm sorry. I lied. I'm not in the bathroom. I can't do it. I need to see my mom. I'm going home."

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: What is the delay here? Where's Ryan? Why is he not here?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I had to send him home. As brilliant and creative as he is, he is nothing… compared to this guy!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh…

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's right. Will you just give us a second?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: You are gonna bloody ruin it. You're gonna bloody ruin it because you're a no-good half-assed cock-eyed…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: okay.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: That's…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jim —

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm not doing the Presentation.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Look at me. Look at me! Look… at… this… face. This is not the face of a performer. This is the face of a scary apparition you see before you die. I'm telling you… if you don't do this, [whispers] I don't stand a chance. Please, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, I'll do it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, my God. O… Kay! Go get into Ryan's costume and check out his notes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: A costume?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Of course there's a costume! [laughs] Oh, this is gonna be great. There's nothing like some last-minutes changes to really energize a presentation.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Did you pass out in there? What is taking so long?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I've been in here for 20 seconds.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hurry up. Let me in. I wanna watch you get dressed. Did you find the eyeliner?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm not wearing eyeliner.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You are wearing eyeliner, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Time. Space. Gender. [Dwight mouthing words] There are no rules anymore. All boundaries are breaking down in the wake of the infinite future. The only thing that — the only thing that remain — the only thing that remains are the things that have stood the test of time — love, values, and of course, the pyramids — the strongest shape ever constructed, a shape that fits all other shapes inside of it. [softly] No, that's —

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's true.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: This… is the future, because… This is the past. I've been through a lot of issues in my life. I've seen drug addiction — unemployment. I've been in a relationship that tore my heart apart, without ever being able to accept that love drove the pain. [scattered applause]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: When I was ten years old, my parents took me to Disney world. I cried the whole time. I was not able to comprehend the beauty that was before me. I just wanted… to go home. This is what the Pyramid will do for you. It is the bridge to the world. It has a usb port. Wireless… will be available in 2013. You can play Anything from Chuck to Cars 2. With the Pyramid, you have the connection to everything — in time… and space.

scenes.speaker: Crowd
scenes.line: ahhhhhh

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Psst.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: [image on Pyramid] Sabre… It's time… to come home.

scenes.speaker: Crowd
scenes.line: [applause]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right. Thank you so much. Wow. Wow! And good night! [applause continues]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. Thank you. Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Okay, this isn't over. Let's stay focused, okay? We made fun of Andy earlier for getting beat up by a little girl, but… little things can be dangerous.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Whether it's a gremlin or chucky the doll. The key is to throw it in something. Like a fireplace, or a tub of electricity.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Okay. Good point…

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Good point? What is a tub of electricity?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I don't… I don't…

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: With all due respect we know what we're defending against: a twelve year old female bully.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: I was a twelve year old bully.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Great! I think Kelly should attack Toby.

scenes.speaker: Others
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Yeah, that's not a bad idea, actually, because I have had a lot of pent up aggression.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Thanks.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Good. Let's go.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I don't know if this is gonna help…Uh…

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Let's go Kelly.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: We should stay to maybe some more traditional models…

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: You think you're so pretty! Well you're not gonna be so pretty come Prom time!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Okay, this is what's called pre-violent posturing.

scenes.speaker: Kelly
scenes.line: Take that! Not so pre-violent anymore!

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Okay, I'm at what's called "the decision point."

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey, hey, hey. Kelly Kelly, Kelly… come on… Ow! God! My good eye!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [laughs] Oh boy. Oh no, I'm not laughing at you. I'm laughing at, um, something that Cece did on the playground earlier — yesterday. This morning.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You know why I got hit by girls? Because I stood up for others. Pam and for Toby. I stepped in and I didn't care that I was standing up to girls. You may wanna ask yourselves, "Where were you when the girls came?"

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Tough day. Yes. But I feel good. I put the office in their place, took a bunch of pain killers, drank a half a bottle of wine, took my pants off. I just feel good!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, okay, I will be the first to admit it. We could have integrated more Chuck into the Presentation.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Dwight. You're the vice president.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ha, ha, ha, ha! Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [squealing]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay! Come on!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: aagh!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hah! Yah! [kicking and punching the air] Boom!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [exiting office] Everyone stop what you're doing, I have terrible news. Dwight is no longer with us.

scenes.speaker: Everyone
scenes.line: [gasps] What?! Why is that?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: He's gone, damn it! He's been promoted to VP of Sabre Retail and he's staying in Florida forever.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: So, he's alive.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah. That was him on the phone. He sounds wonderful.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Well, the way you said it made it sound like he was dead.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: How could I have been more clear? He had a massive stroke [slight pause] of good fortune and he is now in a better place.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: If Dwight's not coming back, does that mean we can open his treasure?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You guys, we've gone over this, there is no treasure. [Erin retrieves the "treasure box" and slams it down on Dwight's desk]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: When the team left for Tallahassee, Dwight told everyone not to touch his treasure. [cut to Dwight holding treasure chest and telling the office "Don't touch my treasure. Ok, you understand?"] Obviously he wants us to obsess about it. There's nothing in there. [has realization] Which is obviously what he would want us to think, making it the perfect place to hide a treasure. Oh god, I'm Wallace Shawn in The Princess Bride.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I think that Dwight wanted us to realize that this conversation among friends is the true treasure. [everyone disagrees]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I am dying to know what's in there.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, I know, Oscar we all are but nobody's gonna open it. You'd have to be insane. [everyone turns to look at Creed]

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Hi, hello.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [to Creed standing in front of the "treasure box"] Now, carefully… open the box.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [opens box, pulls out and displays contents] It's a photo of all of us.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Aw, that's so sweet! [dart fires out of box and lodges in ceiling]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [feigning surprise] A dart? Are you kidding me? Who would put a poison dart, well, I mean, I don't know that it's poison. I mean, I just have to imagine. God, I'm glad he's OK though. Kinda sounds like he deserved it, opening another man's treasure and all. Wow!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [on a golf course] Well, mister ball, it's been a pleasure. Now, give my regards to hell. Da! [hits ball]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, all right! Well swung my VIP VP.

scenes.speaker: Robert California
scenes.line: I am loving the chemistry between you two.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: I am so happy Dwight is gonna be working alongside me. We are a regular Archibald and his man George.

scenes.speaker: Robert California
scenes.line: I bet. I'm excited.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Trick… there's no such thing. It's not even a real English duo.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ah!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: I just made you look like the goat of Dover. And that doesn't exist either.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [to Robert] You think you're excited? You should feel my nipples. [Robert gives a fake laugh]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, that reminds me. [reaching into golf cart] Little something from all of us. [hand Dwight a small wrapped gift]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [sarcastically] Oh my gosh, thank you Jim, that's so thoughtful. [sets gift on golf tee] Four! [smashes gift] Oh yeah!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: He doesn't even care.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Don't even care!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: This is the last time I'll ever see Dwight. It's a weird feeling, it's, um, what's the word? It's not, it's not bittersweet. It's uh… sweet. Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [entEring Andy's office] Hey, man. Selling cookies for Jada. Want the same as last year?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Would if I could. And I can so I will. Put me down for one box. Don't care what it is, dealer's choice.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I'll put you down for shortbreads.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Damn it.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [entEring Andy's office] Knock, knock. Hey, Sasha's first year in the troops, so I'm selling cookies for her. Anyway, would you like some?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: No. No.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I been selling here for five years. This is my spot.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You can't claim territories. This is the only place I interact with people. Can't you sell at your church or barber shop? [Darryl looks hurt] Or chess club, or?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You know what? It's your first time, let's split the office. You can have sales, the annex, Creed, and I don't know I'll just take, uh, accounting.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: That's it? Yeah, well, ok. Thanks Darryl.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: OK, great.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [exits Andy's office smiling] All I need is Kevin. Dude buys more cookies than everyone combined and then some. [Kevin waves at him] When I first started selling cookies he was a relatively thin man. Not a thin man, mind you. Relatively thin.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [entEring a home carrying groceries] Hellosi, I'm home, babaloo.

scenes.speaker: Elderly Woman
scenes.line: [rises from chair] Oh, here let me help.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [spilling groceries] I got it. It was so busy at the store today. Really good cheese samples. I had, like, a hundred.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Irene hired me as her live-in helper. We met at the store launch. I told her I was moving here and I needed a place and it just sort of made sense. I basically do everything for her. [Erin randomly adds an assortment of pills to a weekly pill box] I run errands. I do chores around the house. I cook and clean. Honestly, I don't know how she survived without me.

scenes.speaker: Irene
scenes.line: When can I introduce you to my grandson? He's a wonderful swimmer. Shallow end, deep end. He does it all.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Well, today might be kind of tough, Irene. I have to talk to my old boss, Andy, and tell him I'm staying in Florida. [hands Irene a mug]

scenes.speaker: Irene
scenes.line: [takes mug] Thank you. [takes a sip] Oh, what kind of tea is this?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, I boiled some Gatorade.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [misses putt] Ah. In England, they put the holes a little bit to the right, you see. We'll just chalk it up to cultural bias.

scenes.speaker: Robert California
scenes.line: If I may, [assists Nellie] try holding the putter… yeah, with your wrists here. And your thumbs here.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Robert California
scenes.line: That's right. Your little finger.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [approaches Kevin] Would you like to buy some cookies?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Cookies, eh?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [singing] Oh, the springtime thinks that it's the best. And fall time thinks that it's the best. Cold time has, kind of a strut. And Valentine's thinks that it's the best. But gather round, peeps, I'll tell you the truth. Nothing beats the cookie season, that's the truth.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [Kevin scratches cookie order form and sniffs it] It's not a scratch-and-sniff, Kev.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I know. But sometimes you still get a little something.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [to Darryl] Hey, you tricked me. You just wanted Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You're new to the game. You learned a lesson today. See you next year, sport.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: No, no, no. It's not fair. What if Kevin wants to buy cookies from me?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I do.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: See?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: That doesn't mean anything. [to Kevin] Kevin, do you want to buy cookies from me?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh, I definitely do.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [to Toby] Huh. Hit the road, jack.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: No, you hit the road, jack.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [looking pleased] Hey guys, come on. Don't fight over me.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You know, why don't we split the order? It's only fair.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No. Wait, no. I'm buying, I make the rules. I actually do want you to fight over me. I wanna be wined and dined and… 69ed.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Ugh.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Metaphorically 69ed. Ew. Perverts… no offence Oscar. [Oscar looks flabbergasted]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Hop in, we have places to be. No rest for the wicked.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to Dwight] All right. So… I guess this is it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well, Jim, I just want to say that we haven't always got along and at times, I've even hated your guts. But…[smiles] bye, bye. I win.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [attempts to shake Dwight's hand] Goodbye, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [drops golf ball into Jim's open hand] Robert, race you to the clubhouse, gentlemen's bet. Woohoo! [takes off in golf cart]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, he's Florida's problem now.

scenes.speaker: Robert California
scenes.line: I'll let Dwight have his fun. Today will not be his day.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What's that?

scenes.speaker: Robert California
scenes.line: I'm gonna tank the Sabre store at the presentation to the board.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I thought you liked the store?

scenes.speaker: Robert California
scenes.line: Well, the store is lovely. You created a wonderful space to showcase our product line. Great job. Cheers.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Robert California
scenes.line: But, there's a reason we sell our products online and over-the-phone. Have you ever used Sabre electronics, Jim? [Jim shakes head] They're cheap. They're unintuitive. The Sabre store would work if we adopted the carnival model of leaving town once everyone's wives do us.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow. When you put it that way, I guess it does sound pretty terrible.

scenes.speaker: Robert California
scenes.line: I couldn't just kill the project from the start. Jo Bennett endorsed it. Shame though, I did like Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [from distanced golf cart] Robert! I'm gonna win, ha ha, I'm the gentleman! Suck it!

scenes.speaker: Robert California
scenes.line: [to Dwight] Bravo, Dwight! Very good! [Jim looks surprised] [to Jim] Shame.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [at Sabre headquarters] The math is simple folks. Deeper market penetration, plus greater visibility, will raise Sabre [Nellie emerges from behind Dwight] [together] to the power of two.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: How did that look?

scenes.speaker: Gabe
scenes.line: I'm not just saying this, that was the best thing I've ever seen.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [to Nellie] I told you.

scenes.speaker: Todd Packer
scenes.line: When you guys do that whole power of two shebang, how 'bout I pop up also? I guess we'd have to say 'power of three'. Hm, actually, you know what, yeah, that actually works. [to Nellie] You'd spin off right. I'd spin off-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You know what? That is a great idea. Cathy, write that down and print it out. It's gonna make some really good toilet paper.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [enters room] All right. There he is.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What are you doing here? I thought I got rid of you?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Can I just talk to you for one quick second?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What, your stylist ran out of 'messy spray'? [others laugh]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Um, actually it's, it's for your own good. I think maybe we should- [gestures toward hallway]

scenes.speaker: Dwight

scenes.line: So no one can tell me what's going on. Well, let me illuminate things for you. We are getting to know each other. [in American accent] But why, m'lady? [in normal voice] Because I am your new manager.

scenes.line: Robert, is Nellie our new manager?

scenes.speaker: Robert

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: I came in here simply trying to get to know you, learn your names, maybe have someone teach me the company song. And what I got in return was nothing but disrespect. You leave me no choice but to get to know you in a more intimate way.

scenes.line: Hot tub party?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Performance reviews.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How can you give us performance reviews if you don't know us?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: On first impressions, so I recommend smiling. It goes a long way with me.

scenes.line: Erin, you really nailed the hot dogs today.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, thanks. I've been re-using the hot dog water so it gets more flavor. It's only going to keep getting better.

scenes.speaker: Irene

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, we're not really dating anymore, so… basically, I mean, I just have to cross a few Ts and dot a few I's, you know.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: So you came to get me, but you still have a girlfriend.

scenes.speaker: Irene
scenes.line: I think you should leave, young man.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: All right. Technically, yes, I am still technically dating Jessica. But when I realized that I wanted you back, I just jumped in the car and I drove down here, and I didn't want to stop until I saw you.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You didn't even stop to pee? Gross.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Any luck?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No. He just keeps letting all the calls go to voicemail.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [on phone message, singing] Please leave a message for Andy Bernard, include your na-

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, you're doing so good. Oh my God, you're superman over there. [Andy's phone vibrating]

scenes.speaker: Irene
scenes.line: You should take it. It's probably your girlfriend wondEring where you are.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Nope. It's just work. Not important. You know, I can really feel this is my quads, I can tell I'm getting stronger.

scenes.line: You really wouldn't feel those kinds of results after one session.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I don't know. [phone vibrating] Just let it vibrate. It's fine.

scenes.line: You could put it on silent.

scenes.speaker: Irene

scenes.line: I like working here.

scenes.line: Dwight, should she be our manager?

scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.line: No.

scenes.line: No.

scenes.line: I always find one. Have you ever heard of buying a toothbrush?

scenes.line: I grew up poor. I had little formal education. No real skills. I don't work especially hard, and most of my ideas are either unoriginal or total crap. And yet, I walked right into a job for which I was ill-prepared, ill-suited, and somebody else already had, and I got it. If you ask me, that's the American dream right there. Anything can happen to anyone. It's just random.

scenes.line: Oh, great. [reads] "Glad they didn't mix up your tonsillectomy with a moustachectomy." Oh that's not good.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh, because your jokes are all hilarious.

scenes.line: It's nice. It's funny. It mentions his tonsillectomy and makes a funny little joke about his moustache.

scenes.line: Stanley doesn't have a moustache.

scenes.line: Phyllis! What are you talking- The whole card depends on this!

scenes.line: Sorry, sorry, everyone, I'm late! But you all are here, so no harm done at all by my lateness.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Important.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Mm-hmm.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I can't believe he's making us throw a party for her.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I know, right?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: She's always late, she's always rude…

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: It kinda makes me want to throw a really bad party.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: On purpose.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Phyllis!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [laughs] We should do it right here in the break room. [they giggle]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Order carrot cake. [laughter]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: …and Jessica, just so you know, this is way more about my love for Erin than anything wrong with you.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Well, Andy, I'm upset, but you did this in the best way possible, and I knew you as a lover and I'll remember you as a gentleman. Okay, that was one minute and ten seconds.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Consider it nailed.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [vocalizing] I think we should try again. This time, worst case scenario.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay, here we go. Jessica, I'm really sorry. I just need you to know-

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [whining] What?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I just need you to know-

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: What is it? I didn't sleep well last night. [they laugh]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [lifting box] Ugh! Ow.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Nellie, that reminds me. Do you want this chair in the bedroom? 'Cause to be honest, I don't think it's gonna fit through the door.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Don't listen to Jim. Have you ever seen him play Tetris? "Oh, I think I'll just use this line horizontally. Oh, I had no idea what a gift this line is."

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That was one time-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I will get the chair in. Watch the Great Schrutini work his magic.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, no. Really? Magic? No, no, no. Let's not go there. No, nothing is more repellant than magicians. Bunch of grown men waving wands, pulling bunnies out of body crevices. Magicians are repulsive. Next topic.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [cell phone rings] Excuse me, one second. Hi.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, what's up?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ah, nothing, just hauling some cube with Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [shouting] Haulin' cube!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's moving boxes. We just came up with the term to make it sound cooler.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So we're planning this party for Nellie, and we're gonna make it really bad.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sounds like every other party.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No. We're gonna make it like a prank. Like order bad food, give her this passive-aggressive card.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh! Hire a magician.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Trust me.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [laughs] Okay.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Wow. There's a lot of cars here. This is just weird.

scenes.speaker: Lauren
scenes.line: [knocks on car window] Andy! Hey, what are you doing here?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey, Lauren. Look at you.

scenes.speaker: Lauren
scenes.line: Well, I know. Look at me.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I was just on my way back from this business trip, thought I'd stop and say hi to Jessica.

scenes.speaker: Lauren
scenes.line: Aww! [clicks tongue]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Why is Erin with me? That's a great question. She is my coworker, and she needed a ride because she totaled her car.

scenes.speaker: Lauren
scenes.line: Oh. God.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: So, I'm Erin. Hi.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yep. This is Erin.

scenes.speaker: Lauren
scenes.line: Nice to meet you. [Erin gasps at another girl outside her window] Well, Jess went out for a run but she'll be back soon. Hey ladies, Andy's here!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Okay Andy, that is a bachelorette party, this is Jessica's friends and they've been drinking during the daytime. Should we go?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah. Uh, you know, we had such a quick window to make this work, I think we should probably just-

scenes.speaker: Lauren
scenes.line: Oh, Jess! [claps] Look who stopped by after his business trip!

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: Andy! Hey!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I wonder if king-sized sheets are called presidential-sized in England. I really should have a Tweeter account.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes, you should.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [finds shoe box] Ooh.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [reads] "Nellie, don't open, stupid. Love, Nellie."

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I have to see these shoes.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I doubt that they're sh-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Whoa. Who is this guy?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Here's the two of them taking a hike. I'm guessing he's some kind of friend.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Boyfriend.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Here's the two of them kissing at a beach and kissing at the Eiffel Tower. I'm guessing he's some kind of close romantic friend.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Like a boyfriend?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You read my mind.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. Whoa. Here's one with his face whited out.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hmm. Maybe someone threw a pie in his face. New theory- he's a hated Italian politician.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Better theory. This is her ex-boyfriend and they went through some kind of painful breakup.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [walks in] Oh.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, Nellie. I'm so sorry. We were just…

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: I see you've discovered Benjamin. That's what I call my box full of photos of Henry.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why not call…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Shh!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: God. We owned this flat together. Then one morning, just like that, he was gone. He ran off with the waitress at our favorite restaurant.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's awful. What kind of restaurant.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Dwight!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: I couldn't afford the flat myself. So I sold it at a loss. Ah, but what's ten years of bliss down the drain compared with the thrill of starting over with nothing and no one?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm so sorry. These must be very painful memories.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: If it would help you to forget, I could hit you in the brain stem with this candlestick.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Thank you. No. Look, Jim, Dwight, please, don't tell anyone about this.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, no. Of course. Just one quick question. Was this um, Halloween, or…

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: God, no. That's the most embarrassing thing of all this. What kind of fool gets her heart broken by bloody stage magician?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [in the phone] You know what, Pam? I was thinking maybe we should change course here. Let's give up on all this mean stuff.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What? No! No, I just had this brilliant idea- everyone loved it. You don't have a copyright on pranks. I might be better at this than you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, that's not what I-

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Jim, could you give us a hand?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Absolutely. Yeah. [whispers] Call it off, Pam. Call it off, okay? It's way more complicated than you think. Cancel the magician. Trust me.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, okay. Okay, I will. [hangs up phone]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Pam, we have a great idea.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Listen to this.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: We're going to have the fluorescent lights flickEring. It's gonna make everyone sick.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Or what if…

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We discuss… [Angela and Phyllis giggle] the idea of doing the party totally normal. Like, not mean. Just a regular party. [giggling stops] Not mean.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I knew she'd crack! I wanted to leave you out, you know.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: We're in far too deep. We can't change course at this point.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What are you talking about? Yes we can.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What I mean to say is we don't want to.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Toots, we're not stopping this train, so get off the tracks.

scenes.speaker: Lauren
scenes.line: [pops balloon] Suck it! [cheers, applause]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Andy-

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It'll be fine. Just act natural. Do you want a gummy penis?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: No, uh, I'll just have some gummy bears.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: These are delicious.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: But… they're penises.

scenes.speaker: Lauren
scenes.line: And we come to Matthew. The guy who was with his old girlfriend basically the whole time we were together. [party guests groan]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ew! Aww! That seems gross at first blush, right? But relationships are always more complicated than you think. I mean, we don't know Matthew's history with this other woman. Maybe she saved his life. [laughs] I don't know. I just- I don't think we should rush to judgment about Matthew. Maybe we don't pop that one.

scenes.speaker: Party guests
scenes.line: No, pop it. Pop it! [Lauren pops the balloon, party guests cheer]

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: Sorry. It's kind of a madhouse.

scenes.speaker: Megan
scenes.line: [grabs Andy] Ahh!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh! Ah, Megan.

scenes.speaker: Megan
scenes.line: You are one of the good ones, nard dog.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Aww.

scenes.speaker: Megan
scenes.line: No, really. [to Jessica] Where's my Andy?

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: I dunno.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, he's out there.

scenes.speaker: Megan
scenes.line: Aww. Are you going to sing for us?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, you guys are doing a pretty good job with the scary yelling, so…

scenes.speaker: Megan
scenes.line: That's not like you. That's not like you. Come on, sing! Sing!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [singing] By yon bonnie banks and by yon bonnie braes…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay, they're almost here- What? Come on. If you guys are gonna be mean, could you at least be subtle? [rips down ugly photo of Nellie]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Oh, in the warehouse we use code names for people we want to talk about. Andy was Jelly Roll. Mike was Dennis the Menace. Ryan was douche bag.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hey, that's not a code name. That's just an insult.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Plus everyone would know who you meant.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, that's a great idea. Let's have a code name. How about Mondays? I hate Mondays? Mondays are the worst?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Nobody's named Monday.

scenes.speaker: Ryan
scenes.line: Hey, how about we go with Pam? Simple, easy to remember.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: 'Cause there's someone already here named Pam.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Shh, here she comes!

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Welcome to your party.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Everybody get comfy now. This first song's over a half hour long. [plays off-tune notes]

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Best gig ever. They asked me to play only originals. I said, "Have you heard my originals? They're terrible." They said, "Even better." I said, "I get it. It's an ironic party for Nellie."

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Maybe we should just go.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No. I gotta do this. Hey Jessica, could I talk to you?

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: Uh, yeah, sure. What's up?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh, maybe we could talk in private?

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: Uh, yeah. What is it?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, first just let me say that I hope when I'm done with the sort of ugly bits that we can stay friends.

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: You're breaking up with me?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh, no. No. You always do this. You twist my words around. Part of me thinks we should just end this right now.

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: Oh my God. Are you leaving me for Erin? You said she wasn't relationship material and she wasn't as good as me, but it's her, isn't it?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Whoa! That? No. Okay. You want honesty? Super-honesty time. I'm gay.

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I am gay, and I prefer men.

scenes.speaker: Kenny
scenes.line: I knew it!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You did not, Kenny!

scenes.speaker: Kenny
scenes.line: You invited me to go shopping with you.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I like hanging out with you. You're a cool guy. Which proves my point. That I'm gay.

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: Andy, you're not gay. I mean, we were… together. And you seemed pretty excitable.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, I was faking it. I had to fake it every time. I had to imagine that I was in a steam room with John Stamos.

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: I can't say it doesn't make sense…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well… I mean, I was good at hiding it, but-

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: Look, it's fine, Andy. I didn't think we were gonna get married or anything. I just… I'm just upset for now.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Understandable. And I'm really sorry. I really am. [hugs Jessica, grunts] So… we should probably… go.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: This humble but sincere effort is all for our valued new colleague. Excellent.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: To Nellie Bertram, you are a most welcome and friendly presence at our company.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: Cheers.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Why thank you.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Pam, on the other hand, is a most unwelcome, entitled, unfriendly presence in our company.

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: Cheers.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Nellie is terrific, but to be honest, every day I imagine how happy I'd be if Pam died. [laughter]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh. Well. I feel that as someone who knows Pam only a little bit… enough. A good amount. Not the most, though. I would say that she is misunderstood and that maybe there's some stuff in her past that you guys don't know about that's a little messed up and probably makes her such a torture to work with.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: We hate Pam. We hate Pam.

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: We hate Pam! We hate Pam!

scenes.speaker: Magician
scenes.line: So we've established-

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. No.

scenes.speaker: Magician
scenes.line: -that you guys hate Pam. Do you ever wish she would just… disappear? [sets off flash paper]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh! [laughter, murmuring]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: That was a really rough scene.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Right? Rough scene.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh… at least we can kiss now.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, yeah. [gives him a quick kiss]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You know, that stuff that I said about you to her… I did- That's just- I had to say it. You know, I was dating her at the time.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah. Yes, of course. Ah… I feel really tired.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Probably from seeing that turkey.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh yeah.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: When we drove by the farm. Oh. Always does it.

scenes.speaker: Magician
scenes.line: Are you Nellie? Oh, I think you're my volunteer. Come on over here, huh?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, I'll do it. I will volunteer.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: no, Nellie, she-

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'll do it.

scenes.speaker: Magician
scenes.line: Oh! Big guy, huh? How's the air up there? Watch out for… birds. [chuckles] All right, let's uh- let's do some card magic. Now, what I want you to do is… I want you to pick a card just by looking at it. Do not say what it is.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [picks a card] It's the four of hearts.

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: Oh, no, you-

scenes.speaker: Magician
scenes.line: Looks like we got a guy from another country here, huh? No hablo el cardo, senor? Hmm? Ha. All right, the card is picked. Now sir, will you please shuffled the deck? [Jim drops the cards] You didn't just do that on purpose, did ya?

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: [to Dwight] Why is Jim treating the magician poorly?

scenes.speaker: Magician
scenes.line: Little known fact about me. Before I was a magician, I used to work at a rope factory.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Not true. 'Cause that's not a real place.

scenes.speaker: Magician
scenes.line: But I never could seem to figure out those knots.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's not a real knot. When you pull on it, it disappears.

scenes.speaker: Magician
scenes.line: [yells] What the hell? All right, where's Phyllis? Who's Phyllis? Look. This is really uncool, okay? I put on a clean show here-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay scram, wizard.

scenes.speaker: Magician
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You heard me!

scenes.speaker: Magician
scenes.line: Huh!

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: Well Nellie, I'm sorry. If I'd known Jim and Pam would use this party as an excuse to abuse a magician-

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Well, I thought it was quite fun. In fact, I think they're brilliant employees, in their own way. Don't you see what I see?

scenes.speaker: Robert
scenes.line: Interesting. Yes. No, yes, I see that. Great work, team. Great party.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: You think this is a great party? This cake has vegetables in it. Like a salad bar, Robert. How do I get this taste out of my mouth?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: What? Why are we-

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I just gotta do one thing. [leaves car, knocks on door]

scenes.speaker: Megan
scenes.line: Oh. Hello. Hey everybody, look who's here.

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: What are you doing here?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hi. Super-duper honesty time. I'm not gay. In fact, I'm so not gay, I'm in love with a girl. Her name is Erin Hannon and she's right there. She's sweet, funny and beautiful and total relationship material.

scenes.speaker: Megan
scenes.line: Why the hell did you come back here?

scenes.speaker: Jessica
scenes.line: Go away.

scenes.speaker: Kenny
scenes.line: Get lost!

scenes.speaker: Woman
scenes.line: Get out!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Lauren
scenes.line: You're done!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Bye guys.

scenes.speaker: Lauren
scenes.line: Get out! You ruined my party! Who does that? Are you kidding me? [Andy and Erin run to the car] Yeah, run away!

scenes.speaker: Kenny
scenes.line: You're disgusting!

scenes.speaker: Lauren
scenes.line: I can't believe you're not gay! [Andy and Erin kiss]

scenes.speaker: Kenny
scenes.line: Yeah get out of here.

scenes.speaker: Various
scenes.line: Don't come back. [someone throws food at the car]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Uh-oh! [laughs, they drive away]

scenes.speaker: Various
scenes.line: You don't even know how to drive! Bye Andy! Loser! Nice car!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey Hank.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: Yes ma'am.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I thought I was very specific about you not letting up a magician.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: Yes ma'am. I got my eyes open.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, turns out he actually made it up there.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: What? That ain't right.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, he came and went.

scenes.speaker: Hank
scenes.line: Wait a minute! You said it was a magician, right? [Pam nods] You don't think he could've used… it couldn't have been…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Let's just- let's go.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Night-night.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Whoo! Wow, it is raining cats and dogs out there. Holy moley.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Phyllis says the same twelve clichés every time it rains. So, I promised everyone that if she says them all by noon today, I will send out for hot chocolates.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: So how was the drive in?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh, nobody knows how to drive in the rain.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You don't say?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Yeah. You know the roads are actually the slickest in the first half hour?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh, the plants are gonna love this.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I actually sleep better when it's raining.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Tell me about it.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Time's almost up. How many are left?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Just one. "This weather makes me want to stay at home, curled up with a good book."

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Phyllis. This rain… does it make you wanna be doing something?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What do you mean?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You know, like aren't some things just so nice and cozy in the rain?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, come on.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Lots of things are cozy in the rain.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And that's noon. Exactly. [others groan]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I mean, normally the rain would make me want to stay home, curled up with a good book. But everybody's being so nice to me today. I'm really happy being here.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [singing] My girlfriend's back and there's gonna be trouble-

scenes.speaker: Andy & Erin
scenes.line: Hey la, hey la…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: …my girlfriend's back!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [simultaneously] …his girlfriend's back! [others cheer and applaud]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Anyway, I know it's the end of the day. We just wanted to stop by and say hi.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Welcome home.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Hey, Kev.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Nice sweater.
