scenes.line: You will. Yeah we weigh about the same, wouldn't you say?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Sure, if you weigh 105 pounds.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: So you'll do it?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Come on, this will be the only thrill of your boring life.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dwight, you may find this hard to believe, but I love my boring life.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Come on.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Exactly the way it is.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes, and there's nothing you could say that would get me to run the slightest risk of losing it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Please? Please, Pam?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Find someone else, I don't know. Ask Phyllis.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I can't use Phyllis. Are you kidding me? The moment she steps off this bar I'll be launched into space. God, you're so insensitive.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Why are you getting rid of it?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Allergies.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Your husband?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No, the baby. Please, it's my husband's favorite cat. He's broken up about it. It's the only time I've seen him cry other than our wedding night.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You know what? I will take Comstock.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Really? Oh, Oscar, thank you!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I'll come by after work and pick him up.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yay! Oh, poor Robert. He won't get to say goodbye. He has this business dinner tonight

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: C'est la vie.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Please don't teach the cat French.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [on phone] Yeah. Good news, tonight when you come over for dinner, you can play with your old buddy Comstock.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You ready?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. You know what? I'll meet you down there. Just gotta make a quick call.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Kay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ok. [prepares bike trapeze] Oh, god.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Attention, employees of Dunder Mifflin. Everyone thinks the new guys are so cool cause they can slack line. Boo. Hey Clark, this is what a areal salesman looks like. They say that you only live once and I'm about to prove it. Dwight Schrute!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, man. It's halpert. Did you go to the other guy yet? Great, don't. I'm in. Yeah, yep, I'm all in. Ok, talk to you soon. Bye. [hangs up] Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Woo! [starts pedaling out until trapeze bike flips over, he dangles from the handlebars] Ahh!!

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: In the parking lot today there was a circus. The copier did tricks on the high-wire, a lady tried to give away a baby that looked like a cat. There was a Dwight impersonator and a Jim impersonator; a strong man crushed a turtle. I laughed and I cried. Not bad for a day in the life of a dog food company.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Crap. Sorry, Nellie.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Once again, I understand that old habits die hard, but if everyone would kindly walk their refuse to the trash bins instead of tossing them, then we would—[hit in the face with trash]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Mm, swish.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, it's nothing to do with me. I just happen to be sitting near to where the bins are.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: There are two things that I am passionate about. Recycling and revenge.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [As trash is thrown at her] Fluke.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [surveying an untidy office] The building's custodian is on vacation for the month and Dwight is too cheap to hire a replacement. So, instead, we're living in filth. But, not for long. Because I have created the chore wheel.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [viewing the chore wheel for the first time] Oh, yeah! Can I spin first?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, it doesn't spin. We'll just move the wheel one notch each morning and… you see what chore you get that day.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: A wheel is supposed to spin.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah, you know, like [motions arm in circles] guh, guh, guh, guh, guh, guh, guh… guh.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, I'm familiar with spinning. It's just that wouldn't work with a chore wheel because people might get the same chore-

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [interrupting] Bugh, boring. All she talks about is chores.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: A wheel wants to spin, Pam.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [reluctantly] Spinning would be more fun.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [frustrated] 'Kay.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [spinning a new 'chore wheel' while everyone claps] Okay, that's what I'm talking about! Big money, big money! [wheel stops on 'mug duty', disappointed] Mug duty?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes, you clean all the mugs in the sink.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: This sucks.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah, seriously, it's like everything on there is work.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't think you guys understand why we're doing this. It's-

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah, I don't think that you understand wheels.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I've been through several rounds of development with the team and here's where we stand with the chore wheel. [introducing a third 'chore wheel', excited] We've got prizes! Ten bucks, candy bar, manager for an hour but, there are also penalties. Like, no internet, Stanley gets your lunch. The one thing that is not on the chore wheel is chores. But they were right; it's more fun this way.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [everyone cheers as Meredith spins and lands on 'tiny wheel'] The tiny wheel actually does have chores. It's so cute no one seems to mind.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [referencing the 'tiny wheel'] Toilets! [everyone cheers as Meredith accepts her chore]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [at the Halpert residence as Cece twirls in the front yard, exiting front door] Pam, we gotta go. Cece, go back inside. Grandma's got breakfast, OK? [to camera] We are going to Roy's wedding. Yep, Roy. I think the only weird thing about going to your wife's ex-fiancé's wedding on a weekday at eight AM is that it's your wife's ex-fiancé.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [exiting house] Thanks, mom!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to Pam] A banana?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah. I'm afraid he's only gonna have hot dogs.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, come on. Not even Roy will have hot dogs at his wedding.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Planned a wedding with him. He wanted hot dogs.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to camera] Just… so weird.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [as Pete and Clark enter office] Oh, Pete, you've got mail.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Really? I got something?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Well, it's addressed to Customer Service so, it's your mail.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Well, you know, I'm also Customer Service.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah, I'm alternating. [gestures both men]

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: [sarcastically] Yay, another person yelling at me.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Well, it could be a nice letter. I write nice letters to companies all the time.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: That's really nice.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: [looking down at Erin's desk] Wow, Newsweek, huh? This election… thing is crazy, right?

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: [referring to the letter] It's open.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh yeah, I accidentally read it. It's not a nice letter.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: [whispEring] OK.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [distributing paperwork to the office] Get excited. The special projects fairy has arrived.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I know you don't really exist.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Today, I launch my big charity initiative 'Operation Give Back'. Andy has shot down all of my special projects thus far but, this one is about charity. So, I'd like to see him piss on that one.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: [at Roy's wedding] Darryl! Ha-ha! What's happening?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Congratulations, baby!

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Ah, thank you!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Jim and Pam approaching the wedding venue] Is this his house?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Think so.

scenes.speaker: Server
scenes.line: [approaching Jim and Pam] Mimosa?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [taking glass] Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Server
scenes.line: Would you like me to take your peel?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [embarrassed] Yes, thank you. [finishes banana and hands server the peel]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [as Jim receives and declines a call] Who's that?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, my ex-fiancé.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [sarcastically] Ha-ha.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I started a new business with my college friend. But, Pam doesn't know. Um… actually I did tell Pam and we decided 'no'. But, then I decided 'yes' anyway. So, I'm thinking there's another conversation coming. And, it's hard to know when that will be.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: With Operation Give Back, you pick the charities Dunder-Mifflin supports.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [grinning] Oh boy! What's happening?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: There's four thousand dollars to give away. So, who has filled out their form? Stanley?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: American Diabetes Association.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Um, you have diabetes, Stanley. [to Nellie] I'm sorry, is the assignment to pick a selfish charity?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: I w-, uh, I would love to give uh-

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [excited] Heifer's International. Listen to this. They give a poor person like, a goat or something. It's a great prank.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I wanna work with, uh, Jimmy Carter and help build gnomes.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Dwight, what about you?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I will not be participating as there is no evidence that charity works.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh, correction, I give to a foundation that teaches homeless children nautical flag signaling. Changes lives.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Thank you, Andy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'm not doing it for you. I'm doing it for the preservation of nautical flag signaling.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Dwight, you will be participating.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No thank you.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Participation is mandatory; Dwight, but you can choose whatever cause you like.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Fine, I chose the Global Relief Foundation.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Great, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Which was recently discovered to be a front for the Taliban.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [everyone groans] Oh, for goodness' sake, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah. The Taliban in Afa-ghanistan.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: The Taliban is the worst. Great heroine, though.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Dwight, I cannot have the Taliban on the roster of Operation Give Back.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Well, it looks like there won't be any Operation Give Back. Ha, ha. The nanny state is over, ladies and gentlemen. You're welcome. [wads up Nellie's charity sheet and tosses it toward her]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [approaches Roy back at the wedding] There he is. Is it almost time to cut the pancake, or what?

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Aw, yeah, god, we appreciate everyone coming so early. It's, everyone's just been so nice.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thanks for inviting us, by the way-

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Are you kidding?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That was, that was a surprise.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Come on. If it wasn't for you, I never would've met Laura. I mean, seriously, kinda dodged a bullet on that one. [sees Jim's reaction] Just kidding.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You're welcome.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Thanks…aw.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: By the way, man, this place is… beautiful.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Started a gravel company. I mean, who knew it'd take off?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Gravel company?

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Yeah. What about you? What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Not gravel, obviously. [both chuckle] No, things are good. Things are good. Got some stuff in the works. So-

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: Oh, cool.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah, you never know.

scenes.speaker: Kenny
scenes.line: Hey bro, stop wasting time with this haircut. [referring to Jim] He's got a fifty-thousand dollar sports car. Cheers.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK, Kenny.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: [talking on phone] Duncan, listen, I would love to help you out but where am I gonna find somebody that's pretty, smart and well-informed? Huh? Hold on, hold on. [covers phone's receiver] Erin, do you know anybody that might want… [has realization] Oh my gosh. You love the news, right?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Well, it depends. I mean, sometimes I find out things that are really sad.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Well, I got a buddy that's a big time local news producer and I can't tell you his name, but it'd blow your mind.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Uh, is it Duncan?

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: He's looking for on-air talent and he'd kill me if I didn't get you on tape.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You mean, put me on the news?

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: You'll just come over, put on little lipstick, loosen up with a glass of red wine and then we'll just run through a few stories. You know, a couple different ways, with a couple different outfits. It'd be really tasteful and it'd really help me out with Duncan… with my friend. [Erin considers] What do you say? Huh?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Maybe, ok? Let me think about it.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: [Pete looks on disappointed] Ok.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Whoo!

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Think it over. [punches Pete]

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: No, Clark's not my friend. He is the douche that sits next to me at the office. My friends are Scott, Glenn, and Rob. But, you don't know them.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I never really thought much about being more than a receptionist. But, why? Because I happened to answer help wanted ad to be a receptionist? I mean, what if the ad had been for a CEO? Or for a brain surgeon?

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: So, ah, it was a year ago today that I met Laura. I thought she was my waitress and, uh, took her three weeks to tell me that she actually owned the place. You are full of surprises. You are my beautiful mystery girl. And, today, I have a surprise for you. [approaches piano]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He plays piano?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No. Roy? No.

scenes.speaker: Roy
scenes.line: You know how I said I was taking boxing lessons? Actually, I was doing this. Um, so, I hope that you like it. [sits in front of piano]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [clapping] You got this, Roy. [Roy begins playing and singing She's Got a Way by Billy Joel, Pam and Jim looked shocked, Phyllis and Bob begin making out]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [in the car] We still surprise each other.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Definitely.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You know, I never did it, but for your 30th birthday I really wanted to surprise you with-

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Courtside seats. Sixers.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes. But, what I didn't tell you is that I actually bought the tickets. We only didn't go because it was-

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It was an away game.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: In Phoenix. They should really tell you that more specifically. I mean, every game is an away game for one of the teams. [long pause] Do we know everything about each other?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Tell me one thing about you I don't know.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [laughs] Um, ok. [thinks but says nothing]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [in the kitchen] Oh, here's one. Did I ever tell you about the time that my brothers videotaped the lottery announcement? And bought the winning numbers the next day? And then, played the tape for me the next week, and I-

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: And you thought you guys were millionaires.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You heard that one.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes. But there's, wait, oh, there's a funny ending to that story. I can't remember.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That I thought we were millionaires.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Thought you were millionaires, yeah. That's funny. Shoot, I knew that one.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's all right.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: The senator and I still have mystery. I'm always waiting to see what he's gonna surprise me with next. [Oscar chokes on his coffee]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You all right? [Oscar nods]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: You support the Taliban abroad. So I assume you're willing to live by their rules here.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Anything else would be inconsistent.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Will you join me then in a pledge to live by Taliban law in this office? [offers Dwight a contract]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [takes contract] Absolutely, I will.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I feared Nellie had some sort of a plan but she used a ridiculous font. Huh. [in a fake English accent] You don't have a plan.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: When you use a ridiculous font, no one thinks you have a plan.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [holds up pen as Dwight searches his desk] Looking for this?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What the? [follows Nellie into the break room]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, this is a lovely pen. Ah. But, it's mine now because I stole it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [taking pen back] Gimme that.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Didn't you sign a contract to live under Taliban law? And now, there's been theft. That means, you're not serious or… someone's getting their hand cut off.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You're insane.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: I know. So, it's better that you pick another charity.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, and let your precious Operation Power Grab proceed unchecked? No thank you.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: In that case, you… [pulls out a cleaver] will have to chop off my hand.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [considers then takes cleaver] This cleaver appears to need sharpening. I suggest you spend some quality time together just you and your hand. Tie a shoe, toss a salad. Do any of the two hand activities that you'll miss the most.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: I tell you what. I need to make three calls. And then after that, you can become a person who chops off people's hands.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Sounds like a plan.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [in his office] Clark wants to film you in different outfits inside his apartment?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [entEring annex] Clark, you and I need to have a little chat. What clothes does Erin need for this news audition?

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Uh… couple of button-downs, a camisole, a blazer, a pencil skirt, stilettos, maybe, no, no, not maybe, definitely open-toed. Uh, something low-cut because the camera makes everything seem higher cut.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Yeah, industry secret. You're gonna want some of those panty hose with the seam up the back.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Seems unnecessary for an audition.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: And then, you know, maybe just a robe to wear in between takes but I probably got one she can borrow at my place, so-

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Thank god someone here knows what their talking about. I want you to take this credit card, take Erin to the mall and get that stuff.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: I absolutely will do that.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Awesome. [to Pete] Plop!

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Pff. Guess I'll just head over to the mall then. Buy Erin some sexy, fun outfits.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: That Clark, huh? Errr [punches palm] Ca!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [in kitchen with several people around] Next question for our oldie-weds-

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: What's the craziest place you've ever made whoopie?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [to Kevin] Language.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Who was Pam's first celebrity crush?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Pam's first celebrity crush.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [whispEring] John Stamos.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ready?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Uh-huh.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [as he and Pam flip their cards] John Stamos.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes. But John Stamos was temporary. I quickly moved on to-

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Johnny Depp.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Johnny Depp. [everyone looks confused toward Toby]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [after awkward pause] Sh, uh, um, I was having this separate conversation with Kevin. Uh, Johnny Depp.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Totally. George Clooney.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Uh-huh.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: OK, I have one. I have one. [Jim's phone rings and he motions he's taking the call elsewhere]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [while Angela tries asking a question] What is the craziest place you've ever made whoopie?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [as Pam wonders about Jim] Kevin, stop it with that question.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [in the stairwell on his phone] Right. And did you show them the market? Yeah. And what'd they say? That's awesome! That, oh my god! Wow!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's not even real yet. And I'm not gonna tell her 'til it's real.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I think maybe there actually is something I don't know about Jim.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Everyone, we have a voluntary meeting in the conference room to discuss Erin's confidence.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Her body. We're gonna talk about her body. [to Darryl] Good. Great job.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Andy made me his consigliere. Which means Assistant Regional Manager. I guess he thought I'd be into The Godfather 'cause I'm black. Wrong! I'm into The Godfather 'cause I'm a cinephile. I like Scarface 'cause I'm black.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [to a full conference room] Erin has an audition to be a newscaster. [general acknowledgement]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh-huh. And I want her to feel very comfortable in her very sexy skin. So, everybody say something that you like about her body. All right? Darryl.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: OK, um, I like Erin's hair. It's a very pretty color.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah, right?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm sorry. This is for a news audition?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Then why are we talking about her looks? Why not her credibility? Or her reliability?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: News flash everyone. The human race finds attractive people more trustworthy.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I'm so sorry, Andy, but for twenty years, the most trusted man in America – Walter Cronkite.

scenes.speaker: Meredith

scenes.line: My ex behaved like Nixon. All of the lying. None of the sexual charisma. [pauses] I just made a joke there.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm sorry. It's just, uhm, I actually do have this weird feeling that there's something Jim isn't telling me.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh no! Oh! An affair! It is always an affair!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Jim? No.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [sighs]. How can you be sure?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Because he just loves me too much.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: You're a cocky little thing, aren't you, Pam?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I've done a little genealogy research of my own. Turn out I'm not the only one with a few skeletons in the ol' family closet. For example, Phyllis's great-great grandmother was responsible for spreading cholera to the United States.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Ew.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Kevin is related to both John Wayne Gacy and John Wayne Bobbitt.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: And John Wayne?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No. Not that I see here.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Wayne Johnson? The Rock?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You mean Dwayne? And no. What about Jim Halpert? Uh oh! Turns out, distant relative of the reviled, Richard Nixon!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pam always says I look like Nixon. That's crazy, right? I mean there's nothing there. True—[touches his nose] Oh no.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Dwight's grandfather was a—[is interrupted by Dwight].

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Was a member of the Bund. Which is not technically the same thing as the Nazi party. So…[clears throat]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I was gonna say he was a tax evader.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh. I was joking about that whole Bund thing. Oh ho, the look on your faces! Hahhahahahahah! Hahahahahah!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: And Meredith is a blood relative of Lizzie Borden.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Cool! Ah! Ah! Ah! Ah! [mimics stabbing into Angela's throat]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Stop it! Stop it! You're frightening me!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Andy, did you call this meeting just to talk junk about our families?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah, that—you're being really mean, Andy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, Andy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No, I'm proving a point, okay? We all have ancestors who may have done horrible things in the past. But it's in the past and it's not our fault. So we don't have to talk about it.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: The difference is, Andy, that you're the only be here still benefitting from the terrible things that your ancestors did.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Might've done. And how… do you figure?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Your family's rich! I have to believe that a big part of the Bernard fortune was earned on the backs of slaves.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You know, there's nothing wrong with being successful in America, Oscar! I'm not gonna apologize for my family's wealth. That wealth, could one day benefit society…if capital gains are ever taxed as the same rate as earned income.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Really?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: We merely transported them. Which at worst, makes us amoral middlemen.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yo, d-dog. I need your help. I'm trying to think of things I can say that make it sound like I had a more difficult childhood than I actually had.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You're gonna po' mouth

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Exactly. Help me po' mouth, Darryl.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Actually, Andy, you promised me five minutes to talk about productivity suggestions—

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What if I said that my dad beat me. And, I just left out the croquet of it all. Or, I could just go all the way and just say I grew up in an apartment. Or is that too crazy?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: That could work.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You now, Darryl, this is textbook assistant regional manager stuff here, and I feel like I'm doing all the heavy lifting. I'm coming up with all the ideas here.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I'm going for a walk.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [with a sigh] Okay.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Good. Good. And—[Nellie hits the car against the bushes]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You doing alright, man?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I'm done. I gotta get out of here.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. Not the easiest day to be assistant regional manager.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: It's not just today, it's everyday. It seems like the better title I have, the stupider my job gets.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, come on, it can always get better. Right?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Hmm. Yeah right

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, I'm serious. There's always something better.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Like what?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Like hypothetically… if I said there was another job. That you and I could both have.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: What kind of job?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Something cool. Like, sports marketing or… that sound something like you'd be into?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Hell yeah!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: That sounds awesome!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok, but wait. What if I told you that it was in Philly! So you'd have to…

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I love Philly!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: It's not even a thought—

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Not even a thought! It's not even that far away! I could still commute! Exactly. Exactly! Alright!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: What? Wait, wait, wait? So what? This happening?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, it's happening! Let's just keep it between you and me for right now.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah. Yeah, yeah, yeah. For sure. For sure. for sure. Man! And Pam's into it?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We, uh, we haven't talked about. But I think that she's—I think she understands… what this is.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Oh, come on, man. I thought you had something real.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What? No, no, no! Come on! This is real!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: It's not real… until your wife is on board.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So what did you want to show me?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: That is quite an ugly wall, isn't it?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah. It's really ugly

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Needs something, doesn't it? I'm thinking…a mural.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You mean me?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Yes! You! You are soo talented! It's going to be my next special project. Hiring Scranton's most dangerous young muralist to paint the warehouse wall.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh my god! I love it! Uh, I—Nellie, this is brilliant! [sees Jim] Hey!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey! Can I talk you? For a second?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Anything you have to say to her, you can say to me. She never loved you!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?! No! I-I got this. [Laughs] Okay?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [quietly] This is his fault. It is not your fault. I'm gonna find you someone better, and rich.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: And Filipino. But we'll break that to her later.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [to Darryl] You know what this is all about.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah. You too, huh?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Yeah. Go on, spill it. Tell her all the gory details, youuuu sssnake!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Hey! He deserves this. And he said I could get in on it too. [whispers] Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Ohhh, Pam, nooo! Oh, I can't bear to watch this.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I don't know what I was so worried about. I have the best wife in the world.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I still can't believe he didn't tell me.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I was helping Nellie drive—[Stanley interrupts]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Do not care.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Fonas chek!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Dothraas! chek! [giggles]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I like that guy. We should hook him up with Meredith.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [in agreement] Hmmm!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Alright everybody, great season of softball, I'm super proud of you guys and I think you're gonna like this little highlight reel that I put together. [Andy plays video]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: That's me.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Is this like a blooper reel?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: A blooper reel? What is this, 2005? I look like Bob Saget? Fail! [Points to video] Who's this guy?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Fail!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I deserved that.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: That was a triple.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Can't take the fail? Get out of the fail video!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: My pleasure.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'd like to take a solemn moment to remember Jerry in the warehouse who passed away this year.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What was that? That was just a normal video with you making vulgar noises.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Well, I worked with what I had, Oscar. Next time do more failure stuff, OK?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, what happened to that video I sent you?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh that wasn't…that didn't work. That was not the right…[Group protests]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think I got it right here.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That was not a fail.

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Fail! Fail! Fail!…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [Group continues chanting "Fail!"] That was actually a serious accident that could have resulted in severe bodily harm. [Group keeps chanting] You're all failing right now. [Group continues] Congratulations on your epic fail of the use of the word fail! [Group claps and chants]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Toby uses tester on wall as Erin marks wall with red tape X] Oh, god.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What's going on?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Nothing! Nothing is going on. Keep moving please.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: What's he measuring?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: OK, excuse me. I am the landlord. This is between me and the management, no one else. Please.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: It's an EMF hotspot.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [Gasps] Oh my god!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: It stands for electromagnetic field. Generally cause by a concentration of wiring in one area [Erin marks red tape X on the floor] Especially if they're poorly insulated. Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Um, OK I'm just walking into this. Am I to understand there is a bee hive in the wall?

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: You think I have a machine for measuring bee hives?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I was just asking a question, Toby. How are you not murdered every hour?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Well I'm not getting paid to work in a microwave oven.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: OK, listen. Everything here is up to code.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [mocking] Oh, the wires need insulation. [normal voice] It's a wire people. I'm not buying it a fur coat.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [Jim rushes to open door for her] Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You got it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Last week, I finally told Pam about the other job I took in Philly…the side job. And she was so incredibly cool about it. And now I just wanna do something huge for her. Like if we were in some biker bar and she mouthed off to some bikers and they came lumbEring over and I was like wham! [mimes punch] Gotta go through me first.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Andy, could I have a word please? Um, it won't take a moment. It's extremely important and it really has to happen now.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Fine. I will give you one minute.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, please don't use the hourglass.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You have one minute and your minute has begun and no time will be added at the end, even to accommodate this sentence with all of it's baroque dependent clauses and cascading turns of phrase.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: I'm trying to adopt a baby.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: A baby what? A human?!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: And the…agency require a character reference from my employer.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: You wouldn't have to do anything. I would write the letter myself and you just simply sign it. So.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, OK. And fall right into your plagiarism entrapment scheme? I don't think so.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: It's not…it's-

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: And I happen to notice you're down to about thirty seconds here.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Well then if I could just convince…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: And those sand grains are tumbling…

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: You.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: With fury…

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: It's not…it's not

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Down the sides…

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Entrapment if I'm…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Of the hourglass…

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: …writing…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Time's up!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Fine.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Sure. I'll read her letter. And if she tells the truth about how evil and unfit to be a mother she is, then yeah. I'll sign that.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Reading from computer] "Statistical correlations exist between EMF radiation and various health hazards. But mainstream studies are inconclusive!" That means you can't make me do squat.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: You better fix this. I already ditched my uterus and I ain't losing any more good parts.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You people don't realize what you're asking. I'd have to rip open the walls. We'd have to shut this place down for a week.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Week off. That'd be great.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [Jim puts popcorn bag in microwave] Hey, if you don't want to teach me Power Point, just say so.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: I don't want to teach you Power Point.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Come on! Just show me the Power Point.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Just do the tutorial.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You're the tutorial.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: No, dude, I'm not. I'm not the tutorial.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You could be.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Mm-mm.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [to Jim] What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Getting my wife a week off from work.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You popped one kernel.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Awesome, right? [leaves]

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: So Creed is that dude's step dad?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Correct.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I don't know about the rest of you but I'm just gonna say it. I'm nervous. I have no idea what health problems this is all gonna cause. [group agrees, protests]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What? Come on.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I'm getting older. I'm losing my hair…

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: I'm not gonna grow a third arm!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I know what Jim is trying to do. He's trying to get big bad Dwight to shell out for a huge repair job while lucky Jimbo gets a paid vacation. Well sorry, lucky Jimbo, I can live very happily in a magnetic field. Most of my childhood heroes got their power that way.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [reading from computer] "Side effects of EMF include: headaches…"

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Had 'em all my life.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: "…breast pain…"

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No nobbies, no probbies. Nice try Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oof. "Infertility."

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [scoffs] Yeah right. [Dwight moves mouse pad over his crotch]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ah! There's my popcorn. Can you just grab that for me?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Psh. Keep your snacks on your side, Jim. Idiot. [notices popped kernels in the bag] What the?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Some of these kernels have crowned.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's impossible, cause that's a brand new bag…[looks up to ceiling where there is a red tape X over Dwight's chair] Oh my god.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Andy! [Jim mimes basketball shot]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm gonna drive you up to the lake, give you a whole week on the water. Just you, me and the kids.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, can we stop by that pie stand on the way?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You mean Laverne's Pies Tires Fixed Also? [Pam nods] Yes we will be doing that. We'll be getting a dozen.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: A dozen different pies? Cause that means rhubarb.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Why would you say that? I meant 4 apple, 4 blueberry, 2 cherry, 1 peach and 1 chocolate. I thought that was implied.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, OK then.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ladies and gentlemen, I have heard your complaints and we reached a settlement.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: So, we will be leaving the office for one whole week.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Nice job.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: In my contract, it is stipulated that I provide a temporary work space. It will arrive in one hour.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What's this?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Whoa!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Bus pulls into lot] Bring it in!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Roll into the future with Work Bus. Say goodbye to wasteful buildings. These days a mobile office isn't just for hotshot politicians. Now anyone can rent a work bus. [Meredith and Kevin bump chairs in bus angrily] If you've got a parking lot, a work space is just a phone call away. [Erin tapes candy dish to pole] In this age of belt tightening and less empowered workers, a work bus is how tomorrow gets things done.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: [on phone] There are a hundred packs…

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [On phone] No six after the eight, no…

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Shh!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Shh!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Ninety nine cases…yeah.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Six. [Pete opens air vent over Angela, papers go flying]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Ooh!

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Oh sorry! Sorry.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh my god!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [bumps into Meredith] Sorry.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Lose weight.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I'm trying. Sorry.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [handing Nelly envelope] Oh, the Pennsylvania Department of Public Welfare Pre-Adoption Standard.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh of course, you were adopted.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [laughs] I wish! No, I um, I made some short lists. I had a couple sleepovers, but I never managed to get in the end zone. I don't know what it was. Not loveable maybe? [laughs] Oh well.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Listen, I'm really struggling with this form. But as you know the system, you think maybe you could…?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Absolutely. I know exactly what they want to hear. I would love to help.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh thank you so much!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [whispers] Just don't tell Andy, because…

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: He hates me and thinks I'm a monster. Should go back to Loch Ness. [Erin nods]

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Stretch. Alright.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: How many times do you need to take a stroll?

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: I, my legs cramp up! Ok, it's a circulation issue.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Boy, I will hammer spank your rear.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright, alright, gang. Let's just settle down. You're yelling in her face.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: It's a medical thing.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Just…you good?

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: I'm good. I…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to Pam] I'm so sorry for all of this.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: It's OK. You know what they say, a change is as good as a rest.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I, I need to get to the paper please. [Reaching for overhead bin above Pam, papers fall and Pam has liquid spilled on her]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh my god! Ah!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'll get you a napkin. Someone get napkins please!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You know what? It's fine, it's fine. Let me just…it's fine. [Pam leaves work bus]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pam, I'm really sorry. I- I'm really sorry about…all that. [Dwight smiles at Jim] Really? Smirking?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What can I say? I love justice. You forced me to spend money on needless repairs, and uh now you're locked in a prison bus and your woman drips with beverage.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, Dwight. I was trying to do something nice for Pam. Can you just, help me out? Can we maybe take this thing somewhere? Or do something to not make this the worst day ever?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's not my responsibility to solve your marriage problems by spending my money on gas.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Andy!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yo. Dudeces.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You're the boss. Don't you think we'd all be a lot more productive if while we were doing work we looked up and saw the best rural pie stand in Pennsylvania?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Oh, I know I'd be more productive.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: As would I.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: No question.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No. No! This is a work bus. The wheels are for transporting the work space to and from the work site.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What are you talking about? You're not the boss. Andy is. Andy?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis, Kevin, & Stanley
scenes.line: Pies! Pies! Pies! Pies! Pies!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Alright! The fat people have spoken! Dwight, get this bus moving.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yes! [Group cheers]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Next stop: Laverne's Pies Tires Fixed Also.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh! Yes! [Group cheers, Dwight moves to driver seat]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [To Dwight] So it looks like this work bus was a pretty good idea after all, huh?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Get your foot behind the yellow line.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You got it.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah Jim! [Group claps]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [Sitting outside building] Stop.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Come back.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Too late.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Mmm.

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Shabooyah, role call. Shabooyah, yah yah shabooyah, role call.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: My name is Pam.

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I like to paint.

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You think you're better?

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh no you ain't!

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Role Call! Shabooyah, yah yah shabooyah role call! Shabooyah, yah yah shabooyah, role call!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: My name is Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: That is my name.

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: They call me Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Cause that's my name.

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Role call! Shabooyah, yah yah shabooyah role call! Shabooyah, yah yah shabooyah role call!

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: [Dwight pulls over to pick up hitchhiker] Thanks. Playing a little hookey from work today…Oh my god.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Dunder Mifflin road trip twenty twelve! [group takes pictures] Ah OK, now a serious one.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, where's Dwight? He should be a part of this. Has he been acting kinda weird to you lately?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: If by lately you mean the last twelve years, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, I mean he's sulking. That's not like him.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He's just mad that we're all having fun.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Then why isn't he scheming? Or preparing to avenge?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: He's fine. He's indestructible.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Always say that a child is placed for adoption, never surrendered. We're not hostages.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [laughs] Well, I have considered kidnapping one.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Never say that.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I am so excited thinking about this child you're going to adopt.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: I wish I could just wave a magic wand and make you a parentless five year old again. I would snap you up.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Next stop pies! [group joins in]

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Next stop pies!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Next stop pies!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Let's go driver! [clapping] Laverne packs up the pie wagon at five so…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: At five? That's only twenty minutes from now. The pie shop is thirteen miles away. So at fifty five miles an hour that just gives us five minutes to spare.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: So wait, when pies are involved you can suddenly do math in your head?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Wh…

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Hold on, Kevin, how much is 19,154 pies divided by 61 pies?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: 314 pies.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What if it were salads?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Well, it's the…carry the four…and…it doesn't work.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm sorry to spoil Jim's fantastic voyage everyone, but we're almost out of gas.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK, well I saw a station about a mile back so, chop chop.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That name brand place? Nope forget about it, sorry. The tanks are so big on this thing, five cents a gallon extra, that really adds up.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you kidding me? Dwight, come on!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey honey, I don't think we should push him.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh no, I'm gonna push him. You know why? Because you're getting a pie. Why? Cause you deserve it. And what is he doing? He's trying to drive us all around the countryside looking for gas because he knows we won't get there. Is that what we want?!

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: No!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Stop ordEring me around, Jim!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What do we want?!

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Pies!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: When do we want it?!

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Pies!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: OK, fine. You win. Jim, you win. We have been battling for a long time, but you know what? You win, cause you are the winner, you are the alpha male, there you go. [drops keys in Jim's lap] Alpha male, go buy your wife a pie. Go buy the whole world a pie.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's impossible. [Dwight climbs through ceiling hatch] Dwight!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Oh my!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What are you doing?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Dwight, what the hell?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Dwight!

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Well now I don't even feel like pie. Wait…no it's back.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: [Dwight's footsteps sound from the ceiling] Just drive away. Just…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Phyllis! That's not safe.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Guys, we only have eighteen minutes left. At sixty one miles an hour we're just gonna barely make it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [to Jim] Go up and check on him. He's upset.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know he's doing all this on purpose.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Please? Just make sure he's OK? [Jim climbs through hatch]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Hurry it up for god's sake. They're gonna be out of banana cream!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Banana cream is the first to go. We'll be lucky to get pumpkin at this point! [group gasps]

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Dwight? Why are you such a jerk? I am trying to do something for my wife and you keep derailing-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm barren, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: My trouser hives are void of honey. I had congress with Angela and the child that she bore did not issue from my loins. I thought I would be a father and instead I am a eunuch. Neutered by my own building.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Is this about the popcorn? Or the X on the ceiling? Dwight, that was a prank.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You mean you flooded my building with dangerous electromagnetic radiation as a prank?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That's genius. That's the best prank you've ever done. [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'll take it.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Andy?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Who is it?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Um, is this a good time?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah. Perfect time. I'm right in the middle of a rooftop crisis. [takes paper from Nelly] Fine, let me read it. What do we have here? Uh, ok, [reading] blah blah blah blah blah, dah dah dah dah dah dah, you've made this very easy for me. It's unsignable.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, why, is there something?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It's inaccurate, dishonest and…in a word? Dongwater.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Ah well, perhaps I could rewrite some of the-

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Here's the thing, you asked me to do you a favor? I did it. I read it. Thank you very much to me for my time. Good luck with your impossible dream.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Alright then.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Dwight, sometimes it takes couples years to get pregnant.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Really? How long did it take you and Pam to conceive?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That doesn't matter.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What position did you use to conceive?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok…that's not…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Regular? Or lady on her back? You used lady on her back, didn't you, you freak. Yuck, gross. Never mind, Jim.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [To Pete. Crying sounds come from behind Nelly's curtain] British women. Famously overemotional. Am I right?

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: I don't think that's Nelly.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, oh no, no. Look, it's alright. [Erin cries, Nelly comforts her] It really isn't your fault. No, no. Look, it's…you were so kind. And it isn't anything to do with you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Did you ever think that because you own the building, everyone in it, we're all kinda like your children?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You know there's a phrase about that in German. Bildenkinder. Used almost exclusively by childless landlords to console themselves. But now? I really understand it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, now you have a bus full of real…bilden…kin…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Bildenkinder.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: OK. And they're all dangerously close to not getting pie. And there's only one guy who can save them. It's not me.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh! [Jim reenters bus through hatch] Hey! How'd it go?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's pretty good actually.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We bonded. We got to- [Dwight starts dropping into the bus on top of Jim]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Whoa! Whoa! Dwight! [group reacts]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: When you don't get out of the way! Out of the way!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You feel OK now?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, better than OK. [grabs Pam's shoulders] You know what honey? I'm gonna get you that rhubarb pie.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, actually, rhubarb is-

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Don't…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: the one pie that I don't.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Don't…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Everybody! Hang on! [Dwight pulls out quickly]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh! [bus tears around corners as group crashes into each other]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Group chants along] Pie! Pie! Pie!

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Pie! Pie! Pie! Pie! [cheers as they arrive]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I changed my mind. [gives Nelly papers]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, you signed it?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah. Not as is, obviously. Made a couple changes. Added some sentences at the end. Trust me it needed it. [laughs] Well, yeah, whatever. So. [walks away]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [Reading] "She's tough in business, but tender with the people she cares about. She'll make a wonderful mother to any child who can overlook weird accents."

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I insult you, Oscar.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I insult you! To your face!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I don't know what you're talking about.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Then why don't you do something about it?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [laughs] Kevin, are you trying to get me to hit you? In the face with my pie?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: You don't have the guts. You stupid, dumb, doo doo face! [Oscar pies Kevin] Yes!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh my god. I'm getting so stuffed.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We did it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You did it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: My name is Andy!

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: [bored] Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I don't do drugs!

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Now check the style!

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Of Flatt & Scruggs!

scenes.speaker: Group
scenes.line: Yeah. [Andy plays banjo]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Role call.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Role call.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Role call.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: This year I decided to really get into the spirit of Halloween.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [screaming upon seeing pumpkin-headed Dwight]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [screaming then laughing] It may have been the costliest decision I've ever made.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: My greased up head went into the pumpkin no problem, but …

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It won't budge.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I can't get it out. Try again!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I mean, I could try destroying the pumpkin…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [as Jim approaches with a knife] Jim, no. No. No! No!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: But as Jim and I discovered… No! … any blow to the pumpkin itself could prove fatal to me.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: At first I drove myself crazy thinking about the things I should have done differently. I never should have played that joke on Erin. I never should have hollowed out this damn pumpkin in the first place. Then I realized that I was being silly. I mean the pumpkin should rot off of my head in a month or two. Right?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hey guys.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Pam, what are you?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I am Dr. Cinderella.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Cece's really into princesses now. So we decided to turn them into a positive female role models.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm an oncologist and you are a dog.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: No, I'm a puppy. Dang it! I was worried that would happen.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's Okay.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Uh, Jim, you're not dressed up at all.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sure I am. I am… one of the Men in Black guys. [to Pam, under his breath] Can I have your sunglasses?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Jim, come on. I thought we were past this.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So the sports marketing business that Jim told everyone about except for me?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: There's a big investment lunch today, so I decided to skip the costume.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Unless he has a secret costume that he told everyone about except for me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Gettin' a lot of mileage out of this, aren't ya?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, well, get used to it, bud.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: A jitterbug. [giggles] You guys look great! Just a reminder. The party is right after lunch, so make sure you get all your work done before that or throw it out. Any questions?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: The senator will be joining us later.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Not a question.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No, it wasn't.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Excellent. That reminds me, has anyone seen Treble? Anyone? I could have sworn I saw some Treble somewhere.

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [singing]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh, ladies and gentlemen, Here Comes Treble!

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [sings Karma Chameleon]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Aaah! [everyone clapping] So good!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What lab did these little clones escape from?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: My Cornell a capella group.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You were in an a capella group?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You went to Cornell?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yah! ah. Okay. Ha ha ha ha. But you have no idea how lucky you are because HCT is doing a set at our halloween party.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Ugh. I don't want to sit through a whole concert of that.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: I do. I love the boss's interests.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Atta boy Clark!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Where you boys stayin? How does it work in the rooms? Do you get a privacy partition?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No. Nope. Nope nope nope. Stay away.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You know what I just realized? They might actually call me up to solo on George Michael's Faith. That was one of my signature songs. Oh, man. That would be insane. I'm so not prepared.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you sure you're okay with me putting in this much money.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah. I mean, listen if we're gonna do this thing, we should do it right.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You're the best.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I kind of am. It's crazy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. I'll see you in a little bit.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jim. Look I'm eating you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Shut up.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ha ha. Hey Erin, look, these are Nerds. I'm eating Jims.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [laughing] Must eat more Jims. Oink oink oink oink.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [laughing hysterically] Stop it! Stop it! Stop it!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh no, I'm spilling Jim all over the carpet. [laughing]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Stop it stop it stop it stop it!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [picking up spilled candy] Hello little pill. What do you do?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Dumatril is licensed to treat anxiety symptoms, such as panic attacks, excessive worrying, and fear. Translation: There's a madman in our midst.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay I give up. What are you?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: I'm sexy Toby.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [laughing] Gross. I love it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Dumatril!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Something wrong Dwight?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Dumatril.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Yes?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: This is a pill that I found here in the office. But it's not for worms or eczema like any normal pill. It's not for any disorder of the body. [whispEring] It's for a disorder of the mind.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: The mind is part of the body.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, this is a pill that combats insanity, okay? Whoever is taking it is not only insane… [whispEring] They are now off their meds.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Dwight, our co-workers' health issues are really none of our business so-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Why are you trying so hard to bury this thing, huh? What's going on Nellie? Talk to me.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Hm?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: It's my pill. I have an anxiety issue and I'm not ashamed of that, But I'm not loving the idea of Dwight having that information. I once saw him yell at Phyllis for sneezing wrong.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Yeah, you're right. This man needs to be apprehended.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'll get my apprehension kit.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ruh duh duh da dudes! What's up?

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [mumbled responses]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I know that it's pathetic to re-live your college years, but cut me some slack, Okay? Because I was a freaking rock star in college. When I joined Here Comes Treble, that's when I became somebody. When I got the nickname "Boner Champ," that is when I became me.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You didn't come here to sit in a room, right? You came here for some intergenerational bro time. Well, now's your chance! I'm here. You got Qs; I got As.

scenes.speaker: HCT Member #1
scenes.line: Did you say you've got AIDS?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No, I don't have AIDS. That's not what I said. Next question.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You don't have any– Any questions about the old days? [clears throat] You at least want to know why they call me Boner Champ?

scenes.speaker: HCT Member #2
scenes.line: I thought Broccoli Rob was the Boner Champ.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I'm sorry, what?

scenes.speaker: HCT Member #2
scenes.line: I just thought Broccoli Rob was the Boner Champ.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Broccoli Rob was Broccoli Rob. Andy Bernard is the Boner Champ.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: I didn't realize that everybody here dresses up every year.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Me neither.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: It's Halloween. That is really, really good timing.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I was just talking to some of the actives, and they think that you're Boner Champ.

scenes.speaker: Broccoli Rob
scenes.line: [on computer monitor] I'm so sorry! I don't know how that could have happened.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Did you maybe tell them that or…?

scenes.speaker: Broccoli Rob
scenes.line: I just– I just started yappin' about the old days, and I guess the wine coolers were flowing, and, you know, somehow things just got hinky.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Could you just call them and tell them the truth? 'Cause I know it's really stupid, but it's also really, really, really important.

scenes.speaker: Broccoli Rob
scenes.line: Will do. I love you, Andy.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Love you too.

scenes.speaker: Businessman #1
scenes.line: So the workspace looks awesome.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Wow.

scenes.speaker: Businessman #2
scenes.line: And the graphic designer is going to be sending in some of the logo treatments. I can't wait to see them.

scenes.speaker: Businessman #3
scenes.line: You guys rock. [round of fistbumps]

scenes.speaker: Businessman #1
scenes.line: I killed it.

scenes.speaker: Businessman #2
scenes.line: I've also been running the numbers and between our backers and our own investments, we're looking great for a full year on this.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, uh, is it too late to get in?

scenes.speaker: Businessman #3
scenes.line: Oh Jim, I explained everything. So you're all set.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, I actually talked to my wife and we'd really like to uh you know, invest – get in on the ground floor.

scenes.speaker: Businessman #2
scenes.line: Wow, well what level of investment were you thinking about?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We were thinking somewhere between five – ten thousand? I can do the full ten thousand. We should just – [blows air] – all in.

scenes.speaker: Businessman #3
scenes.line: Welcome aboard!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right. [laughs] Awesome. Cool.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hi Daryl. I'm just here to smear some peanut butter on my forehead.

scenes.speaker: Nellie

scenes.line: Is that how they like to get in?

scenes.speaker: HCT Member #3
scenes.line: No.

scenes.line: Spring sing '95. Got completely ripped on Bud Dries. I had sex with a snowman. I just went at that thing. Cold would have stopped most people but I stayed locked in, you know. Took the face off. It just seemed easier that way.

scenes.line: And I told Phyllis not to put it out, but she insisted. So, anyway… Hi! Oh, Oscar, remember my husband, the senator?

scenes.line: Nice to see you Oscar.

scenes.speaker: Senator Lipton
scenes.line: So Oscar, you're a dinosaur.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Actually I'm the electoral college.

scenes.speaker: Senator Lipton
scenes.line: Ouch! Right on target.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: You know what? This is outrageous. I have to find Phyllis. You two talk, okay? Sorry babe… Phyllis!

scenes.speaker: Senator Lipton
scenes.line: God, it's just so good to see you.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I, uh, huh, just [chuckles nervously]

scenes.speaker: Senator Lipton
scenes.line: All having this wonderful Halloween gathEring. Excuse me, is that punch?

scenes.line: They didn't know about the snowman story, and when I told 'em, they were not impressed.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: What is with these turkeys?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Right?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hey! You better do 'Faith.' You get me?

scenes.speaker: HCT Member #3
scenes.line: We don't know it.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: So learn it. You all go to Cornell, you're like eight Rain men. Just learning the friggin' song.

scenes.speaker: HCT Member #3
scenes.line: Look, I know it was big with the old guys, but–

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Buts… are for pooping. Okay? Make it work. You have to or Andy will flip out… And make it a surprise, please. [to Pete] This isn't stupid.

scenes.line: What?

scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.line: Hey Toby.

scenes.line: Are… are you me?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Oh my goodness, look. Look at this.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Yeah. I…

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: [unintelligible mumbling]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Yes. I thought I'd you know, be you.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Look at… Look at me. [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [laughing] It's funny right? [Toby starts to lean in for a kiss, then runs away]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: All right. All right, just …stay focused on the pill.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Okay, look Dwight, let's just call this thing off. I mean, it's just an anxiety pill. Lots of people have anxiety.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You think I don't have anxiety? I have anxiety all the time. Every waking moment of my life is sheer torture. I have land disputes I've got to settle and idiot cousins to protect. And ne'er- do- well siblings to take care of. But I don't need some stupid pill to get me through all this.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Cool. Free upper.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Ah ha! Ha!!! The jig is up, psychopath! Ah yeah! Gotcha!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Don't dog catch me!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Gotcha! Yeah! Let's see ya get out of this web, huh?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Let me out!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: The pill is mine.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Get her out.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Stop baggin' my head!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh Dwight, look, its just a pill, all right? It's for anxiety. I take it every day. And it makes me feel better. And maybe it could help you too.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, how'd it go?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh man, it was great. They were great.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Did you end up investing?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I did, yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: How much?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, man, by the end I guess it was about… ten…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: About ten?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ten. It was the full ten.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. Yeah. It's a good thing we talked about it though, because we had to…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No yeah. Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So did everybody …

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What is it?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Did everybody end up investing ten thousand?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Um, oh man, I don't actually know.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: They weren't really talking that much about money. They just said, We're good with investing and then I…and I…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ladies and gentlemen, Here Comes Treble!

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [vocalizing]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: They said they were done with the investing and then you volunteered ten thousand dollars?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, no, I had to. Look, I needed to look like a team player, Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: So you invested ten thousand dollars to look like a team player?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You weren't there.

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [singing 'I'll Be']

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It was very clear that ten thousand was what we had…we should talk about it later.

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [singing 'I'll Be' directly to Pam]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Talk about it now.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Jim, that was most of our savings.

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [still singing]

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Wait! Wait. Hold on. Where's the band? 'Cause there's just no way you guys are making this magic with just your mouths.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Yeah. That's what she said.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: What, am I overdoing it? No. No.

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [singing]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We said some. We said 'some.'

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: We'll talk about it later.

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [singing]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: We said part not all.

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [singing 'Car Wash']

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Yes! All right!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Oh Man! [clapping]

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: That's how you do that! Whoo!

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Show some pride. This is crap.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I agree. Yes, crap. Continue.
