scenes.line: Now folks, by special request, we're going to take it a little old school. There is a former Trebler in this room.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Who?

scenes.speaker: HCT Member #3
scenes.line: It's Mr. Andy Bernard!

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: [clapping]

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [singing 'Faith']

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No. Do not sing that. Do not… Oh man…

scenes.speaker: HCT Member #3
scenes.line: He reminded us today of how much he means to us. And we certainly seem to mean a lot to him, so without any further ado, here's an old Treble classic.

scenes.speaker: HCT
scenes.line: [singing 'Faith']

scenes.speaker: Broccoli Rob
scenes.line: [on flat screen tv] [singing lead of Faith]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Whoa! Whoa! What the hell is Broccoli Rob doing here?

scenes.speaker: HCT Member #3
scenes.line: She said you wanted to hear 'Faith'. That's Broccoli Rob's signature song.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: That's my signature song.

scenes.speaker: HCT Member #3
scenes.line: I really didn't know that man. I just thought you wanted to hear it.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Russell, I'm dressed like George Michael.

scenes.speaker: HCT Member #3
scenes.line: I thought you were Adam Lambert.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Wha…?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: The more I hear about all this a capella drama, the more I think it's kind of pathetic. But when you're with someone, you put up with the stuff that makes you lose respect for them, and that is love.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Are you okay?

scenes.speaker: Broccoli Rob
scenes.line: [on screen] He's still mad.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Shut up, Broccoli.

scenes.speaker: Broccoli Rob
scenes.line: Champ, I feel awful about this whole thing. Russell called me up. And they said they needed 20 cc's of George Michael stat. So just… Wham! I sprang into action. You know me. I assumed you wanted to hear me do your signature number.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: You thought I wanted to sit in the audience like some slutty Treb rat? A man's signature solo is his for life, okay? That's group policy and you know it.

scenes.speaker: Broccoli Rob
scenes.line: Look, it's not my fault that I still live near campus, and it's my duty as an alum to be friendly to the young guys., and stop in two, three times a week.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Just don't do the song anymore.

scenes.speaker: Broccoli Rob
scenes.line: I tell you what, we'll have a sing-off for it. You pick twelve alums from any year to back you up and I'll do the same, and I'm so confident that I'll win, I won't even warm up.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Fine, go ahead. Thrash your pipes.

scenes.speaker: Broccoli Rob
scenes.line: My pipes are primo, Champ. Why don't you ask Trey Anastasio about my pipes?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I knew you would go there, you son of a bitch!

scenes.speaker: Broccoli Rob
scenes.line: He said, and I quote, 'Hey Rob, nice pipes'. That happened!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: OK, fine, yeah. that's one guy's opinion!

scenes.speaker: Broccoli Rob
scenes.line: That's real. 'That'll never change!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Okay!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Doesn't mean you're the best singer ever. Dick.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I thought that concert was pretty great.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh yeah. I decided that acapelca music is awesome.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: They lost me when they sang 'Monster Mash'. That song obviously glorifies the occult.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Angela, it's Halloween. You have to sing 'Monster Mash'.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh you have to Jim? You literally have to?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No I'm just, I'm saying, what would happen if they didn't sing it? Would they go to jail? Would they be shot?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. We'll, just forget it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No! No, I'm interested. I mean I think everybody's interested in why they have to sing it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Because it is Halloween. So if you're going to sing a concert, it's a good idea to throw that one in.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yeah, yeah, no, no. It's a good idea to brush your teeth. But you have to um, feed your children. Send them to school. You know, all things you can't do if you just keep singing 'Monster Mash.'

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: It turns out, that Pam? Really, really hates 'Monster Mash.' I mean like, never bring that song up in front of her. Even though Jim was making great points, like, in favor of the song, Pam was like, No! Hate it! Stupid!

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: This is all so silly right? What am I gonna do? Move back to Cornell?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [laughing] Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: I mean, what if we did that? Like we got jobs and we were happy all the time?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh well, Andy, we're not moving to Cornell.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Duh. I know. That would be insane.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: It could totally work though. I don't know why we wouldn't. Oh my god are we doing this?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oy. Andy, what's going on?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: If I am not Boner Champ, I don't know who I am.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Well, um, you know maybe you're the wise old guy that the new uh, B-O-N-E-R champ looks up to. You know, you could just–

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Make a donation.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Well, I was gonna say, be a mentor.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yes. I am gonna make a donation. And it just so happens that I know someone who works at the Bernard Family Foundation. Her name is mom.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [whispEring] I want some of those pills.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, well good for you. I mean, you'll need a prescription.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, no. No, no, no. no. They're not for me. They're for my cousin Mose. He's just having a tough time, being wifeless, and a high pressure job and his crazy cousin Mose. Other cousin Mose.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Mm. Got it. Well, you tell Mose that he's a good man and that I hope he feels better.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Which one? Mose or the real Mose?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: The real Mose.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: He says Thank you.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: [on phone] Mom, I had this really charitable idea to set up this scholarship for a capella kids at Cornell and just need to wire some money over there. [pause] What?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: What's wrong?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: My parents are broke.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [to camera crew] Can you guys come with me for a minute?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I know you saw me with the Senator. I think I'm in love, possibly for the first time. So yes, Senator Lipton and I are having an affair. I hope that I can count on your sensitivity, maturity and discretion. [turns to see Kevin has overheard him]…Why?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Alright, good. Yeah. Just sell it and get the best price you can, okay?

scenes.speaker: White
scenes.line: Or we can hope for a holiday rally?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: White, I'm not a day trader, I'm just a first responder in a disaster.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Andy's family had a total meltdown. His dad blew through all their money and took off to Argentina with a younger woman.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And his brother, Walt Jr., locked himself in the wine cellar.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: The weirdest part is Andy. The aftermath got dumped on him and the way he's been handling it is just…so…

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Competent.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Right?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Are the 'Nard's hurting? Yeah, you bet. Got kicked pretty hard. Family shattered, super sad. But, I'm kinda crushing it in the damage control department. So, that's cool. I wish my dad could see me now. Of course he caused this whole mess, so, [bleep] him.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Kevin, listen to me. I'm in love with the Senator. And I need time to sort this out in a responsible matter so I need your help in keeping it a secret because this means the world to me. Ok?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: That's beautiful. No, I totally get that.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Can you do this, Kevin?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I really want to. Whatever happens, always remember that.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I don't know what that means. Hey, hey-

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [On phone] Oh, great! Yeah, um, I'll get right back to you. [hangs up] Hey guys! Anyone ever heard of Iris Black on the radio?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Yeah, she hosts the Dr. Laura Show.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Nope, that's Dr. Laura. Well, her show Biz Whiz wants someone from Dunder Mifflin to come on the air today. Does anybody feel particularly passionate about local business issues? [Dwight raises hand]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I do! I do. I do. I do. I do.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: The media can make you famous. And do you have any idea how easy it is to sell something when you're famous? [Pretends to be on phone] "Uh, yeah wow. 10 reams of 40 pound bond at only $690 after discount? Um, whatever you say, Brad Pitt." It's that easy.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Hey, so that good looking single brother of yours? Heard he's on a downward spiral with booze.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yeah. He's in rehab actually.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Which place? The one right near Philly? I could be there in an hour.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: No, it's in New Mexico.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Oh…So…- how are you holding up?

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: We're done Meredith.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [wagging tongue for voice exercises] blah blah blah, rat tat tat tittle tattled and prattled on about the little metal bottle, she spat a bit of spittle…[Group protests]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Dwight!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: …In a bitter battle…Hey, hey! Stop questioning my methods, OK? I was chosen for this task for a very good reason.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, you chose yourself.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [walking away] Tricky siskel spat a bit of wicked biscuit…

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Alright, guys. A lot of assets here that my dad couldn't steal. Now, first of all, there is the family boat. 43 foot Tartan Sloop. My lawyer has lined up a buyer in the Bahamas, the sale would cover the cost of a condo and living expenses for my mom.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Sounds great.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Perfect.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Totally, except it is a no go. This boat was the heart and soul of the family. So…what else we got? Non-boat ideas. [Oscar looks outside conference room at Kevin and Angela at the copier]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: What happened?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Jammed. This day couldn't get worse. [Kevin laughs]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah, I think this day could get worse.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: What does that mean?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Kevin!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [to Angela] I don't know what you're talking about. [Thumbs up Oscar]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: She could get like sixty packages of Ramen noodles for five bucks. She could eat for a month.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Alright, what's the grand total? Did we make our nut?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: If we sell everything but the boat, your mom should be set for about six months.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Guys, you don't understand, this boat's been in our family since before I was born.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Don't you guys have that place where you used to spend your summers and have all those memories?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I worked at a Jiffy Lube.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: See? I bet you wouldn't sell that Jiffy Lube for all the money in the world. Would you Darryl?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I would if I owned it and I went broke.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Alright, uh…alright. I'm gonna tell the lawyer to pull the trigger on the boat.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Yes the boat means everything to my family, but we need the money. Got the memories, don't need the boat. Can't cry about it. What are you gonna do? Cry about it? [chokes up] Excuse me.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [On phone] Oh, OK. No problem. Thanks. Hey guys, WPTU called. The interview's off. They're opening a new cupcake store at the Steamtown Mall and Iris wants to cover that, so…

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Well why don't I go and tell Dwight so he can stop being such a complete nipple.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: He's gonna be disappointed.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes. He is. And you know what? We cannot let that happen.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Fax?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh yeah, just. Watermelon teeth. This isn't how I would cheer up just anyone. But, it's a girlfriend's job to know her man and I know Andy. [laughs] He's seriously juvenile.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Cool. He's like 40 though, right?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh no, he couldn't be more than late thirty's. Tops.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Awesome. Have fun.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Vroom! Dunder Mifflin. Dunder Mifflin. Good. Sounds- [phone rings in break room, Dwight picks up] This is Dwight Shrute.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [on other end in conference room] Please hold for Ms. Black.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [Darryl plays radio show music on keyboard] And welcome back to Biz Whiz. I'm Iris Black. On the line we have Dunder Mifflin's senior sales associate Dwight Shrute.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Iris, thank you so much for having me.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [muffled by watermelon teeth] Hey! My teeth are all this stuff in my mouth. [laughs]

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Uh, did you need something?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, I just need your signature on this.

scenes.speaker: Andy
scenes.line: Ok. [signs paper] thanks.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Kevin, we're out of 11-38 forms. Did you order more?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I… did not.

scenes.speaker: Angela
