scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No matter! Belsnickel cares not about this–off with you!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Perfect. Merry Christmas, everybody.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wait, wait, wait, wait! Don't you want to know your present?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You know what? Yeah. Have at it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jim Halpert. Cheer or fear? Belsnickel is here! [Jim holds his hands like a bowl] I judge your year as impish. [Hits Jim with stick]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ooh! Are you nuts?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Hits Jim three more times] I judge you impish!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ow! Ow! Okay, that is three, and you didn't hit anybody that hard.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: They're not abandoning the party. [Hit's Jim again]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Just–Just–Hey!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [As he's walking out] That's enough, I'm done! Okay? Agh!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Hits Jim some more] Impish! [Chases Jim out]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Aah! Ow!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Belsnickel, I gotta run out early too. [Leans up against the wall as Dwight comes back in]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [In the parking lot, holding his side, walking to the taxi, Pam follows] Oh…what was that? Now I'm gonna be all whipped for my first day at work. God. [To taxi driver] One second. Oh…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well…this is it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'm probably never gonna see you again.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Shut up. I'm trying to be serious.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, sorry, sorry.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I can't believe this is actually happening.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Listen, thank you so much for putting that all together. That was the perfect last Christmas party. All right, wish me luck.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay. [Jim and Pam hug] Good luck. You're gonna be great.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I'll call you when I get in.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Love you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Love you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What's going on?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Party's over. You quit on Christmas, Christmas quits on you. [To camera] And guess what, kids. Belsnickel isn't real. It's me, Dwight! [Takes off hat and beard]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: We found some old decorations in the warehouse. Oscar ran to the store for some food and drink, and I dipped into my stash of eggnog. I guess they needed me after all. It's like in it's a wonderful life when Jimmy Stewart realizes that all thos people at the building and loan were just jerks, and he was the real hero.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Kevin. Kevin! Aaah. Stop it!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, it sounds like the party's starting up out there.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Yeah. So anyway, the entire jury wants me to vote guilty. But then I did a little research of my own, and forget everything you thought you knew about fingerprinting.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Meredith's a little cute. I'm just realizing. She got, like, a Emma Stone thing.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [At Meredtith] Boo!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: For what it's worth, I liked your party better.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Everyone thought the food was gross, and that belsnickel was some darkly erotic freak.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I don't think anyone thought that.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Jim couldn't even stay till the end of the party.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, that didn't have anything to do with you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I don't care. Guess how much I care on a scale of one to ten.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Zero.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Damn It!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I'm gonna tell Jim to go [Bleep] himself.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Do you think Andy would ever jump off an exploding building tied to a hose for me?

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Yeah. Definitely. [Erin starts to cry] Hey, what's–Oh, no, come here. [Starts to put his arm around Erin] Hey, hey. Come on, huh?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [Sliding away from Pete] I'm still Andy's girlfriend.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Oh, yeah, of course. I know.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: But you can leave your arm.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dwight, want me to get you some eggnog?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No, thanks. I'll just have another dumatril. Jim taught me this really cool way to take it. You crush it into a powder, and you snort it up your butt.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Walks back into The Office] Yep, I did say that.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Jim!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What's going on? Where's the belsnickel?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh–Oh my god!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What are you doing? Last time I saw you, you were whipping me out of the building.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Holds his finger to Jim's lips] Shh. Let's not speak of that. The Pig Rib! We could totally break the pig rib! I'm gonna dig it out of the trash! [High fives Jim]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What happened? Did you miss your bus?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No. I just missed my wife.[Gives Pam a hug and a kiss]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Comes back in, holding up the pig rib] I found it!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And I found out that there's a bus at 5:00 a.m.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh! [Pig rib breaks and Jim wins, and stuff splatters people. Everyone groans] Damn It! Jim got the bigger half.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [To himself] Back for more, huh? [Gets up and walks towards Jim]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ooh, nog it. Let me get some nog. [Everyone talking Phyllis pours Jim some eggnog, as Daryl walks in] Thanks, Phyllis. Where's Andy?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: You!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, hey, man. [Daryl walks over to Jim, angrily and stares at Jim] Oh, you know what? Before I forget again, I talked to the guys about hiring you. They're gonna bring you in for an interview.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [Looking at Jim confused] That's great.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Thanks, man.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, of course.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I shall come by at your convenience.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thank you, sir. [Tips his glass to Daryl]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [Claps his hands once, spins around] Whoo!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Go get 'em.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [Falls backwards onto the food table] Oh! Whoa!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Very impish.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Two dimes, seven nickels–Well, okay, no, that doesn't add up. It was one quarter and–

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Shh. [Puts her finger to Toby's lips]

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: What? I was just explaining–

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Shh.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Why wouldn't it–

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: [Put her finger to his lips again] Shh.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: But why?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: No…more…talking.

scenes.speaker: Toby
scenes.line: Are you gonna kiss me?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Yes. [Kisses Toby]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: To me, the Sixers are a five seed tops.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think they're going to the conference finals.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Bynum, obvious monster and the three point shooting, don't even-… [Jim bites his lip]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I bit my lip at lunch today.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Sucks. Anyway, I just don't see it. The Knicks are tough.The Nets are tough.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Oh, the Nets are super tough. [Jim in pain from his lip]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Now I have this big bump in my lip that hurts. I hate it.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: The Hawks are terrible. They're always terrible.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, you need to think about it before you come with the… [Jim bites his lip again and pounds on table]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Whatever. It's not a big deal. You know I always tell my three year old, if this is the worst thing that's gonna happen…[Jim bites his lip again] You gotta be kidding me! Ok! Pam! That's it, I'm going home!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Good morning, Meredith.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, sorry, Pam. Yikes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Jim's been spending a few days a week in Philly and I'm not gonna lie, it's been challenging. Yesterday, things took a turn for the worse. I found out Cece has lice. So I was up all night disinfecting every sheet, towel, toy, item of clothing in the entire house. I'm exhausted. But don't tell Jim. He has a huge meeting today, under a lot of pressure and he's doing it all for the family.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I am meeting Dr. J today, otherwise known as Julius Irving, famed 76er and my own personal hero. But i have to be careful not to rub it in Pam's face because let's be honest, how would I feel if I was at home stuck with the kids while she was go carting with John Stamos.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [talking on phone] You sound tired. Everything ok?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Great. Everything's great. Hey are you nervous about your big meeting?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uhh, a little bit. It's a lot of pressure, you know, but that's what I signed up for right?

scenes.speaker: Worker
scenes.line: Jim, limo's here.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Uh, you know what, I gotta hop off because my, uh, taxi is here to take me to the meeting.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, call me later!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Ok

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Good luck!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thanks!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Love you.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Love you too. Bye.

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: How you doing?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Alright. I mean, it's what you want, so…

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: It's how it has to be.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I know, I know. It's just hard.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Me and Val were going nowhere and if I'm gonna be working in Philly, I'm gonna need my freedom. So, I convinced Val to breakup with me. Here's how you do it. You say, "What are you gonna do, breakup with me?" Like it's a joke, and then you gain a lot of weight.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I'll never be sorry, not for a moment of it.

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: Me neither. Come here. [she hugs Darryl, and Darryl smiles behind her back]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey Meredith, I need your supplier requests today.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Jeez H. in the morning. Will you stop your nagging already? No wonder Jim left you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: He didn't leave me. He just went part time. [Meredith scratches her head vigorously] Can you just fill out the form please?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm sure she's just confused. People scratch their heads when they're confused. Not always like an ape, the way Meredith just did, but it happens.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Hurry up already.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [checking Meredith's head] Trust me, I know what I'm doing. Between the foster homes and the orphanage, I had lice 22 times.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Holy wow, that's a big one. Alright, pencils down everyone, we got lice!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh God, Meredith, lice? Did you not sign a pledge to shower?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What? Lice? Oh my god. Lock the doors, we are on full quarantine.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Dwight, relax. It's just lice. Maybe, possibly.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Just lice Pam?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Of all of the vermin in God's great green kingdom, lice are the ones I detest the most. My first day of school, I had lice, and no one would play with me. For 15 years, they called me freak and four eyes and sci-fi nerd and girl puncher. All because I had lice when I was 7.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Make way, nope, inspect me.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, this is the cleanest scalp I've ever seen. You are all clear.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Should be. I use lice shampoo every morning. [Dwight starts spraying everyone with disinfectant]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Stop that!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Dwight!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Next!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [getting her head checked] Geez Meredith, you know, this is an office not one of your bean bag orgies.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Alright, let's give her a break. We don't know for sure this is Meredith's fault.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Pam, really? Come on.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Hey, what do you want? I know who I am. Nobody's taken Meredith Palmer to the opera to meet the queen.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Lice. More lice. [Angela shrieks in disgust] Angela has lice.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Ew! Oh.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [checking Stanley's head] Ooh yabber, lice!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [checking Pam's head] Yikers, lice.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No! How? I'm so clean!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [checking Oscar's head] Oh yeah, big time lice.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I wash my hands at least six times a day. Toilet seat covers? Yes, thank you, even when I pee. Apparently, none of that is protection enough. Not when it comes to Meredith.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What are you wearing?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It's a Hazmat suit. That stands for hazaderous materials men's suit wearing. If you rent more than four times a year, it just makes sense to buy. Is there anyone else here that is lice free? [Phyllis, Kevin, Darryl. and Nellie raise their hands] Excellent. Do you have your own hazmat suits?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Renters. Ok, I'm gonna need you to gather your belongings, retreat to the warehouse, conduct your business there until the infected have been deloused. Let's get going. I'm gonna stay here and fight. If you don't hear from me by lunch, call me. I might want lunch.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Alright, we're going down to my warehouse, that means we're playing by my rules. No messing with the baler and be cool in front of me and Val. We just broke up.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: You got dumped?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah, she ended things.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Breakups are the worst. The only thing that got me through mine are large amounts of shepard's pie and Brandy. The singer, not the drink.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Here man. [Kevin hands Daryll some chocolate] You need that more than me.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Thanks, man.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah [kisses Darryl on the cheek]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Guys, I think we should all ease up on Meredith. This has got to be hard for her.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh, no no no no no. I have not yet begun to shame.

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: That's it. I'm getting my stuff. I'm leaving for the day.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: No! Stanley! If you leave now then you'll get it in your car and then you'll get it in your house! [Erin jumps on Stanley's back]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Get off me!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I'm trying to save you from yourself!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Alright, I'll stay! There's a pencil broken in my rolls.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Maybe it was Meredith. Maybe she brought in lice that are totally different than the lice that i got from Cece. So let's not jump to the simplest conclusion that she got her lice from me. That is how wars get started. Fine, I'll tell her it was me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh man, that's fresh squeezed. And, uh are all the snacks complimentary?

scenes.speaker: Limo Driver
scenes.line: Yeah, take some home if you want.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh no, no, no. That's ok. [Jim shoves some snacks in his pocket as he gets out of limo] Um I'm sorry, is this the conference center?

scenes.speaker: Limo Driver
scenes.line: No, Mr. Irving called. Said he'd rather meet you at his private court.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You gotta be kidding me.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, Meredith I need to tell you something.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [shaving her own head] Yes, Pam what do you want?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh my God, Meredith what are you doing!?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Baking a cake, what does it look like I'm doing? Getting rid of the lice.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh stop! I am so sorry!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Oh, can you hold that thought? That's my wax. You know, I think these critters migrated from down south. What were you saying?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Nothing.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I am going to tell her, but now is clearly not the time. I will buy her a wig, we'll have a few laughs. There's a right way to do this.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Scalp leeches, skull vampires, follicle gypsies, hair lawyers. One thing is clear, it's kill or be killed!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: No, no. It's more of a nuisance really. It's not that big a deal. So, I collected your hats and your coats…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: To be burned!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: To be washed.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: What do we do about our heads?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I'm not gonna lie. Lye!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: No, all we need is mayonnaise.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Excuse me?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: She's right, it works. I would imagine.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Yes, it helps to suffrocate the little buddies and it's a really healthy alternative to the chemicals found in most lice shampoos.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I can appreciate that. I also only eat local, organic produce.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [walks in conference room] Shaboom! How do you like me now!?

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Wow.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Take a picture. It will last longer.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: We don't want it to last longer. It's horrible.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Bald people make me sick.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Yeah, yeah, everybody pile on Meredith. But I'm the only one with the balls to show them lice who's boss.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Ok, nobody panic. If everybody just follows my instructions, then nobody else needs to end up bald. Not that it looks bad, Meredith. It looks…It looks awesome. You look like a baby who suddenly aged 50 years. A cute baby, but something sucked the life force out of it. I'm so sorry. We need mayonnaise! We need it now.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh! Uh, uh I'll go.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Okay. Oh, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You're a saint, Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, no, it's not a big deal, please. No. Um, Meredith can I get you something special while I'm at the store, candy, or…or one of those stylish turbans?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Thanks Pam! I'll take a pack of Nicorette gum and a pack of Kools.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Let's talk pubes, people.

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: Hey, Darryl.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Oh, hey Val.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, that was tragic, Oh, that was like a car crash. I couldn't look away. You two clearly still have feelings for each other.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What's gonna make you feel better, big guy?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: When I was a kid, my grandmother used to make me chocolate cake when I wasn't feeling good. She's not around to do that anymore. I'm sorry, I just need a moment to myself just to clear my head.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Aw, poor Darryl. I can't bear to see him suffer like this.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I think he needs some hugs, and maybe some chocolate cake.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Mmm, this won't help him, it's a muffin, not cake.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Listen, let's try and get Darryl the one thing in the world he clearly wants and needs the most.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: An Escalade.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Or what's her name.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Val.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Let's get Darryl Val.

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: I hope you don't mind me bringing you out here. I can't get my knees under a desk.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Are you kidding me? I can literally scalp tickets to this.

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: Well, do you think you can sink one from deep?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Listen, I don't mean to intimidate you, but I did play a little high school ball.

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: Okay. [Jim shoots the basket and it goes in] Wow, Halpert's got game.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Alright. [Jim's phone rings] Oh, sorry. I'm so sorry. It's my wife, can I take this?

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: It's your wife? You better take it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Right! [Jim laughs as he answers the phone] Hey, what's up? Everything ok?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, no everything's great! Um, I was just calling to see how the meeting went.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's still happening right now actually, so uh…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: He's really making you work for it, huh?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yes, it is very stressful. You sure everything's okay?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Great. I am killing it over here. [drops mayonnaise on the ground] Jim, I gotta go.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, bye. [Jim turns back to Julius] So sorry about that.

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: No problem. Hey Jim, what size do you wear, man? I got a pair of japanese Nikes with your name on them. What do you think?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I love it.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: [handing out mayonnaise jars] Once it's all over your head, just leavr it there for four hours. That will be enough time for the lice to fall asleep, suffrocate, and then pass away.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh sure, and when you're ready to get serious, come to me to get it done right. [Dwight holds up a pair of scissors]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Put those away before you hurt yourself.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [swings the scissors around and puts them into his pocket, putting a hole in his Hazmat suit] Oh God, oh no. No. No. No! No! No! No! No!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Okay, it's easier with a buddy, so everybody pair up.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oscar, do you want to be my partner?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Yeah, yeah, sure. I'd love to…

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Hey, uh, mayo buddy, five dollar tip, you unclog my ears. Okay?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, Creed, I'm so sorry. I'm…I'm already partners with Pete, right Pete?

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Uh, yeah. We promised each other if we ever got lice, we'd buddy up. Sorry, man.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, Creed, wanna be my buddy?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: Oh God. Stuck with the weirdo.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [Angela is slapping mayo on Oscar's head] Angela.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: You don't want bugs. You know? Who knows where those bugs will end up?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [putting mayo on Stanley's head] You're getting a bargain. I ain't got no hair no more.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [putting mayo on Creed's head] Creed, I'm all done. My turn.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I'm sorry, Pam. It looks a little messy.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, wait.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: [putting mayo on Erin's head] How's that?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I feel it working. [Erin and Pete playing around with the mayo] Eiffel tower!

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: Can I help you?

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Well, we don't want to pry but we heard you broke up with Darryl.

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: Yeah, that's true.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: We think you made a big, big mistake.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Big mistake.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Quite enormous.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: He's a real catch and you should take him back.

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: Ok, thank you. Is that all?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: No. No, that is not all. Let me tell you what real life is like. The men dry up, and the nights get lonely. The only calls on your machine are for collection agencies about that pair of motorcycle boots you never even wore. You stalk your old high school boyfriend online, go to his daughter's soccer games, and make a scene. You buy a diamond ring for yourself, wear it on your right hand, and tell yourself, you're all you need. One day, you're alone, tired. At your feet, a dying bird. But where did it come from? Why did you kill it? Is it because in some strange way it is you?

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: Thank you all for your concern, but I'm gonna have to ask you to leave, okay?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: So does this mean you're gonna take Darryl back?

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: No.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Well, then, what do you say to you and me hitting the town? 'Cause I'm free, literally forever.

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: Yeah, Kevin asked me out. I was kinda feeling good about reentEring the dating pool, but then Kevin asked me out. Thought I might trade up to a new level of man. Then Kevin asked me out.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [phone rings] Hello?

scenes.speaker: Helene
scenes.line: [on speaker phone] Hi, honey, it's mom. Look, Cece's school just called. She still has lice.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What, no. That can't…I don't…

scenes.speaker: Helene
scenes.line: Now, don't worry, don't worry. I'm on my way to pick her up, but you might have lice too. You know, lice can be tricky. Sometimes lice, like…[Pam hangs up phone]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh my God.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Shave her head. Shave her head!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [everyone yelling at Pam] You guys, I am so sorry! It's just been so chaotic with Jim gone, that…

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Yeah yeah, Princess Fancypants let Jane 12-pack over here take the fall.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [talking through the loud speaker] She's right Pam.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Is there a volume knob on that thing?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah there's a volume knob on that thing.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Meredith, I am so sorry.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Well, a lot of good your sorrys are doing her now, Pam. She's a monster.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I meant to say something earlier. I just…

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Just? Just what? Just forgot?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Who's the one who didn't bring lice into the office? Meredith. Sure I gave everybody pink eye once, and my ex keyed a few of their cars, and yeah I BMed in the shredder on New Years. But I didn't bring the lice in. That was all Pam.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Attention, people of the office. You have exactly 60 secondes to evacutate the bull pen. At that time, I will be tossing this powerful insecticidal grenade, which contains piperonyl butoxide, as well as…[Dwight drops the grenade and it goes off inside Andy's office]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Dwight, are you okay!?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Whoa. Hypertoxide has a mild hallucigenic effect, but I don't think it's kicked in yet. I'm gonna count down from ten. Nine, yellow, cold, sad, purple. [Dwight collapses]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Wow. He got to purple.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [Angela rinsing Oscar's hair, and she bumps his head] Ow!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Sorry.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You're waterboarding me!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oops.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: [shoving large amounts of bubble wrap into the baler, as a warehouse worker passes] No, this is fine. We are allowed to do this. This is okay.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You're up.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Yeah, I'm kinda sad to see this baby go.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You do kinda look like Elvis, but we should probably wash all the dead lice out.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Okay. Okay. [rinsing Pete's hair out] Is that too cold?

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: No, it actually feels kinda nice.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I wonder what happened over there. I've been sitting here the whole time. [as the baler crushes the bubble wrap, making loud noises]

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Huh?

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: Let's give it a shot. Let's make it work.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Oh, no. I mean, I want to, I just…I don't want to force you into something you don't want to do.

scenes.speaker: Val
scenes.line: You're not. I believe in us.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: But… [Val kisses Darryl]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I'm back together with Val. Yay…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I had a pretty good day today. Not everything went exactly according to plan, but lice if you are watching, I am ready for you anytime, anywhere. [Dwight gets into his car and another insecticidal grenade goes off]

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Hey, did Erin already take off?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: I guess so.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: You're Kareem, coming to help.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, I'm Kareem. That makes total sense. I'm Kareem. You're Dr. J. Just sounds weird to say out loud.

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: And it went like this. [Jim's phone starts ringing]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And that's all?

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: That's it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No one will believe this back home, but that's okay. Let me show you how it's done.

scenes.speaker: Julius
scenes.line: Yeah, you show me how.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [Jim's phone goes to voicemail] This is Jim Halpert, leave a message.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey honey, it's me. Just trying to catch you before going home. Um, oh, well just give me a call whenever. Hope your day got better. Love you.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Hey, what you doing right now?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I'm just gonna go home. My mom's been watching the kids all day.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Let her stay another hour. Let's go get a beer.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Really? A beer sounds incredible right now.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: No duh. Let's go. You're buying.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Meredith, I am so sorry about today.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Forget about it.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I just did not realize how hard it was gonna be without Jim. I mean, I really respect you for being a single mom all these years. It whipped my ass in half a week. I have to say, there are not a lot of people who could pull off a shaved head, but you are rocking it.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Right. I got the bartender's phone number when you were in the john. I'm gonna take that freak to bone town before the night is over.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Get it, girl!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [Pam and Meredith singing karaoke] This one's for all you ladies out there.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: [starts singing] I come…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Not yet.

scenes.speaker: Both
scenes.line: [singing] I come home in the middle of the night. My mother says when you gonna live your life right? Oh Mother dear, we're not the fortunate ones. And girls, they want to have fun. Oh girls just want to have fun.

scenes.speaker: New Instant Message
scenes.line: Stone & Son Suit Warehouse contract expired with their paper provider! Go get it! –David Wallace

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Stone and Son Suit Warehouse recently lost their paper provider. They're a family owned business [chuckles]. Jim and I used to clean up at those. We'd go in pretending to be family – brothers. We did it at a family owned law firm, at a family owned construction company, and a family owned motorcycle store. Jim and Dwight Shrupert. I was the dynamic, likeable winner that was doted upon by Mom. And Jim was the closeted foot fetishist pretending to belong. The client never knew any of that, but I knew.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [on phone with Jim] I hope you've been paying your wig storage bills Jimbo, because it's time for another episode of "Handsome and Stinky, paper brothers for hire".

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Sorry, Stinky, can't do it. Too busy.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, god, this again? You're Stinky.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. There's no possible way I can get there, so just ask Phyllis. She can be your older sister or something.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Phyllis, my sister? More like my dead great great grandmother who died of stupidity.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: I have ears, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh, do you really have ears, Phyllis? Like all human beings? We all have ears. [back to Jim] See what you leave me with here, Jim?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey, I'm in Philadelphia right now.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: How is that my problem? Get in your car and drive down here. You can make it in 30 minutes if you drive 240 miles per hour.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Huh. How long would it take me if I drove 300 miles an hour?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Mmm. That's a good… question. 300 times… [Jim hangs up] 180… Um that comes to 25 minutes. [realizes Jim hung up] Yes. Oh, well, thank you Jim. Yes, I am better than you. Thanks for acknowledging that. Okay, bye bye. Love you.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Darryl, looking good!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Heading to Philly. Interview with Jim's company.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, good luck. When you get to Philly, will you tell Jim I miss him?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Why don't you come along and tell him yourself?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Ha ha. That'd be great. Kind of like ditching school, except instead of getting suspended, you get… What do you get? Oh my god! Why didn't I think of this? Andy's not here. Oh, hey, Erin, um, I'm expecting a shipment of pens. Can you cover that?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Mhm. Cover that. What does that mean, exactly? What are we talking here? Details.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: A delivery guy will deliver a box of pens, and you just make sure everything's in order.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: What? Everything? What, how do I make sure it's in order? I [laughs] haven't been trained for this.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [giggles] Okay, see you later.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Hey guys.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Clark!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Hey!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Hey, look who's back, Dwight Junior.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Hey, so how was it? I mean… the sex with Jan.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: A gentleman doesn't discuss such matters. Especially when the feelings of a lady are involved.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Women reach their sexual peak at whatever age Jan was last week. I mean it was… like making love with a wild animal. But not like a cougar like you might think. It was uh… like a swarm of bees. Bees that just find something wrong with every hotel room.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Nothing wrong with being a gentleman. Like my mom used to say, "Talk classy, act nasty".

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: What's with the wig Meredith?

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: What, is it on backwards? [partially removes wig, revealing her bald head]

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Nope, you got it. You fixed it. Uh, I have a gift from Jan. It's an espresso maker! We came to be quite fond of espresso on the Amalfi Coast so… bon appetite.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Ooo! 16 types of espresso! Now that's Italian.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: My friend has one of these. Fool-proof espresso every time.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Always with the friends Oscar. Can't we just enjoy the new espresso machine?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Actually, it's pronounced "espresso"… Wait. That's what you said. I apologize, I just assumed you would mispronounce it. So…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: There he is! [chuckles] We are all so proud of you for the small part that you played in landing the white pages. Prouder of me, but…

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: If you really want to show appreciation, just give me half the commission.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Gosh, you know, I wish I could but, uh… No. Hey, listen, remember how everyone used to call you Dwight Junior and how much you loved that?

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: [sarcastically chuckling] I loved it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: How would you like to pretend to by my son in order to land a sale?

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: If it'll lead to me being a salesman, I'll pretend to be your friend.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Then looks like we have a deal… Son [holds up a suit identical to his]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Hi guys!

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Hey, look who it is!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Sorry. Super-busy. Pens coming in later, just grabbing a Java before all hell breaks loose.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Try this one. [handing Erin a cup of espresso]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Thank you! [leaves the room]

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: I don't really have time to think about Pete right now. I just have a lot going on with this whole shipment of pens. And I have a lot of people trusting me, and I would feel super guilty if I broke anyone's trust. About the pens.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You ready for your interview?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: I was born ready! No, I suck at interviews. I had Andy's job in the bag until my interview.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, you shouldn't be nervous about this. This is a tiny start-up with a bunch of guys just as dorky as Jim.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah, I guess…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Really, you can't be scared of a room full of Jims. I love the guy, but he's basically Gumby with hair. [Darryl laughs]

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Father
scenes.line: [chuckling] It's kind of funny, a father and son sales team meeting with a father and son suit store.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You know, you're right! We hadn't even thought of that, had we boy? [to Clark]

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: No, we sure hadn't Pop. [both chuckling]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [Takes picture from desk] Oh! You're a hunter I see. Spend your early mornings out in the blinds, like Clarky and me. Huh? [grabs Clark's shoulder]

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: He calls me Clarky 'cause he's my Dad.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Guilty!

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Father
scenes.line: You don't meet many hunters these days.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: My dad is the best hunter there is. I mean, he's like a serial killer… of animals. One time, he snuck up behind a sleeping deer and just sawed its head right of. It was sick! [Dwight imitates sawing and blood spurting out of his neck, then makes a dying noise]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: It was his birthday, just turned three. So…

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Father
scenes.line: Ahh…

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: You guys, I kind of think I want to try them all. Is that crazy?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: No. Look, without a taste test, how are we supposed to know which flavors we like to reorder?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Taste test? I'm in!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: YOLO! [singing and dancing]

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: What? [everyone is confused]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: It's a thing. It means "you only live once".

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah, we're aware of what it means Oscar, you just do not look cool saying it.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Well…

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Alright everybody, who's in? [everyone except Angela puts their hand in the middle of the group, like a huddle] Angela? [Angela shakes her head] Don't make us come over there.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: No, I don't… no.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Alright, let's go. [starts shuffling the whole group towards Angela]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Can't I just agree without putting my hand in?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Absolutely not!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: No way.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh, fine. [puts a napkin on top of everyone else's hands and reluctantly puts her own hand on the napkin]

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Ok guys, "we all drink them all".

scenes.speaker: Everyone
scenes.line: [Meredith, Phyllis, Nellie, Angela, Creed, Oscar, Stanley] We all drink them all!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Yes!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Whoo!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Hey, where's my ring?

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I'm sure it'll turn up.

scenes.speaker: Athlead Employee
scenes.line: [in the background] Yes ma'am, you want to go east on Franklin, take that all the way to Commonweath. You'll see us on the right side, you can't miss us.

scenes.speaker: Dennis
scenes.line: …And I want to reach every demographic possible.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: No, I hear what you're saying, and we will. The thing is, we gotta lock down this key demographic first. The rest will come, I promise. Just give me a couple weeks, alright?

scenes.speaker: Dennis
scenes.line: We're talking weeks here, not months, right?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Weeks. Always weeks. Man, the last time I talked months was like, a million weeks ago.

scenes.speaker: Dennis
scenes.line: Alright. Good.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Thanks Dennis, I appreciate it. [To Pam] Hey! How are you?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Good!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: What are you doing here?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I just wanted to see you!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: That's so great!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Damn! Jim, you got a real Facebook energy going on here man. You Zuckerberged this place out!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's pretty great, right? I mean, we're coming along… [to coworker] Hey, Wade, we gotta just push up Dennis's timeline

scenes.speaker: Wade
scenes.line: Okay

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [back to Pam] Actually, you know what? Give me one second, okay? Make yourselves at home.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: …But I think that all of your concerns will be answered when you see the brochure that Clark's getting out of my car. He's a good boy, does whatever I say.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Father
scenes.line: [sighs] I can't relate to that, my son hates my guts.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh… really.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Father
scenes.line: Bring him into the business, and he resents me. How do you like that?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [fumbling] Well, things between me and Clark are good, but not great. In fact, I will say that they're not even good. Really, they're bad. Like you and your son.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: [enters] Here you go, Pop! I know it was just a couple minutes, but… God I missed you!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What took you so long? Were you loitEring out there like a hooligan, smoking a doobie?

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: [confused] I sure was. Just like he taught me, looking cool.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You're being disrespectful!

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: …And I love you, for saying that.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [whispers to Clark] We don't get along.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: [catches on] Ha ha! I just burned him. Because the truth is… our relationship is… terr-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Terrible!

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Terrible.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes! Genius. Stupid, stupid genius!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Wow, this place is… so great. I had no idea – on the phone, you made it sound kind of dinky.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, I mean, I don't even have the paycheck yet. It is a startup, so… These things go down all the time.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: If this company's going down, I wanna go down on it. With it. I wanna go down with it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [to Pam] Are you cool to just hang out?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Sure, no problem.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah? [to Darryl] You ready?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Let's do it!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: The pen delivery went amazing, and now I've got all these pens just waiting to be unpacked. But Pam did not tell me to unpack the pens, and I'm not one of those people who's just like, "Uh, sure. I'll accept the pens when they come in, and then as soon as your back's turned, I unpack the pens and get all this credit as some great pen unpacker. On the other hand… they are just sitting here. Pam didn't tell me not to unpack them. Don't want to be a busybody, but I don't want to be a lazybones. Busybody, lazybones. Busybody, lazybones. Ahh! My brain is ping-ponging around in my head right now, it's insane! I'm sorry, what was your question again? Oh yeah, no. I've never had an espresso before. They're good though.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: A-bam! [slams espresso cup on table] My favorite is Viennese Amaretto. And the worst flavor I've tried so far is Alpine Select!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yes! [giggles and picks up Angela]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Ugh!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: One! [as he picks Angela up in the air]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Kevin! Kevin! Kevin!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Two… [picks Angela up again]

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Stop it!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Three…

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: That's enough Kevin.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Stop it Kevin!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Four!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: That's enough!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Kevin!

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: So for your menswear catalogue, I think we can offer you some very competitive pricing.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Father
scenes.line: I heard that before…

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Well, I understand, but –

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: I bet you have. He knows nothing about what people have heard before, my son.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Here we go again, another lecture from the old man.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Father
scenes.line: Listen to him. He created you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Maybe if you listened a little bit, you'd improve. No wonder women despise you.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Women don't despise me…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: His last girlfriend was a transvestite. I knew it right away. Adam's apple like the prow of a ship, thumbs like a lowland gorilla. Ha, but this one couldn't see it, or didn't wanna see it.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Alright, that's enough, 'cause I can say some things about him too.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah? Like what?

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Like the time that you got drunk and, and then… Killed those kids on their way to prom!

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That never happened. He's always been a liar. Ever since he was a little kid. He got caught "saving treats" from the kitty litter box.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Father
scenes.line: Really shameful…

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: So we can offer you matte or glossy printing-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Glistening brown morsels tumbling from every pouch in his trousers.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: There's obviously a volume discount uh, if you-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Following the cat around on his knees with his hands cupped beneath its tail, going "please kitty, may I have some more?" You can't make this stuff up!

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: No, I think someone could make it up. Someone with very few friends.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Son
scenes.line: Hey fellas, sorry to keep you waiting.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Father
scenes.line: Here he is, my son.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [scoffs] Got cat turd collector written all over him.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Son
scenes.line: …Did you say cat turd collector?

scenes.speaker: Athlead Employee
scenes.line: …So definitely looking to expand our market, but for now we're just concentrating on athletes that are popular here in the northeast. Of course, that's not a mandate.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: "Mandate"- Always think of two men on a date. [awkward moment] I have gay friends… I have one gay friend. [to Jim] Oscar?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Mm-hm

scenes.speaker: Athlead Employee
scenes.line: Alright, so what makes you think you'd be a good fit here?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: [freezes] Ummm… [a moment later] Alright. Obviously y'all look really busy, and uh, I don't want to waste your time anymore. Sorry, I just uhh… Obviously I'm not qualified to be here man, I'm… I'm a warehouse manager, you know…

scenes.speaker: Athlead Employee
scenes.line: Darryl, I was a newspaper editor.

scenes.speaker: Female Athlead Employee
scenes.line: Science teacher, volleyball coach.

scenes.speaker: 3rd Athlead Employee
scenes.line: I work at a home shopping network.

scenes.speaker: 4th Athlead Employee
scenes.line: I'm a laywer. I'm the only one here who can honestly help. [group chuckles]

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: And as you know, I was a paper salesman. [whispers to Darryl] Hey, I find it helps if you just picture everybody naked. [group overhears and chuckles]

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Cool. Hey, thanks…

scenes.speaker: Athlead Employee
scenes.line: So how about we start over, hmm? Darryl, do you have any thoughts on the company?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yes, as a matter of fact, I uh… [pulls booklets from his bag] I wrote some down. There you go. [passes out booklets] Wow, this guy came prepared, it impresses me! [group laughs]

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Ah! So, this is what 2:00 P.M. looks like around here!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: I usually take a siesta about now.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: [to Erin] Stocking pens, huh? You're like the new office administrator.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: No, I just took over the pen shipment because Pam had to leave. When I say it out loud, I know that sounds insane, but it's the truth, I swear.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Pam! Pam, look out! Erin's gunning for your job!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: No, I'm not! [Kevin imitates gunfire] It's not like that at all! Forget it, I'm so sorry.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Pam, look out!

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Pens, you did not buy into this. I am sorry, what a day you've had.

scenes.speaker: Athlead Employee
scenes.line: By the way, Jim talks about you all the time.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: That's sweet that he talks about me.

scenes.speaker: Athlead Employee
scenes.line: It's too bad he still hast to work part time in Scranton though…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, that's funny because I think of him as working part time in Philadelphia.

scenes.speaker: Athlead Employee
scenes.line: We can't wait until you move here.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Son
scenes.line: I'm sorry, you guys are here to sell us paper?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Do you mind? The men are talking.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Father
scenes.line: Sons used to idolize their fathers.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Us old timers need to stick together. And how better than by signing a contract?

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Father
scenes.line: I'd love to! Sam Junior here, he runs the business now. Kind of pushed me out, truth be told. I'm just here for human contract.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Son
scenes.line: Okay Pop…

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Wait, so you're the boss?

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Son
scenes.line: That's right.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Hi, I'm Clark.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Son
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Let's talk.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Son
scenes.line: Okay.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: So if you look at our catalog here…

scenes.speaker: Athlead Employee
scenes.line: Well, thanks for coming down Darryl.

scenes.speaker: Female Athlead Employee
scenes.line: It was nice meeting you Darryl, I think you'd fit in great here.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah, yeah me too. I think it'd be like… You know what? [grabs basketball] I think it'd be like a Kevin Durant jump shot… Perfecto! [shoots basketball at hoop on wall, basketball misses and lands in fish tank, killing the fish] Oh my god…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: They're the ones who put a fish tank next to a basketball hoop. It's like if I put a glass of milk on the edge of the table and Cece knocks it over, I don't blame Cece.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: So I'm like a three year old girl in this scenario…

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Say they don't hire you. It's not like you're out on the street. You have a great job with people who love you.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: And I'd only get to see Jada on the weekends. You know, I'm… I'm not so sure I'd like living in Philadelphia.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Right? Thank you! It's just Philly. Everyone's acting like it's New York or Paris or London.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Who needs it?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Not us.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [enters] Okay, so the consensus was that that was unique. They're going to make you pay for the fish, and… they wanted to know when you can start.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: What? [Jim shrugs] How about yesterday?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Congratulations.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Oh, thank you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I guess you gotta move to Philly after all.

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yes, I love Philly! Two-One-Five or die!

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: No, I'm not upset. I'm really excited for Darryl… Maybe I'm a little disappointed that we'll be losing him.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: It feels really hot in here. Is it hot in here? It feels really really hot in here.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: It's insane! They need to have the A.C. on year round! January too!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: [banging on window] I don't get the point of this stupid window!

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: I mean, look, you and I both know that in paper or fashion, styles change. Check out my dad's suit. You are looking at pure acrylic. That's why his face always breaks out.

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Son
scenes.line: Does that suit come with a fire extinguisher? [Clark chuckles]

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: You know what Dad? Maybe you should buy me a suit. I mean, I'm going to need one right? If I'm ever going to get a "real job" and move my "lazy ass" out of your "G.D. house".

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Son
scenes.line: He's got you there…

scenes.speaker: Suit Store Son
scenes.line: [to Clark in dressing room] That's Italian silk. Very comfortable. Very tasteful… Although expensive.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, you don't want Italian. You'll look like a mafia don. Next thing you know, you'll be doing life in Rikers Island.

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Well, that's better than looking like the undertaker from boring island.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: That place doesn't exist. It's not a documented island. Ha ha, cartograph much?

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: [emerges from dressing room wearing a sharp black suit] How do I look?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Actually… You look great. They steered you right. I guess it does make sense buying from a father son team. You know what? I'll take one too.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Everyone! Now that we have all this energy, why don't we move the copier into the annex like we've always wanted to?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Whoo!

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Frickin' A!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Huh?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: So long, noise!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: One, two, three! [all gather around copier and push, tearing carpet beneath]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: And we have torn up the carpet! Oh, we're going to be in so much trouble!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Wait! [looking at the hardwood floor beneath the carpet] It's beautiful. Hardwood! I always knew it was down here, I just never dreamed that I would actually see it.

scenes.speaker: Meredith
scenes.line: Tear up the carpet!

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Whoo!

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Kill their fish, and they still hire me. That's how you do that, baby. It's all good, I'm ready. Y'all ready for this? [sings intro to "Everybody dance now", points to Pam to sing first line]

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [reluctantly] Everybody dance now… [Darryl continues singing]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Kevin, move. I can't pull up the rug if you're standing on it with your rhinoceros feet.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Well I can't stand here if you pull the carpet out from under me.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Oh, my head is killing me. Does anyone have a baby asprin?

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, enough with the whining already! Why don't you just have some more coffee?

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: It's all gone. I didn't get a chance to try them all because Creed poured my Bogota Sunrise in the plant.

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: I saw the leaves twitch!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Shut up!

scenes.speaker: Creed
scenes.line: You shut up!

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Everybody shut up and work!

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: We don't work for you!

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Yeah!

scenes.speaker: Stanley
scenes.line: Hey, it's five o'clock. [everyone leaves and a traffic backup occurs in the parking lot]

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: [with horns honking] Kevin, can-

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: What's going on?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yes! We did it! [leaving the suit store]

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: You opened the door-

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: And you closed it. The boys are back in town. [high fives Clark] High fives! Ha ha!

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Hey, so all that really specific cat turd business, that was about you, right?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You got me! [tickles Clark and chuckles] I used to collect them!

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: Why?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Each one is very different, like a snowflake.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [shocked after seeing the torn up carpet] Hey… What happened here?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: You left me in charge of the pens, Pam. That's what happened. The pens happened.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: …Are the pens here?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Gotta clear out these file cabinets people, a lot of these are dead accounts. "Scranton Mimeograph Corp?" I don't think we're doing business with them any time soon. That's odd. A letter from Robert Dunder. "A valuable artifact has come into my possession. I have hidden it until such time as a person of strong intellect may safely recover it. This golden chalice is of immeasurable historical and religious significance." The Holy Grail.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [on phone]: Did you send Dwight on a quest for the Holy Grail?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I think I'm a little too busy these days to s— [whispEring] Oh ,my God. I did send Dwight on a quest for the Holy Grail.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: The Dunder Code! I completely forgot about that prank. That had to be like six or seven years ago. Stayed late every night for a month. Had a lot more free time back then.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: I don't get it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Aha! A lightbulb.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: A lightbul–

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: A lightbulb. Okay. Okay. [holding note over lamp] Invisible ink.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Whoa.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: "Higher than numbers go." The ceiling above accounting!

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: Dwight! Down, Dwight! Dwight!

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: [on phone]: Man, I wish I was there to see his face when he gets to the end …

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: …and finds the… fake grail? No grail?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: You don't remember?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I don't.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: An "X."

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Annex. It must open something in the annex.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Whoa.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: "Sedes introiti." Seat of entrance.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [shouts while cutting up seat cushion – gasps upon finding playing cards]

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: That's a flush.

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: [murmuring as Dwight holds up toy forklift]

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: The warehouse.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: [on phone to Jim] There's nothing down here.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Oh, I expected more from young Halpert.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Let's just forget it. Forget it. [warehouse worker dips donut into golden chalice]

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: So, how are we getting on with our grand social media initiative?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Well, we created a fake profile for a really cool guy named Derek McBlack.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Wow.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: It's just Pete in sunglasses.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: And then we had him "Like" Dunder Mifflin.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Then we created a bunch of fake friends for Derek, and we had all of them "Like" Derek's "Likes."

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: So far, we're only popular with imaginary people, but we think this is the start of something big.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: You two are geniuses. And I am a genius putting you two together.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: All right.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Pete and I work well together — not that there's anything special about Pete. It could be any guy… or girl– not that I'm into girls. Not that I'm into Pete. Ugh! What was the question?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey.

scenes.speaker: Co-worker
scenes.line: Hey Jim. Peter Rowley at Bridgeport Capital requested a meeting at lunch.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. Can we keep it on the early side, though? I got that thing in Scranton later.

scenes.speaker: Co-worker #2
scenes.line: Uh sure. No problem.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Cece's ballet recital is today. I cannot wait. I've been working with her on her move. It's called the Cece Spin and Kiss. Do you want to see it? It's kind of like this. It's pretty cute, right?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Pfft, "Athlead"? Please. They're too lazy to call it Athletes Lead? Jim should just call it "Stumpany," for "Stupid Company."

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Nothing stupid about working for yourself. Hanging out with pro athletes, getting free tickets to the games. That's why I'm doing it.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You're working for "Stumpany" too?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yeah, just weekends for now, but pretty soon, I'm switching over.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Yep.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [on phone] Hey, Halpert, what's the big idea? First you jump ship. Now you're stealing Darryl too. When will it end?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Well, take your worst fear and multiply it by infinity.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You won't stop until you've poached us all.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Yeah. Even you.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: No. I'll be damned if I'm gonna let us lose me.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Bye, Dwight.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hi. How are ya? Good to see you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, Angela? Did you hear about the Irish-American Cultural Center mural?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Ooh, I haven't heard it. So, what about the Irish-American Cultural Center mural? Potato?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Oh, no, Kevin, it's not a joke. Angela's husband put me up for a– um, just never mind.

scenes.speaker: Angela
scenes.line: I have no information. But I'm sure as soon as they know, they'll call you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Senator Lipton helped me submit my design for a new mural on a building downtown. Now I'm just waiting to hear from the selection committee. But, you know, let's be realistic. There are a ton of great artists in Scranton with way more experience. I mean, who are they gonna go with — some nobody like me or a big name like Tracy Fleeb?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Well, I'm heading out to Cece's dance recital.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: Aw.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, Cece, Daddy's gonna have dinner with us tonight after he comes to your recital. Are you excited?

scenes.speaker: Cece
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Let's call him.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Hey. I was just about to call you.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hey, Hon, are you close?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: I am still in Philly, actually.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: What?

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: It's insane. This huge investor got cold feet, so I'm stuck here trying to keep him on board.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Hon, I wish you would have told me an hour ago, when you knew you weren't gonna make it.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Pam, I couldn't get out. I barely made it out just to make this phone call.

scenes.speaker: Cece
scenes.line: I want Daddy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: You're gonna do great. And you know what? Mommy's gonna record it. So we'll watch it together. Do you mind doing that, Pam?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Of course.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay. Are you sure you know how to do video on the phone?

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: Yes, Jim, I think I know how to point a rectangle at something.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Okay, okay, you know, just sometimes you're not the best with the phone.

scenes.speaker: Pam
scenes.line: I know how to operate my phone, okay? Listen, we're getting close. We will talk to you later. Say, "Bye, Daddy."

scenes.speaker: Cece
scenes.line: Bye, Daddy.

scenes.speaker: Jim
scenes.line: Bye. [pause] Yep. See, you've still got to press "End," Pam.

scenes.speaker: Cece
scenes.line: Press "End."

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Oh, check it out. This is our first real "Like."

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Oh, my gosh!

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Oh! All right, Alan Olson from North Dakota. He also likes Hammermill and Georgia Pacific.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: Wow. That guy's really into paper.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Yeah.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Well done, you two.

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: We did it. Youth task force forever.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: Yes.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: [doing a series of hand bumps with Erin] Bap, bup, bup, bap. Wait. Did I go first and then you?

scenes.speaker: Erin
scenes.line: No, you go — okay.

scenes.speaker: Pete
scenes.line: All right, all right.Okay, start over.

scenes.speaker: Nellie
scenes.line: Oh, no, no, no, no. Oh God. Andy has just started to be nice to me, I just sent his girlfriend into the arms of a younger man. "Our social media presence should be hot, hot, hot. Go at it vigorously." I did everything but unzip their pants for them. Oh, God, Nellie.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Hey, everybody. Uh, coffee order is going around — on me. Just sign your name below.

scenes.speaker: All
scenes.line: [murmuring]

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: You're welcome.

scenes.speaker: Phyllis
scenes.line: Wait. This says "Dunder Mifflin Loyalty Pledge"?

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: This — uh, what? Double mocha latte, please? You got it. Just sign your name below. Whatever you want.

scenes.speaker: Oscar
scenes.line: "Loyalty pledge"?

scenes.speaker: Darryl
scenes.line: Come on, Dwight, stop overreacting. I'm getting all my work done here. No customers have complained. Nobody even knows.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Yeah, we'll see about that.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Bust out your complaint files. I need everything you've got on Darryl since he started working for Jim in the last few weeks. Break it down by keyword, okay? "Infuriating, irresponsible"…

scenes.speaker: Clark
scenes.line: They got us set up with Windows 95, so you're kind of dreaming here.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: Okay, I'm gonna need you to print it out.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
scenes.line: [writing on white board] Customer Loyalty. What is it? Can you hold it in your hand? Can you nudge it with your finger? Can you dump it on a woman? No. Why? Because it's an idea. But what does it mean?

scenes.speaker: Kevin
scenes.line: Ooh, it's when you get a free sandwich after you've already eaten ten sandwiches.

scenes.speaker: Dwight
